x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a ACM Report is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

APTransaction.title: AP Transaction
APTransaction.description: Accounts payable sub-ledger invoice recording vendor billing and payment obligation per REQ-AP-003. Posting (issued transition) materialises one balanced GLTransaction per T1 REQ-JE-007 (credit AP payable, debit expense per lines). Lifecycle: draft → received → issued → paid with partially-paid / overdue / disputed / written-off / voided branches per REQ-AP-004. The issued → overdue transition fires via OR ScheduledWorkflow (ADR-031 path 2 — no PHP cron job). Aged-payables aggregations (detail / summary / timeline) declared inline per REQ-AP-006 .. REQ-AP-008. Sub-ledger linkage: every GLLine emitted from issue or write-off carries subLedgerType=ap + subLedgerRef=<APTransaction UUID> (REQ-AP-001 scenario).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Bookkeeping sub-ledger register; every lifecycle transition (receive / issue / match / dispute / overdue / write-off / void) and every header/line edit is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022. Audit trail is the canonical evidence chain for the AP write-off scenario per REQ-AP-005.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Under construction. Lines and header fields may be edited.

received.label: Received
received.description: Vendor invoice physically received and recorded; awaiting approval/posting. Vendor invoice-number uniqueness already enforced.

issued.label: Issued
issued.description: Header immutable. Balanced GLTransaction materialised; awaiting payment match.

partially-paid.label: Partially paid
partially-paid.description: One or more bank-reconciliation matches applied; cumulative matched amount is less than totalAmount.

paid.label: Paid
paid.description: Full payment matched via bank-reconciliation engine. Terminal state for the happy path.

overdue.label: Overdue
overdue.description: today > dueDate and no full payment match yet. OR dunning-workflow drives REQ-AP-005 reminder cadence from this state.

disputed.label: Disputed
disputed.description: Operator placed payment-match pursuit on hold pending vendor-raised dispute investigation.

written-off.label: Written off
written-off.description: Vendor restant uncollectible / waived; compensating GL posting emitted per REQ-AP-005. Terminal state.

voided.label: Voided
voided.description: Issued invoice voided. The materialised issue GLTransaction MUST already be reversed per T1 REQ-GL-004.

receive.label: Receive invoice
receive.description: Operator records vendor invoice receipt. Guard: vendor invoice number unique per (administrationId, vendorId) per REQ-AP-003 scenario 2.
receive.x-adr-031-exception: Single-method guard pending OR's unique-key extension stabilisation. Documented per ADR-031 §'PHP guards remain a legitimate seam' and the spec's REQ-AP-005 fallback clause.

issue.label: Issue / post invoice
issue.description: Operator approves and posts the AP invoice. Guards: (1) balanced materialisation per T1 REQ-JE-007; (2) FiscalPeriod open per REQ-PC-004; (3) Payee.lifecycleState=active. Actions: (a) materialise one balanced GLTransaction (debit expense per line, credit AP payable account); (b) set glTransactionId back-reference; (c) set periodId from invoiceDate.

matchFull.label: Match full payment
matchFull.description: Operator confirms a bank-reconciliation ReconciliationMatch per REQ-AP-009. Guard: cumulative matched amount = totalAmount.

matchPartial.label: Match partial payment
matchPartial.description: Operator confirms a bank-reconciliation ReconciliationMatch per REQ-AP-009 where matched amount < totalAmount.

markOverdue.label: Mark overdue
markOverdue.description: Scheduled lifecycle action fires when today > dueDate and no full payment match yet. Triggered by OR ScheduledWorkflow per REQ-AP-004 + ADR-031 path 2 — NOT a shillinq *Job PHP class.

x-scheduled-workflow.description: Daily 01:00 sweep evaluates open AP invoices and transitions issued|partially-paid → overdue when today > dueDate. Per ADR-031 §'Background jobs that walk an object queue' path 2.

dispute.label: Dispute invoice
dispute.description: Operator marks invoice as disputed. Payment-match pursuit pauses pending resolution.

resolveDispute.label: Resolve dispute
resolveDispute.description: Vendor-raised dispute resolved; payment-match pursuit resumes.

writeOff.label: Write off
writeOff.description: Operator in role controller writes off the residual balance. Action: materialise a compensating balanced GLTransaction (debit AP payable account, credit bad-debt recovery / write-off account). Audit-trailed reason required per REQ-AP-005. Sets writeOffGlTransactionId back-reference.

void.label: Void invoice
void.description: Operator voids the issued invoice. Guard: materialised GLTransaction MUST already be reversed per T1 REQ-GL-004.

dunning.description: Per REQ-AP-005 the dunning cadence (reminder-1 / reminder-2 / formal-notice / collection) is owned by OR's dunning-workflow extension. The policy referenced via Payee.dunningPolicyRef drives DunningNotice creation from the overdue state. If OR's extension is not yet stable at implementation time, ADR-031's exception path applies: OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\APGuard ships a single-method fallback documented in the spec.

agedPayablesDetail.description: REQ-AP-006: Aged Payables Detail report — per-invoice breakdown grouped by vendor and due-date bucket. Excludes paid / written-off / voided. BLOCKED (cross-tab): OpenRegister's aggregation engine honours only a single-field groupBy ({field: <name>}) today — this multi-field groupBy [vendorId, dueDateBucket] plus the buckets/return projection are INERT engine-side and must not be read as a working capability. Tracked by openregister#432 (honour multi-field groupBy); the shillinq spend-analytics feature ships single-dimension views against the honoured path meanwhile.

agedPayablesSummary.description: REQ-AP-007: Aged Payables Summary report — vendor totals grouped by aging bucket. Excludes paid / written-off / voided. BLOCKED (cross-tab): the multi-field groupBy [vendorId, agingBucket] and the aggregate/buckets/return projection maps are INERT — OpenRegister honours only a single-field groupBy ({field: <name>}) today. Tracked by openregister#432.

agedPayablesTimeline.description: REQ-AP-008: Aged Payables Timeline report — payment due dates with amounts and vendor summary. Excludes paid / written-off / voided.

vendorOpenApBalance.description: Per-vendor open AP balance used by Vendor detail view and pre-payment-run checks. Aggregates open (state in issued/partially-paid/overdue/disputed) APTransaction totals by vendorId.

icpContext.description: Intra-community supplies overlay populated when the invoice is treated as ICP (REQ-ICP-001, REQ-ICP-006, REQ-ICP-007). Set by the VIES validation flow when the customer is in another EU member state with a valid VAT-ID. Drives ICP ledger aggregation, reverse-charge PDF rendering (REQ-ICP-007), and the Belastingdienst rubriek 3b reconciliation gate (REQ-ICP-004). Triangulation supplies (Article 141 VAT Directive 2006/112/EC) carry supplyType T and report the C-party VAT-ID rather than the A-party's.

treatAsIcp.description: True when the invoice MUST be reported on the ICP-opgaaf (intra-community supply, zero-rated, reverse-charged). Drives REQ-ICP-003 aggregation and REQ-ICP-007 PDF rendering.

supplyType.description: ICP supply-type code per Belastingdienst NT18 taxonomy: L = goods (Leveringen), S = services (diensten), T = triangulation (driehoekstransactie / ABC-levering per Article 141 VAT Directive). Routes to chart-of-accounts 8190 / 8195 / 8196.
supplyType.title: Supply Type

viesValidationId.description: FK to the ViesValidation record proving the buyer VAT-ID was VIES-verified at invoice time (good-faith defence per Implementing Regulation 282/2011 Article 18).
viesValidationId.title: Vies Validation ID

triangulation.description: True when this invoice is a triangulation supply (REQ-ICP-006). When true the system validates and reports the C-party VAT-ID against VIES, never the A-party's.
triangulation.title: Triangulation

icpContext.title: ICP Context

paymentMethod.description: Expected payment method (REQ-SDD-002). When `direct_debit`, `directDebitMandateId` MUST be populated and reference an `active` SepaMandate; collection scheduling is gated on this combination.
paymentMethod.title: Payment Method

directDebitMandateId.description: FK to the SepaMandate UUID under which this invoice is to be collected (REQ-SDD-002). Required when `paymentMethod = direct_debit`; ignored otherwise. The mandate MUST be `active` at collection-scheduling time; cancellation or expiry triggers `sdd.mandate.cancelled` / `sdd.mandate.expired`.
directDebitMandateId.title: Direct Debit Mandate ID

directDebitPreNotificationInvoiceId.description: Optional FK to the ARInvoice whose line item carried the SEPA pre-notification text for this collection (REQ-SDD-003, design D3 invoice-line channel). When set, this invoice's pre-notification proof is sourced from the linked invoice's issue date + line text; the `PreNotification` register entry references the same invoice via `recipientAddress`.
directDebitPreNotificationInvoiceId.title: Direct Debit Pre Notification Invoice ID

marginScheme.description: Whether this invoice is supplied under the VAT margin scheme for second-hand goods, works of art, collectors' items and antiques (VAT Directive arts. 312-325); enables the art. 315 margin-taxable-amount and art. 322 no-separate-VAT checks.
marginScheme.title: Margin Scheme

marginPurchasePrice.description: Purchase price of the margin-scheme goods (VAT Directive art. 312); subtracted from the selling price to derive the taxable margin (art. 315).
marginPurchasePrice.title: Margin Purchase Price

marginSellingPrice.description: Selling price of the margin-scheme goods (VAT Directive art. 312); the taxable margin is this less the purchase price (art. 315).
marginSellingPrice.title: Margin Selling Price

marginTaxableAmount.description: Stated taxable amount under the margin scheme (VAT Directive art. 315); must reconcile to marginSellingPrice - marginPurchasePrice.
marginTaxableAmount.title: Margin Taxable Amount

invoicingPeriodPresent.description: Whether a document-level invoicing period (BG-14) is used; independent of its dates (BR-CO-19).
invoicingPeriodPresent.title: Invoicing Period Present

buyerCountryCode.description: Buyer country code (BT-55), ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (EN 16931 BR-11 / BR-CL-14).
buyerCountryCode.title: Buyer Country Code

amountDue.description: Amount due for payment (BT-115) = total with VAT - paid amount + rounding amount (EN 16931 BR-15 / BR-CO-16).
amountDue.title: Amount Due

paidAmount.description: Paid amount (BT-113), already settled before issue (EN 16931 BR-DEC-16).
paidAmount.title: Paid Amount

roundingAmount.description: Rounding amount (BT-114) applied to the amount due (EN 16931 BR-DEC-17).
roundingAmount.title: Rounding Amount

taxCurrencyCode.description: VAT accounting currency code (BT-6), ISO 4217 alpha-3 (EN 16931 BR-CL-05 / BR-53).
taxCurrencyCode.title: Tax Currency Code

taxAmountAccountingCurrency.description: Invoice total VAT amount in accounting currency (BT-111); required when taxCurrencyCode is present (EN 16931 BR-53 / BR-DEC-15).
taxAmountAccountingCurrency.title: Tax Amount Accounting Currency

actualDeliveryDate.description: Actual delivery date (BT-72); supports the intra-community delivery-info rule (EN 16931 BR-IC-11).
actualDeliveryDate.title: Actual Delivery Date

paymentMeansTypeCode.description: Payment means type code (BT-81), UNCL4461 (EN 16931 BR-49 / BR-CL-16).
paymentMeansTypeCode.title: Payment Means Type Code

paymentAccountId.description: Payment account identifier (BT-84); required for credit-transfer payment means (EN 16931 BR-50 / BR-61).
paymentAccountId.title: Payment Account ID

sellerElectronicAddressScheme.description: Seller electronic address scheme identifier (BT-34-1); required when the address is present (EN 16931 BR-62).
sellerElectronicAddressScheme.title: Seller Electronic Address Scheme

buyerElectronicAddressScheme.description: Buyer electronic address scheme identifier (BT-49-1); required when the address is present (EN 16931 BR-63).
buyerElectronicAddressScheme.title: Buyer Electronic Address Scheme

sellerTaxRepAddress.description: Seller tax representative postal address (BG-12) (EN 16931 BR-19).
sellerTaxRepAddress.title: Seller Tax Rep Address

sellerTaxRepCountryCode.description: Seller tax representative country code (BT-69), ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (EN 16931 BR-20).
sellerTaxRepCountryCode.title: Seller Tax Rep Country Code

payeeName.description: Payee name (BT-59); required when a payee different from the seller is given (EN 16931 BR-17).
payeeName.title: Payee Name

deliverToCountryCode.description: Deliver-to country code (BT-80); required when a deliver-to address or an intra-community supply is present (EN 16931 BR-57 / BR-IC-12).
deliverToCountryCode.title: Deliver To Country Code

supportingDocuments.description: Additional supporting documents (BG-24); each carries a supporting document reference (BT-122) (EN 16931 BR-52).
supportingDocuments.title: Supporting Documents

precedingInvoiceReferences.description: Preceding invoice references (BG-3); each carries a preceding invoice reference (BT-25) (EN 16931 BR-55).
precedingInvoiceReferences.title: Preceding Invoice References

buyerName.description: Buyer name (BT-44); the customer's full name (EN 16931 BR-07 / VAT Directive art. 226(5)).
buyerName.title: Buyer Name

cardPan.description: Card primary account number (BT-87); an Invoice should never include a full card PAN (EN 16931 BR-51). Must remain absent.
cardPan.title: Card Pan

itemStandardId.description: Item standard identifier (BT-157) at line level; requires a scheme identifier (EN 16931 BR-64).
itemStandardId.title: Item Standard ID

itemClassificationId.description: Item classification identifier (BT-158) at line level; requires a scheme identifier (EN 16931 BR-65).
itemClassificationId.title: Item Classification ID

supplyType.description: Nature of the supply for place-of-supply determination (VAT Directive title V): goods, a general service, immovable-property service (art. 47), an event activity (art. 54) or admission (art. 53), restaurant/catering (art. 55), short-term hire of a means of transport (art. 56) or telecom/broadcasting/electronic services (art. 58).
supplyType.title: Supply Type

customerType.description: Whether the customer is a taxable person (business, B2B) or a non-taxable person (private, B2C); selects the applicable general place-of-supply rule (art. 44 vs art. 45).
customerType.title: Customer Type

goodsTransported.description: Whether the goods are dispatched/transported to the customer; selects art. 32 (place = dispatch origin) over art. 31 (place = goods location).
goodsTransported.title: Goods Transported

placeOfSupplyCountry.description: The Member State the directive deems the place of supply (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Must equal the directive-mandated location for the supply nature (arts. 31/32/44/45/47/53/54/55/56/58).
placeOfSupplyCountry.title: Place Of Supply Country

goodsLocationCountry.description: Country where the goods are located at the time of supply (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); the place of supply for goods not dispatched/transported (art. 31).
goodsLocationCountry.title: Goods Location Country

dispatchOriginCountry.description: Country where dispatch/transport of the goods to the customer begins (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); the place of supply for transported goods (art. 32).
dispatchOriginCountry.title: Dispatch Origin Country

propertyCountry.description: Country where the immovable property is located (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); the place of supply for property-connected services (art. 47).
propertyCountry.title: Property Country

eventCountry.description: Country where the event/cultural activity actually takes place (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); the place of supply under arts. 53/54.
eventCountry.title: Event Country

serviceCountry.description: Country where the service is physically carried out or the vehicle is put at the customer's disposal (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); the place of supply under arts. 55/56.
serviceCountry.title: Service Country

continuousSupply.description: Whether the supply gives rise to successive statements of account or payments (art. 64), so the tax point falls on expiry of the period.
continuousSupply.title: Continuous Supply

periodEndDate.description: End of the statement/payment period for a continuous supply (art. 64); the tax point must fall on or after this date.
periodEndDate.title: Period End Date

prepaymentAmount.description: Amount of a payment on account received before the supply (art. 65); VAT becomes chargeable on receipt of this amount.
prepaymentAmount.title: Prepayment Amount

prepaymentReceiptDate.description: Date the prepayment was received (art. 65); the tax point must fall on or after this date.
prepaymentReceiptDate.title: Prepayment Receipt Date

taxableAmountReduction.description: Reduction of the taxable amount on cancellation, refusal, non-payment or price reduction after the supply (art. 90 bad-debt relief).
taxableAmountReduction.title: Taxable Amount Reduction

triangulation.description: Whether this sale is the intermediary's (B) leg of a triangular intra-Community transaction (arts. 141/197); enables the triangulation-simplification and reverse-charge checks.
triangulation.title: Triangulation

intermediaryCountryCode.description: Member State of the intermediary (B) in a triangular transaction (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); must differ from the seller and final-customer Member States (art. 141).
intermediaryCountryCode.title: Intermediary Country Code

finalCustomerCountryCode.description: Member State of the final customer (C) in a triangular transaction (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); must differ from the seller and intermediary Member States (art. 141).
finalCustomerCountryCode.title: Final Customer Country Code

finalCustomerVatId.description: VAT identification number of the final customer (C) who accounts for the VAT under reverse charge in a triangular transaction (art. 141).
finalCustomerVatId.title: Final Customer VAT ID

directDelivery.description: Whether the goods are dispatched/transported directly to the final customer (C) in a triangular transaction (art. 141 condition).
directDelivery.title: Direct Delivery

reverseChargeMention.description: Whether the invoice carries the reverse-charge mention required where the customer is liable for the VAT (arts. 197/226(11a)).
reverseChargeMention.title: Reverse Charge Mention

invoiceNote.description: Free-text invoice note; may carry the reverse-charge wording ('Reverse charge' / 'btw verlegd').
invoiceNote.title: Invoice Note

smeExemptionApplied.description: Whether the small-enterprise VAT exemption (art. 282) is applied to this supply; enables the SME turnover-threshold check.
smeExemptionApplied.title: Sme Exemption Applied

annualTurnover.description: The taxable person's annual turnover, used to test the small-enterprise exemption against the national threshold (art. 282).
annualTurnover.title: Annual Turnover

smeThreshold.description: The national small-enterprise turnover threshold below which the exemption is available (art. 282).
smeThreshold.title: Sme Threshold

crossBorderSme.description: Whether the cross-border Union SME scheme is used; if so the Union-wide turnover must not exceed EUR 100 000 (art. 282).
crossBorderSme.title: Cross Border Sme

unionTurnover.description: The taxable person's Union-wide annual turnover, capped at EUR 100 000 for the cross-border SME scheme (art. 282).
unionTurnover.title: Union Turnover

vatNote.description: Free-text VAT legal note printed on the invoice (VAT Directive art. 226(11a)/(11)/138). Carries the mandatory 'Reverse charge' wording where the customer is liable, and/or the reference to the exemption provision (e.g. 'intra-Community supply, art. 138') where the supply is exempt.
vatNote.title: VAT Note

sourceContractReference.title: Source Contract Reference
sourceContractReference.description: Handoff provenance pointer to the contract this AR invoice originated from (ADR-051; bound to the ns#Invoice kind-contract field `source`). Scalar URN `shillinq:contract:<contractNumber>` written by the contract-to-initial-invoice emitter mapping — scalar because the notification created-filter grammar string-casts objects to ''. UUID-level provenance additionally lives in the engine-written `handoff:<id>:originated-from` relation and the immutable audit trail. Null/absent for operator-created invoices.

ARInvoice.title: AR Invoice
ARInvoice.description: A customer (accounts-receivable) invoice sub-ledger record per REQ-AR-003. On issue it materialises a balanced GLTransaction (T1 REQ-JE-007 pattern) and is subject to a credit-limit check (REQ-AR-006). Dunning is consumed from OR's dunning-workflow per REQ-AR-005 (DunningGuard fallback per ADR-031). Payment matching links to a BankStatementLine from bank-reconciliation.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Bookkeeping sub-ledger register; every lifecycle transition (issue / overdue / match / dispute / write-off / void) and every header / line edit is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-RAP-001 / REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Under construction.

issued.label: Issued
issued.description: Credit-limit checked; balanced GLTransaction materialised; glTransactionId written.

paid.label: Paid
paid.description: Payment matched from bank-rec; matchedBankLineId set; payment GLTransaction posted.

overdue.label: Overdue
overdue.description: Due date passed (OR isOverdue calculation); dunning workflow triggers.

disputed.label: Disputed
disputed.description: Customer disputes the invoice; dunning paused.

written-off.label: Written off
written-off.description: Bad-debt write-off; compensating GLTransaction posted (debit bad-debt expense, credit AR control).

issue.label: Issue invoice
issue.description: Credit-limit check (REQ-AR-006); materialises a balanced GLTransaction and writes glTransactionId.

write-off-issued.label: Write off
write-off-issued.description: Posts compensating GLTransaction; requires period-closer or ar-controller role. Blocked until writeOffReason is set (REQ-AR-007).

write-off-overdue.label: Write off overdue
write-off-overdue.description: Posts compensating GLTransaction; requires period-closer or ar-controller role. Blocked until writeOffReason is set (REQ-AR-007).

isOverdue.description: Derived overdue flag per REQ-AR-004; drives the automated overdue transition and dunning workflow.

arAging.label: AR Aging
arAging.description: Groups open AR invoices by customer and aging bucket per REQ-AR-008. Excludes paid and written-off invoices.

creditExposure.label: Customer Credit Exposure
creditExposure.description: Sums grossAmount of all non-paid, non-written-off AR invoices per customer for the credit-limit check on issuance per REQ-AR-006.

x-shillinq-delivery-substates._comment: Documentation-only state graph for ARInvoice.deliveryStatus (REQ-AR-011). NOT an x-openregister-lifecycle block — see _meta.description. Enforced imperatively by EInvoiceService + PeppolDeliveryStatusListener.

not-sent.label: Not sent
not-sent.description: No Peppol transmission has been attempted, or the last attempt fell back to PDF + email.

queued.label: Queued
queued.description: Pre-send validation passed and nl.conduction.peppol.outbound.requested was emitted; awaiting access-point acceptance.

sent.label: Sent
sent.description: The access point accepted the transmission (delivery.status: sent).

delivered.label: Delivered
delivered.description: The recipient access point confirmed delivery (delivery.status: delivered). Terminal.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: The access point or recipient rejected the document (delivery.status: rejected). The finance operator is notified.

failed.label: Failed
failed.description: Transmission failed before the access point could process it (delivery.status: failed).

queue.label: Send e-invoice
queue.description: Operator triggers Send e-invoice after pre-send validation passes (REQ-EINV-005). Enforced by EInvoiceService.

accept.label: Access point accepts
accept.description: nl.conduction.peppol.delivery.status status: sent. Enforced by PeppolDeliveryStatusListener.

confirm.label: Recipient confirms
confirm.description: nl.conduction.peppol.delivery.status status: delivered. Enforced by PeppolDeliveryStatusListener.

requeue-rejected.label: Re-send after correction
requeue-rejected.description: Operator re-triggers Send e-invoice after correcting the rejection cause.

requeue-failed.label: Re-send
requeue-failed.description: Operator re-triggers Send e-invoice after a transmission failure.

Aansluiting.title: Aansluiting
Aansluiting.description: The declarative definition of one tie-out: source A, source B, the expected relationship between them, and the tolerance within which a difference is not considered drift. One Aansluiting definition is computed once per fiscal period, producing an AansluitingResult. Master data — created once per tie-out, not per period.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: REQ-AT-001: changes to the declarative tie-out definition (tolerance, expected relationship, source resolvers) are audit-trailed — this is master data that governs how every AansluitingResult for this tie-out is computed.

reconciliationType.description: The resolver AansluitingService dispatches to for source A / source B totals (REQ-AANS-002). Only two are implemented in this change; additional types are a named follow-up (see proposal.md).
reconciliationType.title: Aansluiting Type

sourceALabel.description: Display label for source A (e.g. 'BTW-grootboek (huidig)' or 'Debiteuren subgrootboek').
sourceALabel.title: Source A Label

sourceBLabel.description: Display label for source B (e.g. 'Ingediende BTW-aangifte' or 'Grootboekrekening 1300 Debiteuren').
sourceBLabel.title: Source B Label

toleranceCents.description: Maximum absolute difference (whole cents) still considered within tolerance (REQ-AANS-003). Below or equal: AansluitingResult.withinTolerance = true and status defaults to resolved. Above: status = open.
toleranceCents.title: Tolerance Cents

expectedRelationship.description: How source A and source B are expected to relate (REQ-AANS-003). 'equal': sourceATotal - sourceBTotal should be ~0. 'equal-with-sign-flip': sourceATotal + sourceBTotal should be ~0 (a GL control account carries the opposite sign convention from its subledger total, e.g. a liability control account).
expectedRelationship.title: Expected Relationship

controlAccountNumber.description: For aansluitingType=subledger-gl-control: the GL control-account number source A resolves against (e.g. 1300 Debiteuren, 1600 Crediteuren). Unused for btw-ledger-aangifte.
controlAccountNumber.title: Control Account Number

subLedgerType.description: For aansluitingType=subledger-gl-control: which subledger source B sums (REQ-AANS-005). Unused for btw-ledger-aangifte.
subLedgerType.title: Sub Ledger Type

active.description: False retires the definition from the recurring compute list without deleting its history.
active.title: Active

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

AansluitingResult.title: Aansluiting Resultaat
AansluitingResult.description: One per-period computed instance of an Aansluiting (REQ-AANS-004): the resolved source A / source B totals, the difference, whether it is within tolerance, a bucket-level drill-down (lineDeltas), and the open -> explained -> resolved lifecycle with an audit-trailed explanation (who explained what, REQ-AANS-006). Computed by AansluitingService::compute(); one result per (aansluitingId, periodId) — recomputing replaces the totals/lineDeltas of an `open` result in place but never a result already `explained` or `resolved` (must reopen first).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: REQ-AANS-006: every lifecycle transition (explain/resolve/reopen) and the explainedBy/explainedReasonText fields are audit-trailed.

reconciliationId.description: FK to the Aansluiting definition this result was computed for.
reconciliationId.title: Aansluiting ID

periodId.description: Fiscal period this result was computed for (REQ-AANS-004).
periodId.title: Period ID

sourceATotal.description: Resolved source A total in EUR (REQ-AANS-004).
sourceATotal.title: Source A Total

sourceBTotal.description: Resolved source B total in EUR (REQ-AANS-004).
sourceBTotal.title: Source B Total

differenceCents.description: The signed difference in whole cents, computed per the parent Aansluiting's expectedRelationship (REQ-AANS-003).
differenceCents.title: Difference Cents

withinTolerance.description: True when abs(differenceCents) <= the parent Aansluiting's toleranceCents.
withinTolerance.title: Within Tolerance

status.description: Lifecycle state (REQ-AANS-006). open: drift detected, unexplained. explained: an operator recorded a reason but has not confirmed resolution. resolved: closed out, either because it was within tolerance or an operator confirmed the explained drift is settled.
status.title: Status

lineDeltas.description: Bucket-level drill-down (REQ-AANS-005). Always carries a 'TOTAL' summary row; aansluitingType=btw-ledger-aangifte additionally carries one row per (type, taxRate) rubriek bucket; aansluitingType=subledger-gl-control additionally carries one row per open subledger item contributing to sourceBTotal.

bucketKey.title: Bucket Key
bucketKey.description: TOTAL, a type:taxRate rubriek key, or an open-item id.

sourceAAmount.title: Source A Amount
sourceAAmount.description: The bucket's contribution to source A (null when source A does not decompose to this bucket).

sourceBAmount.title: Source B Amount
sourceBAmount.description: The bucket's contribution to source B (null when source B does not decompose to this bucket).

deltaAmount.title: Delta Amount
deltaAmount.description: sourceAAmount - sourceBAmount for this bucket (sign-flip relationships already normalised).

lineDeltas.title: Line Deltas

explainedBy.description: Actor (user id) who recorded the explanation (REQ-AANS-006).
explainedBy.title: Explained By

explainedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the explanation was recorded (REQ-AANS-006). Null while the difference is unexplained. An explanation documents why a tie-out difference exists; it does not clear it — resolvedAt does that.
explainedAt.title: Explained At

explanationReasonCode.description: Classification of the explanation (REQ-AANS-006), mirroring the T4 bank-reconciliation resolutionStatus vocabulary (bookkeeping-reconciliation-reports REQ-REC-004) for a consistent operator vocabulary across all tie-out UIs.
explanationReasonCode.title: Explanation Reason Code

explanationReasonText.description: Operator-supplied free-text reason (REQ-AANS-006). Required before a resolve transition is permitted.
explanationReasonText.title: Explanation Reason Text

resolvedBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the actor who closed this tie-out difference — i.e. who confirmed the two sources now reconcile, or that the remaining difference has been corrected in the ledger. Null while the difference is still open. Distinct from explainedBy, which only documents the cause.
resolvedBy.title: Resolved By

resolvedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the tie-out difference was closed. Null while the difference is still open; a non-null value is what takes this result out of the operator's open-differences worklist.
resolvedAt.title: Resolved At

relatedVatCorrectionId.description: For aansluitingType=btw-ledger-aangifte: FK to the VatCorrection the btw-suppletie-detection flow already created for the same drift, if any (REQ-AANS-007 integration, not duplication). Null when no correction has been prepared yet or the aansluiting is not BTW-typed.
relatedVatCorrectionId.title: Related Vat Correction ID

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

open.label: Open
open.description: Drift detected (or first computation) and not yet explained.

explained.label: Explained
explained.description: An operator recorded a reason for the drift but has not confirmed it is fully resolved.

resolved.label: Resolved
resolved.description: Closed out — either the drift was within tolerance, or an operator confirmed the explained drift is settled.

explain.label: Explain difference
explain.description: Operator records explanationReasonCode + explanationReasonText (REQ-AANS-006). Requires non-empty explanationReasonText.

resolve.label: Resolve
resolve.description: Operator confirms the explained drift is settled (REQ-AANS-006).

resolve-within-tolerance.label: Auto-resolve (within tolerance)
resolve-within-tolerance.description: System-driven: a compute() finding withinTolerance=true resolves automatically without requiring an explanation (REQ-AANS-004).

reopen.label: Reopen
reopen.description: Operator or a later recompute reopens an explained-but-not-yet-resolved result, e.g. because the underlying drift changed.

reopen-resolved.label: Reopen resolved
reopen-resolved.description: A later recompute finds fresh drift on a previously resolved result and reopens it, audit-trailing the reason.

openCountByAdministration.description: REQ-AANS-008: count of open AansluitingResult rows per administration, for a dashboard tile / period-close flag surface.

openCountByAansluiting.description: Count of open results per Aansluiting definition, across all computed periods.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on Account with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

isSuspenseAccount.description: REQ-BR-007: when true, this Account is the designated bank-reconciliation suspense account for the administration. Unmatched BankStatementLine rows materialise a balanced GLTransaction debiting/crediting the bank-account GL against this account when the operator marks a line `routed-to-suspense`. A non-zero suspense balance is reportable through trial balance (REQ-TB-001) and surfaced as a follow-up flag in the bank-rec UI.
isSuspenseAccount.title: Is Suspense Account

isTreasuryAccount.description: REQ-SBK-002: flags this account as a Treasury (schatkist) account so SchatkistPosition aggregates its postings. Additive extension merged onto the T1 Account schema via ADR-037 deep-merge.
isTreasuryAccount.title: Is Schatkist Account

taxBasisDifferenceCategory.description: Optional hint for the deferred-tax GL detection logic (REQ-DT-001). Maps this account to a TemporaryDifference.category so detection is automatic. Leave null for accounts with no expected timing difference.
taxBasisDifferenceCategory.title: Tax Basis Difference Category

vpbPligtig.description: Whether postings against this account contribute to the Vpb-balans (REQ-VPB-001). Defaults to false; flagged accounts are filtered into VpbBalansFiltered when they appear in a VpbBalansLink.accountNumbers list (REQ-VPB-003).
vpbPligtig.title: VpB Pligtig

accountType.description: Classification of the account (e.g. bank, cash, trust, escrow, iolta, derdengelden). A trust/escrow account is subject to the segregation rules.
accountType.title: Account Type

isTrustAccount.description: True when this Account holds third-party client monies (derdengelden / trust / IOLTA / escrow). Such an account must be segregated and never commingled (nl-derdengelden-segregation, us-iolta-escrow-segregation).
isTrustAccount.title: Is Trust Account

segregated.description: True when a trust/escrow account is held as a separate account, distinct from the firm's own funds (nl-derdengelden-segregation, us-iolta-escrow-segregation).
segregated.title: Segregated

commingled.description: True when client monies are commingled with the firm's own funds — a violation for a trust/escrow account (nl-derdengelden-segregation, us-iolta-escrow-segregation).
commingled.title: Commingled

rgsCode.description: Standardised RGS (Referentie Grootboekschema) reference code mapped onto this general-ledger account, enabling uniform SBR exchange to KvK, Belastingdienst and CBS (RGS rgs-coa-standard-codes). Hierarchical alphabetic reference code, e.g. 'BLimVap' (immateriele vaste activa).
rgsCode.title: Rgs Code

rgsReferenceNumber.description: Unique numeric RGS reference number that maps one-to-one to the corresponding SBR taxonomy element (RGS rgs-code-structure), e.g. '10101010'.
rgsReferenceNumber.title: Rgs Reference Number

accountNumber.description: RGS-style account code (e.g. '1000', '4100'). Unique within an administration.
accountNumber.title: Account Number

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this account's base currency.
currency.title: Currency

parentAccountNumber.description: FK to the parent Account.accountNumber for hierarchy navigation.
parentAccountNumber.title: Parent Account Number

isClosingAccount.description: Designates this as the administration's single closing account for period-end equity absorption.
isClosingAccount.title: Is Closing Account

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this account. Scopes uniqueness of accountNumber.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state of the account.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

emuSaldoByQuarter.description: Quarterly EMU-saldo (debit minus credit) grouped by ESA-2010 sector for a given quarter, riding the IV3-base quarterly data per REQ-EMU-003. Filters GLLine rows by period and respects per-line emuInclusionRule (included|partial only; excluded lines are omitted). Partial lines count at 50% contribution. If the declarative engine cannot express the combined multi-sector + emuInclusionRule filter, the guard OCA\Shillinq\Guard\EmuCalculator::computeQuarterlySaldo is invoked per ADR-031 exception path.

emuSaldoByYear.description: Annual EMU-saldo and EMU-schuld from the closed jaarrekening per REQ-EMU-003. Filters all closed-year GLLine rows, groups by ESA-2010 sector, and respects emuInclusionRule. EMU-schuld is derived as the cumulative net liability position across S.13 sectors. Same guard fallback as quarterly per ADR-031.

daysUntilRetention.description: Account records are kept indefinitely (disposition: keep_indefinite per selectielijst:5.1.1). This field always returns null for Account objects. JSON-AST: lit(null).

emuAggregationHash.description: Declarative (ADR-031) stable SHA-256 hash over the contributing-GLLine count + esaClassifier for this account's last EMU computation, enabling audit-trail reproducibility per REQ-EMU-005. The contributing set is folded via the emuContributors aggregate-ref (closed GLLines with emuInclusionRule in [included, partial], joined on accountNumber). Replaces the former imperative sha256(@aggregation...) string; the @params.emuInclusionRule term is dropped (not available in the calc payload) — same contributing set + sector still yields the same hash. JSON-AST: sha256(concat(@aggregate.emuContributors, ':', esaClassifier)).

ActuarialValuation.title: Actuarial Valuation
ActuarialValuation.description: Per-balansdatum measurement of a DB plan's defined-benefit obligation (DBO) and plan assets, with the actuarial assumptions and actuaris sign-off (REQ-PEN-001, REQ-PEN-002, REQ-PEN-005). Projected Unit Credit (PUC) methodology is mandatory for DB plans (REQ-PEN-001); the discount rate must be market-referenced and is flagged when a government-bond source is used (REQ-PEN-002). netPensionLiability = dboGross − planAssetsFairValue + assetCeilingApplied (IFRIC 14, REQ-PEN-005).

Administration.title: Administration
Administration.description: A legally self-contained bookkeeping entity (juridisch-onafhankelijke boekhouding). The first-class multi-tenant isolation boundary: every financial record carries an administrationId FK to this schema (REQ-MA-001). Each Administration owns its own chart-of-accounts, fiscal-year cycle, presentation currency and VAT regime independently of other administrations (REQ-MA-002). Holding/werkmij structures link via parentAdministrationId / childAdministrationIds.

verifyDrop.description: On publicatie, look up the gemeenteblad reference via the DROP API (openconnector OC-source) and write the verification envelope back onto dropVerification (REQ-WMO-005 §automatic verification). Fail-soft: an unavailable DROP API logs a verification record with success=false but does NOT block the transition.

flagDependentActivities.description: When an ABB enters intrekking or herziening, flag dependent CommercialActivity records (those whose exemptionBesluitId points at this ABB) for operator review (REQ-WMO-005 §dependents).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Public Interest Decision is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on AllocationRule with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

sourceAccountPattern.description: Glob or range pattern matching source GL accounts (e.g. 1000-1099 or 4900). Evaluated against GLLine.accountNumber on per-posting rules per REQ-CC-004.
sourceAccountPattern.title: Source Account Pattern

targets.description: At least 2 target entries. For fixed-percentage: percentages MUST sum to 100 (enforced by x-openregister-lifecycle.requires on save per REQ-CC-004). For fixed-amount: amounts specify absolute allocation per target. For volume/headcount: source specifies the reference register or field.

code.description: Target dimension code (FK to CostCenter.code, KostenDrager.code, or Project.code depending on targetDimension).
code.title: Code

percentage.description: Allocation percentage for fixed-percentage driver. All targets MUST sum to 100.
percentage.title: Percentage

amount.description: Fixed allocation amount for fixed-amount driver.
amount.title: Amount

source.description: Reference field or register for volume/headcount driver.
source.title: Source

targets.title: Targets

targetDimension.description: Which dimension the targets[].code values refer to per REQ-CC-004.
targetDimension.title: Target Dimension

cadence.description: Execution cadence per REQ-CC-004. per-posting fires on GLTransaction.post lifecycle action; monthly and period-close fire via OR ScheduledWorkflow.
cadence.title: Cadence

lifecycleState.description: Activation state. Seeded rules ship in paused state per design Seed Data section.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this allocation rule.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

AllocationRule.title: Allocation Rule
AllocationRule.description: A cost-allocation rule declared as schema metadata per ADR-031 (design D2). Stores the rule shape: source pattern, driver, targets, target dimension, and cadence. Per-posting rules fire as x-openregister-lifecycle action on GLTransaction.post; monthly/period-close rules fire via OR ScheduledWorkflow. No AllocationService.allocate() ever runs the rule. Compliance: REQ-CC-004.

active.label: Active
active.description: Rule is evaluated on its cadence. For per-posting: on every GLTransaction.post.

paused.label: Paused
paused.description: Rule is stored but not evaluated. Default for seeded example rules.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Rule is retired; no longer evaluated or activatable.

save.message: Fixed-percentage allocation rule: target percentages must sum to 100 per REQ-CC-004.

activate.label: Activate rule
activate.description: Operator confirms the rule and activates it for evaluation on its cadence.

pause.label: Pause rule
pause.description: Temporarily suspend rule evaluation without archiving.

archive.label: Archive rule
archive.description: Retire the rule permanently.

monthlyAllocation.description: Evaluates all active AllocationRule records with cadence=monthly against the previous month's posted GLLines per REQ-CC-004 design D2. No PHP AllocationService orchestrates this — the rule body lives in this schema.

periodCloseAllocation.description: Evaluates all active AllocationRule records with cadence=period-close when the fiscal period closes per REQ-CC-004 design D2.

AmlReport.title: AML Report (CTR / SAR / 8300 / CMIR / FBAR / unusual)
AmlReport.description: A currency- / suspicious- / large-cash-transaction report, modelled so its threshold, filing-window, same-day-aggregation, payer-statement and retention obligations can be machine-checked.

administrationId.description: The administration / legal entity the report belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

amount.description: Reported transaction / account amount.
amount.title: Amount

thresholdAmount.description: The reporting threshold that applies to this report type.
thresholdAmount.title: Threshold Amount

transactionDate.description: Date of the reportable transaction (CTR / 8300 filing-window and payer-statement reference).
transactionDate.title: Transaction Date

detectionDate.description: Date of initial detection of the facts (SAR filing-window reference).
detectionDate.title: Detection Date

eFiled.description: True when the report was filed electronically (CTR BSA E-Filing).
eFiled.title: E Filed

sameDayAggregate.description: Same-business-day aggregate of currency transactions by/for one person (CTR aggregation).
sameDayAggregate.title: Same Day Aggregate

payerStatementDate.description: Date the written payer statement was furnished (Form 8300; must be by 31 January of the year after the transaction).
payerStatementDate.title: Payer Statement Date

retentionUntil.description: Date until which the report and its supporting data are retained (at least five years after filedDate; NL Wwft report-retention).
retentionUntil.title: Retention Until

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a AML Report (CTR / SAR / 8300 / CMIR / FBAR / unusual) is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on AnalyticalDimension (unified successor to CostCenter + KostenDrager + custom dimensions, per REQ-ADIM-001) with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

code.description: Stable operator-facing dimension code, unique per (administrationId, dimensionType). Referenced as a key in GLLine.dimensions (custom), GLLine.costCenterCode (cost-center), GLLine.kostenDragerCode (cost-object), VpbBalansLink.costCenterId (cost-center with ondernemingsActiviteit). Preserved byte-for-byte by the UnifyAnalyticalDimensions migration per REQ-ADIM-007.
code.title: Code

name.description: Human-readable dimension name shown in the operator UI and segment P&L drill-down.
name.title: Name

description.description: Optional long-form description of the dimension and its intended use.
description.title: Description

dimensionType.description: Discriminator. cost-center = kostenplaats (carries budget / ondernemingsActiviteit surface); cost-object = kostendrager (hierarchy without budget); custom = operator-defined dimension (carries dataType / isHierarchical / referenceSchema metadata); project = former CostProject folded into AnalyticalDimension per REQ-RCP-001 (carries totalBudget / totalEstimatedCosts / projectNumber / startDate / endDate / externalProjectRef / budgetVariance; budget-vs-actuals via GL-derived spentToDate). Required on every row per REQ-ADIM-001.
dimensionType.title: Dimension Type

parentCode.description: FK to parent AnalyticalDimension.code (within the same dimensionType and administrationId) for hierarchy navigation per REQ-CC-002. Drives the byCostCenterHierarchy / byCostObject roll-up aggregations.
parentCode.title: Parent Code

lifecycleState.description: Operator-managed activation state. Archived dimensions remain referenced from historical GL lines but cannot be selected on new postings.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

administrationId.description: Owning administratie. Dimensions are scoped per administration; the same code MAY exist with different dimensionTypes across administrations.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

status.description: Convenience alias of lifecycleState for active/inactive integrations per REQ-CPA-104. Applies to cost-center rows only; cost-object and custom rows should use lifecycleState directly.
status.title: Status

budget.description: Allocated annual or periodic budget amount in EUR per REQ-CD-002. Applies only when dimensionType = cost-center. Constrained to two-decimal cents via multipleOf to prevent IEEE-754 drift.
budget.title: Budget

spentToDate.description: Derived via x-openregister-aggregations: sum of GLLine.amount where costCenterCode = @self.code AND side = debit per REQ-CPA-106. Applies only when dimensionType = cost-center. Read-only.
spentToDate.title: Spent To Date

allocatedBudget.description: Derived via x-openregister-calculations: budget + sum(children.allocatedBudget) recursively per REQ-CPA-107. Applies only when dimensionType = cost-center. Read-only.
allocatedBudget.title: Allocated Budget

organizationId.description: FK to the Organization owning this dimension per REQ-CPA-104. Typically meaningful for cost-center and cost-object rows.
organizationId.title: Organization ID

responsibleUser.description: Nextcloud user id of the dimension owner. Applies to cost-center and cost-object rows.
responsibleUser.title: Responsible User

enterpriseActivity.description: Marks this cost-center dimension as an ondernemingsactiviteit per Wet modernisering Vpb-plicht (2016). When true, the dimension MAY be referenced by a VpbBalansLink (REQ-VPB-002). Only meaningful when dimensionType = cost-center. Default false.
enterpriseActivity.title: Ondernemings Activiteit

dataType.description: JSON value type for the dimension. Required only when dimensionType = custom. reference indicates the value MUST be a slug of another register (operator picks the target via referenceRegister/referenceSchema). Not applicable to cost-center or cost-object rows.
dataType.title: Data Type

isHierarchical.description: When true, the dimension supports parent-child roll-up via the parentCode self-relation. Drives drill-down navigation. Most meaningful for custom dimensions; cost-center and cost-object hierarchy is always via parentCode.
isHierarchical.title: Is Hierarchical

referenceRegister.description: When dataType=reference, the slug of the register the dimension value references (typically shillinq). Applies to custom dimensions only.
referenceRegister.title: Reference Register

referenceSchema.description: When dataType=reference, the slug of the schema the dimension value references (e.g. Contact, Project). Applies to custom dimensions only.
referenceSchema.title: Reference Schema

sortOrder.description: Display order in the operator UI. Most meaningful for custom dimensions.
sortOrder.title: Sort Order

totalBudget.description: Authorised spend ceiling for project-flavoured cost centers in integer cents (e.g. 5000000 = €50.000,00) per REQ-RCP-001. Applies when dimensionType = project. Reused with spentToDate (GL-derived) and budgetVariance (calculated) for budget-vs-actuals. Optional and nullable for plain departmental cost centers.
totalBudget.title: Total Budget

totalEstimatedCosts.description: Project-manager estimate of total project costs in integer cents per REQ-RCP-001. Applies when dimensionType = project. Optional and nullable for plain cost centers.
totalEstimatedCosts.title: Total Estimated Costs

projectNumber.description: Operator-facing project label per REQ-RCP-001 (was CostProject.projectNumber). Non-unique — code remains the unique key. Applies when dimensionType = project; ignored for plain cost centers.
projectNumber.title: Project Number

startDate.description: Time-box start date per REQ-RCP-001 (was CostProject.startDate). Applies when dimensionType = project; optional for plain cost centers.
startDate.title: Start Date

endDate.description: Time-box end date per REQ-RCP-001 (was CostProject.endDate). Applies when dimensionType = project; optional for plain cost centers.
endDate.title: End Date

externalProjectRef.description: ADR-019 integration-registry reference to an external OpenProject delivery project per REQ-RCP-002. Stores an OpenProject project id/URL and cached display label only. Resolution routes through OpenRegister ExternalIntegrationRouter and the OpenProject IntegrationProvider (external storage strategy, OpenConnector-backed). shillinq stores NO OpenProject delivery data. Cardinality 0..1. Valid and inert when the OpenProject provider is not yet registered (ADR-019 permissive-on-read).
externalProjectRef.title: External Project Ref

migratedFrom.description: Migration provenance marker written by RetireCostProjectStep per REQ-RCP-005. Contains the source CostProject id from which this AnalyticalDimension was created. Used for idempotency — dimensions with this marker are skipped on repair re-runs. Not editable.
migratedFrom.title: Migrated From

AnalyticalDimension.title: Analytical Dimension
AnalyticalDimension.description: ONE canonical operator-extensible analytical dimension register, discriminated by dimensionType (cost-center / cost-object / custom) per REQ-ADIM-001. Replaces the prior CostCenter (kostenplaats), KostenDrager (kostendrager), and custom AnalyticalDimension registers. Cost-center rows carry budget + spentToDate + allocatedBudget + ondernemingsActiviteit; cost-object rows carry hierarchy without budget; custom rows carry dataType / isHierarchical / referenceSchema metadata. All types share code / name / parentCode / lifecycleState / administrationId. CRUD is exclusively via OpenRegister's generic object surface (ADR-022).

active.label: Active
active.description: Usable for GL line dimension tagging.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable but rejected as target of new GL line dimension tags.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical only; no new dimension tags.

block.label: Block dimension
block.description: Prevent new GL line tagging against this dimension.

unblock.label: Unblock dimension
unblock.description: Re-enable GL line tagging against this dimension.

archive.label: Archive dimension
archive.description: Move to historical archive; GL lines with this code remain queryable.

segmentPnl.description: Segment P&L per cost-center (REQ-CC-005): debit/credit sums of non-eliminated GLLine amounts, grouped by costCenterCode + periodId + accountNumber. Returns EVERY cost-center; narrow to one with the extraFilter query params (?costCenterCode=...). It does not correlate on @self — no caller supplies a parent row. Parent roll-up over the parentCode tree is NOT included here; byCostCenterHierarchy does that through the join.

segmentPnlByCostObject.description: Segment P&L per cost-object (REQ-CC-005): debit/credit sums of non-eliminated GLLine amounts, grouped by costCarrierCode + periodId + accountNumber. Returns EVERY cost-object; narrow to one with the extraFilter query params (?costCarrierCode=...). Replaces the retired KostenDrager.segmentPnl; the field is costCarrierCode — kostenDragerCode is not declared on GLLine and matched nothing.

spentToDate.description: Sum of GL debit postings tagged to this cost-center dimension (recursive over descendant cost-centers via parentCode self-relation) per REQ-CPA-106. Excludes eliminated intercompany lines. Scoped dimensionType = cost-center.

allocatedBudget.description: Roll-up budget for cost-center dimensions per REQ-CPA-107: this dimension's own budget plus the allocatedBudget of every child cost-center reached via the parentCode self-relation (recursive descent). Applies only when dimensionType = cost-center.

budgetVariance.description: Budget-vs-actuals variance for project-flavoured cost centers per REQ-RCP-001: authorised spend ceiling minus GL-derived costs incurred to date. Mirrors the retired CostProject.budgetVariance. Positive = under budget, negative = over budget. Applies only when dimensionType = project and totalBudget is set; zero otherwise.

AnnualBudget.title: Annual Budget
AnnualBudget.description: The fiscal-year budget container (begroting), crossed with LedgerGroup via BudgetLine (REQ-BCS-006). Carries the one-default invariant AnnualBudgetDefaultGuard enforces on the activate transition: at most one AnnualBudget per administrationId + fiscalYear may have isDefault=true — aligned now so the budget-scenarios follow-up change does not need to retrofit it (design.md §4b).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this budget.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year this budget applies to.
fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default AnnualBudget for its administrationId + fiscalYear. Governs WHICH ONE WINS when more than one active budget could theoretically exist for the same year (e.g. a draft alternate/scenario budget under budget-scenarios) — a separate axis from state, which governs editability (design.md §4b).
isDefault.title: Is Default

state.description: Lifecycle state. draft: under construction, lines editable. active: the budget in force for its fiscal year, lines still editable. closed: locked at year-end, superseded, retained for audit.
state.title: State

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Under construction; lines editable.

active.label: Active
active.description: The budget in force for its fiscal year; lines still editable.

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: Locked at year-end; superseded, retained for audit.

activate.label: Activate budget
activate.description: Requires no other AnnualBudget with isDefault=true for the same administrationId+fiscalYear (REQ-BCS-006).

close.label: Close budget
close.description: Year-end lock; no further line edits.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of an AnnualBudget is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on AnnualReport with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this jaarrekening.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

financialYearStart.description: First day of the boekjaar covered by this jaarrekening.
financialYearStart.title: Boekjaar Start

financialYearEnd.description: Last day (balansdatum) of the boekjaar. Drives all wettelijke termijnen per art. 2:391 BW (REQ-T9-010).
financialYearEnd.title: Boekjaar Eind

sizeCategory.description: Computed size category per art. 2:395a-398 BW two-of-three criterion over two consecutive boekjaren (REQ-T9-001). Computed, not operator-selectable (design D1); operator override requires groottecategorieOnderbouwing.override with motivatie.
sizeCategory.title: Groottecategorie

sizeCategorySubstantiation.description: Supporting numerics behind the groottecategorie classification (REQ-T9-001). Holds the two-of-three criterion values per boekjaar plus the matched-criteria count.

balanceSheetTotal.description: Balanstotaal (balance sheet total) used in classification.
balanceSheetTotal.title: Balans Totaal

averageCountEmployees.description: Gemiddeld aantal werknemers (average number of employees).
averageCountEmployees.title: Gemiddeld Aantal Werknemers

criteriaMatched.description: Number of the three criteria that fall within the category band.
criteriaMatched.title: Criteria Matched

override.description: True when an operator overrode the computed category (design D1).
override.title: Override

overrideRationale.description: Required justification when override is true.
overrideRationale.title: Override Motivatie

sizeCategorySubstantiation.title: Groottecategorie Onderbouwing

rapportageBasis.description: Reporting basis (waarderingsgrondslag). rj-commercial is the Titel 9 default.
rapportageBasis.title: Rapportage Grondslag

currency.description: ISO-4217 presentation currency of the jaarrekening.
currency.title: Valuta

status.description: Lifecycle status (REQ-T9-010). draft: real-time, editable; opgemaakt: bestuur-signed immutable snapshot; in-review: under accountant review (bestuur read-only); determined: AV-approved, frozen; gedeponeerd: filed at KVK.
status.title: Status

layoutDate.description: Date the bestuur marked Opgemaakt (snapshot taken). Wettelijke termijn: 5 months after boekjaarEind, extendable to 10 (REQ-T9-010).
layoutDate.title: Opmaak Datum

determinationDate.description: Date the AV vaststelde the jaarrekening. Within 2 months after opmaak (REQ-T9-010).
determinationDate.title: Vaststelling Datum

depositDate.description: Date the jaarrekening was deponed at KVK. Within 8 days after vaststelling; absolute deadline 12 months after boekjaarEind (REQ-T9-010).
depositDate.title: Depositering Datum

snapshotHash.description: Cryptographic hash of the immutable snapshot taken at opmaak (REQ-T9-010, design D2). Set by the opmaak action.
snapshotHash.title: Snapshot Hash

auditorsStatementRequired.description: True when an accountantsverklaring is wettelijk verplicht (middelgroot+; REQ-T9-007/REQ-T9-009).
auditorsStatementRequired.title: Accountantsverklaring Vereist

auditorsStatementStatus.description: Status/type of the accountantsverklaring (NV-COS 700/4410/2400) per REQ-T9-007.
auditorsStatementStatus.title: Accountantsverklaring Status

cashFlowStatementRequired.description: True for middelgroot+ where a kasstroomoverzicht is verplicht (REQ-T9-005/REQ-T9-009).
cashFlowStatementRequired.title: Kasstroomoverzicht Vereist

boardReportRequired.description: True for middelgroot+ where a bestuursverslag is verplicht (REQ-T9-006/REQ-T9-009).
boardReportRequired.title: Bestuursverslag Vereist

boardMembers.description: Names of the bestuursleden who sign the opmaak (REQ-T9-010).
boardMembers.title: Bestuur Leden

shareholdersJSONB.description: Shareholder structure snapshot relevant to disclosure (free-form per administration).
shareholdersJSONB.title: Aandeelhouders Jsonb

decisionRef.description: Decidesk Decision id for the AV/board adoption (REQ-SIGN-002). Written only by the decidesk registry callback.
decisionRef.title: Decision Ref

decisionOutcome.description: Mirror of the adoption Decision outcome (REQ-SIGN-002). The vaststellen transition is OUTCOME-DRIVEN — fires only when decisionOutcome==approved.
decisionOutcome.title: Decision Outcome

AnnualReport.title: Annual Report
AnnualReport.description: Titel 9 Boek 2 BW jaarrekening root record for one administration and one boekjaar (REQ-T9-001, REQ-T9-010). Carries the computed groottecategorie with its onderbouwing, the rapportagegrondslag, valuta, and the concept -> opgemaakt -> in-review -> vastgesteld -> gedeponeerd lifecycle with its wettelijke termijnen. The constituent documents (BalanceSheet, IncomeStatement, CashFlowStatement, Note, DirectorReport) reference this record by reportId. Groottecategorie is computed, not operator-selectable (design D1); the report becomes an immutable snapshot at opmaak (design D2). No AnnualReportService PHP class; generation is templated per ADR-022/ADR-031.

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Earliest form; balans/V&W recalculate as the GL changes (REQ-T9-010). Editable.

opgemaakt.label: Opgemaakt door bestuur
opgemaakt.description: Bestuur-signed; an immutable snapshot is taken and all figures freeze (design D2).

in-review.label: In review (accountant)
in-review.description: Under accountant review. Bestuur source data is read-only until the review is cancelled (REQ-T9-007).

determined.label: Vastgesteld door AV
determined.description: Approved by the algemene vergadering; final snapshot frozen; deponering activated (REQ-T9-010).

gedeponeerd.label: Gedeponeerd bij KVK
gedeponeerd.description: Filed at KVK via SBR-XBRL; immutable final state (REQ-T9-008).

opmaken.label: Opmaken door bestuur
opmaken.description: Bestuur signs the concept; an immutable snapshot is created (REQ-T9-010, design D2). Requires the balans to balance (activa = passiva).

naarReview.label: Indienen voor accountantscontrole
naarReview.description: Submit the opgemaakte jaarrekening to the accountant. Bestuur source data becomes read-only (REQ-T9-007).

reviewAnnuleren.label: Review annuleren
reviewAnnuleren.description: Cancel the review to re-open bestuur editing (REQ-T9-007). The accountant change-log is retained.

vaststellenZonderReview.label: Vaststellen door AV
vaststellenZonderReview.description: AV approves directly where no accountantsverklaring is verplicht (klein/micro; REQ-T9-007/REQ-T9-009). OUTCOME-DRIVEN per REQ-SIGN-003: requires adoption decisionOutcome==approved from decidesk.

vaststellen.label: Vaststellen na review
vaststellen.description: AV approves after accountant sign-off; an accountantsverklaring MUST be attached for middelgroot+ (REQ-T9-007/REQ-T9-010). OUTCOME-DRIVEN per REQ-SIGN-003: requires adoption decisionOutcome==approved from decidesk.

deponeren.label: Deponeren bij KVK
deponeren.description: Hand the final AnnualReport snapshot to bookkeeping-sbr-xbrl-reporting for SBR-XBRL conversion and Digipoort submission (REQ-T9-008).

actions.description: Emit a CloudEvent consumed by bookkeeping-sbr-xbrl-reporting to convert the snapshot to SBR-XBRL and submit via Digipoort (REQ-T9-008). Cross-module integration point; no PHP orchestration here (ADR-022).

subject.en: Annual report adopted by the general meeting

body.nl: De jaarrekening voor boekjaar {{boekjaarEind}} is vastgesteld via decidesk.
body.en: The annual report for fiscal year {{boekjaarEind}} was adopted via decidesk.

body.nl: De vaststelling van de jaarrekening voor boekjaar {{boekjaarEind}} is afgewezen via decidesk.
body.en: The adoption of the annual report for fiscal year {{boekjaarEind}} was rejected via decidesk.

Appointment.title: Appointment
Appointment.description: A booked appointment linking a customer contact to a Service and Resource at a specific UTC time window. The single source of truth for the bookings create flow (admin, customer self-service, API) per bookings-create-appointment. Validation (duration match, double-booking, operational hours, customer eligibility) runs in the AppointmentGuard save precondition (ADR-031 exception path) per REQ-BCA-003/004/006.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this appointment for tenant isolation and IDOR-safe scoping.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

appointmentId.description: Unique appointment identifier within the administration.
appointmentId.title: Appointment ID

startTime.description: Appointment start time as ISO 8601 UTC per design D6.
startTime.title: Start Time

endTime.description: Appointment end time as ISO 8601 UTC. endTime - startTime must match Service.duration within tolerance per REQ-BCA-003.
endTime.title: End Time

customerId.description: FK to the customer contact record (Nextcloud contact / IManager-synced). A customer is a Nextcloud contact entity, not a bespoke schema, per fleet convention.
customerId.title: Customer ID

status.description: Appointment lifecycle status. Admin bookings create as confirmed; customer self-service bookings create as pending_confirmation per REQ-BCA-005.
status.title: Status

notes.description: Customer-provided notes or special requests.
notes.title: Notes

cancelledAt.description: Timestamp when the appointment was cancelled (set by phase-2 cancellation flow).
cancelledAt.title: Cancelled At

cancelledReason.description: Reason for cancellation (set by phase-2 cancellation flow).
cancelledReason.title: Cancelled Reason

customerName.description: Customer full name captured by the public widget at booking time (1-255 chars). Write-only via the public widget API; never returned by widget read endpoints (design D6). Additive widget extension of the canonical bookings-create-appointment Appointment schema; the canonical customerId FK is still set to a generated guest identifier.
customerName.title: Customer Name

customerEmail.description: Customer email (RFC 5322) captured by the public widget. Write-only; never returned by widget read endpoints.
customerEmail.title: Customer Email

customerPhone.description: Optional customer phone (E.164) captured by the public widget. Write-only.
customerPhone.title: Customer Phone

source.description: Channel the appointment originated from. 'widget' marks self-service public bookings (REQ-WSW-003). Additive widget extension.
source.title: Source

appliedPolicy.description: Snapshot of the CancellationPolicy terms in force at appointment-creation time (design D2): policyId, minNoticeDays, lateFeeBrackets, noShowFee, refundPolicy. Used for fee calculation so later policy edits do not alter historical bookings.
appliedPolicy.title: Applied Policy

appointmentCost.description: Appointment cost in integer cents, used as the base for cancellation-fee calculation (design D4).
appointmentCost.title: Appointment Cost

refundAmount.description: Amount eligible for refund in integer cents = appointmentCost - fee, never negative (design D4). Set at cancellation.
refundAmount.title: Refund Amount

refundStatus.description: Refund lifecycle (design D6). Set to pending on cancellation; transitioned by phase 3 payment integration.
refundStatus.title: Refund Status

refundedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the refund completed (set in phase 3).
refundedAt.title: Refunded At

seriesId.description: FK to AppointmentSeries.seriesId when this appointment was generated from a recurring series; null for a standalone booking.
seriesId.title: Series

status._note: DELIBERATELY LEFT DUTCH — do not anglicise these values piecemeal. RenameDutchValueDecisions::VALUE_MAP is keyed by PROPERTY NAME and every entry applies REGISTER-WIDE, so a `status` entry translating `in_behandeling` or `afgewezen` would also rewrite stored rows of Rechtmatigheidstoets.status, Rechtmatigheidsbevinding.status and JournalEntry.lawfulness.status (bookkeeping-rechtmatigheidsverantwoording.json) plus ReviewWorkflow's nested step/comment statuses (bookkeeping-titel-9-jaarrekening.json) — all of which still declare the Dutch enum. Schema and data would silently desync: OpenRegister does not reject an out-of-enum stored value, the filter just returns nothing. A wholly Dutch enum is honest; a half-renamed one is a trap. Anglicise this only together with those fragments, or after the value map grows a schema-scoped key.

The per-topic verdict (acceptable/qualified/adverse) and the derived opinion require the materialiteit-relative ceiling comparison + the BADO decision tree, which the declarative engine cannot yet express, so the service is the engine-side fallback (ADR-031).
