totalBudget.label: Total budget per programme
totalBudget.description: Sum of GL-budget × (allocation% / 100) over every BudgetBBVMapping pointing at this programme. Pure arithmetic — declarative per ADR-031. Carries REQ-BBVW-005 (TotalBudget(P) = Σ GL-budget × allocation%).
Integer-cent total budget for the programme. Engine MUST evaluate as integer-cent arithmetic to avoid float drift (ADR-031 money rule).

ytdSpend.label: YTD spend per programme
ytdSpend.description: Sum of GL transaction amounts on mapped GL accounts (where postingDate ≤ today AND postingDate ≥ fiscalYear-start) × allocation%, per programme. Pure arithmetic — declarative per ADR-031. Carries REQ-BBVW-005 (YTDSpend(P) = Σ GL.amount × allocation% per mapping).
Integer-cent year-to-date spend. Engine MUST evaluate as integer-cent arithmetic to avoid float drift (ADR-031 money rule).

utilization.label: Utilization ratio
utilization.description: Ratio of YTD spend to total budget per programme. Pure arithmetic over the two aggregations above. Carries REQ-BBVW-005 (Utilization(P) = YTDSpend / TotalBudget).
Dimensionless ratio in [0, ∞). Engine MUST compute as cents/cents to retain precision; the ratio itself is allowed to be a float.

complianceStatus.label: Compliance status
complianceStatus.description: Derived enum bucket per REQ-BBVW-005 thresholds. 'unconfigured' if no BudgetBBVMapping exists for the programme; otherwise the threshold against utilization. Computed at query time, NEVER persisted as a stored column (giant D3 / ADR-031).

hasMappings.description: Truthy when at least one BudgetBBVMapping resolves a non-zero allocated budget for this programme.

complianceStatus.description: Carries REQ-BBVW-005 thresholds: unconfigured | on-track ≤ 75% | at-risk 75–90% | non-compliant > 90%. Boundary semantics (≤ vs <) match the giant — utilization == 0.75 is on-track, utilization == 0.90 is at-risk, utilization > 0.90 is non-compliant.

programmeCodeUniquePerYear.description: Per REQ-BBVW-008, programmeCode SHALL be unique within (administrationId, fiscalYear). Two BBVProgramme records sharing all three values MUST be rejected on save.
programmeCodeUniquePerYear.errorMessage: A BBV programme with this code already exists for the selected fiscal year. Programme codes must be unique per (administration, fiscalYear).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on BalanceSheet with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

totalAssets.description: Computed total assets. MUST equal totalPassiva (balans balances).
totalAssets.title: Total Activa

totalLiabilities.description: Computed total liabilities + equity. MUST equal totalActiva.
totalLiabilities.title: Total Passiva

status.description: draft while the parent AnnualReport is draft; final once opgemaakt (design D2).
status.title: Status

rubrieken.description: Wettelijke rubriek lines per art. 2:373 BW. Rubriek codes are first-class data (design D3).

rubrieckCode.description: Wettelijke rubriek code per art. 2:373 BW (e.g. B.I, B.II, C.II, A, D).
rubrieckCode.title: Rubrieck Code

side.description: Which side of the balans this rubriek belongs to.
side.title: Zijde

notes.description: FK references to linked Note records (toelichting).
notes.title: Notes

rubrieken.title: Rubrieken

reportDate.description: Snapshot date of the balance sheet (typically fiscal-year-end).
reportDate.title: Report Date

totalEquity.description: Computed total equity in base currency. Populated by balance-sheet aggregation on draft→final transition.
totalEquity.title: Total Equity

isBalanced.description: Computed flag: totalAssets = totalLiabilities + totalEquity. Surfaced with diagnostic when false.
isBalanced.title: Is Balanced

fiscalYearId.description: FK to the FiscalYear this balance sheet covers.
fiscalYearId.title: Fiscal Year ID

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this balance sheet belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

BalanceSheet.title: Balance Sheet
BalanceSheet.description: Balans conforming to art. 2:373 BW (REQ-T9-002). Activa split into vaste activa (B.I immaterieel, B.II materieel, B.III financieel) and vlottende activa (C.I voorraden, C.II vorderingen, C.III effecten, C.IV liquide middelen); passiva split into A eigen vermogen, B voorzieningen, C langlopende schulden, D kortlopende schulden. Each rubriek carries huidigJaar, vorigJaar (comparatief) and footnote references. GL-to-rubriek mapping is configuration (lib/Settings/seeds/balans-rubriek-mapping.json), not code (design D3).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Balance sheet under preparation; GL entries may still be posted.

final.label: Final
final.description: GL period closed; all entries posted; aggregations computed and verified.

published.label: Published
published.description: Released to stakeholders via OR publication extension. Immutable — no further edits.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Retained for audit trail per administration retention policy.

finalise.label: Finalise balance sheet
finalise.description: Operator or scheduled workflow closes fiscal period. Triggers balance-sheet aggregation (REQ-FS-004).

publish.label: Publish balance sheet
publish.description: Operator (role: controller) releases to stakeholders via OR publication extension or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031.

archive.label: Archive balance sheet
archive.description: Operator archives after retention period per administration retention policy.

onFinalise.description: Fire balance-sheet aggregation to populate totalAssets, totalLiabilities, totalEquity, and isBalanced from GL entries (REQ-FS-004). Also triggers TrialBalance finalisation for the same fiscalYearId and administrationId.

onPublish.description: Publication workflow via OR publication extension (ADR-022) or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031. Records publication timestamp and actor. Marks statement immutable.

balanceSheetTotals.description: Computes totalAssets, totalLiabilities, totalEquity from GLLine entries grouped by Account.accountType for the fiscal period. Satisfies REQ-FS-004. No BalanceSheetService — pure declarative aggregation per ADR-031.

isBalanced.diagnostic: Balance-sheet equation violated: assets({{totalAssets}}) ≠ liabilities({{totalLiabilities}}) + equity({{totalEquity}})

BankAccount.title: Bank Account
BankAccount.description: A bank account held by a Shillinq administration. Holds the IBAN / BIC / bank name plus the optional `primaryCurrency` (ISO 4217, REQ-MC-002) declaration. Existing single-currency deployments may leave `primaryCurrency` null — the system treats null as EUR on read (REQ-MC-001 scenario 'Single-currency account without primaryCurrency declared'). Multi-currency tracking is delegated to CurrencyBalance snapshots keyed on (accountId, currency).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: BankAccount changes (IBAN remapping, primaryCurrency reclassification, lifecycle transitions) MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — every change is bookkeeping-relevant (it influences cash-position reporting, reconciliation, FX scope) and is subject to operator + auditor review.

iban.description: IBAN of the bank account (ISO 13616). Used as the natural-key for reconciliation against BankStatement.
iban.title: IBAN

bic.description: BIC / SWIFT code of the bank holding the account (ISO 9362). Optional — only required for non-SEPA payments.
bic.title: BIC

bankName.description: Display name of the bank that issued the account (e.g. ABN AMRO, Rabobank, Bunq).
bankName.title: Bank Name

primaryCurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency code declaring the native currency of the account (REQ-MC-002). Optional; null is treated as 'EUR' on read for backward compatibility (REQ-MC-001 scenario 'Single-currency account without primaryCurrency declared'). MUST be exactly three uppercase letters when set. Examples: EUR, USD, GBP.
primaryCurrency.title: Primary Currency

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this bank account. One bank account belongs to exactly one administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

lifecycleState.description: Lifecycle of the bank account: `active` (in normal use), `closed` (no further postings), `frozen` (manual hold). Default `active`.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

notes.description: Free-text operator notes about the account (purpose, restrictions, mandates).
notes.example: Main operational EUR account; used for SEPA payment runs.
notes.title: Notes

currency.description: Base currency of the account (ISO 4217). Kept for backwards compatibility with T1 GL accounts; use primaryCurrency for multi-currency declarations.
currency.title: Currency

balance.description: Current balance (legacy single-currency field). Multi-currency balances are tracked via CurrencyBalance register.
balance.title: Balance

active.label: Active
active.description: Bank account is active and available for multi-currency balance tracking.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Bank account is archived; historical CurrencyBalance records remain queryable.

archive.label: Archive account
archive.description: Archive the bank account without deleting balance history.

reactivate.label: Reactivate account
reactivate.description: Restore the bank account to active status.

balanceByCurrency.description: Latest balance per currency for this bank account. Aggregates CurrencyBalance records grouped by currency. Used for T3 cash-position dashboards per REQ-MC-004.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on BankConnection with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

connectionNumber.description: Operator-readable reference for this bank connection.
connectionNumber.title: Connection Number

aggregator.description: PSD2 AIS aggregator providing the connection. Credentials live in the corresponding openconnector Source record.
aggregator.title: Aggregator

aggregatorSourceSlug.description: FK to the openconnector Source slug that holds the aggregator OAuth credentials. shillinq carries this reference only; credentials never land here.
aggregatorSourceSlug.title: Aggregator Source Slug

bankBic.description: BIC/SWIFT code of the bank the connection covers.
bankBic.title: Bank BIC

bankCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the bank.
bankCountry.title: Bank Country

bankAccountIban.description: IBAN of the linked bank account.
bankAccountIban.title: Bank Account IBAN

consentReference.description: Aggregator-issued consent identifier returned from the SCA flow. Non-credential metadata — NOT an OAuth token or client secret.
consentReference.title: Consent Reference

consentGrantedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the PSD2 consent was granted.
consentGrantedAt.title: Consent Granted At

consentExpiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the PSD2 consent expires. PSD2 mandates SCA renewal every 90 days.
consentExpiresAt.title: Consent Expires At

consentRemainingDays.description: Derived (do not set directly): days until the PSD2 consent expires. Negative when already expired. Materialised via x-openregister-calculations.
consentRemainingDays.title: Consent Remaining Days

lastSyncAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent successful transaction pull.
lastSyncAt.title: Last Sync At

lifecycleState.description: Current PSD2 consent lifecycle state.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this bank connection.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

BankConnection.title: Bank Connection
BankConnection.description: A PSD2 AIS bank connection authorising access to one or more bank accounts via an openconnector aggregator source. Credentials live in openconnector; this record carries the consent reference only.

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: SCA consent flow not yet completed; connection not usable.

active.label: Active
active.description: Consent granted and valid; transaction polling enabled.

expiring.label: Expiring
expiring.description: Consent expires within 14 days; operator must trigger renewal.

expired.label: Expired
expired.description: Consent has lapsed; transaction polling suspended until renewed.

revoked.label: Revoked
revoked.description: Operator or bank revoked consent; connection permanently disabled.

activate.label: Activate connection
activate.description: SCA consent flow completed successfully; activate the connection.

expire.label: Mark as expired
expire.description: Auto-transition fires when consentExpiresAt is reached.

renew.label: Renew consent
renew.description: Operator triggered SCA renewal via openconnector source reauthorise action; updates consentReference and consentExpiresAt on success.

onEnterExpiring.description: Notify configured recipient 14 days before consent expires.

consentRemainingDays.description: Number of days until the PSD2 consent expires. Negative when already expired. JSON-AST: diffDays(consentExpiresAt, now()).

shillinq-bank-transaction-polling.name: Bank transaction polling
shillinq-bank-transaction-polling.description: Pulls transactions from the PSD2 aggregator via the openconnector source slug, normalises the aggregator JSON to CAMT.053 XML, attaches the XML via docudesk, and creates a BankStatement record per active BankConnection. Runs 4× daily per REQ-BC-004. No BankPollingJob extends TimedJob.

BankReconciliation.title: Bank Reconciliation
BankReconciliation.description: One bank-account reconciliation session for a fiscal period. Tracks statement opening/closing balance, the server-recomputed reconciled balance, the residual variance, and an auditable status lifecycle (draft → in-progress → reconciled → archived). Per REQ-BBR-001/005/006. All monetary fields are stored as EUR with 2-decimal precision; reconciledBalance and variance are server-authoritative — recomputed by BankReconciliationGuard in integer cents and never trusted from the client.

bankAccountId.description: FK to the bank account being reconciled. A plain reference string; the bank-account register is owned by a separate spec (bookkeeping-bank-connectors) and only consumed here.
bankAccountId.title: Bank Account ID

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this reconciliation. Scopes per-tenant isolation for IDOR-safe queries per ADR-005.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

statementStartDate.description: First date on the bank statement.
statementStartDate.title: Statement Start Date

statementEndDate.description: Last date on the bank statement. Must be on or after statementStartDate (REQ-BBR-001 validation).
statementEndDate.title: Statement End Date

openingBalance.description: Balance at statement start, taken from the bank statement (EUR, 2 decimals). Operator-supplied.
openingBalance.title: Opening Balance

closingBalance.description: Balance at statement end, taken from the bank statement (EUR, 2 decimals). Operator-supplied.
closingBalance.title: Closing Balance

reconciledBalance.description: Derived: openingBalance + sum(approved match amounts). Server-authoritative — recomputed by BankReconciliationGuard::recalculateBalance in integer cents on every match change; never accepted from the client (REQ-BBR-005).
reconciledBalance.title: Reconciled Balance

variance.description: Derived: closingBalance − reconciledBalance. Server-authoritative; recomputed alongside reconciledBalance (REQ-BBR-005).
variance.title: Variance

unmatchedBankCount.description: Count of bank transactions without an approved journal match. Server-recomputed.
unmatchedBankCount.title: Unmatched Bank Count

unmatchedJournalCount.description: Count of journal entries without an approved bank match. Server-recomputed.
unmatchedJournalCount.title: Unmatched Journal Count

status.description: Lifecycle state. Driven by x-openregister-lifecycle; do not set directly to reconciled/archived — use the approve/archive transitions (REQ-BBR-006/009).
status.title: Status

approvedBy.description: User ID of the operator who approved the reconciliation. Set by the approve transition.
approvedBy.title: Approved By

approvedAt.description: Timestamp of approval. Set by the approve transition.
approvedAt.title: Approved At

varianceReason.description: Operator-documented explanation of a non-zero variance, captured at approval for the audit trail (REQ-BBR-006).
varianceReason.example: Bank charged €5.00 monthly fee (posted 2026-06-01, not yet journaled).
varianceReason.title: Variance Reason

notes.description: Free-text operator notes on discrepancies.
notes.title: Notes

statementDate.description: The statement issue date (period-end date by convention).
statementDate.title: Statement Date

statementPeriodStart.description: First day of the reconciliation period (inclusive).
statementPeriodStart.title: Statement Period Start

statementPeriodEnd.description: Last day of the reconciliation period (inclusive).
statementPeriodEnd.title: Statement Period End

expectedGLBalance.description: Expected GL balance computed per REQ-REC-002 formula: Account.balanceAtPeriodStart + SUM(GLLine.debit - GLLine.credit) for the period. Server-authoritative — populated by StatementVerifyGuard, never trusted from the client.
expectedGLBalance.title: Expected GL Balance

reconciliationStatus.description: Lifecycle state per REQ-REC-003. See x-openregister-lifecycle for the transition map and guards.
reconciliationStatus.title: Reconciliation Status

preparedBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the operator who initiated the reconciliation. Populated on the `initiate` transition (REQ-REC-009).
preparedBy.title: Prepared By

verifiedBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the verifier who confirmed all unmatched items resolved (REQ-REC-006). Populated on the `verify` transition.
verifiedBy.title: Verified By

closedAt.description: UTC datetime when the reconciliation transitioned `verified → closed`. Once set, no further edits per REQ-REC-003.
closedAt.title: Closed At

signOffComment.description: Verifier sign-off note required on `in-progress → verified` per REQ-REC-006. Empty value blocks the transition.
signOffComment.title: Sign Off Comment

unmatchedGLCount.description: Server-derived count of GL transactions in the statement period without a confirmed match.
unmatchedGLCount.title: Unmatched GL Count

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Session created; statement not yet imported. Editable.

in-progress.label: In progress
in-progress.description: Statement imported and auto-matching has run; operator is resolving exceptions. Editable.

reconciled.label: Reconciled
reconciled.description: Approved and locked for audit. Immutable — no further match changes (REQ-BBR-006); corrections require a new session.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Closed and moved to the archive view. Queryable for audit, not editable (REQ-BBR-009).

startReconciling.label: Start reconciling
startReconciling.description: Statement imported and auto-matching has run.

approve.label: Approve reconciliation
approve.description: Lock the reconciliation for audit. All pending-review matches must be resolved first; reconciledBalance and variance are recomputed server-side before locking (REQ-BBR-006).

approveFromDraft.label: Approve reconciliation
approveFromDraft.description: Direct approval for a trivially-empty statement; same resolved-matches precondition applies.

archive.label: Archive reconciliation
archive.description: Move the reconciled session to the archive view (REQ-BBR-009).

countByStatus.description: Number of reconciliation sessions per lifecycle status, for the index status filter and dashboard.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: REQ-REC-009: every lifecycle transition (preparer, verifier, sign-off comment, timestamp) appended to an immutable audit trail per ADR-022.

BankReconciliationGroup.title: Bank Reconciliation Group
BankReconciliationGroup.description: A multi-administration bank-reconciliation run across all participants of a pool (REQ-IHB-009). Links one bank line to GL entries from several administrations in a single workflow (typical for shared-service-centre payments), with an auto-match score and an exception queue for operator review.

participatingAdministrationIds.description: Administrations whose ledgers are searched for matches (REQ-IHB-009).
participatingAdministrationIds.title: Participating Administration Ids

autoMatchedCount.description: Number of bank lines auto-matched at score >= 95%.
autoMatchedCount.title: Auto Matched Count

manualMatchesRequired.description: Number of lines needing operator review.
manualMatchesRequired.title: Manual Matches Required

exceptionQueue.description: Lines below the auto-match threshold with suggested candidates.

bankLineId.title: Bank Line ID

suggestedMatches.title: Suggested Matches

operator.title: Operator

exceptionQueue.title: Exception Queue

state.description: Reconciliation-run lifecycle (REQ-IHB-009).
state.title: State

retention.description: Reconciliation runs retained 7 years per AWR art. 52.

draft.label: Concept

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Bank Reconciliation Group is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

BankReconciliationMatch.title: Bank Reconciliation Match
BankReconciliationMatch.description: One paired transaction: a bank-statement line matched to a journal entry (APTransaction, GLLine, or Payment). Auto-matching is deterministic by amount + date ± reference; ambiguous and orphaned items are flagged pending-review for operator resolution. Every decision is timestamped and attributed (REQ-BBR-002/003/004/008). The bank transaction is NOT embedded as a full object — only a reference key + cached amount are stored (design D3).

bankTransactionRef.description: Deduplicating bank-transaction key: {bankAccountId}#{statementDate}#{amount}#{externalId}. Stable across re-imports of the same statement.
bankTransactionRef.title: Bank Transaction Ref

bankTransactionAmount.description: Amount from the bank statement, cached for display and for the reconciledBalance recomputation (EUR, 2 decimals).
bankTransactionAmount.title: Bank Transaction Amount

journalEntryId.description: FK to the matched journal entry (APTransaction, GLLine, or Payment). Null when unmatched/orphaned.
journalEntryId.title: Journal Entry ID

journalEntryDescription.description: Cached description of the matched journal entry for display.
journalEntryDescription.title: Journal Entry Description

matchType.description: Match lifecycle state. Only approved matches contribute to reconciledBalance (REQ-BBR-005).
matchType.title: Match Type

confidenceScore.description: Auto-match confidence 0–100 (+100 exact amount, +20 reference found, −10 per day past deadline). ≥70 = auto-matched; 30–69 = pending-review; <30 = orphaned (journalEntryId null).
confidenceScore.title: Confidence Score

operatorNotes.example: Matched by invoice reference in memo field.
operatorNotes.title: Operator Notes

createdBy.description: User ID of the creator, or 'system-auto-match' for engine-created matches.
createdBy.title: Created By

approvedAt.description: When the operator approved this match.
approvedAt.title: Approved At

auto-matched.label: Auto-matched

pending-review.label: Pending review

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Operator-confirmed. Contributes to reconciledBalance.

rejected.label: Rejected

approve.label: Approve match

approvePending.label: Approve match

countByType.description: Number of matches per matchType, for the detail-page match summary.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Bank Reconciliation Match is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

Barcode.title: Barcode
Barcode.description: A scannable code (EAN, GTIN, UPC, SSCC, or internal) bound to a Product at a specific unit-of-measure. Declared as a separate register (not an inline array on Product) so barcodes are individually queryable, auditable, and have an independent lifecycle (deactivate without delete). Consumed by the shillinq barcode lookup endpoint and the pipelinq pos-barcode-scan module. Spec: inventory-barcode-sku. Depends on inventory-product-catalog (Product schema). bcf-claim-submit-approval.description: Approval chain that gates the BcfClaim draft → submitted transition (REQ-BCF-006). The transition runs through OpenRegister's approval-workflow primitive: a single approver with the role bcf-administrator must approve within 7 days (configurable). On approval the claim advances to submitted and is queued for the next quarterly digikoppeling-bcf ScheduledWorkflow run; on rejection the claim stays draft and the operator is notified with the rejection comment. Declarative metadata only — OR materialises the actual approval task; this app ships no PHP approval-chain implementation.

bcf-claim-settled.description: Settlement webhook routing (REQ-BCF-007). OR's generic webhook handler routes inbound CloudEvents of type nl.conduction.bcf-claim-settled to BcfClaim and applies the settle transition. The event payload is { type, objectId, data: { state: 'settled', settledAmount, settledDate } }. The handler verifies the OpenConnector signature, looks the BcfClaim up by objectId (administration scope enforced via the audit-trail context), sets state=settled + settledOn=settledDate + settledAmount=settledAmount, and records the webhook event in the audit trail (source=webhook, event-id, timestamp, payload-hash). Lost webhooks do not block — the operator can transition accepted → settled manually via the detail page as a fallback.

BillableInvoice.title: Billable Invoice
BillableInvoice.description: Invoice materialised from approved time entries + expenses with explicit billing-model semantics. Companion to the canonical Invoice (from bookings-deposit-to-invoice); the BillableInvoice carries the model-specific projection while the Invoice carries the AR-aging-facing record. The billingModel is set once at draft time and immutable after posting (REQ-ITE-001, D1). Source-id arrays (timeEntryIds, expenseIds) are checked for duplicates against existing posted/draft BillableInvoice rows before generation (REQ-ITE-006, D9).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on BillableInvoiceLine with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration (mirror of parent invoice for tenant-scoped queries).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

sourceId.description: FK to the source record (UrenRegistratie ID for time_entry, ExpenseClaimEntry ID for expense, RetainerSchedule ID for retainer_charge). Null for fixed_fee and manual.
sourceId.title: Source ID

description.description: Customer-facing line description rendered on the PDF.
description.title: Description

billableUnits.description: Hours (for time_entry) or count (for expense / retainer_charge). Pre-multiplier figure used for the rate × units display.
billableUnits.title: Billable Units

rateApplied.description: Snapshot of the rate used: {rateCents (integer cents), currency, rateCardVersion, effectiveDate}. Null when the line is not rate-based (expense / fixed_fee / manual).
rateApplied.title: Rate Applied

markup.description: Markup percentage applied to (rate × units). Per-invoice in T2; per-line markup is T3+.
markup.title: Markup

costAmount.description: Final line cost in euros after rate × units × (1 + markup/100). Persisted as integer cents in services for exact arithmetic.
costAmount.title: Cost Amount

vatRate.description: VAT/BTW percentage for this line. Dutch invoices use 21 / 9 / 6 / 0.
vatRate.title: VAT Rate

vatAmount.description: VAT amount in euros (= costAmount × vatRate / 100, rounded to €0.01 with bankers' rounding).
vatAmount.title: VAT Amount

modelSpecificFields.description: Model-specific metadata: {milestoneId, milestoneCompletedAt, milestoneName, milestoneBudget} for milestone; {retainerMonth: 'YYYY-MM'} for retainer; {} otherwise.
modelSpecificFields.title: Model Specific Fields

BillableInvoiceLine.title: Billable Invoice Line
BillableInvoiceLine.description: Single line item on a BillableInvoice. sourceType identifies the originating record (time_entry, expense, retainer_charge, fixed_fee, manual). rateApplied snapshots the applicable RateCard rate so historical invoices preserve their original rates if the rate card is later amended (REQ-ITE-003, D2). modelSpecificFields carries milestone/retainer-month metadata when applicable.

BlanketOrder.title: Blanket Order
BlanketOrder.description: Blancokorder — a master commitment with call-off releases drawn over months and remaining-quantity tracking (design D8).

committedQuantity.title: Committed Quantity

calledOffQuantity.description: Quantity released through call-off SalesOrders so far.
calledOffQuantity.title: Called Off Quantity

agreedUnitPrice.description: Agreed unit price for the commitment.
agreedUnitPrice.title: Agreed Unit Price

callOffOrderReferences.title: Call Off Order References

expiryHandling.title: Expiry Handling

administrationId.title: Administration ID

remainingQuantity.description: remainingQuantity = max(committedQuantity - calledOffQuantity, 0). Declarative per ADR-031 (design D8).

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: A scheduled appointment on a resource's calendar per bookings-resource-calendar REQ-003. Times are stored in UTC (ISO 8601). The resource FK is denormalized from the calendar for efficient per-resource conflict queries.

calendar.description: FK to the Calendar this booking belongs to.
calendar.title: Calendar

resource.description: Denormalized FK to the Resource (mirrors Calendar.resource) for efficient conflict queries per design Decision 4.
resource.title: Resource

endTime.description: Appointment end time in UTC (ISO 8601). Must be after startTime.
endTime.title: End Time

status.description: Booking lifecycle status. A pending booking that overlaps another is flagged as conflicting in the UI.
status.title: Status

externalId.description: Optional external calendar event ID for future Tier-3 sync (Google/Outlook).
externalId.title: External ID

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this booking for tenant isolation (ADR-005).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

bookingId.description: Operator-assigned unique booking identifier within the administration.
bookingId.title: Booking ID

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: Submitted but not yet confirmed. Highlighted as conflicting in the calendar UI when the slot also has a confirmed booking.

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.description: Booking is live and blocks the time slot for the resource.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: Released without deleting the audit record; no longer blocks the slot.

cancelPending.label: Cancel pending
cancelPending.description: Cancel a pending booking that was never confirmed.

BookingCancellation.title: Booking Cancellation
BookingCancellation.description: Immutable cancellation record for an appointment. Captures the cancellation timestamp, reason, the policy snapshot that applied, the calculated refund amount, and the refund lifecycle. One per cancelled appointment; a second cancellation of the same appointment MUST be rejected (REQ-BCR-008 immutability). The appointmentId FK targets the Appointment register declared by the bookings-create-appointment fragment (10-bookings-create-appointment.json); the x-openregister-relation below resolves it.

appointmentId.description: Identifier of the cancelled appointment (FK to Appointment.appointmentId).
appointmentId.title: Appointment ID

cancelledAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the cancellation was recorded (design D8). Immutable once set.
cancelledAt.title: Cancelled At

cancelledReason.description: Reason enum (design D5). Immutable; set at cancellation time.
cancelledReason.title: Cancelled Reason

cancelledBy.description: Actor that initiated the cancellation (admin user id or 'customer:<email>'). Recorded for audit (REQ-BCR-007).
cancelledBy.title: Cancelled By

notes.description: Optional free-text note supplied at cancellation time.
notes.title: Notes

appliedPolicy.description: Snapshot of the CancellationPolicy terms in force at appointment creation time (design D2): policyId, minNoticeDays, lateFeeBrackets, noShowFee, refundPolicy. Used for fee calculation so later policy edits do not alter historical bookings.
appliedPolicy.title: Applied Policy

appointmentCost.description: Appointment cost in integer cents at cancellation time, used as the base for fee calculation.
appointmentCost.title: Appointment Cost

cancellationFeeApplied.description: Fee withheld in integer cents (appointmentCost - refundAmount).
cancellationFeeApplied.title: Cancellation Fee Applied

refundAmount.description: Amount eligible for refund in integer cents = appointmentCost - fee, never negative (design D4).
refundAmount.title: Refund Amount

refundStatus.description: Refund lifecycle (design D6). Set to pending on cancellation; transitioned by phase 3 payment integration.
refundStatus.title: Refund Status

refundedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the refund completed (set in phase 3).
refundedAt.title: Refunded At

administrationId.description: Tenant/administration scope for IDOR-safe filtering (ADR-005).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: Cancellation recorded; refund not yet processed.

failed.label: Failed
failed.description: Refund attempt failed; customer must contact support (phase 3).

process.label: Mark refund processed
process.description: Phase 3 payment integration completed the refund.

fail.label: Mark refund failed
fail.description: Phase 3 payment integration could not complete the refund.

cancelRefund.label: Cancel refund
cancelRefund.description: Refund was cancelled before processing (edge case).

operator.description: Operators record and view cancellations. No delete: cancellation records are immutable (REQ-BCR-008).

customer.description: Customers may self-cancel their own appointments and read the resulting record.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Booking Cancellation is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

BookingCancellationTemplate.title: Booking Cancellation Template
BookingCancellationTemplate.description: Branded email dispatched when a booking is cancelled. When cancellationReasonRequired is true the {{cancellationReason}} variable is included in the available bindings (REQ-BET-009). Subject/body support {{variable}} placeholders. Lifecycle draft -> published -> archived controls the active version.

published.label: Published
published.description: Active template; used for new booking-cancellation emails.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Previously published; no longer dispatched. Kept for audit and history.

publish.label: Publish template

archive.description: Operator retires the template (REQ-BET-003).

BookingConfirmationTemplate.title: Booking Confirmation Template
BookingConfirmationTemplate.description: Branded email template dispatched immediately when a booking is created. Operators customise subject, HTML/plain-text body, logo, accent colour and footer without code access. Body and subject support {{variable}} placeholders rendered at dispatch by the OpenRegister notification engine (ADR-022). Lifecycle draft -> published -> archived controls which version is active (REQ-BET-001/002/003).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Template under preparation; not used for dispatch.

published.label: Published
published.description: Active template; used for new booking-confirmation emails.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Previously published; no longer dispatched. Kept for audit and history.

publish.label: Publish template
publish.description: Operator (role: communications-manager) activates the template; sets activatedAt to the current timestamp (REQ-BET-002).

archive.label: Archive template
archive.description: Operator retires the template; new emails are no longer dispatched with it (REQ-BET-003). Existing instances remain visible in history.

archiveDraft.label: Archive draft
archiveDraft.description: Operator discards a draft that was never published; kept for history without ever activating.

onPublish.description: Stamp activatedAt with the publication timestamp so the first activation is auditable (REQ-BET-002).

communications-manager.description: Full access: create, edit drafts, publish and archive booking-confirmation templates (booking:template:* per REQ-BET, Task 22).

operator.description: Read-only access for staff who dispatch bookings but do not edit templates (booking:template:list).

auditor.description: Read-only access for audit and compliance inspection.

activatedAt.description: First-publication timestamp. Set once on the publish transition; preserved on later edits (REQ-BET-002).

renderedSubject.description: Subject line with {{variableName}} placeholders replaced from the supplied variable map. Undefined variables render as an empty string (REQ-BET-004).

renderedHtmlBody.description: HTML body with {{variableName}} placeholders replaced from the supplied variable map. Variable values are HTML-escaped to prevent injection (REQ-BET-004, Task 25).

renderedPlainTextBody.description: Plain-text fallback body with {{variableName}} placeholders replaced. Displayed when the client cannot render HTML (REQ-BET-006).

name.description: Human-readable template name shown in the admin list.
name.title: Name

status.description: Lifecycle state of the template.
status.title: Status

subjectLine.description: Email subject. Supports {{variable}} placeholders. Limited to 78 characters after substitution for cross-client compatibility (NFR-BET-002).
subjectLine.title: Subject Line

htmlBody.description: HTML email body. Inline styles only, no external CSS or JavaScript. Supports {{variable}} placeholders (NFR-BET-001).
htmlBody.title: Html Body

plainTextBody.description: Plain-text fallback body for clients without HTML rendering. Supports {{variable}} placeholders (REQ-BET-006).
plainTextBody.title: Plain Text Body

logoUri.description: URL to the organization logo image. Loaded from a CDN or document store; inline base64 is not used (NFR-BET-004).
logoUri.title: Logo URI

accentColor.description: Hex colour code for branding accents (e.g. button and header colour).
accentColor.title: Accent Color

footerText.description: Custom footer text (address, contact, legal notice).
footerText.title: Footer Text

senderName.description: Display name shown as the email sender.
senderName.title: Sender Name

senderAddress.description: From-address used for dispatch. Validated by the notification engine against the configured provider (ADR-022).
senderAddress.title: Sender Address

locale.description: BCP-47 language tag the template is authored in. Used to select the template for a customer's language preference (NFR-BET-005).
locale.title: Locale

activatedAt.description: Timestamp when the template was first published. Set on the publish transition (REQ-BET-002).
activatedAt.title: Activated At

onBookingConfirmed.description: Declarative email dispatch consumed from OR's notification engine (ADR-022, REQ-BET-010). When booking.confirmed fires, the engine selects a published template matching the recipient locale, renders subject + html + plain-text with booking variables, and dispatches through the configured email provider — no direct SMTP from app code. Render failure falls back to plain-text (T21) and is logged for operator review.

BookingConstraint.title: Booking Constraint
BookingConstraint.description: Booking-policy constraints attached to an AvailabilityRule (REQ-BAR-003). Carries the advance-notice window, pre/post buffer minutes, cancellation deadline hours, and the blackoutDates array of {startDate, endDate, reason} ranges. All numeric fields MUST be >= 0; maxAdvanceNoticeDays MUST be >= minAdvanceNoticeDays when set. Lifecycle is declarative per ADR-031: active → archived.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this constraint for tenant isolation (ADR-005).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

bookingConstraintId.description: Operator-assigned unique constraint identifier within the administration.
bookingConstraintId.title: Booking Constraint ID

minAdvanceNoticeDays.description: Minimum days in advance a booking may be made (REQ-BAR-003). 0 = same-day allowed.
minAdvanceNoticeDays.title: Min Advance Notice Days

maxAdvanceNoticeDays.description: Maximum days in advance a booking may be made. null = unlimited. When set MUST be >= minAdvanceNoticeDays.
maxAdvanceNoticeDays.title: Max Advance Notice Days

preBufferMinutes.description: Prep time required before each booking, in minutes.
preBufferMinutes.title: Pre Buffer Minutes

postBufferMinutes.description: Cleanup time required after each booking, in minutes.
postBufferMinutes.title: Post Buffer Minutes

cancellationDeadlineHours.description: Minimum hours before a booking starts that a cancellation is still allowed without late fee.
cancellationDeadlineHours.title: Cancellation Deadline Hours

blackoutDates.description: List of date ranges during which no booking is allowed (holidays, vacation, maintenance). Each entry is a {startDate, endDate, reason} object; endDate MUST be >= startDate.

startDate.description: Inclusive start of the blackout span.
startDate.title: Start Date

endDate.description: Inclusive end of the blackout span. MUST be >= startDate.
endDate.title: End Date

blackoutDates.title: Blackout Dates

status.description: Booking constraint lifecycle state.
status.title: Status

maxAdvanceNoticeBoundsValidator.description: Cross-field validator (REQ-BAR-003): rejects records where maxAdvanceNoticeDays is set and is less than minAdvanceNoticeDays. Returns null when valid.

active.label: Active
active.description: Constraint applies inside its parent rule's effective window.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Constraint is soft-deleted.

archive.label: Archive constraint
archive.description: Soft-delete the constraint.

BookingNotificationTrigger.title: Boekingsnotificatie-trigger
BookingNotificationTrigger.description: Configurable trigger for booking lifecycle notifications (REQ-BNT-001/003/004/006/007/009). Selects an event type (booking.created / booking.changed / booking.cancelled / booking.reminder), an ordered list of recipient rules (role + channels + optional condition), a fallback channel order, rate-limit + dedupe bounds and an opt-out gate. Dispatched through OR's notification engine (ADR-022); template selection delegates to the BookingConfirmationTemplate / BookingReminderTemplate / BookingCancellationTemplate schemas already declared by bookings-email-templates. Lifecycle: enabled → disabled → archived. No PHP listener class — trigger gating is declarative (x-openregister-notifications.appliesWhen / skipWhen).

name.description: Human-readable trigger name shown in the admin list (REQ-BNT-007).
name.example: Booking confirmation — customer (email primary, SMS fallback)
name.title: Name

status.description: Lifecycle state (REQ-BNT-007/008). enabled = trigger evaluates and dispatches; disabled = paused (admin disable-all toggle target); archived = retired for audit, cannot be re-enabled.
status.title: Status

triggerType.description: Which booking lifecycle event fires this trigger (REQ-BNT-001). booking.created on the Booking pending→confirmed transition; booking.changed on a non-status field change (startTime, organizer, attendee, location); booking.cancelled on confirmed→cancelled / pending→cancelled; booking.reminder fires on a scheduled offset (reminderHoursBeforeStart) before bookingStart.
triggerType.title: Trigger Type

reminderHoursBeforeStart.description: Only used when triggerType == booking.reminder (REQ-BNT-001). Hours before bookingStart to dispatch the reminder. Common values: 15 (≈15 min via /60), 1, 24. OR's notification engine schedules dispatch at bookingStart − this value (±15 min tolerance); missed windows dispatch immediately.
reminderHoursBeforeStart.title: Reminder Hours Before Start

channels.description: Channel priority order for fallback (REQ-BNT-004). Engine tries channel[0]; on adapter failure falls back to channel[1], etc. Each channel routes through the corresponding openconnector adapter. Recording every attempt in NotificationDelivery is mandatory (REQ-BNT-005).
channels.title: Channels

role.description: Recipient role (REQ-BNT-003). customer = the booking attendee; organizer = the resource staff member; admin_group = members of the Nextcloud 'admin' group.
role.title: Role

channels.description: Optional per-rule channel override (REQ-BNT-003). Falls back to the trigger-level channels when omitted.
channels.title: Channels

condition.description: Optional condition expression evaluated against the booking payload (REQ-BNT-003). Supports comparisons (==, !=, >, <, >=, <=) and boolean literals. Variables: booking.price, booking.status, booking.duration. Empty / true = always send.
condition.title: Condition

recipients.description: Ordered list of recipient rules (REQ-BNT-003). Each rule resolves at dispatch time to one or more recipients; rules with a false condition are skipped (audited as 'skipped (condition)'). At least one rule is required.
recipients.title: Recipients

rateLimitPerBookingPerHour.description: Maximum dispatches per booking per UTC calendar hour (REQ-BNT-006). Default 10. Excess dispatches are queued (status=queued) and visible in the admin monitor (REQ-BNT-008).
rateLimitPerBookingPerHour.title: Rate Limit Per Booking Per Hour

rateLimitPerOrganizerPerDay.description: Maximum dispatches per organizer per UTC calendar day (REQ-BNT-006). Default 100.
rateLimitPerOrganizerPerDay.title: Rate Limit Per Organizer Per Day

deduplicationWindowMinutes.description: Dedupe window in minutes (REQ-BNT-006). If the same (recipient, triggerType, bookingId) tuple already dispatched within this window, the second dispatch is skipped and audited as 'skipped (deduplicated)'.
deduplicationWindowMinutes.title: Deduplication Window Minutes

respectOptOut.description: When true (default), a recipient that has opted out of this trigger type (recipient.notificationOptOut[triggerType] === true) is skipped and audited as 'skipped (opt-out)' (REQ-BNT-009). GDPR / AVG mandates honouring opt-out for marketing-style notifications; operators can set false for strictly transactional triggers.
respectOptOut.title: Respect Opt Out

templateOverrideSlug.description: Optional per-trigger template slug override (REQ-BNT-002). When set, the engine fetches the named template (BookingConfirmationTemplate / BookingReminderTemplate / BookingCancellationTemplate) instead of the locale-matched default published template selected by the bookings-email-templates dispatch.
templateOverrideSlug.title: Template Override Slug

appliesToBookingSlug.description: Optional per-booking scope (REQ-BNT-007). When set, the trigger only fires for that single Booking slug — the modal-driven override pattern. When null, the trigger is global (applies to every Booking of the matching event type).
appliesToBookingSlug.title: Applies To Booking Slug

lastDispatchedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful dispatch from this trigger. Surfaced in the admin monitor (REQ-BNT-008). Stamped by the notification engine on each successful send.
lastDispatchedAt.title: Last Dispatched At

activatedAt.description: Timestamp when the trigger first transitioned to enabled. Stamped on first enable.
activatedAt.title: Activated At

enabled.label: Actief
enabled.description: Trigger evaluates lifecycle events and dispatches notifications via OR's engine.

disabled.label: Uitgeschakeld
disabled.description: Trigger paused (admin disable-all toggle or per-trigger pause). No dispatches; reactivation via enable transition.

archived.label: Gearchiveerd
archived.description: Retired. No further dispatches; audit history retained. Terminal — cannot be re-enabled.

disable.label: Trigger uitschakelen
disable.description: Pause dispatch without losing config (admin emergency off-switch target, REQ-BNT-008).

enable.label: Trigger inschakelen
enable.description: Resume dispatch. Stamps activatedAt on first enable.

archiveEnabled.label: Archiveren
archiveEnabled.description: Retire an active trigger. Terminal — history retained for audit (REQ-BNT-005).

channelCount.description: Number of channels configured for fallback (REQ-BNT-004). UI warns when 1 (no fallback).

isReminder.description: True when this is a time-based reminder trigger. The admin UI uses this to show / hide the reminderHoursBeforeStart field.

rateLimitSummary.description: Human-readable rate-limit summary for the admin list (REQ-BNT-006/008).

x-openregister-rbac.description: Trigger administration is restricted to the notification-administrator role (full CRUD), booking-administrator (read/update, used for the admin monitor disable-all toggle), booking-organizer (read/update — limited to triggers scoped via appliesToBookingSlug to their own bookings), and auditor (read-only). Permission slugs map onto OR CRUD permissions; enable/disable are modelled as status updates gated by the lifecycle state machine.

BookingNotificationTrigger._note: Design sketch removed from x-openregister-notifications (shillinq#1193). 'onTriggerEventFired' was never a notification rule and could never fire: its trigger was the literal placeholder '{{triggerType}}', its channels and recipients were '{{channels}}' / '{{recipients}}', and it used five keys the ADR-031 dialect has no concept of (scheduleOffsetHours, appliesWhen, scopeBy, selectTemplate, skipWhen). It described what a user-configured BookingNotificationTrigger OBJECT should contain — this schema's own instances — rather than a rule the engine dispatches for this schema. The intended behaviour it sketched: fire the object's triggerType for enabled triggers, scoped by appliesToBookingSlug (null meaning global), selecting a template by event type with a locale match and an override slug, offset by reminderHoursBeforeStart. That belongs in the service that reads these objects, not in a schema annotation. Kept here verbatim so the design is not lost: {"onTriggerEventFired":{"trigger":"{{triggerType}}","channels":"{{channels}}","scheduleOffsetHours":"{{reminderHoursBeforeStart}}","appliesWhen":{"field":"status","in":["enabled"]},"scopeBy":{"field":"appliesToBookingSlug","matchBooking":"slug","nullMeansGlobal":true},"recipients":"{{recipients}}","selectTemplate":{"byType":{"booking.created":"BookingConfirmationTemplate","booking.changed":"BookingConfirmationTemplate","booking.cancelled":"BookingCancellationTemplate","booking.reminder":"BookingReminderTemplate"},"overrideSlug":"{{templateOverrideSlug}}","matchLocale":"recipient.languagePreference"},"skipWhen":{"any":[{"recipientField":"notificationOptOut[{{triggerType}}]","equals":true,"onlyIf":"{{respectOptOut}}"},{"rateLimit":{"scope":"booking","max":"{{rateLimitPerBookingPerHour}}","windowMinutes":60}},{"rateLimit":{"scope":"organizer","max":"{{rateLimitPerOrganizerPerDay}}","windowMinutes":1440}},{"deduplicate":{"key":["recipient","triggerType","bookingId"],"windowMinutes":"{{deduplicationWindowMinutes}}"}}]},"audit":{"schema":"NotificationDelivery","writeOn":["sent","failed","skipped","queued"],"fields":{"triggerName":"{{name}}","triggerType":"{{triggerType}}","bookingId":"booking.id","channel":"channel","recipient":"recipient.address","status":"status","failureReason":"failureReason","retryCount":"retryCount","sentAt":"now"}},"fallback":{"mode":"next-channel","description":"On adapter failure, advance to the next channel in the trigger's own channels list. Each attempt is recorded in NotificationDelivery (REQ-BNT-004/005)."},"description":"Declarative trigger dispatch consumed from OR's notification engine (ADR-022, REQ-BNT-001/003/004/005/006/009). When the configured booking lifecycle event fires (booking.created / changed / cancelled / reminder), the engine evaluates appliesWhen (status=enabled), scope (appliesToBookingSlug null = global, else match), the recipient rules (each rule's condition expression), the skipWhen gates (opt-out, rate-limit per booking/organizer, dedupe), and dispatches the rendered template through the first available channel. Every attempt is recorded immutably in NotificationDelivery for audit (REQ-BNT-005). Pure-logic gating (rate-limit window, dedupe key, recipient-rule condition parsing, opt-out lookup) is implemented in Shillinq's Notification/ helper namespace for unit-test coverage; live dispatch stays in OR's engine."}}

BookingOrder.title: Booking Order
BookingOrder.description: Base order/agreement primitive. Concrete kinds (booking, sales, purchase, grant, engagement, quote, blanket) discriminate via `orderType` and extend with their own tail; payments (deposits, disbursements) and lines are related objects (Payment / OrderLine), not fields. Booking orders (orderType=booking) keep the completed → invoiced lifecycle: on completion a final Invoice is materialised and linked via invoiceId; on cancellation after invoicing a reversing CreditNote is materialised (REQ-DI-001/002).

orderType.description: Discriminator selecting the order kind + lifecycle. Existing rows default to 'booking'.
orderType.title: Order Type

direction.description: incoming (we receive/are awarded) vs outgoing (we issue/award).
direction.title: Direction

orderNumber.description: Human reference (PO / quote / grant / booking number).
orderNumber.title: Order Number

counterpartyId.description: Supplier / customer / grantee / contractor party id (generalises customerId).
counterpartyId.title: Counterparty ID

totalAmount.description: Headline amount (order total / awarded amount / engagement value).
totalAmount.title: Total Amount

projectReference.description: Optional project this order is for.
projectReference.title: Project Reference

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this order for tenant isolation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

orderId.description: Operator-assigned unique order identifier within the administration.
orderId.title: Order ID

bookingTypeId.description: FK to the booking type that priced this order.
bookingTypeId.title: Booking Type ID

customerId.description: FK identifying the customer. A customer is a Nextcloud contact entity (ADR: contacts are NC entities), not a bespoke schema; this is the shared external reference.
customerId.title: Customer ID

description.description: Human-readable description of the booked service, used as the service invoice line description.
description.title: Description

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Final invoicing is EUR-only in this tier (multi-currency is out of scope).
currency.title: Currency

basePrice.description: Net service price in minor currency units (EUR cents), excluding VAT.
basePrice.title: Base Price

taxRate.description: VAT percentage applied to the service line (21 standard, 9 reduced, 0 exempt) per REQ-DI-004.
taxRate.title: Tax Rate

estimatedTotal.description: Estimated gross total in minor units at confirmation time. Informational.
estimatedTotal.title: Estimated Total

depositRequired.description: Whether a deposit rule applies to this order. When false, the final invoice carries no credit line (REQ-DI-008).
depositRequired.title: Deposit Required

depositAmount.description: Authorised deposit amount in minor units (EUR cents), credited on the final invoice (REQ-DI-003).
depositAmount.title: Deposit Amount

depositPaymentId.description: FK to the DepositPayment that holds the authorised deposit (bookings-deposits T1).
depositPaymentId.title: Deposit Payment ID

paymentTermsDays.description: Net payment terms in days used to compute the final invoice due date (REQ-DI-005).
paymentTermsDays.title: Payment Terms Days

invoiceId.description: FK to the final Invoice created on completion. Null until completed; set by the complete transition action (REQ-DI-001/002).
invoiceId.title: Invoice ID

completedAt.description: Timestamp the booking was fulfilled/completed. Must be set before invoicing (REQ-DI-002).
completedAt.title: Completed At

state.description: Order lifecycle state.
state.title: State

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Order created, not yet priced or confirmed.

pending_payment.label: Pending payment
pending_payment.description: Awaiting deposit authorisation when a deposit rule applies (bookings-deposits).

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.description: Booked and confirmed; deposit (if any) authorised. Awaiting fulfilment.

completed.label: Completed
completed.description: Fulfilled/checked out. A final Invoice has been materialised in Shillinq and linked via invoiceId (REQ-DI-002).

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: Cancelled. If a final Invoice was already issued, a reversing CreditNote was materialised (REQ-DI-006). Remains queryable for audit.

confirm.label: Confirm order
confirm.description: Confirm once the deposit (if required) is authorised.

confirmDirect.label: Confirm order (no deposit)
confirmDirect.description: Confirm an order that requires no deposit.

complete.label: Complete order
complete.description: Operator confirms fulfilment/checkout. Gated by InvoiceFromBookingGuard (completedAt set, deposit authorised, not already invoiced) then materialises exactly one final Invoice with service + deposit-credit lines, linking Order.invoiceId back (REQ-DI-002, idempotent per REQ-DI-002).

actions.description: Materialise exactly one final Invoice (with InvoiceLine children: a service line at the order tax rate and, when a deposit is authorised, a negative 0%-VAT deposit-credit line) and set Order.invoiceId. Declarative outcome per REQ-DI-002/003/004 — line amounts and the deposit credit are computed by InvoiceFromBookingGuard before persistence.

cancelConfirmed.label: Cancel order
cancelConfirmed.description: Cancel a confirmed order that was never invoiced. No CreditNote needed.

cancelAfterInvoice.label: Cancel invoiced order
cancelAfterInvoice.description: Cancel after a final Invoice was issued. Gated by BookingCancellationGuard and materialises exactly one reversing CreditNote against the linked Invoice (REQ-DI-006, idempotent).

actions.description: Materialise exactly one CreditNote reversing the linked Invoice for the full invoice gross. Declarative outcome per REQ-DI-006; amounts computed by BookingCancellationGuard. The original Invoice is preserved.

countByState.description: Number of orders per lifecycle state.

BookingReminderTemplate.title: Booking Reminder Template
BookingReminderTemplate.description: Branded reminder email dispatched N hours before a booking starts. The hoursBeforeBooking field configures the reminder timing; the booking system queues dispatch at that offset (REQ-BET-005). Subject/body support {{variable}} placeholders including {{hoursUntilBooking}}. Lifecycle draft -> published -> archived controls the active version.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Template under preparation; not used for dispatch.

published.label: Published
published.description: Active template; reminders dispatched at the configured offset before booking start.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Previously published; no longer dispatched. Kept for audit and history.

publish.label: Publish template
publish.description: Operator activates the reminder template; sets activatedAt (REQ-BET-002).

archive.label: Archive template
archive.description: Operator retires the template; new reminders no longer use it (REQ-BET-003).

archiveDraft.label: Archive draft
archiveDraft.description: Operator discards a never-published draft; kept for history.

onPublish.description: Stamp activatedAt with the publication timestamp (REQ-BET-002).

auditor.description: Read-only access for audit and compliance inspection.

renderedHtmlBody.description: HTML body with placeholders substituted; values HTML-escaped (REQ-BET-004).

subjectLineLength.description: Subject character count, validated against the 78-character limit (NFR-BET-002).

bodySizeBytes.description: Combined body size validated against the 102 KB limit (NFR-BET-003).

status.description: Lifecycle state of the template.
status.title: Status

hoursBeforeBooking.description: Number of hours before booking start at which the reminder is dispatched (e.g. 24, 2, 1). Configures timing per REQ-BET-005.
hoursBeforeBooking.title: Hours Before Booking

htmlBody.description: HTML email body, inline styles only (NFR-BET-001).
htmlBody.title: Html Body

plainTextBody.example: Hallo {{customerName}}, over {{hoursUntilBooking}} uur start uw boeking.
plainTextBody.title: Plain Text Body

logoUri.description: URL to the organization logo image (NFR-BET-004).
logoUri.title: Logo URI

accentColor.description: Hex colour code for branding accents.
accentColor.title: Accent Color

senderName.description: Display name shown as the email sender.
senderName.title: Sender Name

locale.description: BCP-47 language tag the template is authored in (NFR-BET-005).
locale.title: Locale

activatedAt.description: Timestamp when the template was first published (REQ-BET-002).
activatedAt.title: Activated At

administrationId.description: Tenant administration this template belongs to. Null for shipped defaults.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

onBookingReminderDue.description: Reminder dispatch consumed from OR's notification engine (REQ-BET-005/010). The engine derives the dispatch time as bookingStart − scheduleOffsetHours; missed windows (e.g. activation after the scheduled time) dispatch immediately. Render failure falls back to plain-text and is logged for operator review (T21).

BookingSmsReminderChannel.title: SMS-herinneringskanaal
BookingSmsReminderChannel.description: Configurable SMS reminder channel for booking reminders (REQ-SMS-001). Selects an SMS provider (messagebird, twilio, or a custom openconnector connector), carries a ≤160-char message template with {{variables}}, an active → inactive → archived lifecycle (REQ-SMS-006/007), delivery timing (sendMinutesBefore) and retry config. SMS dispatch is consumed from OpenRegister's notification engine (ADR-022); message rendering and phone/length validation are declarative calculations (ADR-031). Provider API credentials are stored in the referenced openconnector connector (REQ-SMS-013), never in this register.

name.description: Human-readable channel name shown in the admin list (REQ-SMS-001).
name.title: Name

status.description: Lifecycle state (REQ-SMS-006/007). active = SMS enabled and dispatched; inactive = paused; archived = retired for audit, cannot be reactivated.
status.title: Status

provider.description: SMS provider (REQ-SMS-002). messagebird / twilio map to built-in openconnector connectors; custom uses an operator-supplied connector.
provider.title: Provider

providerConfig.description: Provider configuration (REQ-SMS-013). Holds the openconnector connector id; API credentials are stored encrypted inside that connector, not here. Sensitive values are never returned to or logged by Shillinq.

connectorId.description: Slug/id of the openconnector connector that holds the provider API credentials (encrypted, centralized).
connectorId.title: Connector ID

accountReference.description: Non-secret provider account reference (e.g. originator pool id). Never an API key.
accountReference.title: Account Reference

providerConfig.title: Provider Config

messageTemplate.description: SMS message text with {{variables}} (REQ-SMS-003/009). Constrained to ≤160 characters (single SMS). Allowed variables: customerName, bookingRef, bookingDate, bookingTime, bookingLocation, organizationName, bookingUrl.
messageTemplate.example: Hallo {{customerName}}, herinnering: uw boeking op {{bookingDate}} om {{bookingTime}}. Ref: {{bookingRef}}
messageTemplate.title: Message Template

sendMinutesBefore.description: Minutes before booking start to dispatch the reminder (REQ-SMS-005). 1440 = 24h. OR's notification engine schedules dispatch at bookingStart - sendMinutesBefore (±15 min tolerance).
sendMinutesBefore.title: Send Minutes Before

fallbackPhoneNumber.description: Default E.164/NL phone number used when the booking contact has none (REQ-SMS-004/012). Validated against E.164 + NL rules (+31… or 06…).
fallbackPhoneNumber.title: Fallback Phone Number

senderId.description: Sender ID/name shown to the recipient (REQ-SMS-011). Provider-dependent; MessageBird and Twilio cap alphanumeric sender IDs at 11 characters.
senderId.title: Sender ID

phoneNumberFormat.description: Locale phone format applied when normalizing recipient numbers (REQ-SMS-004).
phoneNumberFormat.title: Phone Number Format

retryCount.description: Number of delivery retry attempts on transient failure (REQ-SMS-008). Executed by OR's notification engine.
retryCount.title: Retry Count

logSmsCost.description: When true, each dispatch logs timestamp, provider, masked phone, message length and cost (if the provider returns it) for future billing (REQ-SMS-019).
logSmsCost.title: Log SMS Cost

respectOptOut.description: When true (default), a recipient who has opted out of SMS reminders (contact-level smsOptOut flag, resolved at dispatch time) is skipped and no message is sent (REQ-SMS-021). Phone numbers are personal data (GDPR); honouring opt-out is mandatory unless an operator explicitly disables it for transactional-only channels.
respectOptOut.title: Respect Opt Out

activatedAt.description: When the channel was first activated (set on first transition into active).
activatedAt.title: Activated At

active.label: Actief
active.description: SMS reminders are enabled and dispatched from this channel.

inactive.label: Inactief
inactive.description: SMS reminders are paused; no dispatch occurs. Can be re-activated.

archived.label: Gearchiveerd
archived.description: Channel retired. Removed from the active list; history retained for audit. Cannot be reactivated (REQ-SMS-007).

activate.label: Kanaal activeren
activate.description: Resume dispatch (REQ-SMS-006). Stamps activatedAt on first activation.

renderedPreview.expression: renderTemplate(@self.messageTemplate, {customerName: 'Jan Jansen', bookingRef: 'BK001', bookingDate: '21 mei', bookingTime: '14:30', bookingLocation: 'Kantoor Amsterdam', organizationName: 'Example BV', bookingUrl: 'https://example.nl/b/ABC'})
renderedPreview.description: Preview of the SMS rendered with sample variable values (REQ-SMS-009). {{variable}} placeholders are substituted; undefined variables render as empty string; bookingLocation truncated >30 chars and organizationName >20 chars with an ellipsis (REQ-SMS-010).

renderedPreviewLength.description: Character count of the rendered preview (REQ-SMS-003). Used by the admin UI to warn when a real send could exceed 160 characters.

fallbackPhoneValid.description: Whether the fallback phone number is a valid E.164/NL number (REQ-SMS-004). Empty/null is treated as valid (number is optional).

onBookingReminderDue.description: Declarative SMS dispatch consumed from OR's notification engine (ADR-022, REQ-SMS-005/008/018/021). When a booking.reminder-due event fires, active channels render their template with booking variables and dispatch via the referenced openconnector connector — unless the recipient has opted out (skipWhen, respected when respectOptOut is true). Retries on transient provider error per retryCount/retryIntervalSeconds; failures are logged with a masked phone number. The pure-logic gating/rendering/normalization is implemented in Shillinq's SmsReminderDispatcher helper (provider-adapter interface), keeping the orchestration unit-tested while live dispatch stays in OR's engine.

x-openregister-rbac.description: Channel management is restricted to the sms-channel-administrator role (full CRUD) and booking-administrator (read/update); auditors read-only (REQ-SMS-020). Permission slugs map onto OR CRUD permissions. Providers credentials are never readable through this schema (they live in openconnector).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on BtwAangifte with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

regime.description: VAT regime variant (REQ-VAT-004). Standard applies all rates (21% / 9% / 0%); KOR is the kleineondernemersregeling exemption (totals forced to 0); reverse-charge is intra-EU / import goods + services.
regime.title: Regime

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this return belongs to; reads are scoped per administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

submissionDate.description: When the return was submitted to the Belastingdienst.
submissionDate.title: Submission Date

totalVATCollected.description: Total VAT payable from sales / AR (rubrieken 1a/1b/1c) — derived by VATReturnService::deriveVATLines (REQ-VAT-002, REQ-VAT-011).
totalVATCollected.title: Total VAT Collected

totalVATPaid.description: Total VAT deductible from purchases / AP — derived by VATReturnService::deriveVATLines (REQ-VAT-002, REQ-VAT-011).
totalVATPaid.title: Total VAT Paid

vatBalance.description: totalVATPaid − totalVATCollected (negative = owed to Belastingdienst, positive = refund) (REQ-VAT-006).
vatBalance.title: VAT Balance

totalTaxableAmount.description: Total taxable turnover (sum of VATLine.taxableAmount across all declarations).
totalTaxableAmount.title: Total Taxable Amount

notes.description: Operator notes (review findings, exceptions, regime context).
notes.title: Notes

BtwAangifte.title: BTW-aangifte
BtwAangifte.description: Dutch VAT return for a fiscal period (quarter / month / year), regime-typed (standard / KOR / reverse-charge) per Wet OB 1968. Tracks totalVATCollected (sales / AR rubrieken 1a/1b/1c), totalVATPaid (purchases / AP deductible) and the derived vatBalance (paid − collected). Operator-driven lifecycle draft → submitted → verified → filed; once submitted, the linked VATLine records are immutable until the return is explicitly rebased to draft (REQ-VAT-008).

retention.description: BTW-aangiftes 7 jaar bewaren (Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen art. 52).

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Operator can rebuild VAT lines from GL; totals recompute on each derive.

submitted.label: Ingediend
submitted.description: Aangifte locked; awaits Belastingdienst verification. Re-open via rebase (back to draft).

verified.label: Geverifieerd
verified.description: Authority acknowledged receipt; still viewable + exportable.

filed.label: Definitief
filed.description: Authority accepted return as final; read-only.

submit.label: Indienen
submit.description: Submit to Belastingdienst; validates totals are non-negative and sets submissionDate (REQ-VAT-005).

rebase.label: Heropenen
rebase.description: Re-open a submitted return; clears submissionDate / verificationDate / filingReference, deletes VAT lines, re-derives from GL (REQ-VAT-008).

totalsByReturn.description: Declarative shape of VATReturnService::deriveTotals (REQ-VAT-011). Sums VATLine.vatAmount grouped by type within the return; collected → totalVATCollected, paid → totalVATPaid, vatBalance = totalVATPaid − totalVATCollected. Reverse-charge lines contribute to totalVATPaid with the operator-liable sign convention (REQ-VAT-010).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on BudgetBBVMapping with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

glAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber within the same administration (REQ-BBVW-002).
glAccountNumber.title: GL Account Number

programmeCode.description: FK to BBVProgramme.programmeCode within the same administration (REQ-BBVW-002).
programmeCode.title: Programme Code

allocationPercentage.description: Allocation share for this (glAccount, programme) pair as a percentage 0–100. Multiple mappings on the same GL account MUST sum to 100 across active mappings — the chain member 02 aggregation service enforces the sum invariant.
allocationPercentage.title: Allocation Percentage

effectiveFrom.description: ISO-8601 date this mapping starts being honoured (inclusive).
effectiveFrom.title: Effective From

effectiveTo.description: Optional ISO-8601 date this mapping stops being honoured (inclusive). Null = open-ended.
effectiveTo.title: Effective To

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this mapping (many-to-one). Scopes uniqueness with glAccountNumber + programmeCode + effectiveFrom.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

glAccountBudgetCents.description: Annual budget on the GL account, in integer cents (Euro precision). The TotalBudget aggregation multiplies this by allocationPercentage / 100.
glAccountBudgetCents.title: GL Account Budget Cents

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year the mapping applies to.
fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year

BudgetBBVMapping.title: Budget BBV Mapping
BudgetBBVMapping.description: A many-to-one junction record linking a GL account to a BBV programme with an allocation percentage (REQ-BBVW-002). Multiple mappings per GL account are allowed when allocationPercentage values sum to 100 across active mappings — the aggregation service in chain member 02 enforces the sum invariant. The effectiveFrom / effectiveTo window lets operators re-cut allocations between fiscal years without losing the prior split. Records are admin-write / public-read (ADR-005).

effectiveToOnOrAfterFrom.description: Cross-field validator (REQ-BBVW-008): rejects mappings where effectiveTo is set and earlier than effectiveFrom. Returns null when valid, an error string when invalid. Empty/null effectiveTo is treated as open-ended and skips the check.
effectiveToOnOrAfterFrom.expression: @self.effectiveTo == null || @self.effectiveTo >= @self.effectiveFrom ? null : 'effectiveTo must be on or after effectiveFrom'

glAccountForeignKey.description: Per REQ-BBVW-008 / REQ-BBVW-002, glAccountNumber SHALL reference an existing Chart-of-Accounts entry (Account.accountNumber) within the same administrationId. Mappings referencing an unknown GL account MUST be rejected on save.

BudgetScenarioModifier.title: Budget Scenario Modifier
BudgetScenarioModifier.description: One dated modifier belonging to one BudgetScenario (REQ-BSC-003): RECURRING_END (a CashflowRecurring row's schedule hypothetically capped at effectiveDate — models "employee A+B leave the org" as GL-recognised cost lines ending, never as an HR concept), RECURRING_AMOUNT_CHANGE (a CashflowRecurring row's standardAmount hypothetically replaced from effectiveDate forward — "recurring drops X from date X"), or LEDGER_AMOUNT_DELTA (a one-off signed adjustment to one LedgerGroup for effectiveDate's own month only — "amount X transferred to the bank at date X"). Calendar.title: Calendar
Calendar.description: A per-resource calendar carrying time-zone and working-hours configuration per bookings-resource-calendar REQ-002. Bound to exactly one Resource. All booking times are stored in UTC; the timeZone field drives display conversion on the client. NOTE: `organization` below is the RETIRED alias of `administrationId` and is OPTIONAL — see the same note on Resource above. Requiring it here is what made every seeded Calendar (cal-001..cal-003) fail to import, so GET /api/v2/calendars answered `{"calendars":[]}` and GET /api/v2/calendars/{id} answered 404 for calendars this app ships.

workingHours.description: Optional working-hours template keyed by weekday (e.g. {"monday": "09:00-17:00"}). A weekday that is OMITTED means the resource is closed that day. Omit it, do not send null: OpenRegister's validator reads JSON-Schema types and rejects null against type "string" regardless of the OpenAPI `nullable` keyword, which is honoured only at the TOP level of a schema and never inside a nested object's additionalProperties. Sending null is what dropped the seeded Calendar below ("Property 'workingHours.saturday' should be type 'string' but is 'null'"). A null value for the whole workingHours object still means 24/7 availability — that is top-level and is accepted.

Materialised nightly (not computed per evaluation, REQ-CCM-003) by the ccm-baseline-materialisation scheduled workflow over a rolling window per scope. stable=false when the sample size or variance is too small to flag.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a CCM Baseline is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

ccm-baseline-materialisation.name: Baseline materialisation
ccm-baseline-materialisation.description: Nightly job (23:30) computing mean/median/stddev/Benford/typical-hour/typical-day baselines per scope over a rolling 12-month window (REQ-CCM-003). Completion SLA ≤1h. No PHP TimedJob — declarative scheduled workflow.

scopeKey.description: Identifier within the scope (vendor id, GL-account code, etc.).

period.description: Period the baseline was computed over, e.g. 2026-Q1.
period.title: Period

sampleSize.title: Sample Size
