computedValue.description: The computed scalar value (for scalar metrics).
computedValue.title: Computed Value

distribution.description: Distribution payload (e.g. Benford leading-digit frequencies, typical-poster set).
distribution.title: Distribution

confidenceIntervalLow.title: Confidence Interval Low
confidenceIntervalLow.description: The numeric value for confidence interval low.

confidenceIntervalHigh.title: Confidence Interval High
confidenceIntervalHigh.description: The numeric value for confidence interval high.

stable.description: False when the sample size or variance is too small to flag against (REQ-CCM-002).
stable.title: Stable

CcmFinding.title: CCM Finding
CcmFinding.description: A single rule firing (REQ-CCM-004). Captures an immutable evidence snapshot at fire time (before/after, actor, approver chain, GL context) and transitions through a four-state triage workflow via x-openregister-lifecycle. Investigation notes and status history are append-only. Resolution requires a mandatory rationale (CcmFindingGuard). The assignee is a Nextcloud user id. Immutable audit trail per REQ-CCM-009.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a CCM Finding is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

dismissed-false-positive.label: Dismissed — false positive
dismissed-false-positive.description: Closed with rationale; not a real anomaly.

dismissed-acceptable-risk.label: Dismissed — acceptable risk
dismissed-acceptable-risk.description: Closed with rationale; accepted by management.

investigate.label: Start investigation
investigate.description: An investigator takes ownership of the finding (REQ-CCM-004).

confirmDeficiency.label: Confirm control deficiency
confirmDeficiency.description: Escalate as a control deficiency with a mandatory rationale (REQ-CCM-004).

confirmFraud.label: Confirm — fraud suspected
confirmFraud.description: Escalate; fraud investigation triggered, mandatory rationale (REQ-CCM-004).

onCreate.description: Notify the rule owner / assignee when a critical or high-severity finding is created (REQ-CCM-008). The `field` recipient resolves the finding's own assignee and yields nobody while a finding is still unassigned; the `relation` recipient reaches the owner of the CcmRule that fired, which is the fallback the retired imperative dispatcher applied.

onAutoEscalate.description: Auto-escalate critical findings still open after 24h to the CFO (REQ-CCM-008). The 24h re-check cadence is the scheduled trigger's intervalSec; the filter is the escalation condition.

subject.nl: Escalatie: kritieke CCM-bevinding op regel {{ruleCode}} staat nog open — {{title}}

ccm-finding-auto-escalation.name: Critical finding auto-escalation
ccm-finding-auto-escalation.description: Hourly sweep that escalates critical findings still in 'open' for >24h to the CFO (REQ-CCM-008). No PHP TimedJob — declarative scheduled workflow.

CcmRule.title: CCM Rule
CcmRule.description: A Continuous Controls Monitoring rule definition (REQ-CCM-001). Carries the control family, objective, COSO assertion, severity, evaluation mode, trigger events, and the constrained JSON DSL logic (ruleLogic) evaluated by CcmRuleEngine (REQ-CCM-002). Parameters are tenant-configurable thresholds; ruleLogic is never arbitrary code. rule owner/reviewer are Nextcloud user ids (FK to the NC user directory). Immutable audit trail per REQ-CCM-009.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a CCM Rule is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

ruleCode.description: Sequential rule code within the tenant, e.g. SoD-01 (REQ-CCM-001/007).
ruleCode.title: Rule Code

description.description: Plain-language description of what the rule detects.
description.title: Description

controlFamily.description: One of the eight control families plus custom (REQ-CCM-007).
controlFamily.title: Control Family

controlObjective.description: Control objective free text, e.g. 'prevent vendor master fraud'.
controlObjective.title: Control Objective

severity.description: Rule severity; inherited by findings unless overridden (REQ-CCM-004).
severity.title: Severity

evaluationMode.description: Block prevents the transaction; warn flags it; async runs on the nightly sweep (REQ-CCM-003).
evaluationMode.title: Evaluation Mode

ruleLogic.description: Constrained JSON DSL expression evaluated by CcmRuleEngine (REQ-CCM-002). Operators: event-matches / field-equals / field-in-set / field-greater-than / field-between / field-matches-regex / time-is-within / time-is-weekend / time-is-outside-business-hours / user-has-function / user-also-has-function / user-is-in-role / value-deviates-from-baseline / value-violates-benford / count-of-similar-in-period-exceeds / duplicate-of-existing / master-data-changed-within / approval-chain-bypassed / posted-while-period-closing / same-user-as; compound: all-of / any-of / none-of. Never arbitrary code — no eval().
ruleLogic.title: Rule Logic

parameters.description: Tenant-configurable thresholds (z-score, lookback window, chi-square cutoff, etc.).
parameters.title: Parameters

suppressionRules.description: Known exceptions that should not fire (e.g. month-end consolidation JE from parent).
suppressionRules.title: Suppression Rules

enabled.description: Whether the rule is active for this tenant.
enabled.title: Enabled

effectiveTo.description: Last date the rule applies (open-ended when null).
effectiveTo.title: Effective To

ruleOwner.description: Nextcloud user id of the rule owner (typically internal-audit or CFO). FK to the NC user directory — a person is an NC entity, never an invented schema.
ruleOwner.title: Rule Owner

ruleReviewer.description: Nextcloud user id of the reviewer (typically external auditor for SOX engagements).
ruleReviewer.title: Rule Reviewer

lastReviewDate.title: Last Review Date
lastReviewDate.description: The date and time for last review date.

nextReviewDate.title: Next Review Date
nextReviewDate.description: The date and time for next review date.

soxKeyControl.title: Sox Key Control

CcmSegregationMatrix.title: CCM Segregation Matrix
CcmSegregationMatrix.description: Segregation-of-duties reference data (REQ-CCM-005). One row per function code, listing the conflicting function codes a single user may not also hold, with conflict severity, rationale (Dutch), and the compensating controls allowed. Pre-loaded with the standard SAP/Oracle function library, tenant-configurable.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a CCM Segregation Matrix is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

functionCode.description: SoD function code, e.g. VENDOR-CREATE, INVOICE-POST, PAYMENT-RELEASE (REQ-CCM-005).
functionCode.title: Function Code

conflictingFunctions.description: Function codes that conflict with this one (no single user may hold both).
conflictingFunctions.title: Conflicting Functions

conflictSeverity.description: Severity of holding a conflicting function (REQ-CCM-005).
conflictSeverity.title: Conflict Severity

compensatingControlsAllowed.description: Compensating controls that mitigate the conflict if both functions must be held.
compensatingControlsAllowed.title: Compensating Controls Allowed

CcmUserFunctionAssignment.title: CCM User Function Assignment
CcmUserFunctionAssignment.description: Materialised mapping of a Nextcloud user to a SoD function code (REQ-CCM-005), recomputed nightly from roles + direct grants + temporary elevations by the ccm-sod-materialisation scheduled workflow. The user is a Nextcloud entity (FK to the NC user directory). conflictWith records the SoD conflicts the user currently holds.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a CCM User Function Assignment is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

ccm-sod-materialisation.name: SoD function-assignment materialisation
ccm-sod-materialisation.description: Nightly job (23:15) that recomputes every user's SoD function-code assignments from roles + grants + temporary elevations and records conflicts against CcmSegregationMatrix (REQ-CCM-005). No PHP TimedJob — declarative scheduled workflow.

user.title: User

functionCode.title: Function Code

source.title: Source

grantedBy.title: Granted By

conflictWith.title: Conflict With

CddRecord.title: Customer Due Diligence Record
CddRecord.description: A customer-due-diligence record, modelled so the occasional-transaction CDD threshold, the UBO 25% ownership test and the five-year retention obligation can be machine-checked.

administrationId.title: Administration ID

customerId.description: The customer the CDD record concerns.
customerId.title: Customer ID

performed.description: True when CDD was performed (required at or above the threshold).
performed.title: Performed

transactionAmount.description: Amount of the occasional transaction the CDD concerns.
transactionAmount.title: Transaction Amount

uboOwnershipPct.description: Ownership / voting-rights percentage of the identified beneficial owner.

uboIdentified.title: Ubo Identified

OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on ChartOfAccountsMapping with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

allocationDetail.title: Allocation Detail

effectiveTo.description: Date the mapping ceases to apply; null while open-ended.

coveragePercent.description: Percentage of existing RJ mutations the mapping converts successfully on the validation test-run (REQ-DGAAP-002). Activation requires ≥95 unless an exception is documented.

ChartOfAccountsMapping.title: Chart of Accounts Mapping
ChartOfAccountsMapping.description: Maps a source (RJ) account to one or more target (IFRS) accounts with an allocation rule (REQ-DGAAP-002). Supports one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one and recharacterization cardinalities; activation is blocked until a test-data reconciliation reaches ≥95% coverage or an explicit exception justification is recorded.

ClaimsVoorzieningDetail.title: Claims Voorziening Detail
ClaimsVoorzieningDetail.description: Type-specific detail register for claims- en geschillen-voorzieningen (IAS 37 §37, REQ-PROV-006). FK back to a Provision with provisionType=claims. legalAdviceMemo is mandatory and stored under restricted access (CFO / audit committee / accountant only) to preserve legal privilege. The activation guard blocks status=active when the memo FK is missing.

bestEstimateSettlement.title: Best Estimate Settlement

legalAdviceMemo.title: Legal Advice Memo

administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Claims Voorziening Detail is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

CloseChecklistInstance.title: Close Checklist Instance
CloseChecklistInstance.description: Per-period instantiation of a CloseChecklistTemplate (REQ-CLS-004). Carries per-task status (pending | in-progress | completed | overdue), owner override, completedAt, evidence attachment, and slaBreach flag. Lifecycle: pending → in-progress → completed with SLA escalation on overdue.

periodId.description: FK to FiscalPeriod.periodId (REQ-CLS-004).
periodId.title: Period ID

taskId.title: Task ID
taskId.description: The identifier of the associated task.

CloseChecklistTemplate.title: Close Checklist Template
CloseChecklistTemplate.description: Reusable list of close tasks per administratie type (BV, NV, eenmanszaak); instantiated per period as a CloseChecklistInstance (REQ-CLS-004). Each task carries owner, dueBefore, dependsOn (task-dependency graph), and evidenceRequired flag.

dependsOn.title: Depends On

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: CloseChecklistTemplate changes (task list, owners, due-before, dependsOn, evidenceRequired) MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 / REQ-CLS-004 — close procedures are an SOX-relevant control; auditors trace which template version produced each CloseChecklistInstance.

ClosingAccount.title: Closing Account
ClosingAccount.description: Designates the single closing / income-summary account per administration (typically account 9900) per REQ-YEC-003. All revenue and expense closing entries flow through this account before being transferred to retained earnings. Supports time-bounded historicity via `effectiveFrom` so administrations can rotate their closing account across fiscal years if needed.

accountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber. Typically 9900 (income summary) or another equity-side closing account. Per REQ-YEC-003.
accountNumber.title: Account Number

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration. One active ClosingAccount per administration at any point in time per REQ-YEC-003.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

isActive.description: Whether this is the currently active closing account for the administration. The lifecycle action on ClosingEntry / FiscalYear close selects the active record. Per REQ-YEC-003.
isActive.title: Is Active

effectiveFrom.description: Optional start date if the administration rotates closing accounts across fiscal years (e.g. switching from 9900 to 9990). When null, this ClosingAccount applies indefinitely. Per REQ-YEC-003.
effectiveFrom.title: Effective From

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Closing Account is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

ClosingEntry.title: Closing Entry
ClosingEntry.description: A manual or automated year-end closing entry per REQ-YEC-001. Tracks accrual postings, reversals, revenue/expense closings to the income-summary account, depreciation postings, retained-earnings rollforward, and opening-balance seeding. Materialises as a balanced GLTransaction via the JournalEntry materialisation pattern (T1) when approved and posted. All amounts are stored as integer-cent for money-safe arithmetic per the foundation cents-based money convention.

closingEntryNumber.description: Sequential closing-entry number unique per administration (e.g. CE-2026-0001). Per REQ-YEC-001.
closingEntryNumber.title: Closing Entry Number

fiscalYearId.description: Reference to the FiscalYear this closing entry belongs to. Per REQ-YEC-001.
fiscalYearId.title: Fiscal Year ID

entryDate.description: Posting date of the closing entry. Typically the last day of the fiscal year (or first day of next FY for opening-balance entries). Per REQ-YEC-001.
entryDate.title: Entry Date

entryType.description: Classification of the closing entry. Per REQ-YEC-001.
entryType.title: Entry Type

description.description: Operator-authored description of the entry. Per REQ-YEC-001.
description.example: Close revenue accounts 4000-4999 to income summary 9900
description.title: Description

automationTemplate.description: FK to ClosingEntryTemplate.templateId when this entry was generated automatically by a template. Per REQ-YEC-001 / REQ-YEC-010.
automationTemplate.title: Automation Template

amountCents.description: Total closing-entry amount in minor units of the currency (integer cents). Per REQ-YEC-001. Money-safe arithmetic per the foundation cents-based convention.
amountCents.title: Amount Cents

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the closing entry amount.
currency.title: Currency

glTransactionId.description: Reference to the GLTransaction that materialised this closing entry when posted. Set by the lifecycle action on transition:post per REQ-YEC-009.
glTransactionId.title: GL Transaction ID

approvalStatus.description: Lifecycle state of the closing entry. draft -> pending-approval -> approved -> posted; or posted -> reversed. Per REQ-YEC-001 / REQ-YEC-009.
approvalStatus.title: Approval Status

approvedBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the financial officer / CFO who approved this closing entry. Per REQ-YEC-001.
approvedBy.title: Approved By

approvedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the closing entry was approved. Per REQ-YEC-001.
approvedAt.title: Approved At

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this closing entry. Per REQ-YEC-001.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Under construction. Editable. Not yet visible to approvers.

pending-approval.label: Pending approval
pending-approval.description: Submitted for CFO / financial-officer approval. Editable only by the originating bookkeeper until approved or rejected.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Approved by CFO / financial officer. Ready to post to the GL.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Materialised as a balanced GLTransaction. Immutable from the closing-entry side; reversed only via a compensating closing entry.

reversed.label: Reversed
reversed.description: Superseded by a compensating closing entry. Excluded from active reporting but remains queryable for audit.

submit.label: Submit for approval
submit.description: Bookkeeper submits the closing entry to the CFO for review per REQ-YEC-001.

approve.label: Approve
approve.description: CFO / financial-officer approves the closing entry per REQ-YEC-001.

post.label: Post to GL
post.description: Materialise the closing entry as a balanced GLTransaction with matching GLLine rows per REQ-YEC-009. The lifecycle action invokes the same materialisation extension T1 uses for JournalEntry per ADR-031.

reverse.label: Reverse
reverse.description: Mark this closing entry as reversed. A compensating closing entry must be created and posted separately to keep the GL balanced.

onPost.description: Materialise the approved closing entry as a balanced GLTransaction with matching GLLine rows per REQ-YEC-009. The lifecycle action mirrors the JournalEntry materialisation extension (T1). Lines are derived from the linked ClosingEntryTemplate.accountPattern (for automated entries) or from the operator-supplied draft body (for manual entries).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Closing Entry is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

ClosingEntryTemplate.title: Closing Entry Template
ClosingEntryTemplate.description: Declarative rule that drives automated closing-entry generation per REQ-YEC-004. Each template matches a range of account numbers, transfers their balances to the configured closing account, and optionally reverses in the next period. Lifecycle (active/paused/archived) lets operators disable templates without deleting them. Templates are consumed by the FiscalYear in-progress -> closed transition per REQ-YEC-010 and by the ClosingEntry materialisation hook per REQ-YEC-009.

templateId.description: Stable operator-readable identifier (e.g. revenue-closing). Unique per administrationId. Per REQ-YEC-004.
templateId.title: Template ID

templateName.description: Display name shown in the closing-entry generation UI. Per REQ-YEC-004.
templateName.title: Template Name

description.example: Close all revenue accounts (4000-4999) to income summary (9900).
description.title: Description

accountPattern.description: Account range or regex matching the GL accounts whose balances close through this template (e.g. 4000-4999 for revenue accounts, 5000-6999 for expense accounts). Per REQ-YEC-004.
accountPattern.title: Account Pattern

closingAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber. The target closing / income-summary account (typically 9900). Per REQ-YEC-004.
closingAccountNumber.title: Closing Account Number

reverseNextPeriod.description: When true, an accrual-reversal closing entry is generated in the next fiscal year reversing this one. Used for prior-period accrual reversals per REQ-YEC-004.
reverseNextPeriod.title: Reverse Next Period

automationTrigger.description: When this template fires. on-close = at the FiscalYear in-progress -> closed transition (default); on-check = during the closing checklist; manual = only when explicitly invoked. Per REQ-YEC-004.
automationTrigger.title: Automation Trigger

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this template. Per REQ-YEC-004.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

lifecycleState.description: Whether this template is consumed by the FiscalYear close lifecycle. paused = skipped this cycle but remains in the catalogue; archived = retained for audit only. Per REQ-YEC-004.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

Commitment.title: Commitment
Commitment.description: A financial obligation (commitment) that reserves budget. The obligation may originate manually, from an inkooporder, or from a won TenderNed tender (bron field, REQ-001). A concept obligation must be enriched (kostenplaats, grootboekrekening) and activated by a contractmanager before it locks budget (design D2). This fragment is the TenderNed OVERLAY on the Commitment schema: bookkeeping-verplichtingenadministratie.json owns the schema and is the single place its `required` list is declared, because ADR-037's deepMergeConfig() CONCATENATES list values — two `required` declarations become an unsatisfiable union. Everything below is additive: TenderNed provenance (bron, bronReferentie, gegundeLeverancierKvk), the milestone plan, and the concept -> active enrichment lifecycle.

commitmentNumber.description: Sequential obligation number unique per administration, as written by TenderNedAwardDetectedListener and read by CommitmentGuard. This is the camelCase half of a LIVE TWO-SPELLING SPLIT — bookkeeping-verplichtingenadministratie.json owns this schema and declares `verplichtingsnummer` for the commitment-accounting path, which is the spelling in the merged `required` list. Until the two collapse, a record written through the TenderNed path does not satisfy that requirement. Resolving the split belongs to the English domain rename (Commitment -> Commitment), which owns the repair step that migrates stored values; renaming here without one would make every stored value invisible, because OpenRegister's MagicMapper discards undeclared properties.

commitment-approval.description: Approval chain that gates the Commitment in_approval -> committed `goedkeuren` transition (REQ-VPL-013). A commitment reaches in_approval only when MandateEnforcer::requiresApproval routed it there because the signer's mandaat was insufficient (REQ-VPL-002); this chain then runs the finance approval workflow that releases it. Threshold-routed on totaalbedrag_excl_btw (EUR cents): a single commitment-administrator approves from EUR 0, and a finance-director approves commitments at or above EUR 250.000. Separation of duties is enforced - the requester who submitted the commitment cannot approve their own step. On completion the goedkeuren transition auto-advances (BudgetBlocker still gates the budget). Declarative metadata only: OpenRegister's approval-workflow primitive (x-openregister-approval-chains, ApprovalChainGateListener/ApprovalChainAdvanceListener) materialises and gates the actual steps; this app ships no PHP approval-chain implementation. INERT until the OpenRegister release carrying the declarative approval-chains capability (PR #396/#397) is deployed - see openspec/changes/migrate-mandaat-to-approval-chains/design.md for the sequencing and the named follow-up.

committedVsRealisedPerBudgetLine.description: REQ-VPL-011: per-budget-line committed-vs-realised rollup, grouped by budget coderingscombinatie (programma + kostenplaats + boekjaar + grootboekrekening). Excludes afgesloten regels. verplicht = sum(restant_verplicht); gerealiseerd = sum(gefactureerd_bedrag); geautoriseerd is joined from the matching CommitmentBudget (administrationId + programmaCode = programma + boekjaar); vrij = geautoriseerd - verplicht - gerealiseerd is computed by the drilldown view (BudgetLineCommitments.vue) from these three declared figures — no parallel PHP reporting service (ADR-031).
committedVsRealisedPerBudgetLine._grammar_note: Rewritten into OpenRegister's actual annotation vocabulary (openregister#2846 + #2849). It previously used `source` and a `sum` list, neither of which the engine reads — the runner recognised the aggregation by NAME and understood none of its body, returning metric:"", field:null, groups:[] against live objects with no error at all (issue #1216). `source` is dropped because this is an intra-schema aggregation declared ON CommitmentLine; `from` is the cross-schema key and would have sent it down a different path. `sum: [a, b]` becomes `metrics: [{metric, field}, ...]`, the multi-metric spelling. `on` uses the explicit {parentField: joinedField} map rather than the string shorthand: the shorthand names only the joined side and leaves the parent side to be inferred from the group fields, which happens to give the right answer here but is a guess, and the map is the only spelling that could express a composite key later.
committedVsRealisedPerBudgetLine._scoping_note: administrationId is NOT declared here, deliberately. It used to read `@self.administrationId`, which is not a placeholder the resolver knows — `$currentUser` is the only one — so it was left literal, matched nothing, and filtered every row away. Declaring it as a constant is impossible because it differs per caller, so scoping is supplied BY the caller as a narrowing filter: BudgetLineCommitments.vue passes filter[administrationId] from /api/administrations/context. openregister#2852 makes that safe — a request filter may ADD a constraint and can never relax or replace a declared one, so this cannot become a way to widen the set. Do not re-add a placeholder here without first checking PlaceholderResolver actually implements it.

complianceScore.description: Weighted rule-match aggregation per REQ-SCHATKIST-006 — sums the per-rule weight contribution of every PASSING BankingRule (where isActive=true AND administrationId=@self.administrationId), scaled to 0-100. With N active rules each rule contributes 100/N points on pass and 0 on fail (uniform weighting baseline). Operator-configurable per-rule weight overrides are out of scope for the T2 baseline.

criteriaResults.description: Per-rule evaluation status array per REQ-SCHATKIST-006 — one entry per active BankingRule with { ruleNumber, ruleType, severity, status: pass|fail, evaluatedAt }. complianceByAdministrationAndPeriod.description: Period-based compliance metric (REQ-SCHATKIST-007). GROUP BY (administrationId, reportPeriod) over ComplianceReport, computing totalAccounts (count distinct treasuryAccountId), compliantCount (count where complianceScore >= 100), nonCompliantCount, averageComplianceScore, and compliancePercentage = 100 * compliantCount / totalAccounts.

complianceByRuleType.description: Per-rule-type pass/fail metric (REQ-SCHATKIST-007). GROUP BY criteriaResults[].ruleType across ComplianceReport.criteriaResults flattened, counting pass vs fail to identify systematically failing rules that need operator attention.

agingByLastCompliantDate.description: Aging-by-compliance metric (REQ-SCHATKIST-007). GROUP BY TreasuryAccount.lastCompliantDate bucketed into 0-30d / 31-60d / 60+d to surface accounts that need revalidation. NO PHP aggregation service — the engine handles bucketing.

Tokens are stored as salted bcrypt hashes (never plaintext) by TokenValidator. Lifecycle: active → redeemed (on confirmation) or revoked (on resend) or expired (when expiresAt passes). One Appointment may have multiple ConfirmationToken rows over time (e.g. after resend); the appointment's confirmationTokenId points at the current active token.

Contract.title: Contract
Contract.description: Generic contract master record covering every contract type (purchase, sales, service, subscription, lease, employment, other) per REQ-CLM-001. CRUD goes through OpenRegister's generic object surface (ADR-022) — no custom PHP model, no parallel table. The counterparty is referenced as a Nextcloud addressbook contact (counterpartyReference); no Party/Customer/Supplier schema is invented. Renewal terms are an embedded object (D3); renewalDecisionDate is a declared calculation. Documents are NC Files references (link, don't store; REQ-CLM-005). Lease contracts become a specialization by link via specializationReference → LeaseContract (REQ-CLM-007); generic records never duplicate lease accounting fields. Lifecycle and notifications are declarative (REQ-CLM-002 / REQ-CLM-004).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Contract repository register; every create / update / lifecycle transition (activate / markExpiring / expire / terminate / renew) is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022. The audit trail is the canonical evidence chain for renewal and termination decisions per REQ-CLM-002.

activate.description: Put the contract in force. Guard: startDate, counterpartyReference, and contractOwner must all be present (REQ-CLM-002).

Replace with a declarative condition when the lifecycle DSL supports multi-field required guards.

markExpiring.label: Mark expiring
markExpiring.description: Time-based transition: fires when today >= renewalDecisionDate. Evaluated by OR's scheduled lifecycle machinery (ADR-031 path 2) — NOT a shillinq cron/Job class.

x-scheduled-workflow.description: Daily 01:00 sweep transitions active → expiring when today >= renewalDecisionDate. The renewal-decision notification (REQ-CLM-004 rule 1) filters on renewalDecisionDate directly, so the notification SLA never depends on this flip having happened.

expire.label: Expire
expire.description: Time-based transition: fires when today > endDate and no renewal was executed. Evaluated by OR's scheduled lifecycle machinery (ADR-031 path 2).

x-scheduled-workflow.description: Daily 01:00 sweep transitions active|expiring → expired when today > endDate and status is not renewed/terminated.

terminate.label: Terminate contract
terminate.description: End the contract early. Guard: terminationReason must be present (fail-closed) per REQ-CLM-002.
terminate.x-adr-031-exception: The 'terminated requires terminationReason' precondition is a conditional-required field the declarative lifecycle DSL cannot yet express inside a requires clause; single-method fail-closed guard per ADR-031. Replace when the DSL supports conditional-required guards.

renew.label: Renew contract
renew.description: Renew the contract. Creates a linked successor Contract in draft carrying the renewal terms forward (startDate = predecessor endDate + 1 day, term = renewalTerms.renewalTermMonths), and sets predecessorContract / successorContract self-FKs on both records per REQ-CLM-002.

The spend dashboard renders an explicit 'no linked spend data' empty state until the chained schemas land.

ContractObligation.title: Contract Obligation
ContractObligation.description: Deadline-bearing obligation row owned by a Contract per REQ-CLM-003. The register row is the source of truth for the deadline and compliance status; the actionable to-do lives in NC Tasks (CalDAV VTODO) or a Deck card, created and linked by ObligationTaskBridge (taskUri). Evidence files are NC Files references (link, don't store). Shillinq declares NO task/todo schema of its own (ADR-022 / 'content types belong in leaves'). Deadline notifications fire from the OR notification engine on this row (REQ-CLM-004), so a deleted NC task never silences a deadline.

CurrencyBalance.title: Currency Balance
CurrencyBalance.description: Point-in-time per-currency balance snapshot for a (BankAccount, currency) pair (REQ-MC-003). DBAOpdracht.title: DBA opdracht
DBAOpdracht.description: Per-opdracht engagement registratie voor Wet DBA-compliance (REQ-DBA-001). Bevat ondernemingId + klantId, intake-status, gekozen modelovereenkomst, lopende risico-score (0-100) en risico-band (LAAG/LAAG_MIDDEN/MIDDEN_HOOG/HOOG), open-flags-count en evidence-dossier-ref. De lifecycle gaat van DRAFT -> INTAKE_VEREIST -> INTAKE_VOLTOOID -> ACTIEF -> BEEINDIGD. Save-precondition DBAOpdrachtGuard valideert dat een actieve opdracht een voltooide intake heeft (ADR-031 uitzondering).

DepositPayment.title: Deposit Payment
DepositPayment.description: A deposit (partial or full prepayment) collected at booking time via Mollie or Stripe, routed through OpenConnector. On authorization a Shillinq AR invoice is materialised; on void an AR credit note reverses it. Payment routing, tokenization and gateway selection are OpenConnector's responsibility — this register never stores card data (REQ-DP-001).

orderId.description: FK to the booking Order this deposit secures. Cross-app reference into the booking module; not resolved inside Shillinq.
orderId.title: Order ID

bookingTypeId.description: FK to the BookingType whose depositRule produced this deposit (cross-app reference for rule lookup).
bookingTypeId.title: Booking Type ID

amount.description: Deposit amount in minor units (EUR cents). 7500 = EUR 75.00.
amount.title: Amount

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Always EUR for now; a distinct field so T5 multi-currency does not break T2 logic (REQ-DP-009).
currencyCode.title: Currency Code

taxRate.description: VAT rate (percent) applied when materialising the AR invoice. Defaults to the Dutch standard rate.
taxRate.title: Tax Rate

eventDate.description: Date of the booked event. Used together with dueOffsetDays to compute the deposit due date (REQ-DP-002, REQ-DP-003).
eventDate.title: Event Date

dueOffsetDays.description: Days before eventDate that the deposit is due, copied from the BookingType depositRule at creation. Range [0, 365] (REQ-DP-002).
dueOffsetDays.title: Due Offset Days

lineDescription.description: Human-readable description used for the AR invoice line item.
lineDescription.title: Line Description

state.title: State

paymentIntentId.description: Opaque payment intent reference from the gateway (Mollie tr_XXXX or Stripe pi_XXXX). NOT a token; carries no card data (REQ-DP-001).
paymentIntentId.title: Payment Intent ID

paymentGateway.description: Gateway selected by OpenConnector from customer preference.
paymentGateway.title: Payment Gateway

paymentMethod.description: Concrete payment method chosen at the gateway.

arInvoiceId.title: AR Invoice ID

creditNoteId.description: FK to the Shillinq AR credit note materialised on void (REQ-DP-008).
creditNoteId.title: Credit Note ID

refundPolicy.description: How a refund is handled on booking cancellation: automatic via OpenConnector, or queued for operator approval (REQ-DP-008).
refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy

lastErrorCode.description: Machine error code from the last failed authorization (e.g. insufficient_funds) (REQ-DP-011).
lastErrorCode.title: Last Error Code

lastErrorMessage.example: Insufficient funds. Please use a different card.
lastErrorMessage.title: Last Error Message

lastWebhookAttempt.description: Timestamp of the last gateway webhook event received for this deposit. Used by the polling fallback to detect stalled deposits (REQ-DP-007).
lastWebhookAttempt.title: Last Webhook Attempt

authorizedAt.description: Timestamp when the payment was authorized.
authorizedAt.title: Authorized At

capturedAt.description: Timestamp when the payment was captured/settled.
capturedAt.title: Captured At

voidedAt.description: Timestamp when the deposit was voided/refunded.
voidedAt.title: Voided At

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this deposit for tenant isolation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Created. No payment intent yet; amount and rule are being validated.

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: Payment intent created at the gateway via OpenConnector; awaiting async confirmation (iDEAL/checkout).

authorized.label: Authorized
authorized.description: Funds reserved. An AR invoice has been materialised and the booking Order may advance to confirmed.

captured.label: Captured
captured.description: Funds settled into the merchant account.

failed.label: Failed
failed.description: Authorization rejected by the gateway. lastErrorCode/lastErrorMessage carry the reason.

voided.label: Voided
voided.description: Deposit refunded or cancelled. An AR credit note reverses the invoice.

requestPayment.label: Request payment
requestPayment.description: Create the payment intent at the gateway through OpenConnector and present the customer payment link. Validates the deposit rule preconditions (REQ-DP-002) before allowing the transition.

guard.description: Deposit rule must be valid: amount > 0, dueOffsetDays in [0,365], currencyCode is a 3-letter ISO code.

conditions.message: Deposit amount must be greater than zero.

action.description: Calls OpenConnector.createPaymentIntent(amount, currencyCode, orderId) and stores the returned paymentIntentId, paymentGateway and paymentMethod. No card data is stored (REQ-DP-001).

authorize.label: Authorize
authorize.description: Idempotently mark the deposit authorized when the gateway confirms (webhook or polling fallback). Materialises the AR invoice (REQ-DP-003).

action.description: Creates a Shillinq AR invoice for this deposit: customer derived from the Order, one line item (lineDescription, amount, taxRate), dueDate = eventDate minus dueOffsetDays, sourceDocumentUri = urn:nextcloud:booking:deposit-payment:@self.id. Stores the new invoice id in arInvoiceId (REQ-DP-003).

fail.label: Fail
fail.description: Record an authorization failure. lastErrorCode/lastErrorMessage are set from the gateway response (REQ-DP-011). The booking Order is cancelled by the booking module.

voidFromAuthorized.label: Void (refund)
voidFromAuthorized.description: Void an authorized deposit on booking cancellation. If refundPolicy = automatic_on_cancellation, initiate a refund via OpenConnector and create an AR credit note (REQ-DP-008).

action.description: Initiates OpenConnector.initiateRefund(paymentIntentId, amount) when refundPolicy is automatic_on_cancellation, then creates a Shillinq AR credit note reversing arInvoiceId and stores it in creditNoteId (REQ-DP-008).

voidFromCaptured.label: Void (refund captured)
voidFromCaptured.description: Void a captured deposit; same refund + credit-note behaviour as voidFromAuthorized (REQ-DP-008).

action.description: Refund via OpenConnector and create the reversing AR credit note (REQ-DP-008).

dueDate.description: The date the deposit invoice is due: eventDate minus dueOffsetDays. If the event is within dueOffsetDays from today, the deposit is due immediately (REQ-DP-002).

vatAmount.description: VAT portion of the gross deposit amount, computed inclusive: amount - (amount / (1 + taxRate/100)).

netAmount.description: Net (ex-VAT) portion of the gross deposit amount.

paymentLink.description: Customer-facing payment URL embedded in the confirmation email. Embeds the deposit id, the AR invoice id and a short-lived signed token; clicking opens OpenConnector's hosted payment UI (REQ-DP-005). Only meaningful while state is pending.

isOverdue.description: True when the deposit is still pending and its due date has passed.

byState.description: Number of deposits per lifecycle state — drives the Deposits overview state filter (REQ-DP-010).

pendingByDueDate.description: Total pending deposit value grouped by due date, for the operator follow-up worklist (REQ-DP-010).

failedCount.description: Count of failed deposits requiring operator follow-up (REQ-DP-011).

onAuthorized.description: Confirm to the booking-operator that the deposit was authorized and the invoice was created.

subject.nl: Aanbetaling geautoriseerd: {{amount}} cent voor boeking {{orderId}}; factuur {{arInvoiceId}} aangemaakt
subject.en: Deposit authorized: {{amount}} cents for booking {{orderId}}; invoice {{arInvoiceId}} created

onFailed.description: Alert the booking-operator that a deposit authorization failed and needs follow-up.

onVoided.description: Confirm a refund was initiated and a credit note created.

subject.nl: Aanbetaling teruggeboekt voor boeking {{orderId}}; creditnota {{creditNoteId}} aangemaakt
subject.en: Deposit refunded for booking {{orderId}}; credit note {{creditNoteId}} created

shillinq-deposit-polling-fallback.name: Deposit polling fallback
shillinq-deposit-polling-fallback.description: Every 5 minutes, queries all DepositPayment records with state=pending and reconciles them against OpenConnector.getPaymentStatus(paymentIntentId), so a lost or delayed gateway webhook never leaves a deposit pending indefinitely (REQ-DP-007). No app-local BackgroundJob extends TimedJob; reconciliation is idempotent (REQ-DP-006).

depositStatus.title: Deposit
depositStatus.description: Booking-detail widget showing deposit state, amount, payment link and the linked AR invoice (REQ-DP-010).

DepreciationSchedule.title: Depreciation Schedule
DepreciationSchedule.description: Per-asset, per-fiscal-year depreciation schedule record (REQ-FA-003). Immutable append-only history backing the audit trail for tax-compliance review (Wet Vpb / Wet IB). depreciationAmount is materialised at period close (or on demand by the DepreciationCalculator) using the asset's depreciationMethod, annualRate and the System Settings Float Precision rounding. bookValue is a derived calculation (purchaseCost − accumulatedDepreciation) and not stored separately. status tracks the schedule lifecycle (planned → active → completed).

scheduleNumber.description: Unique identifier within an administration (e.g. SCH-FA-0001-2026).
scheduleNumber.title: Schedule Number

assetRef.description: FK to FixedAsset UUID — the asset this schedule covers.
assetRef.title: Asset Ref

depreciationMethod.description: Depreciation method applied for this schedule. Mirrors the asset's depreciationMethod at schedule-creation time; immutable thereafter.
depreciationMethod.title: Depreciation Method

annualRate.description: Annual depreciation rate (percentage of depreciable base for linear, declining percentage for declining-balance, units/year for units-of-production). Rounded to System Settings Float Precision per REQ-FA-005.
annualRate.title: Annual Rate

periodStartDate.description: Start date of the depreciation period (typically fiscal-year start).
periodStartDate.title: Period Start Date

periodEndDate.description: End date of the depreciation period (typically fiscal-year end).
periodEndDate.title: Period End Date

depreciationAmount.description: Depreciation expense for this period in base currency. Rounded to System Settings Float Precision per REQ-FA-005.
depreciationAmount.title: Depreciation Amount

accumulatedDepreciation.description: Total accumulated depreciation across all periods through periodEndDate. Equal to the sum of prior depreciationAmounts plus this period's amount.
accumulatedDepreciation.title: Accumulated Depreciation

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year this schedule covers (e.g. 2026).
fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year

status.description: Schedule lifecycle. planned = generated but not yet within period; active = within period; completed = period has ended.
status.title: Status

costCenterCode.description: REQ-FA-006 — Cost-centre allocation at schedule-creation time. Updated by the internal-transfer lifecycle action when a subsequent transfer reallocates depreciation.
costCenterCode.title: Cost Center Code

administrationId.description: FK to Administration — scoping field for multi-administratie installs.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

glTransactionRef.description: When the yearly depreciation-expense posting has been materialised, FK to the resulting GLTransaction UUID. Null until the workflow ticks for the period.
glTransactionRef.title: GL Transaction Ref

calculationFloatPrecision.description: REQ-FA-005 — the Nextcloud System Settings Float Precision value captured at calculation time. Persisted so re-runs can reproduce the rounding deterministically. Defaults to 2 (Dutch accounting standard) when System Settings is unavailable.
calculationFloatPrecision.title: Calculation Float Precision

bookValue.description: Net book value at period end = FixedAsset.purchaseCost − accumulatedDepreciation. Computed field; not stored independently.
bookValue.title: Book Value

bookValue.description: REQ-FA-003 — Net book value at periodEndDate. Computed as FixedAsset.acquisitionCost − accumulatedDepreciation. Not stored.

depreciationAmountByCostCenter.description: REQ-FA-009 (2) — sum of depreciationAmount grouped by costCenterCode for the current fiscal year. Drives the Depreciation Expense cost-center report.

depreciationAmountByMethod.description: REQ-FA-009 (1) — sum of depreciationAmount grouped by depreciationMethod for the current fiscal year. Drives the Depreciation Expense method-mix report.

accumulatedDepreciationByAsset.description: REQ-FA-009 (3) — sum of depreciationAmount grouped by assetRef across all closed periods. Drives the asset-by-asset accumulated-depreciation report.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Depreciation Schedule is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

Derivaat.title: Derivaat
Derivaat.description: Interest-rate swaps / caps / floors / collars restricted to hedging-only purposes per RUDDO (REQ-FDO-004). A derivaat may only be recorded with a RUDDOJustification demonstrating a hedge-relationship to an existing Lening or KasgeldPositie, a notional that does not exceed the hedged exposure, and a counterparty rating of single-A or better; speculative derivatives are never recorded. The FidoTreasuryGuard enforces these cross-field preconditions. Lifecycle: draft → recorded → matured.

organisationId.description: FK to the organisation; reads scoped to the requesting user's organisation.
organisationId.title: Organisation ID

notional.description: Notional amount; must not exceed the hedged exposure (REQ-FDO-004).
notional.title: Notional

hedgedExposureId.description: FK to the underlying Lening (or KasgeldPositie) being hedged; mandatory per RUDDO (REQ-FDO-004).
hedgedExposureId.title: Hedged Exposure ID

hedgedExposureAmount.description: Amount of the hedged exposure the notional is checked against (REQ-FDO-004).
hedgedExposureAmount.title: Hedged Exposure Amount

marketValue.description: Mark-to-market value (negative for an unrealised loss).
marketValue.title: Market Value

RUDDOJustification.description: Narrative demonstrating the hedge-relationship per RUDDO Article 2 (REQ-FDO-004). Mandatory; a derivaat without a hedging justification is never recorded.
RUDDOJustification.example: IRS to hedge floating-rate risk on the €10M floating-rate lening maturing 2028-06-30
RUDDOJustification.title: Ruddo Justification

counterpartyRating.description: Counterparty long-term credit rating; must be single-A or better per RUDDO (REQ-FDO-004).
counterpartyRating.title: Counterparty Rating

status.description: Lifecycle status (REQ-FDO-004).
status.title: Status

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Entered but not yet validated against RUDDO.

recorded.label: Recorded
recorded.description: Passed RUDDO hedging-only validation; a valid hedge.

matured.label: Matured
matured.description: Reached maturity; closed for the audit trail.

record.label: Record derivaat
record.description: Record the derivaat once RUDDO hedging-only validation passes: justification + hedge-link + notional ≤ hedged exposure + counterparty rating ≥ A (REQ-FDO-004).

mature.label: Mark matured
mature.description: Mark the derivaat matured at the end of its hedge term.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Derivaat is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

DeterminationLetter.title: Determination Letter
DeterminationLetter.description: Immutable archival payroll document (REQ-PAY-006): loonstrookje, werkgeversverklaring or salary certificate. Generated on payroll issue; PDF rendering delegated to an external service and attached via OR files relation. 7-year retention per Archiefwet.

year.description: Reporting year for werkgeversverklaring / annual certificates.
year.title: Year

content.description: Human-readable summary (gross, deductions, net, tax details). No raw BSN (ADR-005).
content.title: Content

fileUri.description: URI of the attached rendered PDF (OR files relation). Content lives outside this record (ADR-022).
fileUri.title: File URI

retentionExpiryDate.description: 7 years after generation; eligible for destruction afterwards (Archiefwet).
retentionExpiryDate.title: Retention Expiry Date

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

retention.description: Determination letters retained 7 years per Archiefwet.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Read-only after the retention review (REQ-PAY-006).

archive.label: Archive
archive.description: Transition to read-only archival after the active period.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Determination Letter is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

DirectDebitBatch.title: Direct Debit Batch
DirectDebitBatch.description: A pain.008.001.02 batch aggregating homo-sequence collections for submission (REQ-SDD-005). pain008Xml / pain002Xml are archived 7+ years (bewaarplicht, design D11).

controlSum.description: Sum of all collection amounts in EUR; equals pain.008 CtrlSum (REQ-SDD-005).

requestedCollectionDate.description: Date funds should hit the creditor account (REQ-SDD-002).

endToEndId.description: Unique end-to-end identifier per creditor, max 35 chars (REQ-SDD-002).
endToEndId.title: End To End ID

status.description: Collection lifecycle status (REQ-SDD-002, REQ-SDD-006, REQ-SDD-007).

rejected.label: Rejected

DirectorReport.title: Director Report
DirectorReport.description: Bestuursverslag per art. 2:391 BW (REQ-T9-006), mandatory for middelgroot+. A separate entity from AnnualReport (design D8) so it can be versioned and signed independently. Sections (algemeen, financiële-gang, risico's, toekomst, personeel, milieu, optional r-d and esg) carry auto-populated context plus operator narrative.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on DualTransaction with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

baseTransactionId.description: FK to the base GLTransaction both ledgers derive from (REQ-DGAAP-003).
baseTransactionId.title: Base Transaction ID

rjJournalEntries.description: Journal lines booked under the RJ ledger.
rjJournalEntries.title: Rj Journal Entries

ifrsJournalEntries.description: Journal lines booked under the IFRS ledger.
ifrsJournalEntries.title: Ifrs Journal Entries

divergenceAmount.description: Absolute value of the divergence between the RJ and IFRS treatment, in the administration currency (REQ-DGAAP-003).
divergenceAmount.title: Divergence Amount

divergenceReasonCode.description: Standard-specific reason for the divergence (REQ-DGAAP-003). Empty/absent while the transaction is still being classified.
divergenceReasonCode.title: Divergence Reason Code

divergenceClassification.description: Permanence of the divergence; temporary differences drive deferred tax under IAS 12 (REQ-DGAAP-006).
divergenceClassification.title: Divergence Classification

deferredTaxEffect.description: Deferred-tax impact of a temporary difference (amount × statutory rate); zero for permanent differences and reclassifications (REQ-DGAAP-006).
deferredTaxEffect.title: Deferred Tax Effect

classificationOverridden.description: True when a group-accountant manually overrode the auto-classification (REQ-DGAAP-003).
classificationOverridden.title: Classification Overridden

overrideReason.description: Audit-trail reason for a manual classification override (REQ-DGAAP-003).
overrideReason.title: Override Reason

state.description: Lifecycle state (REQ-DGAAP-003).
state.title: State

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration (REQ-DGAAP-003).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

DualTransaction.title: Dual Transaction
DualTransaction.description: Links one base GL transaction to its parallel RJ and IFRS journal entries, with the divergence amount, reason code and permanence classification (REQ-DGAAP-003, REQ-DGAAP-006). Auto-populated on GL materialisation; the group-accountant may override the classification with an audit-trail reason. Lifecycle: open → classified → reconciled.

open.label: Open
open.description: Materialised under both ledgers; divergence not yet classified.

classified.label: Classified
classified.description: Divergence reason code and permanence assigned (auto or manual override).

reconciled.label: Reconciled
reconciled.description: Included in a period ReconciliationBridge; deferred-tax effect recorded where the difference is temporary.

classify.label: Classify divergence
classify.description: Assign the divergence reason code and permanence (REQ-DGAAP-003).

reconcile.label: Mark reconciled
reconcile.description: Include in the period bridge; requires a reason code and (for temporary differences) a deferred-tax effect (REQ-DGAAP-006).

reopen.label: Reopen for reclassification
reopen.description: Return to open to revise the divergence classification (REQ-DGAAP-003).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on DunningLadder with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

enterpriseId.description: Optional FK to the owning Administration / ondernemer. When null, the ladder applies tenant-wide within the administration scope.
enterpriseId.title: Onderneming ID

customerGroup.description: Customer cohort the ladder applies to. GOVERNMENT gets statutory 30-day terms per Wet betalingstermijnen overheid; VIP softens stage 4–5; AGGRESSIVE accelerates timing.
customerGroup.title: Klant Groep

daysAfterExpiryDate.title: Dagen Na Verval Datum

templateId.description: FK to the docudesk template that renders subject + body for this stage.
templateId.title: Template ID

statutoryEffect.description: Optional legal effect marker. 14_DAYS_BRIEF_BIK triggers the mandatory B2C 14-day grace text (art. 6:96 lid 6 BW); DEFAULT_ENTRY marks formal default (verzuim van rechtswege).
statutoryEffect.title: Wettelijk Effect

action.description: Optional terminal action (e.g. TRANSFER_INCASSO at the overdraft stage).
action.title: Actie

actief.title: Actief

administrationId.title: Administration ID

DunningLadder.title: Dunning Ladder
DunningLadder.description: Configuration of a multi-stage dunning ladder per ondernemer or per klantgroep (DEFAULT, OVERHEID, VIP, AGGRESSIVE). Each stage declares dagenNaVervalDatum, kanaal (EMAIL / EMAIL+POSTREGISTRATIE / AANGETEKENDE_POST / INCASSOBUREAU_API), template reference (docudesk), and optional wettelijkEffect marker (14_DAGEN_BRIEF_BIK or VERZUIM_INTREDEN). One ondernemer MAY define multiple ladders. The active flag determines whether the ladder participates in automated dunning runs. REQ-CCD-001.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Under construction. May be edited freely.

active.label: Active
active.description: Participates in automated dunning runs.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Superseded. Retained for audit; not used at run time.

activate.label: Activate ladder
activate.description: Publish the ladder so the scheduler may pick it up.

archive.label: Archive ladder
archive.description: Take the ladder out of rotation. Existing in-flight DunningRun records keep their snapshot of stages.

DunningNotice.title: Dunning Notice
DunningNotice.description: Per-AP-invoice dunning timeline record per REQ-AP-005. One row per reminder dispatched against one APTransaction in the overdue state. Reminder cadence (reminder-1 at +14d, reminder-2 at +30d, formal-notice at +45d, collection at +60d — all customisable per administration via OR dunning-workflow policy) is owned by OR's dunning-workflow extension, NOT by an app-local PHP service (ADR-022 anti-pattern). This register is a thin audit-trail of what OR's engine emitted.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Dunning-notice timeline; every dispatch and acknowledgement is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022.

reminderLevel.description: Dunning escalation level per REQ-AP-005. Customisable cadence via OR dunning-workflow policy referenced from Payee.dunningPolicyRef.
reminderLevel.title: Reminder Level

dispatchedBy.description: Actor that dispatched the reminder. 'system' if emitted by OR's scheduled-workflow; otherwise the operator user-id.

templateRef.description: FK to OR notification template used for the dispatch.

acknowledgedAt.description: When the vendor acknowledged the notice (e.g. promise-to-pay or dispute response).
acknowledgedAt.title: Acknowledged At

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this dunning notice.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

DunningPauseDispute.title: Dunning Pause / Dispute
DunningPauseDispute.description: Pause registration on a dunning ladder for a specific invoice. Halts further DunningRun stage actions and IncassoKostenBerekening rente accrual. Resolved either by operator action or by the auto hard-deadline (default 60 days after pauzeStart). REQ-CCD-004.

active.label: Active
active.description: Pause is in force; no dunning runs may execute for the linked invoice and no rente accrues.

resolved.label: Resolved
resolved.description: Operator marked the dispute resolved or a partial settlement was reached. Ladder resumes from the stage where the pause began.

hardDeadlineExpired.label: Hard deadline expired
hardDeadlineExpired.description: The configured deadline elapsed without resolution; ladder auto-resumes.

resolve.label: Resolve dispute
resolve.description: Mark the dispute resolved (e.g. partial settlement). Sets pauzeEind.

expire.label: Hard deadline expired
expire.description: Reached hardDeadlineEindigt without operator action; ladder auto-resumes.

DunningRecord.title: Dunning Record
DunningRecord.description: A single dunning (aanmaning) communication issued against an overdue AR invoice per REQ-AR-007. DunningRecord objects are written declaratively by OR's dunning-workflow (REQ-AR-005); shillinq carries no app-local dunning service or table per ADR-022.

issuedDate.description: Date the dunning communication was issued.

dueDate.description: New payment deadline in the notice.

executed.label: Executed

execute.label: Execute dunning run

lock.label: Lock dunning run

runsPerInvoice.label: Runs per invoice

deliveryByStage.label: Delivery by stage

EInvoiceMandate.title: E-Invoicing Mandate Profile

Atomic versioned submission unit; carries the computed EMU-saldo, bruto EMU-schuld ultimo, BBV-aansluiting and CBS-bevestiging. Lifecycle concept → ingediend → herzien per Wet Hof art. 10 (REQ-EMU-001/006). Audit-trail + 10-jaar retention per Archiefwet 1995 (REQ-EMU-012).

ENSIAJaarcyclus.title: ENSIA Jaarcyclus
ENSIAJaarcyclus.description: Annual ENSIA self-evaluation cycle for a Dutch public-sector organisation (REQ-ENSIA-001). One record per (organisatie, jaar). Carries the six-state lifecycle gating cycle intake → answering → peer-review → college-akkoord → portal submission → closure. The vraagSetVersion stamp records which BIO question set version was loaded at cycle initialisation so external auditors can trace the source (REQ-ENSIA-001 second scenario). procesEigenaar owns the assignment + transitions; per-question beantwoorder and peerReviewer are recorded on Evaluatievraag children.

EsrsStatement.title: ESRS Statement
EsrsStatement.description: A flat, self-contained CSRD/ESRS sustainability statement for one reporting period, capturing the period's quantitative ESRS datapoints (GHG Scope 1/2/3 + arithmetic total and intensity, energy mix, pollution, water, biodiversity, circular-economy, own-workforce, business-conduct metrics) and the cross-cutting targets[] set, plus the IFRS S2 climate-risk/opportunity exposures. Used by the sustainability rule domain to evaluate presence, sum, enumeration and threshold obligations of the ESRS (Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2772) and IFRS S2. Per ADR-022 this is a register object, not an embedded structure; it is the auditable reporting summary that sits above the granular GhgInventory / EmissionSource / EsrsDataPoint model.

EuVatRate.description: Per-country, per-period EU VAT rate mirroring the European Commission Taxes in Europe Database (TEDB) v3 (REQ-OSS-001, REQ-OSS-011). Seeded on install and refreshed periodically; manual edits are forbidden (readonly) because applying a hand-typed rate would defeat the audit-trail purpose. The OssRateResolver service resolves the rate effective on the invoice date by (countryCode, rateCategory).

rateByCountryCategoryDate.description: Declarative shape of the rate resolution OssRateResolver performs (REQ-OSS-001): select the EuVatRate row for (countryCode, rateCategory) whose validFrom <= invoiceDate and (validUntil is null or validUntil >= invoiceDate). When the OR aggregation engine cannot express the validity-window selection, OssRateResolver computes it in PHP from the real ObjectService API.

Evaluatievraag.title: ENSIA Evaluatievraag
Evaluatievraag.description: Single evaluation question within an ENSIAJaarcyclus (REQ-ENSIA-001 + REQ-ENSIA-002 + REQ-ENSIA-003). One record per (cyclusId, vraagCode). Carries antwoordType (ja-nee-nvt / volwassenheidsniveau-1-5 / vrije-tekst); antwoord; volwassenheidsScore; toelichting; bewijsstukken; beantwoorder; peerReviewer; peerReviewStatus state machine. Maturity ≥ 3 requires bewijsstukken non-empty AND toelichting ≥ 50 chars per REQ-ENSIA-003 — enforced declaratively at persist preconditions plus the ENSIAValidationGuard fallback. Post-peer-review edits require a `reden` field per REQ-ENSIA-008 (enforced by ENSIAValidationGuard).
