x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Evaluatievraag mutations (antwoord, volwassenheidsScore, toelichting, bewijsstukken, peerReviewStatus) MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 / REQ-ENSIA-008 — pre-peer-review edits record actor + timestamp + before/after; post-peer-review edits additionally require reden (enforced by ENSIAValidationGuard).

OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on ExpenseClaimEntry with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

settlementMode.description: Claim-level dual-mode classification per REQ-ERP-001 / REQ-ERP-003. All line items (Receipt / MileageEntry / PerDiem) MUST have matching settlementMode (mixed-mode claims rejected per REQ-ERP-003). Immutable after submission unless an authorised operator triggers GL reversal per REQ-ERP-011.
settlementMode.title: Settlement Mode

totalReimbursableAmount.description: Sum of Receipt.amountInBaseCurrency + MileageEntry.totalAmount + PerDiem.allowanceAmount where settlementMode = reimbursable. Aggregated declaratively (REQ-ERP-003).
totalReimbursableAmount.title: Total Reimbursable Amount

totalPassThroughAmount.description: Sum of line markupAmountCalculated values where settlementMode = pass-through (cost + markup). Aggregated declaratively (REQ-ERP-003).
totalPassThroughAmount.title: Total Pass Through Amount

passThroughCustomerIds.description: Unique list of linkedCustomerId values across pass-through line items. Populated declaratively for multi-customer pass-through claims (REQ-ERP-003, REQ-ERP-009).
passThroughCustomerIds.title: Pass Through Customer Ids

glReimbursableTransactionId.description: Back-reference to materialised GLTransaction for the reimbursable path (debit expense-payable, credit cost centres). Set by the reimbursable-path post action (REQ-ERP-007).
glReimbursableTransactionId.title: GL Reimbursable Transaction ID

glPassThroughTransactionId.description: Back-reference to materialised GLTransaction for the pass-through path (debit customer AR, credit cost centres + revenue-deferral). Set by the pass-through path post action (REQ-ERP-007).
glPassThroughTransactionId.title: GL Pass Through Transaction ID

reimbursementPolicyId.description: FK to the ReimbursementPolicy applied to this claim — determines auto-approve threshold, optional markup-approval threshold, and the employee bank account mapping (REQ-ERP-004). Defaults to the administration's single active policy when null.
reimbursementPolicyId.title: Reimbursement Policy ID

claimNumber.description: Shillinq-side sequential claim ID per administration (e.g. EXP-2026-0001).
claimNumber.title: Claim Number

employeeId.description: FK to Person (employee submitting the claim).
employeeId.title: Employee ID

submittedDate.description: Timestamp when the claim was formally submitted for approval. Set by the submit lifecycle transition.
submittedDate.title: Submitted Date

fromDate.description: Start date of the expense period covered by this claim.
fromDate.title: From Date

toDate.description: End date of the expense period covered by this claim.
toDate.title: To Date

totalAmount.description: Sum of Receipt.amountInBaseCurrency + MileageEntry.totalAmount + PerDiem.allowanceAmount across all linked items. Auto-aggregated; always EUR (base currency) per REQ-EC-005.
totalAmount.title: Total Amount

currency.description: Always EUR (base currency) in T2. T5 adds multi-currency claims.
currency.title: Currency

receiptIds.description: References to the Receipt records linked to this claim.
receiptIds.title: Receipt Ids

mileageIds.description: References to the MileageEntry records linked to this claim.
mileageIds.title: Mileage Ids

perDiemIds.description: References to the PerDiem records linked to this claim.
perDiemIds.title: Per Diem Ids

approvalState.description: State of the OR approval-workflow for this claim per REQ-EC-006. Managed by OR approval-workflow engine; do not set directly.
approvalState.title: Approval State

state.description: Lifecycle state of the expense claim per REQ-EC-007.
state.title: State

glTransactionId.description: Back-reference to the materialised GLTransaction UUID once the claim is posted. Set by the post lifecycle action per REQ-EC-012.
glTransactionId.title: GL Transaction ID

costCentreAllocations.description: Claim-wide cost centre allocation map ({costCentreCode: percentage}). Per-line codes on Receipt/MileageEntry/PerDiem take precedence.
costCentreAllocations.title: Cost Centre Allocations

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this claim.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

settlementTotals.description: Auto-aggregates dual-path totals across linked Receipt + MileageEntry + PerDiem records grouped by settlementMode (REQ-ERP-003). Recomputed on every line-item save, frozen on submit per REQ-ERP-010. Also derives the unique passThroughCustomerIds list for downstream AR linking (REQ-ERP-009).

invoiced.label: Invoiced (pass-through)
invoiced.description: Pass-through path closure: claim cost + markup included on customer invoice; AR updated (REQ-ERP-007, REQ-ERP-009).

actions.description: REQ-ERP-007 reimbursable path: debit per expense line credit to expense-payable account (Account.isExpenseControlAccount=true); sets glReimbursableTransactionId. Identical to expense-capture-core REQ-EC-012 pattern but selected only when claim.settlementMode = reimbursable.

REQ-ERP-008 SEPA payment notification. Emits ExpenseClaimReimbursementNotification on the event bus for the treasury module to consume; logged in the OR audit trail; idempotent on (claimId, glReimbursableTransactionId). Treasury module is decoupled from Shillinq.

REQ-ERP-007 pass-through path: debit customer AR account (per Receipt/MileageEntry/PerDiem.passthroughDebitAccountCode, fallback ReimbursementPolicy.passthroughDebitAccountCode), credit cost centres + revenue-deferral on the markup delta. Sets glPassThroughTransactionId. Multiple GL entries are emitted when passThroughCustomerIds.length > 1 (REQ-ERP-009 multi-customer).

markReimbursed.description: REQ-ERP-007 reimbursable path closure: payment record matches claim total; SEPA instruction confirmed by treasury module. Available only when settlementMode = reimbursable.

markInvoiced.label: Mark as invoiced (pass-through)
markInvoiced.description: REQ-ERP-007 pass-through path closure: customer invoice generation cycle includes claim cost + markup on next AR invoice. Available only when settlementMode = pass-through (REQ-ERP-009).

changeSettlementMode.label: Change settlement mode (requires GL reversal)
changeSettlementMode.description: REQ-ERP-011 high-privilege transition. Reverses the existing GL entry (glReimbursableTransactionId or glPassThroughTransactionId) per T1 REQ-GL-004 before allowing a re-post with the updated settlementMode. Markup rate stays locked per REQ-ERP-010 on the original GL entry; new mode triggers a fresh lookup on re-post.

actions.description: Reverse the existing glReimbursableTransactionId or glPassThroughTransactionId per T1 REQ-GL-004.

search.description: Search expense claim headers. Use for 'which expense claims are waiting on approval?'. Line-level Receipt rows are reachable through the header and are not separately exposed.

get.description: Get a single expense claim entry by id.

ExpenseClaimEntry.title: Expense Claim
ExpenseClaimEntry.description: Operator-curated batch grouping N receipts, mileage journeys, and per-diem records into a single claim for approval and reimbursement. Lifecycle: draft → submitted → approved → posted → reimbursed with disputed/voided branches. Approval routing consumes OR approval-workflow per ADR-022 (no app-local approval table). Posting materialises a balanced GL entry per T1 REQ-JE-007 pattern. Per REQ-EC-005 through REQ-EC-013.

thresholds.description: Claims at or below €500 are auto-approved (approvalState: not-required) per REQ-EC-010.
Claims above €500 and at or below €5,000 require manager approval per REQ-EC-010.
Claims above €5,000 require CFO approval with dual-control (two independent approvals) per REQ-EC-010.

x-openregister-approval.note: All approval policy configuration (thresholds, roles, delegation) is managed through OR's approval-workflow UI per ADR-022. No app-local approval table.

employee.description: Employees may create and edit their own claims in draft state.

manager.description: Managers may approve or reject submitted claims.

bookkeeper.description: Full access for corrections and GL posting.

ExpiryAlert.title: Expiry Alert
ExpiryAlert.description: Notification record for lots approaching expiry, lots that have crossed their expiry date, and lots received without an expiry date for tracked products per REQ-LOT-007. Distinct register (not embedded on InventoryLot) so multiple thresholds per lot can coexist (30-day + 7-day), acknowledgement is tracked independently of lot state, and the alert history remains queryable after a lot is exhausted or expired. Alert generation is the responsibility of a daily background job (LotExpiryAlertJob); the schema is read-only from the operator dashboard side except for the acknowledge / resolve transitions. Spec: inventory-lot-batch-expiry.

lotId.description: REQ-LOT-007: FK to InventoryLot.id — the lot triggering the alert. Resolves via ?expand=lotId.
lotId.title: Lot ID

alertType.description: REQ-LOT-007 alert taxonomy. approaching_expiry: lot crosses a configured threshold (e.g. 30 days). expired: today > expiryDate. missing_expiry_date: requiresLotTracking item received without expiryDate.
alertType.title: Alert Type

daysBeforeExpiry.description: Days before expiryDate at which the alert was raised (e.g. 30, 7). Null for expired and missing_expiry_date alerts.
daysBeforeExpiry.title: Days Before Expiry

alertDate.description: REQ-LOT-007: date the alert was raised by the daily check.
alertDate.title: Alert Date

status.description: Alert lifecycle state. pending: not yet seen by an operator. acknowledged: operator has seen it (silences the dashboard counter). resolved: action taken (lot quarantined/disposed/relabelled). Drives the lifecycle transitions.
status.title: Status

resolvedDate.description: Date the alert was acknowledged or resolved. Stamped automatically by the lifecycle action.
resolvedDate.title: Resolved Date

recipientId.description: FK to Person.id — the operator notified. Optional; alerts may be dashboard-only (no individual recipient).
recipientId.title: Recipient ID

administrationId.description: FK to Administration. Scoped per org so multi-tenant installs do not leak alerts across administrations.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

notes.description: Operator acknowledgement notes — free text recorded on the acknowledge or resolve transition.
notes.example: Geconstateerd, lot in quarantaine geplaatst voor inspectie.
notes.title: Notes

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: Alert raised but not yet seen. Counted on the expiry dashboard badge.

acknowledged.label: Acknowledged
acknowledged.description: Operator has seen the alert (suppresses the dashboard badge). No corrective action taken yet.

resolved.label: Resolved
resolved.description: Terminal. Corrective action taken (lot quarantined, disposed, or relabelled). Stamps resolvedDate.

acknowledge.label: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: Operator marks the alert as seen.

resolve.label: Resolve
resolve.description: Operator marks the alert resolved after corrective action. Stamps resolvedDate.

FXContract.title: FX Contract
FXContract.description: Foreign-exchange contract with full IFRS 9 lifecycle (REQ-IHB-006). Records counterparty, instrument, buy/sell currency + amount, trade/value/settlement dates, contract rate, hedge designation and settlement instructions. Revalued at period close; unrealised gains/losses post to OCI or P&L per hedge designation (IFRS 9 §6.4).

contractRate.description: Agreed contract rate (buy currency per sell currency), three-decimal FX precision.
contractRate.title: Contract Rate

administrationId.description: Administration that holds the contract.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

state.description: FX contract lifecycle (REQ-IHB-006).
state.title: State

retention.description: FX contracts + confirmations retained 10 years per AWR art. 52.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a FX Contract is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

FXPosition.title: FX Position
FXPosition.description: Per-(entity, currency) open foreign-exchange position (REQ-IHB-006). Mark-to-market valuation and unrealised P&L are derived from the open position and the current spot rate; the consolidated group total is an aggregation across all entity positions per currency.

administrationId.description: Administration holding the position.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

foreignCurrency.description: Foreign currency of the open position, ISO 4217.
foreignCurrency.title: Foreign Currency

position.description: Net open position in the foreign currency (positive = long, negative = short).
position.title: Position

spotRate.description: Spot rate (reporting currency per foreign currency unit) at last valuation, three-decimal FX precision.
spotRate.title: Spot Rate

fairValue.description: Fair value of the position in reporting currency (derived: position × spotRate).
fairValue.title: Fair Value

unrealisedPL.description: Unrealised gain/loss in reporting currency since entry (derived).
unrealisedPL.title: Unrealised Pl

lastUpdated.description: Timestamp of the last revaluation; UI warns when stale > 1 hour (REQ-IHB-006).
lastUpdated.title: Last Updated

groupTotal.description: Consolidated group position per currency = sum of all entity positions and fair values (REQ-IHB-006, REQ-IHB-007).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a FX Position is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

ifrsComponents.description: The IFRS primary statements present in the complete set (IAS 1.10): financialPosition, profitOrLossOci, changesInEquity, cashFlows, notes.
ifrsComponents.title: Ifrs Components

cashFlowStatement.description: Cash flows classified into operating, investing and financing activities (IAS 7.10 / ASC 230), reconciling to the net change in cash for the period.

operating.description: Net cash flow from operating activities.
operating.title: Operating

investing.description: Net cash flow from investing activities.
investing.title: Investing

financing.description: Net cash flow from financing activities.
financing.title: Financing

netChange.description: Net increase/decrease in cash and cash equivalents.
netChange.title: Net Change

cashFlowStatement.title: Cash Flow Statement

pnlCategories.description: The IFRS 18.47 income/expense categories presented in the statement of profit or loss: operating, investing, financing, incomeTaxes, discontinuedOperations.
pnlCategories.title: Pnl Categories

operatingProfitSubtotal.description: The operating profit-or-loss subtotal required by IFRS 18.69.
operatingProfitSubtotal.title: Operating Profit Subtotal

inventoryCostFormula.description: Cost formula for interchangeable inventories (IAS 2.25). FIFO or weighted-average is permitted; LIFO is prohibited.
inventoryCostFormula.title: Inventory Cost Formula

internalGoodwillRecognised.description: True when internally generated goodwill is recognised as an asset. IAS 38.48 prohibits this — compliant statements set this false.
internalGoodwillRecognised.title: Internal Goodwill Recognised

internalBrandsRecognised.description: True when internally generated brands, mastheads, customer lists, etc., are recognised as intangible assets. IAS 38.63 prohibits this — compliant statements set this false.
internalBrandsRecognised.title: Internal Brands Recognised

goodwillImpairmentReversed.description: True when a goodwill impairment loss has been reversed. IAS 36.124 prohibits this — compliant statements set this false.
goodwillImpairmentReversed.title: Goodwill Impairment Reversed

contingentLiabilityRecognised.description: True when a contingent liability has been recognised. IAS 37.27 forbids recognition (disclosure only) — compliant statements set this false.
contingentLiabilityRecognised.title: Contingent Liability Recognised

fxInitialMeasurement.description: Initial recognition of a foreign-currency transaction at the spot rate at the transaction date (IAS 21.21): recordedAmount = foreignAmount x spotRate.

spotRate.description: Spot exchange rate at the transaction date.
spotRate.title: Spot Rate

recordedAmount.description: Functional-currency amount recorded on initial recognition.
recordedAmount.title: Recorded Amount

fxInitialMeasurement.title: Fx Initial Measurement

monetaryItemRateType.description: Exchange rate applied to foreign-currency monetary items at the reporting date. IAS 21.23(a) requires the closing rate.
monetaryItemRateType.title: Monetary Item Rate Type

nonMonetaryHistoricalRateType.description: Exchange rate applied to non-monetary items measured at historical cost. IAS 21.23(b) requires the transaction-date (historical) rate.
nonMonetaryHistoricalRateType.title: Non Monetary Historical Rate Type

currentTaxPosition.description: Current-tax position (IAS 12.12): unpaid current tax is recognised as a liability, any excess paid as an asset. The classification matches the sign of unpaidCurrentTax.

unpaidCurrentTax.description: Unpaid current tax for current and prior periods (negative when overpaid).
unpaidCurrentTax.title: Unpaid Current Tax

currentTaxPosition.title: Current Tax Position

deferredTaxDiscounted.description: True when deferred tax assets/liabilities are discounted. IAS 12.53 prohibits discounting — compliant statements set this false.
deferredTaxDiscounted.title: Deferred Tax Discounted

deferredTaxClassification.description: Balance-sheet classification of deferred tax. ASC 740 requires non-current classification on a classified balance sheet.
deferredTaxClassification.title: Deferred Tax Classification

shortTermBenefitsDiscounted.description: True when short-term employee benefits are discounted. IAS 19.11 requires the undiscounted amount — compliant statements set this false.
shortTermBenefitsDiscounted.title: Short Term Benefits Discounted

creditRiskExposure.description: IFRS 9 credit-risk staging for a representative financial asset. The 30-DPD SICR (5.5.11) and 90-DPD default (B5.5.37) presumptions are rebuttable.

sicrRebutted.description: True when the 30-DPD SICR presumption is rebutted with reasonable supportable information.
sicrRebutted.title: Sicr Rebutted

defaultRebutted.description: True when the 90-DPD default presumption is rebutted.
defaultRebutted.title: Default Rebutted

inDefault.description: True when the asset is classified in default.
inDefault.title: In Default

creditRiskExposure.title: Credit Risk Exposure

acquisitionDate.description: Acquisition date of a business combination (IFRS 3 / ASC 805), from which the measurement period runs.
acquisitionDate.title: Acquisition Date

measurementPeriodEnd.description: End of the business-combination measurement period. IFRS 3.45 / ASC 805 cap it at one year after the acquisition date.
measurementPeriodEnd.title: Measurement Period End

investeeVotingPowerPct.description: Percentage of voting power held in an investee. IAS 28 / ASC 323 presume significant influence (equity method) at 20% or more.
investeeVotingPowerPct.title: Investee Voting Power Pct

equityMethodApplied.description: True when the equity method is applied to the investment. Consistent with investeeVotingPowerPct >= 20%.
equityMethodApplied.title: Equity Method Applied

financingExpedientApplied.description: True when the IFRS 15.63 no-significant-financing-component practical expedient is applied (only valid when transferToPaymentDays <= 365).
financingExpedientApplied.title: Financing Expedient Applied

transferToPaymentDays.description: Expected number of days between transfer of goods/services and customer payment, for the IFRS 15.63 expedient.
transferToPaymentDays.title: Transfer To Payment Days

costObtainingExpedientApplied.description: True when the IFRS 15.94 practical expedient (expensing incremental costs of obtaining a contract) is applied (only valid when costAmortisationMonths <= 12).
costObtainingExpedientApplied.title: Cost Obtaining Expedient Applied

costAmortisationMonths.description: Amortisation period (in months) of the costs of obtaining a contract, for the IFRS 15.94 expedient.
costAmortisationMonths.title: Cost Amortisation Months

leaseRecognition.description: Lessee lease recognition (IFRS 16.22/16.37): right-of-use asset and lease liability at commencement, and the first-period interest at a constant periodic rate.

openingLiability.description: Opening lease liability for the first period.
openingLiability.title: Opening Liability

discountRate.description: Discount rate (periodic) used to unwind the liability.
discountRate.title: Discount Rate

leaseRecognition.title: Lease Recognition

shortTermLease.description: ASC 842 short-term-lease exemption: a lease of 12 months or less with no reasonably certain purchase option may be exempted by class.

purchaseOptionLikely.description: True when a purchase option is reasonably certain to be exercised.
purchaseOptionLikely.title: Purchase Option Likely

exemptionElected.description: True when the short-term exemption is elected (valid only when termMonths <= 12 and no purchase option).
exemptionElected.title: Exemption Elected

shortTermLease.title: Short Term Lease

classifiedBalanceSheet.description: ASC 210 classified balance sheet separating current from non-current assets and liabilities.

currentAssets.description: Assets expected to be realised within one year or the operating cycle.
currentAssets.title: Current Assets

currentLiabilities.description: Liabilities expected to be settled within one year or the operating cycle.
currentLiabilities.title: Current Liabilities

classifiedBalanceSheet.title: Classified Balance Sheet

comprehensiveIncome.description: ASC 220 comprehensive income: net income plus other comprehensive income equals total comprehensive income, in a single or two-statement format.

otherComprehensiveIncome.description: Other comprehensive income for the period.
otherComprehensiveIncome.title: Other Comprehensive Income

comprehensiveIncome.title: Comprehensive Income

asc848ModificationDate.description: Date a contract modification or hedging relationship relies on ASC 848 reference-rate-reform relief. The relief sunsets after 31 December 2024.
asc848ModificationDate.title: Asc848Modification Date

roundedToEuro.description: Whether the financial statements are presented in euro rounded to the euro (IT Codice civile art. 2423).
roundedToEuro.title: Rounded To Euro

inventoryMeasurementBasis.description: Inventory measurement basis; must state the lower of cost and net realisable value (IT art. 2426 n.9 / OIC 13 / ES PGC norma 10ª), e.g. 'lower-of-cost-and-nrv'.
inventoryMeasurementBasis.title: Inventory Measurement Basis

inventoryCostFormulaDisclosed.description: Whether the difference between the inventory cost formula and current cost at year-end is disclosed in the notes (IT art. 2426 n.10).
inventoryCostFormulaDisclosed.title: Inventory Cost Formula Disclosed

oic34Applied.description: Whether OIC 34 (Ricavi) is applied; required for IT statements whose period begins on or after 2024-01-01 (it-oic34-effective-2024).
oic34Applied.title: Oic34Applied

icac2021RevenueApplied.description: Whether the ICAC resolution of 10 Feb 2021 (norma 14ª five-step revenue model) is applied; required for ES statements whose period begins on or after 2021-01-01 (es-pgc-norma14-icac-2021).
icac2021RevenueApplied.title: Icac2021Revenue Applied

statementModel.description: The annual-accounts model the statement is drawn up on (e.g. 'full', 'normal', 'abbreviated', 'abreviado', 'pymes', 'micro'); must be consistent with the size class (ES PGC parte 3ª, BE NBB/BNB models).
statementModel.title: Statement Model

cashFlowStatementPresent.description: Whether a cash-flow statement is included; required for the normal/full model and omitted on the abbreviated model (ES PGC parte 3ª).
cashFlowStatementPresent.title: Cash Flow Statement Present

equityChangesStatementPresent.description: Whether a statement of changes in equity is included; required for the normal/full model (ES PGC parte 3ª).
equityChangesStatementPresent.title: Equity Changes Statement Present

retentionYears.description: Declared statutory record-retention period in years; must meet the jurisdiction minimum (IT 10y, ES 6y, BE 7y, PT/FR/DE/LU 10y, NL/AT 7y, NO 5y).
retentionYears.title: Retention Years

fixedAssetClasses.description: NL BW 2:365 subdivision of vaste activa into intangible, tangible and financial fixed assets; the three sum to the balanceSheet.fixedAssets total.
fixedAssetClasses.title: Fixed Asset Classes

intangibleAssetClasses.description: NL BW 2:365(1) separate disclosure of intangible fixed assets: development costs, concessions/licences/IP, goodwill paid and prepayments on intangibles.
intangibleAssetClasses.title: Intangible Asset Classes

tangibleAssetClasses.description: NL BW 2:366 subdivision of tangible fixed assets: land and buildings, plant and machinery, other operating assets, assets under construction / prepayments.
tangibleAssetClasses.title: Tangible Asset Classes

financialFixedAssetClasses.description: NL BW 2:367 disclosure of financial fixed assets: participating interests, group/participation receivables, other securities, other receivables.

groupReceivables.description: Receivables from group companies and participations.
groupReceivables.title: Group Receivables

financialFixedAssetClasses.title: Financial Fixed Asset Classes

FiscalPeriod.title: Fiscal Period
FiscalPeriod.description: A monthly/quarterly accounting period. Promotes T1's GLLine.periodId stub-string to a real register with an open -> closing -> closed -> audit-locked lifecycle per REQ-PC-001/REQ-PC-003. Postings against a closed period are rejected (REQ-PC-004). Year-end close is deferred to T3. Per ADR-022 the audit trail and per ADR-031 the lifecycle are consumed/declared, not reimplemented.

open.label: Open
open.description: Postings may be created and posted against this period.

closing.label: Closing
closing.description: Close in progress; trial-balance invariant being verified (REQ-TB-003).

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: Postings rejected (REQ-PC-004); reopenable by an elevated period-closer role with an audited reason.

audit-locked.label: Audit Locked
audit-locked.description: Terminal. Frozen after auditor sign-off; no further transitions permitted (REQ-PC-003).

start-close.label: Start close
start-close.description: Operator starts the close; trial-balance invariant must verify per REQ-TB-003.

confirm-close.label: Confirm close
confirm-close.description: Operator confirms close; all open AP/AR invoices in the period are settled or explicitly acknowledged. Writes closedAt + closedBy per REQ-PC-003.

reopen.label: Reopen period
reopen.description: Elevated period-closer role only; records the audited reopen reason in reopenedHistory per REQ-PC-003.

audit-lock.label: Audit lock
audit-lock.description: Auditor action. Irreversible; writes auditLockedAt + auditLockedBy per REQ-PC-003.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on FiscalYear with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

reopenReason.example: Correction of retained-earnings posting following 2026 audit finding

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this fiscal year. Combined with yearNumber forms the composite uniqueness key per D5.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

FiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year
FiscalYear.description: Fiscal year lifecycle record tracking the open -> closing -> closed -> reopened state machine for year-end close per REQ-YEC-001 through REQ-YEC-006. The open -> closing transition emits a balanced retained-earnings transfer JournalEntry (manual sub-type). The closing -> closed transition emits an opening-balance JournalEntry for the next year (balance-sheet accounts only) and fires CloudEvents for dimensional rollover. The admin-only closed -> reopened transition emits two reversing JournalEntry records pairing with the original journals for full audit traceability. No YearEndCloseService PHP class; all close logic is schema-declared per ADR-031.

open.label: Open
open.description: Fiscal year is active; GL transactions post normally to this period.

closing.label: Closing
closing.description: Year-end close is in progress (semantically the spec's in-progress state per REQ-YEC-005); retained-earnings transfer JournalEntry posted. GL still writable until the closed transition completes. The closing checklist (REQ-YEC-006) is being evaluated.

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: Fiscal year is closed. Opening-balance JournalEntry posted for the next year. Dimensional rollover CloudEvents fired. GL becomes immutable for this period per REQ-YEC-007 (archive-period locking via immutablePeriod flag).

immutablePeriod.description: Per REQ-YEC-007: once a FiscalYear enters the closed state, all GLTransaction and GLLine records whose periodId / postingDate resolves to this fiscal year become read-only. New transactions are rejected with NC error 'Fiscal Year @self.yearNumber is closed and immutable. To post corrections, unclose the period (reopen), post the entry, and re-close.' Reads remain unrestricted for audit and reporting.

reopened.label: Reopened
reopened.description: Admin-initiated escape hatch. Two reversing JournalEntry records pair with the original closing and opening journals. GL is writable again.

beginClose.label: Begin year-end close
beginClose.description: Starts the year-end close. Requires all T3 fiscal periods within this year to be in state closed per REQ-YEC-007. Emits a balanced retained-earnings transfer JournalEntry (manual sub-type): credits revenue account closing balances to the closing account (isClosingAccount: true per REQ-CoA-009), debits expense account closing balances, posts net result to the retained-earnings equity account per REQ-YEC-003.

close.label: Complete year-end close
close.description: Completes the year-end close. Emits an opening-balance JournalEntry for the next FiscalYear (balance-sheet accounts only; P&L accounts excluded per REQ-YEC-004). Auto-creates next FiscalYear record in state open if absent. Fires CloudEvents per dimension register (AnalyticalDimension, Project) for dimensional rollover; each subscriber carries active dimensions forward and skips archived per REQ-YEC-005. Re-targeted from the retired CostCenter + KostenDrager to the unified AnalyticalDimension per REQ-ADIM-101. The transition is gated by the closing checklist (REQ-YEC-006) declared in `requirePreconditions`; CFO override via `overrideChecklist: true` is audit-trailed.

requirePreconditions.label: Trial Balance Verified
requirePreconditions.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 1: sum(debit GL lines) = sum(credit GL lines) for the FY within rounding tolerance.
requirePreconditions.failMessage: Trial Balance Verified: FAIL — imbalance @value cents. Post the correcting entry and try again.

requirePreconditions.label: Accruals Recorded
requirePreconditions.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 2: when accrual accounts (default range 9700-9799) carry a non-zero balance, at least one ClosingEntry with entryType in {accrual-reversal, manual} (or a JournalEntry with subType year-end-closing) MUST be posted for this FY.
requirePreconditions.failMessage: Accruals Recorded: FAIL — accrual accounts carry a non-zero balance but no accrual-reversal closing entry has been posted.

requirePreconditions.label: Depreciation Posted
requirePreconditions.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 3: when active FixedAsset records exist for this administration, a ClosingEntry of entryType depreciation MUST be posted for the FY. From T4-base bookkeeping-fixed-assets-depreciation.
requirePreconditions.failMessage: Depreciation Posted: FAIL — active fixed assets exist but no depreciation closing entry has been posted.

requirePreconditions.label: FX Gains/Losses Declared
requirePreconditions.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 4: when the administration's currency configuration includes a non-base currency, each foreign-currency GL account MUST have an FX revaluation closing entry. Multi-currency revaluation is the T5 boundary; T4 enforces declaration only.
requirePreconditions.failMessage: FX Gains/Losses Declared: FAIL — foreign-currency accounts exist but no FX revaluation closing entry has been declared.

requirePreconditions.label: Related-Party Transactions Reviewed
requirePreconditions.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 5: when any GLTransaction or JournalEntry carries `relatedParty: true`, the financial officer MUST acknowledge them via `GLTransaction.relatedPartyAcknowledged: true` (or the equivalent on JournalEntry).
requirePreconditions.failMessage: Related-Party Transactions Reviewed: FAIL — @value related-party transactions remain unacknowledged.

reopen.label: Reopen fiscal year
reopen.description: Admin-only escape hatch per REQ-YEC-006. Emits two JournalEntry records of sub-type reversing pairing with closingJournalId and openingJournalId respectively. Recorded as a CloudEvent in the admin notifications stream. Non-empty reopenReason required.

onBeginClose.description: Emit retained-earnings transfer JournalEntry on open -> closing per REQ-YEC-003. OR engine sums revenue account closing balances (credit to closing account) and expense account closing balances (debit from closing account); net result posted to retained-earnings equity account.

data.description: Year-end retained-earnings transfer — boekjaar @self.yearNumber. Omzet- en kostenrekeningen afgesloten naar sluitrekening; nettoresultaat geboekt op eigen-vermogenrekening.

onClose.description: Emit opening-balance JournalEntry for the next fiscal year on closing -> closed per REQ-YEC-004. Balance-sheet accounts only (assets, liabilities, equity); P&L accounts excluded. Auto-create next FiscalYear in state open if absent.

data.description: Openingsbalans boekjaar @self.yearNumber + 1. Balansrekeningen overgenomen uit afsluiting boekjaar @self.yearNumber; resultaatrekeningen op nul.

onCloseDimensionRollover.description: Fire CloudEvents for dimensional rollover on closing -> closed per REQ-YEC-005. AnalyticalDimension (all dimensionTypes: cost-center, cost-object, custom) and Project subscribers carry active dimensions forward; archived dimensions skipped. Re-targeted from the retired CostCenter + KostenDrager registers to the unified AnalyticalDimension per REQ-ADIM-101.

onReopenReverseClosing.description: Emit reversing JournalEntry for the retained-earnings transfer journal (closingJournalId) on closed -> reopened per REQ-YEC-006.

onReopenReverseOpening.description: Emit reversing JournalEntry for the opening-balance journal (openingJournalId) on closed -> reopened per REQ-YEC-006.

onReopenNotify.description: Record the reopen as a CloudEvent in the admin notifications stream per REQ-YEC-006.

onBeginCloseGenerateClosingEntries.description: Per REQ-YEC-010: when the FiscalYear enters the closing state, auto-generate ClosingEntry records from every active ClosingEntryTemplate whose automationTrigger is on-close. For each matching template, sum the GL line balances inside the accountPattern range for this FY, create a ClosingEntry of the corresponding entryType (revenue-closing, expense-closing, accrual-reversal, …) with approvalStatus: pending-approval and automationTemplate: @template.templateId. When the template's reverseNextPeriod is true, generate a companion accrual-reversal ClosingEntry on the next FY (created as draft until the next FY activates). Per REQ-YEC-004 / REQ-YEC-010.

data.description: Reversal of @template.templateName from FY @self.yearNumber, generated alongside the closing entry per REQ-YEC-010.

onCloseMaterialiseRetainedEarnings.description: Per REQ-YEC-002 / REQ-YEC-009: on closing -> closed, materialise the RetainedEarnings record for this FY. Sums net income (revenue closing - expense closing) and rolls openingBalanceCents forward from the prior FY's closingBalanceCents. Links to the retained-earnings ClosingEntry that posts the equity-side transfer.

trialBalanceImbalanceCents.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 1 backing aggregation: absolute difference (in cents) between debit and credit GL line totals for this FY's GLTransactions in posted state. Feeds the trial-balance-verified checklist precondition. Tolerance is enforced via the precondition's thresholdCents.
trialBalanceImbalanceCents.expression: ABS(SUM(GLLine.amountCents WHERE side = 'debit') - SUM(GLLine.amountCents WHERE side = 'credit'))

accrualReversalCoverage.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 2 backing aggregation: count of ClosingEntry records with entryType in {accrual-reversal, manual} or JournalEntry with subType year-end-closing for this FY. Feeds the accruals-recorded checklist precondition.

accrualAccountBalanceCents.description: Helper aggregation: sum of cents balance on accrual accounts (default range 9700-9799) for this FY. Used by the accruals-recorded precondition's appliesWhen gate.
accrualAccountBalanceCents.expression: ABS(SUM(GLLine.amountCents WHERE side = 'credit') - SUM(GLLine.amountCents WHERE side = 'debit'))

depreciationClosingEntryCount.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 3 backing aggregation: count of ClosingEntry records with entryType = depreciation for this FY. Feeds the depreciation-posted checklist precondition.

activeFixedAssetCount.description: Helper aggregation: count of FixedAsset records in lifecycleState = active for this administration. Used by the depreciation-posted precondition's appliesWhen gate.

foreignCurrencyFxCoverage.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 4 backing aggregation: count of ClosingEntry records with currency != base currency for this FY (FX revaluation entries). Feeds the fx-declared checklist precondition.

foreignCurrencyAccountCount.description: Helper aggregation: count of GLTransaction records on this FY where currency differs from the administration's base currency (EUR by default). Used by the fx-declared precondition's appliesWhen gate.

relatedPartyUnacknowledgedCount.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 5 backing aggregation: count of posted GLTransaction records flagged relatedParty = true but relatedPartyAcknowledged != true for this FY. Feeds the related-party-reviewed checklist precondition.

relatedPartyTransactionCount.description: Helper aggregation: count of posted GLTransaction records flagged relatedParty = true for this FY. Used by the related-party-reviewed precondition's appliesWhen gate.

netIncomeCents.description: Helper aggregation feeding the retained-earnings closing materialiser: sum of credit-side revenue (account range 4000-4999) minus debit-side expense (account range 5000-6999) for this FY in posted GL lines.
netIncomeCents.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN accountNumber BETWEEN 4000 AND 4999 THEN (CASE WHEN side = 'credit' THEN amountCents ELSE -amountCents END) WHEN accountNumber BETWEEN 5000 AND 6999 THEN (CASE WHEN side = 'debit' THEN -amountCents ELSE amountCents END) ELSE 0 END)

priorRetainedEarningsClosingCents.description: Helper aggregation feeding the retained-earnings closing materialiser: prior FY's RetainedEarnings.closingBalanceCents (0 for the very first FY).

distributionsCents.description: Helper aggregation feeding the retained-earnings closing materialiser: sum of distributions posted to the distribution-accounts range (default 9750-9799) for this FY. Operators override this range via the chart-of-accounts configuration.

balanceCarryforwardValid.description: REQ-YEC-008 cross-FY balance-carryforward validation. Aggregation precondition on the next FY's open -> ... activation: confirms the next FY's opening-balance GL postings match the prior FY's closing balances per balance-sheet account. Returns 0 if perfectly matched (within rounding tolerance); positive integer counts mismatched accounts.

active.label: Active
active.description: REQ-FA-002 — The asset is in use and depreciating.

inactive.label: Inactive
inactive.description: REQ-FA-002 — The asset is registered but not yet (or no longer) in use; no depreciation is scheduled.

retired.label: Retired
retired.description: REQ-FA-002 / REQ-FA-008 — The asset has been disposed of; its carrying amount has been zeroed by the disposal journal.

activate.label: Activate
activate.description: REQ-FA-008 — Put the asset into service.

action.description: REQ-FA-008 — On acquisition (transition to active), materialise a balanced GLTransaction (debit assetAccountNumber for purchaseCost, credit cash/AP) AND auto-generate the first-year DepreciationSchedule record (REQ-FA-004) using depreciationMethod, usefulLifeYears/usefulLifeMonths, purchaseDate, and the administration's fiscal year. The DepreciationCalculator (ADR-031 exception, Float-Precision-aware per REQ-FA-005) is the deterministic kernel; OR's ScheduledWorkflow continues firing yearly per REQ-FA-007.

transferInternal.label: Internal transfer
transferInternal.description: REQ-FA-006 — Reassign this FixedAsset between cost centres or departments. Updates costCenterCode and propagates to subsequent DepreciationSchedule records; NO GL posting (the asset stays on the same GL account). For proportional splits, see the `splitTransfer` transition which creates a new FixedAsset for the split-off portion.

action.description: Updates costCenterCode and any open-period DepreciationSchedule.costCenterCode in lock-step. Audit-trailed via OR.

splitTransfer.label: Proportional internal transfer (split)
splitTransfer.description: REQ-FA-006 — Split a percentage of this FixedAsset off to a new FixedAsset record (transferSourceAssetRef pointing back), proportionally reducing the original asset's purchaseCost/accumulatedDepreciation and creating a new DepreciationSchedule for the split-off portion. NO GL posting; both records remain on the same balance-sheet account.

action.description: Creates a new FixedAsset with transferSourceAssetRef pointing back, allocating the configured percentage of acquisitionCost and accumulatedDepreciation. Audit-trailed.

dispose.label: Dispose
dispose.description: REQ-FA-008 — Retire the asset and post its closing journal. Before revive-gl-tax-capabilities this transition declared neither `from` nor `to`, so OpenRegister's TransitionEngine rejected every attempt with "Transition dispose is not allowed from current state ''" and no ObjectTransitionedEvent was ever dispatched — the disposal journal could not fire even in principle.

action.description: REQ-FA-008 — Materialises a balanced JournalEntry zeroing the asset account and accumulated depreciation; if disposalAccountingTreatment = sale and salvageProceeds > 0, posts the gain or loss (salvageProceeds − currentBookValue) to the configured P&L account; if scrap or donation with zero proceeds, the residual carrying amount books to loss on disposal. Materialised on the ADR-031 exception path by FixedAssetDisposalListener → FixedAssetDisposalService → DisposalJournalEmitter::emit(): the declarative DSL cannot read the sibling DepreciationSchedule rows, do integer-cent arithmetic and write a multi-row GLTransaction.

floatPrecisionAware.description: REQ-FA-005 — Tag indicating the asset's depreciation calculations honour the Nextcloud System Settings Float Precision value. The DepreciationCalculator queries the setting at calculation time via SettingsService::getFloatPrecision(); fallback is 2 decimal places (Dutch accounting standard).

yearsElapsed.description: REQ-FA-004 / REQ-FA-007 — Computed years elapsed since acquisitionDate. Drives the yearly auto-fire of depreciation-expense GL postings via the FixedAssets monthly-depreciation ScheduledWorkflow (Phase 4b of InitializeSettings).

depreciationByCostCenter.description: REQ-FA-009 (2) — sum of acquisitionCost grouped by costCenterCode (proxy for current-fiscal-year depreciation allocation). Drives the Depreciation Expense cost-center report.

bookValuesByStatus.description: REQ-FA-009 (4) — count of assets grouped by lifecycleState (proxy for book-value buckets). Drives balance-sheet reporting splits.

FixedAsset.title: Fixed Asset
FixedAsset.description: A capitalised tangible or intangible business asset with declarative depreciation rules, parallel commercial/fiscal streams, and a managed lifecycle (proposed → active → disposed → archived). Depreciation values are derived on demand — no materialised schedule table.

FxRate.title: FX Rate
FxRate.description: Daily exchange-rate snapshot per (transactionCurrency, baseCurrency, date, source) tuple per REQ-MC-002. The FX orientation contract is `baseCurrencyAmount = transactionAmount × fxRate` — i.e. `rate` is the price of 1 unit of transactionCurrency in baseCurrency. ECB publishes rates with baseCurrency=EUR per their canonical orientation; the ECB ingestion ScheduledWorkflow MUST invert exactly once on ingest so the stored `rate` always matches the FX orientation contract above. Manual operator overrides MUST carry a `manualOverrideReason`.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: FxRate snapshots are immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — they drive GL postings and consolidation translation. Manual overrides MUST be auditable (who, when, why).

x-openregister-uniqueness.description: Per REQ-MC-002 a single rate per (transactionCurrency, baseCurrency, date, source) — duplicate ingest MUST be a no-op, not an overwrite.

baseCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code for the administration's functional currency. Example: EUR.

source.description: Provenance of the rate. `ecb` rates are ingested by the daily ScheduledWorkflow; `manual` rates require `manualOverrideReason`; `bank-feed` rates come from the BankConnector adapter.
source.title: Source

rate.description: Exchange rate expressed as transactionCurrency → baseCurrency. baseCurrencyAmount = transactionAmount × rate. ECB published rates MUST be inverted on ingest if their canonical orientation differs.
rate.title: Rate

inverseRate.description: Optional convenience: 1/rate. Computed on ingest, NOT used by the GL posting engine (which always reads `rate`). Surfaces in the FX Rates index for operator readability.
inverseRate.title: Inverse Rate

manualOverrideReason.description: REQUIRED when source=manual per REQ-MC-002 precondition. Operator-supplied justification (e.g. 'ECB feed unavailable for 2026-03-08; using bank-quoted rate').

ingestedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the rate landed in the register (set by the ingest workflow or operator UI).

administrationId.title: Administration ID

Carries the source position, the closing rate used (and how it was resolved), the incremental unrealised movement posted, and the GL account attribution. Lifecycle: posted → reversed (manual controller correction only — this is NOT an automatic month-start reversal; see design.md 'Reversing-entry vs cumulative-adjustment decision').

functionalCurrency.title: Functional Currency

posted.description: Revaluation is live in the trial balance.

reversed.label: Reversed
reversed.description: Manually reversed by a controller to correct an erroneous automated posting; original entry preserved for audit (REQ-MC-008).

reverse.label: Reverse posting
reverse.description: Mark the revaluation posting as reversed; original entry preserved (REQ-MC-008).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: FxRevaluationPosting is append-only audit evidence per REQ-MC-008 / ADR-022 — original posted entry MUST be preserved when a reversal is recorded; the reversal links back to the original via reversalId.

OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on GLLine with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

transactionAmount.description: Amount in transactionCurrency, integer cents (positive). Per MODIFIED REQ-GL-003 the on-the-wire property name remains `amount` on legacy records; this declaration carries the new semantic name as an additive alias. The OR schema engine accepts both; existing single-currency callers keep working without rename.
transactionAmount.title: Transaction Amount

transactionCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code for the currency the line was transacted in. Renamed from `currency` per the RENAMED Requirements block in add-shillinq-multi-currency/specs/bookkeeping-multi-currency/spec.md. NULL on legacy single-currency lines (treated as administration's baseCurrency on read).
transactionCurrency.title: Transaction Currency

baseCurrencyAmount.description: Amount in administration's functional (base) currency, integer cents. Equals `transactionAmount × fxRate` per the FX orientation contract. NULL when single-currency (transactionCurrency == baseCurrency); on read the system substitutes `transactionAmount`.
baseCurrencyAmount.title: Base Currency Amount

baseCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code for the administration's functional currency at the time the line was posted. Snapshot ensures historical re-running of reports stays correct even if the administration's base currency changes.
baseCurrency.title: Base Currency

fxRate.description: Snapshot of the FxRate.rate used at posting time. Joins to the FxRate register via (transactionCurrency, baseCurrency, fxRateDate, fxRateSource). For single-currency lines fxRate=1.
fxRate.title: Fx Rate

fxRateSource.description: Provenance of the rate used at posting (matches FxRate.source). Audit-trail field — operators can trace any GL line back to the rate snapshot used.
fxRateSource.title: Fx Rate Source

fxRateDate.description: Effective date of the rate snapshot used at posting (matches FxRate.date). Usually equals the GL line's transaction date but MAY lag by 1 business day when the ECB feed has not yet published the same-day rate.
fxRateDate.title: Fx Rate Date

subLedgerType.description: Sub-ledger discriminator. `fixed-asset` added by revive-gl-tax-capabilities REQ-GLTAX-001 (list-concat with the base enum, the same additive mechanism inventory-cogs-posting uses for `inventory`): every line of the disposal journal DisposalJournalEmitter::emit() shapes carries subLedgerType `fixed-asset` with the FixedAsset UUID as subLedgerRef, so the trial balance and the audit trail can trace the closing entry back to the asset. Without this member the disposal lines would be rejected by schema validation.
subLedgerType.title: Sub Ledger Type

programmeStructure.description: BBV provincie programma-indeling this GL line is allocated to (REQ-BBL-001). One of the seven canonical provincie programmes per the BBV-provincies handleiding. Null until the line is mapped via the Budget-to-Programme Linker. Distinct from the BBVProgramma.programmaStructure discriminator (taakveld/kostentoedeling); on provincie administrations the seven values below are the canonical programme codes.
programmeStructure.title: Programma Structure

programmeAssignedAt.description: Effective date on which programmaStructure was assigned via the Budget-to-Programme Linker or a manual detail edit (REQ-BBL-001/003). Null when unmapped.
programmeAssignedAt.title: Programma Assigned At

taxTreatment.description: Vpb tax-treatment classification of this posting (REQ-VPB-004). Additively merged onto the monolith GLLine schema via the ADR-037 fragment loader. normal = ordinary deductible business expense/revenue; deductible = tax-benefit item (R&D, green investment); nonDeductible = disallowed (gifts, entertainment, personal use); special = subject to special rules (dividend received, transfer-pricing). Defaults to normal when omitted.
taxTreatment.title: Tax Treatment

administrationId.description: The administration this posting line belongs to (REQ-GLS-001). DENORMALISED from the parent GLTransaction.administrationId, which remains the source of truth — a line's administration is whatever its GLTransaction says it is, and this copy exists only because OpenRegister's aggregation filters address an object's own JSON properties and cannot join to the parent. Every writer sets it from the parent at create time; existing rows were backfilled by OCA\Shillinq\Service\Migration\GlLineAdministrationBackfillMigrator via the BackfillGlLineAdministration repair step. Nullable rather than required so an un-backfilled row still validates on write; SpendAnalyticsService refuses to serve the GL-backed views at all until the repair step has proven zero rows lack it, rather than filtering on a property some rows lack and returning a silent zero.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

transactionId.description: Reference to the parent GLTransaction (holds its object UUID).
transactionId.title: Transaction ID

accountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber (bookkeeping-chart-of-accounts). A business key, not an object identifier — the referenced Account must be in lifecycleState active for the post transition to succeed.
accountNumber.title: Account Number

accountRef.description: Reference to the Account (holds its object UUID). accountNumber RGS code retained.
accountRef.title: Account Ref

side.description: Debit or credit polarity; amount is always non-negative.
side.title: Side

amount.description: Non-negative posting amount in the transaction's currency.
amount.title: Amount

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Must equal the parent GLTransaction.currency (T1 single-currency invariant).
currency.title: Currency

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod. Auto-resolved by the lifecycle engine on the GLTransaction.post transition.
periodId.title: Period ID

subLedgerRef.description: FK into the sub-ledger when subLedgerType is not none.
subLedgerRef.title: Sub Ledger Ref

costCenter.description: Cost-center or department code for allocation reporting.
costCenter.title: Cost Center

eliminationFlag.description: When true, excludes this line from the consolidated trial-balance and financial-statement aggregations. Used to eliminate inter-GR transactions from consolidated views per REQ-GRC-003.
eliminationFlag.title: Elimination Flag

costCenterCode.description: FK to AnalyticalDimension.code (dimensionType=cost-center) for dimension-tagged analytical reporting per REQ-CC-003 + REQ-ADIM-101. A business key, not an object identifier. Field name and stored values are unchanged; only the target was re-pointed from the retired CostCenter schema to the unified AnalyticalDimension, so this stays backwards-compatible with the existing costCenter field.
costCenterCode.title: Cost Center Code

costCarrierCode.description: FK to AnalyticalDimension.code (dimensionType=cost-object) for cost-unit analytical reporting per REQ-CC-003 + REQ-ADIM-101. A business key, not an object identifier. Field name and stored values are unchanged; only the target was re-pointed from the retired KostenDrager schema to the unified AnalyticalDimension.
costCarrierCode.title: Kosten Drager Code

projectCode.description: FK to Project.code for project accounting and WBSO time-per-project pre-positioning per REQ-CC-003 + REQ-CC-007.
projectCode.title: Project Code

dimensions.description: Free-form key-to-value map for custom analytical dimensions (AnalyticalDimension.dimensionType=custom). Each key MUST match an AnalyticalDimension.code where dimensionType=custom; each value MUST resolve to an existing record code in that register. Validation is declared via OR relations engine per REQ-CC-003 + REQ-ADIM-101.
dimensions.title: Dimensions

ozbCategory.description: OZB category flags enabling the Iv3-OZB aggregation to split OZB-postings by eigenaars/gebruikers-deel and woning/niet-woning per REQ-CBSE-004. Null on non-OZB lines.
ozbCategory.title: OZB Category

byCostCenter.description: Per-cost-center roll-up of posted GL amounts within an administration per REQ-CD-004. Surfaces segment P&L per AnalyticalDimension[dimensionType=cost-center].code (joined to name for drill-down). Declared declaratively per ADR-031 — no PHP SegmentReportService. Re-targeted from CostCenter to AnalyticalDimension per REQ-ADIM-101.

byCostCenterHierarchy.description: Hierarchical roll-up of GL amounts per AnalyticalDimension[dimensionType=cost-center].parentCode tree per REQ-CD-007. Child cost-center sums propagate to parents through the self-relation; drives drill-down navigation. Declarative (ADR-031). Re-targeted from CostCenter to AnalyticalDimension per REQ-ADIM-101.

byCostObject.description: Per-cost-object (kostendrager) roll-up of posted GL amounts per REQ-CD-004. Replaces the retired KostenDrager.segmentPnl. Joins GLLine.kostenDragerCode to AnalyticalDimension[dimensionType=cost-object].code. Declarative (ADR-031) per REQ-ADIM-004.

byProject.description: Per-project roll-up of posted GL amounts within an administration per REQ-CD-004. Surfaces project P&L for consultancy and grant-funded work. Declarative (ADR-031).

byAnalyticalDimension.description: Per-custom-dimension roll-up of posted GL amounts per REQ-CD-006. Each registered AnalyticalDimension[dimensionType=custom] contributes a group-by key drawn from GLLine.dimensions[code]. Drives the operator-extensible segment P&L surface; new custom dimensions appear automatically without PHP/Vue edits. Scoped dimensionType = custom per REQ-ADIM-004.

GLLine.title: GL Line
GLLine.description: A debit-or-credit line within a GLTransaction, encoding the polarity in the side enum per REQ-GL-003. Extended with eliminationFlag to support GR consolidation per REQ-GRC-003.

journalType.description: Discriminator folding the former dedicated journal-entry families into this single GLTransaction schema. 'manual' is the default general-journal entry; 'ar-invoice'/'ap-invoice' are sales/purchase journal postings; 'bank' is a bank-statement-derived posting; 'closing' carries the folded ClosingEntry fields (year-end closing); 'intercompany' carries the folded IntercompanyTransaction detection fields.
journalType.title: Journal Type

closingEntryType.description: Closing group (journalType='closing'): classification of the closing entry, folded from ClosingEntry.entryType. Per REQ-YEC-001.
closingEntryType.title: Closing Entry Type

fiscalYearId.description: Closing group (journalType='closing'): FK to the FiscalYear this closing entry belongs to, folded from ClosingEntry.fiscalYearId. Per REQ-YEC-001.
fiscalYearId.title: Fiscal Year ID

approvalStatus.description: Closing group (journalType='closing'): lifecycle state of the closing entry, folded from ClosingEntry.approvalStatus. draft -> pending-approval -> approved -> posted; or posted -> reversed. Per REQ-YEC-001 / REQ-YEC-009.
approvalStatus.title: Approval Status

sourceAdministrationId.description: Intercompany group (journalType='intercompany'): FK to the source administration the transaction was booked in, folded from IntercompanyTransaction.sourceAdministrationId.
sourceAdministrationId.title: Source Administration ID

counterpartyEntityId.description: Intercompany group (journalType='intercompany'): FK to the detected or asserted counterparty entity (administration), folded from IntercompanyTransaction.counterpartyEntityId.
counterpartyEntityId.title: Counterparty Entity ID

detectionMethod.description: Intercompany group (journalType='intercompany'): how the transaction was identified as intercompany, folded from IntercompanyTransaction.detectionMethod.
detectionMethod.title: Detection Method

detectionConfidence.description: Intercompany group (journalType='intercompany'): confidence of the detection; label-based defaults to medium pending operator confirmation. Folded from IntercompanyTransaction.detectionConfidence.
detectionConfidence.title: Detection Confidence

isMatched.description: Intercompany group (journalType='intercompany'): whether the transaction has been included in a match, folded from IntercompanyTransaction.isMatched.
isMatched.title: Is Matched

matchId.description: Intercompany group (journalType='intercompany'): FK to the IntercompanyMatch the transaction belongs to, folded from IntercompanyTransaction.matchId.
matchId.title: Match ID

periodState.description: State of the accounting period this entry is posted to. A posted/reversed entry must not target a 'closed' period unless a controlled reopening is recorded (ledger-no-post-to-closed-period).
periodState.title: Period State

reopened.description: True when a controlled, logged reopening of an otherwise closed period authorised posting this correction (ledger-no-post-to-closed-period).
reopened.title: Reopened

paymentMethod.description: Settlement method of the posting (e.g. cash, ideal, sepa, card, wire). Electronic payment methods require a supporting bank/payment-service record (ledger-electronic-payment-records).
paymentMethod.title: Payment Method

paymentReference.description: Bank / payment-service reference supporting an electronic payment posting (ledger-electronic-payment-records).
paymentReference.title: Payment Reference

counterparty.description: The counterparty of an electronic payment posting (ledger-electronic-payment-records).
counterparty.title: Counterparty

valueDate.description: Value date of an electronic payment posting per the bank/payment-service record (ledger-electronic-payment-records).
valueDate.title: Value Date

retentionUntil.description: Date until which this transaction and its supporting documents are retained. Must be at least the jurisdiction's minimum retention period after postingDate (NL 7y AWR 52 / BW 2:10, DE 8y AO 147 / HGB 257, FR 10y / 6y Code de commerce / LPF, BE 10y BTW, ES 6y / 4y, IT 10y, US 3y/4y/5y/6y/7y).
retentionUntil.title: Retention Until

postingLocked.description: True when the posted entry is locked against in-place editing; corrections are made only by an offsetting reversal entry (immutability / no-deletion principle, GoBD Unveränderbarkeit, §239(3) HGB, §146(4) AO).
postingLocked.title: Posting Locked

periodLocked.description: True when the accounting period of this transaction is closed/locked, so no further postings are made to it without a controlled, logged reopening (period-close integrity).
periodLocked.title: Period Locked

irreversible.description: True when the validated entry has been made irreversible: it can no longer be deleted or modified, only corrected by an offsetting entry (FR PCG art. 911-3/921, NF525 inalterability, FEC validated entries).
irreversible.title: Irreversible

integrityVerified.description: True when the authenticity of origin and integrity of content of the record/invoice are ensured from issue until the end of the storage period (VAT Directive 2006/112/EC art. 233; IT conservazione sostitutiva).
integrityVerified.title: Integrity Verified

archiveAvailable.description: True when an archived copy stays readable, reproducible and available to the tax authority without undue delay (VAT Directive art. 248a; IRS Rev. Proc. 98-25 machine-sensible retrieval).
archiveAvailable.title: Archive Available

saftExportable.description: True when the tax-relevant data of this entry is exportable in a machine-evaluable audit-file format on request (OECD SAF-T, DE GoBD Datenzugriff Z3, FR FEC, PT SAF-T (PT), PL JPK_VAT, RO D406).
saftExportable.title: Saft Exportable

validationDate.description: Date on which the entry was definitively validated (closed), after which it can no longer be modified or deleted (FR FEC validation date; IT conservazione timestamp).
validationDate.title: Validation Date

auditTrail.description: Change audit trail (audit-trail principle / GoBD): every change to the recorded transaction is logged. Each entry carries user, timestamp and action so the full history of the entry is reconstructable.

user.description: The user who made the change.
user.title: User

action.description: The change performed (e.g. post, reverse, correct).
action.title: Action

priorValue.description: The prior value, where the change mutated a field.
priorValue.title: Prior Value

auditTrail.title: Audit Trail

fecExport.description: FR Fichier des Écritures Comptables (FEC) export descriptor: the technical format and file name of the audit export for this entry's accounting file (fr-fec-format).

fileType.description: Export file type: a flat text file or XML.
fileType.title: File Type

delimiter.description: Field delimiter of the flat file: tab or pipe.
delimiter.title: Delimiter

encoding.description: Character encoding of the file (e.g. iso-8859-15, utf-8).
encoding.title: Encoding

fileName.description: File name in the mandated form SIREN (9 digits) + 'FEC' + closing date (YYYYMMDD) + extension, e.g. 123456789FEC20261231.txt.
fileName.title: File Name

fecExport.title: Fec Export

nf525Closing.description: FR NF525 certified-software periodic closing record (grand total perpétuel): the secured, archived closing totals chained as an unbroken sequence (fr-nf525-secured-archive).

period.description: Closing period the total covers: daily, monthly or annual.
period.title: Period

perpetualTotal.description: The perpetual running total (grand total perpétuel) at this closing.
perpetualTotal.title: Perpetual Total

sequenceNumber.description: Gapless sequence number of the closing record, evidencing an unbroken chain.
sequenceNumber.title: Sequence Number

signature.description: Integrity signature/hash securing the closing record against alteration.
signature.title: Signature

nf525Closing.title: Nf525Closing

ptChain.description: PT certified-invoicing chain link: the ATCUD and chained hash ensuring an unbroken, tamper-evident document sequence (pt-certified-invoicing-software).

atcud.description: ATCUD unique document code issued for the certified document.
atcud.title: Atcud

hash.description: Hash of this document, computed over its content and the previous document's hash.
hash.title: Hash

previousHash.description: Hash of the previous document in the chain, linking the sequence.
previousHash.title: Previous Hash

ptChain.title: Pt Chain

transactionNumber.description: Sequential transaction number unique per administration + fiscal year.
transactionNumber.title: Transaction Number

postingDate.description: Effective accounting date of the posting.
postingDate.title: Posting Date

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod record (T3 introduces the schema; T1 accepts any string). Auto-resolved on the post transition per REQ-GL-006.
periodId.title: Period ID

currency.description: ISO 4217 base currency for this posting.
currency.title: Currency

sourceReference.description: External document number (invoice no., bank statement ref, asset repair ID, etc.).
sourceReference.title: Source Reference

state.description: Lifecycle state. draft: under construction; posted: immutable and in trial balance; reversed: superseded by a compensating transaction.
state.title: State

journalEntryId.description: Back-reference to the JournalEntry that materialised this posting, if any.
journalEntryId.title: Journal Entry ID

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this posting.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

reversesTransactionId.description: FK to the GLTransaction that this transaction reverses. Required on the reversed transaction for the reversal guard.
reversesTransactionId.title: Reverses Transaction ID

lines.description: Inverse of GLLine.transactionId; back-reference populated by OpenRegister.
lines.title: Lines

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on GLTransaction with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

nivraBericht.description: NIVRA-bestand projection for a closed period: every posted GLTransaction + child GLLines + audit-trail events + period trial-balance + chart of accounts in effect. Output conforms to the NIVRA standard referenced in _meta.standardVersion. No PHP audit-export service — pure declarative aggregation + docudesk XML template per REQ-REK-002.

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod to export.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration.

standardVersion.description: Controleprotocol version reference. Defaults to the current standard year.

lines.description: All debit/credit lines for each posted transaction.

chartOfAccounts.description: Chart of accounts in effect for this administration.

steekproef.description: Deterministic random sample of posted GLTransaction records for substantive testing. Given periodId, sampleSize, and seed, returns a reproducible ordered sample — re-running with the same seed yields the same records in the same order per REQ-REK-003. shillinq#425: the previously-declared `guard` (OCA\Shillinq\Guard\SteekproefSampler) referenced a class that did not exist, AND OpenRegister's aggregation engine never reads a `guard` key on any aggregation at all — it was dead, unconsumed configuration regardless of the class (same defect shape as the near-duplicate `engineLimitFallback` reference on this same aggregation key in lib/Settings/shillinq_register.json, which points at a different nonexistent class, OCA\Shillinq\Audit\SteekproefSampler — filed as shillinq#436 for both).

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod to sample from.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration.

sampleSize.description: Number of GLTransaction records to include in the sample.

seed.description: Reproducibility seed — same seed with same period produces the same sample. Convention: 'audit-YYYY-qN' or operator-supplied string.

lines.description: All debit/credit lines for sampled transactions.

meta.adimensionalNote: ADR-031 exception path: if the OR aggregation engine cannot guarantee deterministic seed-sampling across engine versions, OCA\Shillinq\Guard\SteekproefSampler::computeDeterministicSample provides a ~20-LOC fallback using PHP's seeded shuffle.

ledenraadpleging.description: Redacted slice of posted GLTransaction records for raadsleden review. Fields tagged redactFor: ['raadsleden'] are replaced by a stable SHA-256 hash (description-level free-text) or [REDACTED] placeholder (AP/AR sub-ledger refs) per REQ-REK-004. Numeric and account-code fields remain intact. No PHP redaction service — redaction profile is declared as aggregation metadata per ADR-031.

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod to export.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration.

lines.description: All debit/credit lines for each posted transaction.

description.description: Free-text posting description may carry personal data (e.g. 'Salaris Jan Bakker maart 2026'). Replaced by SHA-256(description) per REQ-REK-004.

GLLine.description.description: Free-text line description. Replaced by stable hash.

sourceReference.description: AP/AR sub-ledger reference numbers that may identify persons. Replaced by [REDACTED] placeholder per REQ-REK-004.

search.description: Search general-ledger transactions -- the double-entry posting of record. Use for 'what was booked in period 6?' and similar posting-history questions.

get.description: Get a single GL transaction by id.

GLTransaction.title: GL Transaction
GLTransaction.description: A double-entry general-ledger posting header. Owns the lifecycle and the balance invariant; child GLLine rows carry the debit/credit amounts per REQ-GL-001.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on GRDeelnemer with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

administrationId.description: Optional FK to the deelnemer's own shillinq administration. When set, a balanced GLTransaction is materialised in that administration on GR period-close per REQ-GRC-005.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

share.description: Quotum-aandeel (participation share) of this deelnemer in the GR. Must be 0 ≤ x ≤ 1. The sum across all actief deelnemers SHOULD equal 1.0.
share.title: Share

actief.description: Whether this deelnemer currently participates in the GR. Inactive deelnemers are excluded from the aandeel-sum invariant check.
actief.title: Active

lifecycleState.description: Lifecycle state of the deelnemer record.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

GRDeelnemer.title: GR Participant
GRDeelnemer.description: A deelnemer (participating municipality, province, or waterboard) of a gemeenschappelijke regeling (GR). Holds the quotum-aandeel and an optional cross-administration FK for doorbelasting materialisation per REQ-GRC-001.

active.label: Active
active.description: Deelnemer participates in the GR and is included in aandeel-sum and doorbelasting calculations.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Deelnemer no longer participates. Historical records remain queryable; excluded from aandeel-sum and doorbelasting calculations.

archive.label: Archive deelnemer
archive.description: Remove from active participation without deleting historical boekingen.

onGrPeriodClose.description: When the GR period closes, materialise a balanced GLTransaction in each deelnemer's administration where administrationId is set. Idempotency key: (grAdministrationId, deelnemerId, periodId) prevents re-posting on re-run of GR period-close per REQ-GRC-005.
onGrPeriodClose.condition: administrationId IS NOT NULL AND lifecycleState = 'active'

aandeelSumCheck.description: Computes the sum of aandeel across all actief deelnemers. Surfaces a non-blocking warning in the Consolidated view when the result differs from 1.0 per REQ-GRC-004 and design Risk 2.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on GRVerdeelsleutel with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

keyName.description: Human-readable name of this apportionment rule.
keyName.title: Key Name

costClusterAccountNumbers.description: Array of Account.accountNumber strings identifying the cost cluster this verdeelsleutel applies to.
costClusterAccountNumbers.title: Cost Cluster Account Numbers

verdelingsType.description: Apportionment method. vast-percentage uses fixed per-deelnemer percentages in parameters; resident-count weights by population count; weighted-area by weighted surface area; custom-formula accepts free-form parameters JSON.
verdelingsType.title: Distribution Type

parameters.description: Per-deelnemer split parameters validated against verdelingsType. For vast-percentage: object keyed by GRDeelnemer.id with values summing to 1.0. For custom-formula: arbitrary JSON.
parameters.title: Parameters

lineNumber.description: Sequence number controlling the order in which multiple verdeelsleutels for the same cost cluster are applied.
lineNumber.title: Line Number

GRVerdeelsleutel.title: GR Allocation Key
GRVerdeelsleutel.description: An apportionment rule linking a cost-cluster (set of accountNumbers) to a per-deelnemer split method. Multiple verdeelsleutels MAY apply to the same cost cluster, sequenced by lineNumber per REQ-GRC-002.

doorbelastingPerDeelnemer.description: Per-deelnemer doorbelasting aggregation: applies this verdeelsleutel to GLLines whose accountNumber is in costClusterAccountNumbers (excluding eliminated lines). Produces doorbelasting bedrag per deelnemer per cost cluster per REQ-GRC-004.

join.condition: GLLine.accountNumber IN costClusterAccountNumbers AND GLLine.eliminationFlag = false

GarantievoorzieningDetail.title: Garantievoorziening Detail
GarantievoorzieningDetail.description: Type-specific detail register for garantievoorzieningen (REQ-PROV-012). FK back to a Provision with provisionType=garantie. Best estimate is derived from historical claim rates × revenue base per product category.

productCategories.description: Product categories covered by the warranty provision (REQ-PROV-012).
productCategories.title: Product Categories

historicalClaimRate.description: Historical claim rate as a decimal fraction of revenue (REQ-PROV-012).
historicalClaimRate.title: Historical Claim Rate

revenueBaseInPeriod.description: Revenue base in EUR over which the historical claim rate applies (REQ-PROV-012).
revenueBaseInPeriod.title: Revenue Base In Period

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Garantievoorziening Detail is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

GeneratedReport.title: Generated Report
GeneratedReport.description: A report produced under Reporting & Compliance and stored as a file in Nextcloud. Records what was generated, for which period/administration, in which format, where the file lives, and the system tags applied so it is retrievable from the generated-reports index.

reportType.description: ReportCatalogue report-type id (e.g. vat-return, trial-balance, annual-accounts).
reportType.title: Report Type

reportLabel.description: Human label of the report type at generation time.
reportLabel.title: Report Label

category.description: ReportCatalogue category id (tax, statements, ledger, audit-file, public-sector, compliance).
category.title: Category

administrationId.description: Administration the report was generated for.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

format.description: File format: pdf | odt | xlsx | csv | xml | xbrl | json (document-kind reports render as pdf/odt via docudesk; docx is not produced).
format.title: Format

filePath.description: Nextcloud path of the stored file (e.g. /Shillinq/Reports/...).
filePath.title: File Path

fileId.description: Nextcloud file id of the stored file (for download/deep-link).
fileId.title: File ID

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the report was generated.
generatedAt.title: Generated At

generatedBy.description: User id that generated the report.
generatedBy.title: Generated By

status.description: Generation status. 'unavailable' means the render step could not run because its renderer (docudesk, for document-kind reports) was not installed/reachable -- a visible, retryable outcome, distinct from 'failed' (REQ-RVD-005, ADR-081 rule 7).
