x-openregister-threshold-watcher.description: EUR 750M prior-year consolidated-revenue threshold watcher for CbCR / Pillar 2 scope (REQ-CBC-001 / BEPS Action 13 / Wet Vpb art. 29b / Wet minimumbelasting 2024). Declarative contract for the openconnector-owned BackgroundJob that runs nightly on a live instance — when the prior-year consolidated revenue (sum of CbcrJurisdictionSummary.totalRevenue across all jurisdictions for the prior period) crosses thresholdEur, the watcher sets UPE.thresholdCrossed=true + UPE.thresholdCrossedAt=now() + UPE.cbcrIncluded=true + UPE.pillar2Included=true on the UltimateParentEntity record, and emits the first-CbCR (12 months after FYE) and first-GIR (18 months) deadline warnings as system notifications.

ImportBatch.title: Import Batch
ImportBatch.description: A single administration migration tracked end-to-end per REQ-AIM-001/002. The unit of lifecycle, idempotency, reporting, and reversal. Source files live in Nextcloud Files (link via sourceFiles, never copied into the register). Staged parse output, the validation report, the dry-run report, and posting references all live inline on the batch. CRUD goes through OpenRegister's generic object surface (ADR-022); there is NO parallel PHP model or import table.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Import-batch register; every create / update / lifecycle transition (parse / stage / map / validate / dry-run / post / reverse) is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022. The audit trail is the evidence chain for the migration dossier.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Batch created; source files, administration, migration date, and scope being assembled. No books touched.

parsing.label: Parsing
parsing.description: Auditfile + companion CSVs are being stream-parsed via OR background machinery (REQ-AIM-002). A multi-100MB file never parses inside the HTTP request.

staged.label: Staged
staged.description: Parse complete; stagedCounts and stagingPayload populated. Still nothing written to the books.

mapping.label: Mapping
mapping.description: Account mappings being resolved/reviewed. RGS auto-matched and profile-default rows pre-confirmed; suggestion/unmapped rows await operator confirmation.

validated.label: Validated
validated.description: All mappings confirmed and every validation check passed (balanced opening journal, open period, AR/AP control = open items, valid mappings). Ready for the mandatory dry-run.

validation_failed.label: Validation failed
validation_failed.description: At least one error-severity finding (e.g. unbalanced opening journal, control-account mismatch, unmapped account, closed period). Terminal review state; no journal/open item/contact written (REQ-AIM-002 scenario).

dry_run_complete.label: Dry-run complete
dry_run_complete.description: The exact would-be result is persisted on dryRunReport for the accountant to verify before anything is written (REQ-AIM-008). The only legal predecessor of posting.

posting.label: Posting
posting.description: Pipeline is composing the opening journal, AR/AP open items, and contacts/masters through existing surfaces via OR background machinery. Idempotent under idempotencyKey.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Opening journal posted, open items and masters created, contacts created/linked. postingRefs set. Happy-path terminal state (reversible while the period is open).

posting_failed.label: Posting failed
posting_failed.description: A staged-state change was detected (dry-run no longer matches) or a cross-service write failed mid-post. Requires a fresh validation + dry-run (REQ-AIM-008).

reversed.label: Reversed
reversed.description: Reversing journal posted, imported open items and masters soft-deleted, contacts reported (never deleted). Terminal state (REQ-AIM-009).

parse.label: Parse
parse.description: Start parsing. Requires sourceFiles, administrationId, migrationDate, and at least one scope flag. Runs under OR background machinery; the initiating request returns immediately (REQ-AIM-002).

staged.label: Staged
staged.description: Parse finished; stagedCounts + stagingPayload populated by ImportPipelineService::stage().

startMapping.label: Start mapping
startMapping.description: Begin mapping resolution/review. ImportPipelineService::resolveMappings() persists ImportMapping rows.

validate.label: Validate
validate.description: Run all validation checks (balanced opening journal, open period, AR/AP control = open items, every referenced mapping confirmed & mapped). Fails closed to validation_failed on any error finding (REQ-AIM-005/006/007). Unmapped or unconfirmed referenced rows block this transition (REQ-AIM-004).

validationFailed.label: Validation failed
validationFailed.description: Recorded when validation produced an error-severity finding. validationReport holds the findings; no books were touched.

dryRun.label: Dry-run
dryRun.description: Generate and persist the full would-be result on dryRunReport and record the staged-state hash. MANDATORY before posting — there is deliberately NO validated→posting edge (REQ-AIM-002/008).

post.label: Post import
post.description: Begin posting. Idempotent under idempotencyKey; re-post returns existing postingRefs. Composes the existing journal-entry, AR/AP, and NC contacts surfaces (REQ-AIM-005/006/007/009). Runs under OR background machinery.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Posting succeeded; postingRefs set. The dry-run report doubles as the migration verification document.

postingFailed.label: Posting failed
postingFailed.description: Staged-state changed since the dry-run, or a cross-service write failed. Requires a fresh validation + dry-run before retrying (REQ-AIM-008).

reverse.label: Reverse import
reverse.description: Post the reversing journal, soft-delete imported open items and master rows, mark the batch reversed; contacts are reported but never deleted. ONLY while the target period is open (REQ-AIM-009) — guarded.
reverse.x-adr-031-exception: Open-period precondition for reversal is a cross-schema FiscalPeriod check the declarative requires: DSL cannot yet express; ImportBatchGuard::canReverse is the documented ADR-031 PHP-guard seam (mirrors APGuard / StatementParser). Replace with a declarative condition when OR gains the primitive.

ImportMapping.title: Import Mapping
ImportMapping.description: One source-account → Shillinq-account mapping row per REQ-AIM-004. Separate rows (not embedded on the batch) because a real chart has hundreds of accounts and the mapping needs its own review grid, per-row status, and reuse as a saved profile across an accountant's client migrations. Resolution order: source RGS code → target with same RGS (rgs-auto, pre-confirmed); saved profile hit (profile-default); code/name similarity (manual review); else unmapped. Unmapped or unconfirmed rows referenced by staged data block the mapping→validated transition (fail-closed).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Mapping-review register; every resolution and operator confirmation is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022.

IncassoKostenBerekening.title: Incasso Kosten Berekening
IncassoKostenBerekening.description: BIK-staffel + wettelijke rente computation per invoice. Implements the Besluit BIK staffel (15% / 10% / 5% / 1% / 0,5%, minimum €40, maximum €6.775 reached at €1.000.000) plus optional BTW-over-incassokosten (art. 2 lid 2 Besluit BIK, +21% when the creditor cannot offset VAT). Rente uses a maintained date-keyed rate table: handelsrente B2B per art. 6:119a BW (10,15% per 1-1-2026) or wettelijke rente B2C per art. 6:119 BW (4% per 1-1-2026); a window crossing a statutory rate boundary splits per sub-period. Recomputed on partial-payment against the remaining saldo. REQ-CCD-003.

bikStaffel.label: BIK staffel
bikStaffel.description: Declarative shape of the Besluit BIK staffel arithmetic (per REQ-CCD-003). The PHP BIKStaffelCalculator produces an identical record when the OR aggregation engine cannot express the multi-slab expression directly.

renteAccrual.label: Rente accrual
renteAccrual.description: Declarative shape of the wettelijke rente accrual (REQ-CCD-003). For B2B uses HANDELSRENTE_B2B_6_119A_BW (ECB+8pp → 10,15% per 1-1-2026); for B2C uses WETTELIJKE_RENTE_B2C_6_119_BW (4% per 1-1-2026). Rates are resolved from a maintained date-keyed table; the BIKStaffelCalculator PHP guard splits a boundary-crossing window per sub-period.

The tolerance evaluation that sets matchStatus runs in the create lifecycle guard. InventoryCycleCount.title: Inventory Cycle Count
InventoryCycleCount.description: Periodic stock-take batch per REQ-ICC-001 / REQ-ICC-002. A cycle count is a count BATCH covering an operator-selected scope (full or partial by location/category). On transition draft → submitted the engine snapshots the in-scope InventoryStock into InventoryCycleCountLine rows; on counting → posted the VarianceGate (ADR-031 exception) enforces that every line with requiresReason=true carries a reasonCode FK; on posted → reconciled the CycleCountService emits one StockMove per non-zero-variance line with movementType='adjustment-style' (issue/receipt depending on sign) and movementReason='cycle-count-variance' so the existing inventory-stock-movement-ledger lifecycle handles InventoryStock update + GL materialisation. The original posted CycleCount row stays immutable; reconciliation is one-shot and idempotent on countId. No app-local CycleCountMapper / lib/Db table per ADR-024 — the register IS the persistence. xLifecycle states + the variance threshold metadata live in this fragment so the change is fully declarative.

countedValue.description: Total physical value (SUM(line.countedValue)) per REQ-ICC-002. Null until all lines counted.
countedValue.title: Counted Value

varianceValue.description: Calculated countedValue − expectedValue per REQ-ICC-002. Signed: negative = shrinkage, positive = found stock.
varianceValue.title: Variance Value

variancePercentage.description: Calculated (varianceValue / expectedValue) × 100 per REQ-ICC-002. Null when expectedValue=0 (division-by-zero guard).
variancePercentage.title: Variance Percentage

state.description: Lifecycle state per REQ-ICC-006. draft: scope editable; submitted: line snapshot created from InventoryStock; counting: operators entering countedQuantity; posted: variance reviewed, reasonCodes attached; reconciled: StockMoves emitted, InventoryStock updated; cancelled: terminal, no GL impact.
state.title: State

notes.description: Supervisor notes per REQ-ICC-002.
notes.title: Notes

submittedAt.description: Timestamp the count was submitted (line snapshot created). Null while draft.
submittedAt.title: Submitted At

postedAt.description: Timestamp variance review completed (transition counting → posted). Null until posted.
postedAt.title: Posted At

reconciledAt.description: Timestamp adjustment StockMoves emitted (transition posted → reconciled). Null until reconciled.
reconciledAt.title: Reconciled At

cancelledAt.description: Timestamp the count was cancelled. Null unless cancelled.
cancelledAt.title: Cancelled At

administrationId.description: FK to Administration owning this count. Tenant-scoped per REQ-MA-001; cross-org reads/writes are masked 404 by AdministrationContextService.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

quantityVarianceThresholdPercent.description: Per REQ-ICC-004: a line whose |quantityVariance| / expectedQuantity × 100 exceeds this threshold flips requiresReason=true and MUST carry a reasonCode before the count can transition counting → posted.

valueVarianceThresholdAbsolute.description: Per REQ-ICC-004: a line whose |valueVariance| exceeds this absolute amount (administration base currency) flips requiresReason=true irrespective of percentage.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Supervisor is editing scope. countType + filters can change; no snapshot yet.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Scope is frozen. InventoryCycleCountLine rows have been created — one per in-scope (sku, locationId) pair with expectedQuantity populated from InventoryStock and countedQuantity null.

counting.label: Counting
counting.description: Operators are entering countedQuantity per line. Variance fields auto-compute; requiresReason flips when thresholds are crossed.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Variance investigation complete. Every requiresReason=true line carries a reasonCode FK. expectedValue / countedValue / varianceValue / variancePercentage are stamped on the count header.

reconciled.label: Reconciled
reconciled.description: Terminal. One StockMove per non-zero-variance line has been posted via inventory-stock-movement-ledger (movementReason='cycle-count-variance'); InventoryStock updated; GL materialised by the StockMove lifecycle.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: Terminal. No StockMoves emitted; no GL impact. Snapshot lines remain queryable for audit.

submit.label: Submit
submit.description: Freeze scope and snapshot InventoryStock into InventoryCycleCountLine rows per REQ-ICC-006 + REQ-ICC-008.

actions.description: Stamp submittedAt on transition.

REQ-ICC-006 + REQ-ICC-008: query InventoryStock filtered by countType / locationFilter / categoryFilter and create one InventoryCycleCountLine per in-scope (sku, locationId) pair with expectedQuantity populated and countedQuantity null. Delegated to CycleCountService::snapshotScope when the engine cannot express the filtered fan-out declaratively (ADR-031 exception path).

begin-counting.label: Begin counting
begin-counting.description: Warehouse staff begin data entry. No engine work required — a pure state flip per REQ-ICC-006.

post.label: Post count
post.description: Review variance and freeze. REQ-ICC-004 + REQ-ICC-005: VarianceGate enforces every line with requiresReason=true carries a reasonCode FK; otherwise the transition is denied with a 'variance investigation required' error.

actions.description: Stamp postedAt + aggregate header totals from line snapshot.

reconcile.label: Reconcile
reconcile.description: REQ-ICC-007: emit one StockMove per non-zero-variance line via the inventory-stock-movement-ledger lifecycle (movementReason='cycle-count-variance', referenceDocumentUri='shillinq://cycle-count/<countId>'). The StockMove lifecycle updates InventoryStock + materialises GL; the CycleCount row stays immutable.

actions.description: Stamp reconciledAt on transition.

REQ-ICC-007 declarative materialisation: for each InventoryCycleCountLine with quantityVariance != 0, emit a StockMove via inventory-stock-movement-ledger. Sign rules: countedQuantity > expectedQuantity → movementType='receipt' (destinationLocationId = line.locationId, sourceLocationId=null); countedQuantity < expectedQuantity → movementType='issue' (sourceLocationId = line.locationId, destinationLocationId=null). movementReason='cycle-count-variance' always; referenceDocumentUri stamps the originating countId. Delegated to CycleCountService::emitAdjustments — the engine cannot express the fan-out + per-line sign branching natively (ADR-031 exception path).

cancel.label: Cancel
cancel.description: Cancel from any non-terminal state per REQ-ICC-006. No StockMoves emitted; no GL impact. Snapshot rows remain for audit.

actions.description: Stamp cancelledAt on transition.

partialRequiresScope.condition: countType == 'partial' AND locationFilter IS NULL AND categoryFilter IS NULL
partialRequiresScope.message: Partial count requires location or category scope.
partialRequiresScope.messageNl: Gedeeltelijke telling vereist een locatie- of categoriescope.

x-openregister-indexes.description: Sequential count identifier unique per administration.
Powers the Cycle Counts index filter by state + date range per REQ-ICC-010.

InventoryCycleCountLine.title: Inventory Cycle Count Line
InventoryCycleCountLine.description: One snapshot row inside an InventoryCycleCount per REQ-ICC-003. Each line captures the (sku, locationId) pair, the expectedQuantity snapshotted from InventoryStock at submission, the operator-entered countedQuantity, and the derived variance fields. The flagging field requiresReason is computed against the configurable thresholds in InventoryCycleCount.x-openregister-metadata (quantityVarianceThresholdPercent + valueVarianceThresholdAbsolute) per REQ-ICC-004 and reused by the post transition's VarianceGate (REQ-ICC-005). All money/quantity fields are integer-cent (multipleOf 0.01) per the shillinq Money discipline.

lineId.description: Sequential line identifier within a count (CC-YYYY-MM-NNNNN-LLL) per REQ-ICC-003.
lineId.title: Line ID

productName.description: Denormalized product name snapshot for audit traceability.
productName.title: Product Name

locationId.description: Bin Location.id where the count is performed. Required because the resulting variance StockMove targets this location.
locationId.title: Location ID

expectedQuantity.description: InventoryStock.quantity snapshot at submission per REQ-ICC-003 + REQ-ICC-006. Non-negative.
expectedQuantity.title: Expected Quantity

countedQuantity.description: Operator-entered physical count per REQ-ICC-003. Null while the line is un-counted. Negative values rejected per REQ-ICC-003.
countedQuantity.title: Counted Quantity

unitCost.description: Unit cost at count date per REQ-ICC-003. Used for valueVariance + GL posting.
unitCost.title: Unit Cost

countedValue.description: Calculated countedQuantity × unitCost per REQ-ICC-003. Null until counted.
countedValue.title: Counted Value

quantityVariance.description: Calculated countedQuantity − expectedQuantity per REQ-ICC-003. Signed.
quantityVariance.title: Quantity Variance

valueVariance.description: Calculated countedValue − expectedValue per REQ-ICC-003. Signed.
valueVariance.title: Value Variance

requiresReason.description: Calculated flag per REQ-ICC-004: true when |quantityVariance| > expectedQuantity × quantityVarianceThresholdPercent / 100 OR when |valueVariance| > valueVarianceThresholdAbsolute. Drives the VarianceGate check on InventoryCycleCount.post.
requiresReason.title: Requires Reason

reasonCode.description: FK to InventoryVarianceReason.reasonId per REQ-ICC-005. MUST be populated for lines with requiresReason=true before the count can transition counting → posted.
reasonCode.title: Reason Code

notes.description: Line-level investigation or annotation notes per REQ-ICC-003.
notes.example: Found 5 units damaged in northeast corner
notes.title: Notes

adjustmentStockMoveId.description: Back-reference to the StockMove emitted by CycleCountService::emitAdjustments on reconcile per REQ-ICC-007. Null until reconciled or for zero-variance lines.
adjustmentStockMoveId.title: Adjustment Stock Move ID

administrationId.description: FK to Administration owning this line. Tenant-scoped per REQ-MA-001.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

expectedValue.description: REQ-ICC-003: book value of the in-scope inventory snapshot for this line.

countedValue.description: REQ-ICC-003: physical value at count date. Null when countedQuantity is null.

requiresReason.description: REQ-ICC-004 declarative threshold. CycleCountService::recalculateLine mirrors the same arithmetic when the engine cannot evaluate the expression (ADR-031 exception path — VarianceGate uses the PHP mirror for the post-time check).

x-openregister-indexes.description: Powers the count detail view's line-list query.
Powers the VarianceGate check on counting → posted (REQ-ICC-004).

InventoryGLConfig.title: Inventory GL Posting Configuration
InventoryGLConfig.description: Per-administration mapping from inventory stock-movement event types (sale dispatch, goods receipt, count variance) to General Ledger account numbers. One active record per administrationId. Drives the declarative posting lifecycle on InventoryValuation (REQ-CG-002 / REQ-CG-003 / REQ-CG-004). Holds FK account numbers (cogsAccountNumber, inventoryAssetAccountNumber, grIrClearingAccountNumber, inventoryAdjustmentAccountNumber) that MUST resolve to existing Account records in the same administration (REQ-CG-001 FK invariant). When isActive=false or any account is missing, the lifecycle action skips the GLTransaction materialisation and emits a structured warning event — no zero-cost or unmatched GL entries are written. Schema.org Thing.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: InventoryGLConfig changes (account number remapping, isActive toggle) MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — every change to a GL account routing is bookkeeping-relevant: it changes where future COGS / inventory-asset / count-variance postings land and is subject to operator + auditor review.

administrationId.description: FK to Administration owning this posting configuration (REQ-MA-001 multi-administratie scope). One active config per administrationId.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

cogsAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber — debited on sale/dispatch event (Dr COGS). Default RGS 3.5 MKB '7000' Kostprijs omzet. MUST resolve to an existing Account in the same administration (REQ-CG-001 FK invariant).
cogsAccountNumber.title: COGS Account Number

inventoryAssetAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber — debited on goods receipt (Dr Inventory Asset) and credited on COGS posting / negative variance. Default RGS 3.5 MKB '1400' Voorraden. MUST resolve to an existing Account in the same administration.
inventoryAssetAccountNumber.title: Inventory Asset Account Number

grIrClearingAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber — credited on goods receipt (Cr GR/IR clearing); subsequently debited by AP invoice posting per REQ-AP-003. Default RGS 3.5 MKB '1800' GR/IR clearing. MUST resolve to an existing Account in the same administration. Two-step pattern avoids double-posting (REQ-CG-003).
grIrClearingAccountNumber.title: Gr Ir Clearing Account Number

inventoryAdjustmentAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber — debited on negative count variance / credited on positive count variance (REQ-CG-004). Default RGS 3.5 MKB '7100' Voorraadmutaties. MUST resolve to an existing Account in the same administration.
inventoryAdjustmentAccountNumber.title: Inventory Adjustment Account Number

isActive.description: Whether perpetual inventory GL posting is enabled for this administration. When false, the InventoryValuation lifecycle action skips materialisation and logs a 'posting_disabled' structured warning (REQ-CG-002 skip scenario).
isActive.title: Is Active

description.description: Operator notes — e.g. 'NL RGS 3.5 MKB defaults applied' or 'overridden to match parent corporate chart'.
description.title: Description

allowNegativeStockOnDispatch.description: Per-administration policy toggle (inventory-sales-issue-cogs-trigger REQ-005): when false (default), confirming a Delivery whose stock-tracked line exceeds available InventoryStock quantity at the resolved warehouse is denied. When true, confirmation proceeds and the resulting negative on-hand condition is logged as a structured warning instead of blocking. Matches the block-by-default intent already documented in inventory-stock-tracking REQ-IST-013.
allowNegativeStockOnDispatch.title: Allow Negative Stock On Dispatch

cogsAccountExists.message: cogsAccountNumber must reference an existing Account in this administration.
cogsAccountExists.messageNl: cogsAccountNumber moet verwijzen naar een bestaande Rekening in deze administratie.

inventoryAssetAccountExists.message: inventoryAssetAccountNumber must reference an existing Account in this administration.
inventoryAssetAccountExists.messageNl: inventoryAssetAccountNumber moet verwijzen naar een bestaande Rekening in deze administratie.

grIrClearingAccountExists.message: grIrClearingAccountNumber must reference an existing Account in this administration.
grIrClearingAccountExists.messageNl: grIrClearingAccountNumber moet verwijzen naar een bestaande Rekening in deze administratie.

inventoryAdjustmentAccountExists.message: inventoryAdjustmentAccountNumber must reference an existing Account in this administration.
inventoryAdjustmentAccountExists.messageNl: inventoryAdjustmentAccountNumber moet verwijzen naar een bestaande Rekening in deze administratie.

accountsStillExist.condition: CHANGED(cogsAccountNumber) OR CHANGED(inventoryAssetAccountNumber) OR CHANGED(grIrClearingAccountNumber) OR CHANGED(inventoryAdjustmentAccountNumber)
accountsStillExist.message: All four GL account numbers must reference existing Accounts in this administration.
accountsStillExist.messageNl: Alle vier GL-rekeningnummers moeten verwijzen naar bestaande Rekeningen in deze administratie.

InventoryLot.title: Inventory Lot
InventoryLot.description: Lot/batch identifier for a homogeneous quantity of a Product received together (one supplier, one date, one expiry). Sits below InventoryStock — InventoryStock is the aggregate position per (sku, locationId); InventoryLot adds the per-lot granularity required for FEFO (First-Expiry-First-Out) picking, expiry tracking, quality quarantine, and recall traceability per REQ-LOT-001..009. Lifecycle: active → quarantined (release back) | expired (terminal) | exhausted (terminal, qty == 0). FEFO order is declared via x-openregister-sort on expiryDate ASC NULLS LAST so all consumers (pick list, expiry dashboard, batch reports) inherit FEFO ordering. ADR-031 exception path: if the declarative sort directive is advisory rather than enforced at the OR API layer, the single-method FefoSort::sortLots PHP guard in lib/Sort/ applies the order before the response leaves the controller. No bespoke PHP CRUD — spec REQ-LOT-001 prohibits parallel storage. Spec: inventory-lot-batch-expiry. The 'InventoryItem' wording in the spec refers to the shillinq Product schema.

lotNumber.description: Operator-visible lot/batch identifier per REQ-LOT-002. Unique per administration. Examples: LOT-2026-001, PF-KAT-A001.
lotNumber.title: Lot Number

batchCode.description: Supplier-assigned batch reference (often printed on the package). Distinct from lotNumber, which is the warehouse-assigned identifier.
batchCode.title: Batch Code

productId.description: FK to pipelinq Product (productId). Required. Resolved via ?expand=productId via ADR-019 integration registry.
productId.title: Product ID

productSku.description: TRANSITIONAL ALIAS: deprecated — use productId. Retained for 3-way-match fallback only. Will be removed after pipelinq-product-vendor-master is confirmed live.
productSku.title: Product SKU

manufactureDate.description: Date of manufacture / production. Used for shelf-life calculations and recall windows.
manufactureDate.title: Manufacture Date

expiryDate.description: Legal expiry date per REQ-LOT-002. Drives FEFO sort (ASC NULLS LAST) and the expired-state lifecycle transition. May be null for non-perishable items — FEFO order sorts null-expiry lots last.
expiryDate.title: Expiry Date

bestBeforeDate.description: Best-before quality date (EU food law THT). May precede expiryDate. Informational; does not drive lifecycle transitions.
bestBeforeDate.title: Best Before Date

quantity.description: Current available (un-consumed) quantity in this lot per REQ-LOT-002. Decremented by StockMove postings; when it reaches 0 the exhausted-state transition fires per REQ-LOT-006.
quantity.title: Quantity

unitCode.description: UN/CEFACT unit of measure code. Common values: ZAK (bag), BLIK (can), KG (kilogram), ST (piece), CA (carton).
unitCode.title: Unit Code

unitCost.description: Cost per unit at time of receipt in EUR (administration base currency). Used for FIFO/average inventory valuation per inventory-valuation-fifo-avg.
unitCost.title: Unit Cost

warehouseLocation.description: Physical bin / rack / shelf location code where this lot is stored. Free-text for now; future inventory-multi-warehouse spec consumes this for hierarchical Location mapping.
warehouseLocation.title: Warehouse Location

lotStatus.description: REQ-LOT-006 lifecycle state. active: available for picking; quarantined: held for quality inspection (not pickable); expired: past legal expiry (terminal, awaiting disposal); exhausted: quantity 0 (terminal, lot closed).
lotStatus.title: Lot Status

receivedDate.description: Date this lot was received into the warehouse. Defaults to today on create. Used for shelf-life and supplier-performance reports.
receivedDate.title: Received Date

goodsReceiptId.description: FK to the GoodsReceipt event that introduced this lot to the warehouse. Optional — lots may also be created manually (e.g. initial stock-take).
goodsReceiptId.title: Goods Receipt ID

administrationId.description: FK to Administration that owns this lot. Enforced via adminScope.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

notes.description: Operator-authored free text. Common uses: quarantine reason, recall reference, supplier remark.
notes.example: Droogvoer kat senior, leverancier Prins Petfoods
notes.title: Notes

x-openregister-sort.description: REQ-LOT-005: FEFO (First-Expiry-First-Out) default order. Lots without an expiryDate sort after all dated lots. ADR-031 exception: if OR's sort directive is advisory at the API query layer, OCA\Shillinq\Sort\FefoSort::sortLots applies the same order before the response is returned — documented in openspec/changes/inventory-lot-batch-expiry/design.md §D2.

active.label: Active
active.description: Available for picking. Default state on create. Counts toward on-hand FEFO availability.

quarantined.label: Quarantined
quarantined.description: Held for quality inspection per REQ-LOT-006. Not pickable. May be released back to active or transitioned to expired.

expired.label: Expired
expired.description: Terminal state. Past the legal expiryDate; not pickable; awaiting disposal. Reachable only when today > expiryDate (guard enforced).

exhausted.label: Exhausted
exhausted.description: Terminal state. quantity == 0; lot is closed. Reached automatically when a StockMove drains the lot to zero.

quarantine.label: Quarantine lot
quarantine.description: Operator or automated quality flag isolates a lot pending inspection per REQ-LOT-006.

release.label: Release from quarantine
release.description: Operator quality release returns the lot to pickable per REQ-LOT-006.

expireFromActive.label: Mark expired
expireFromActive.description: Daily expiry check OR operator transition. Requires today > expiryDate (guard) per REQ-LOT-006.

expiryDateReached.message: Cannot expire lot: expiry date not yet reached.
expiryDateReached.messageNl: Lot kan niet vervallen worden: vervaldatum nog niet bereikt.

expireFromQuarantine.label: Mark expired (from quarantine)
expireFromQuarantine.description: Quarantined lots that cross their expiry date follow the same expired transition per REQ-LOT-006.

expiryDateReached.message: Cannot expire lot: expiry date not yet reached.
expiryDateReached.messageNl: Lot kan niet vervallen worden: vervaldatum nog niet bereikt.

exhaust.label: Mark exhausted
exhaust.description: Automatic transition when StockMove drains the lot to zero per REQ-LOT-006 (postcondition: quantity == 0).

quantityZero.message: Cannot exhaust lot: quantity is greater than zero.
quantityZero.messageNl: Lot kan niet uitgeput worden: voorraad is groter dan nul.

nonNegativeQuantity.message: Lot quantity must be greater than or equal to zero.
nonNegativeQuantity.messageNl: Lothoeveelheid moet groter dan of gelijk aan nul zijn.

expiryAfterManufacture.condition: manufactureDate IS NOT NULL AND expiryDate IS NOT NULL AND expiryDate < manufactureDate
expiryAfterManufacture.message: Expiry date must be on or after manufacture date.
expiryAfterManufacture.messageNl: Vervaldatum moet op of na de productiedatum liggen.

InventoryReorderRule.title: Inventory Reorder Rule
InventoryReorderRule.description: Per-item, per-location reorder policy declaring min/max stock levels, lead-time-aware reorder-point thresholds, low-stock alert policy, and optional auto-purchase-order generation. Reorder decision logic is fully declarative via x-openregister-lifecycle, x-openregister-aggregations, and x-openregister-notifications per ADR-031 and ADR-022. No PHP InventoryReorderService — all reorder triggers and alert dispatch are schema-driven.

inventoryStockId.description: FK to InventoryStock record (item + location combination). The reorder rule applies specifically to this stock entry.
inventoryStockId.title: Inventory Stock ID

supplierId.description: FK to primary Supplier for reorder. If null, operator selects supplier manually at order time.
supplierId.title: Supplier ID

minimumLevel.description: Stock quantity at or below which a low-stock alert is triggered. REQ-IRA-003.
minimumLevel.title: Minimum Level

maximumLevel.description: Target stock quantity for replenishment. Must be greater than minimumLevel.
maximumLevel.title: Maximum Level

reorderPoint.description: Stock quantity at which reorder is triggered, factoring supplier lead time. Formula: (expectedDailyUsage × leadTimeDays) + safetyStock. REQ-IRA-005.
reorderPoint.title: Reorder Point

reorderQuantity.description: Standard quantity to order on alert. Used as PO line quantity when auto-PO fires. REQ-IRA-006.
reorderQuantity.title: Reorder Quantity

leadTimeDays.description: Supplier lead time in calendar days. Defaults to supplier.leadTimeDays when null; falls back to 7 days if supplier has no lead time. REQ-IRA-005.
leadTimeDays.title: Lead Time Days

safetyStockDays.description: Safety margin in days above lead time for reorder-point calculation. REQ-IRA-005.
safetyStockDays.title: Safety Stock Days

alertThreshold.description: Percentage above minimumLevel at which a warning alert fires (early warning before critical low-stock). E.g. 20 means alert at minimumLevel × 1.20.
alertThreshold.title: Alert Threshold

autoPurchaseOrder.description: Whether to automatically generate a PurchaseOrder when the low-stock alert fires. REQ-IRA-006.
autoPurchaseOrder.title: Auto Purchase Order

autoPurchaseOrderApprovalRequired.description: Whether auto-generated PO requires operator approval before issue. When true PO lands in draft state; when false PO is issued immediately (within spendingLimit). REQ-IRA-006.
autoPurchaseOrderApprovalRequired.title: Auto Purchase Order Approval Required

spendingLimit.description: Maximum spend per auto-generated PO in EUR. If reorderQuantity × supplier.currentPrice exceeds this, the auto-order is blocked and escalated to role='procurement-manager'. REQ-IRA-006.
spendingLimit.title: Spending Limit

alertChannel.description: Notification channel for low-stock alerts. REQ-IRA-004.
alertChannel.title: Alert Channel

alertRecipients.description: Email addresses or Nextcloud user IDs to notify on low-stock alert. REQ-IRA-004.
alertRecipients.title: Alert Recipients

snoozeUntil.description: Temporarily suppress low-stock alerts until this datetime. Operator sets this to acknowledge a situation in progress. REQ-IRA-003.
snoozeUntil.title: Snooze Until

lifecycleState.description: Current reorder rule lifecycle state. Only active rules fire low-stock alerts and trigger auto-PO. REQ-IRA-009.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

administrationId.description: FK to Administration that owns this reorder rule. Rules are scoped per administration for multi-tenant isolation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

reorderPointCalculated.description: Derived (do not set directly): lead-time-aware reorder point. Materialised via x-openregister-calculations.
reorderPointCalculated.title: Reorder Point Calculated

isLowStock.description: Derived (do not set directly): true when the linked stock quantity is at or below minimumLevel and the rule is active. Materialised via x-openregister-calculations.
isLowStock.title: Is Low Stock

active.label: Active
active.description: Rule is monitoring stock levels. Low-stock alerts fire when quantity ≤ minimumLevel. Auto-PO triggers if enabled.

paused.label: Paused
paused.description: Alert dispatch disabled. No auto-PO until rule is resumed. Stock monitoring suspended (e.g. during planned stockout or supplier change).

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Rule permanently deactivated. No alerts, no auto-PO. Retained for audit trail.

pause.label: Pause rule
pause.description: Suspend alert monitoring. Use when a stockout is expected or the supplier relationship is on hold. REQ-IRA-009.

resume.label: Resume rule
resume.description: Re-activate alert monitoring after planned suspension. REQ-IRA-009.

archive.label: Archive rule
archive.description: Permanently deactivate the rule. Audit trail is preserved. REQ-IRA-009.

restore.label: Restore rule
restore.description: Re-activate an archived rule (e.g. seasonal product restocking). REQ-IRA-009.

payload.message: Reorder rule has been paused. No alerts will fire until resumed.

lowStockTrigger.description: Evaluates whether the linked InventoryStock quantity has fallen to or below the reorderPoint. Fires on every InventoryStock quantity change. When true, triggers the low-stock alert lifecycle action. REQ-IRA-007.

lowStockDashboard.description: Aggregates InventoryStock records below their minimum level grouped by location. Powers the Stock Levels Dashboard widget. REQ-IRA-008.

lowStockAlert.description: Dispatches a low-stock alert when InventoryStock.quantity ≤ minimumLevel and lifecycleState = active and (snoozeUntil is null or snoozeUntil < now). REQ-IRA-004.

spendingLimitExceeded.description: Dispatches an escalation notification to procurement-manager role when auto-PO total exceeds spendingLimit. REQ-IRA-006.

reorderPointCalculated.description: Computes the lead-time-aware reorder point. JSON-AST: if(expectedDailyUsage != null, expectedDailyUsage*coalesce(leadTimeDays,7) + expectedDailyUsage*coalesce(safetyStockDays,1), minimumLevel + coalesce(leadTimeDays,7)*5 + 10). REQ-IRA-005.

isLowStock.description: True when the linked InventoryStock quantity is at or below minimumLevel and rule is active. JSON-AST: and(lifecycleState=='active', linkedStockQuantity <= minimumLevel).

warehouse-manager.description: Warehouse managers maintain reorder rules per location.

procurement.description: Procurement team monitors and adjusts reorder rules.

inventory-viewer.description: Read-only access to reorder rules for auditing.

InventoryStock.title: Inventory Stock
InventoryStock.description: Stock-on-hand snapshot per Product per Location (Tryton / Odoo style aggregate). Carries the four quantity states required by Dutch SMB warehouse operators: quantityOnHand (physical), quantityReserved (allocated to pending orders / production), quantityInTransit (en route from supplier or between locations) and quantityAvailable (computed: quantityOnHand - quantityReserved, read-only at query time). One row per (productSku, locationCode, administrationId) — enforced via x-openregister-unique. Updated declaratively by downstream inventory-stock-movement-ledger StockMove postings (the materialisation hook documented in design.md D5); pre-StockMove the records are seeded by SettingsService::seedInventoryStockExamples() and edited manually. Multi-tenancy is scoped by administrationId per REQ-IST-007. The reservation guard (StockReservationGuard::checkReservationDoesNotExceedOnHand) refuses quantityReserved > quantityOnHand at create + update per REQ-IST-013 — the only ADR-031 exception in this fragment. No PHP InventoryStockMapper / lib/Db table per ADR-024 — the register IS the persistence.

productId.description: FK to pipelinq Product (productId). Required. Resolved via ADR-019 integration registry (shillinq → pipelinq). Local denormalised caches (status, unitCost) are refreshed from the registry but stock-keeping + GL posting work offline on cached values.
productId.title: Product ID

productSku.description: TRANSITIONAL ALIAS: deprecated — use productId. Retained for 3-way-match fallback only. Will be removed after pipelinq-product-vendor-master is confirmed live.
productSku.title: Product SKU

locationCode.description: FK to Location.code (budget-planning-control). Required. Represents a physical container — warehouse, regional distribution centre, retail store, repair depot, returns bin. Operators define the master data; this snapshot is scoped per code.
locationCode.title: Location Code

locationName.description: Denormalised human-readable Location name for the operator UI (avoids a JOIN on every list render). Updated via materialisation when the underlying Location is renamed.
locationName.title: Location Name

quantityOnHand.description: Physical quantity in the location. Decimal (2-decimal precision) to support fractional units (0.5 L, 2.25 kg) per design.md D1. May briefly be negative on backorder edge cases — application-level enforcement (REQ-IST-013) blocks the common case.
quantityOnHand.title: Quantity On Hand

quantityReserved.description: Quantity allocated to pending sales orders, production plans or pending shipments. Not available for new allocations. quantityReserved <= quantityOnHand is enforced by StockReservationGuard::checkReservationDoesNotExceedOnHand per REQ-IST-013.
quantityReserved.title: Quantity Reserved

quantityInTransit.description: Quantity en route from a supplier or between this app's locations. Not yet in the destination's quantityOnHand — increments on transfer dispatch, decrements (transferring to quantityOnHand) on transfer receipt per design.md D1 + REQ-IST-003.
quantityInTransit.title: Quantity In Transit

quantityAvailable.description: COMPUTED. quantityOnHand - quantityReserved. Calculated at every retrieval; MUST NOT be stored per REQ-IST-008. The expression in x-openregister-calculations drives the value on every list and detail render.
quantityAvailable.title: Quantity Available

unitCost.description: Standard or average cost per unit at the time of the most recent receipt or manual adjustment. Currency follows the linked Product.currency. Used by P&L (COGS = issued quantity * unitCost) and balance sheet valuation (asset value = quantityOnHand * unitCost). FIFO / average variance is handled by inventory-valuation-fifo-avg downstream.
unitCost.title: Unit Cost

lastRestockDate.description: Timestamp of the most recent stock movement that increased quantityOnHand (receipt, transfer-in, manual adjustment). Drives 'aging inventory' queries (lastRestockDate < today - 30 days) and replenishment planning.
lastRestockDate.title: Last Restock Date

status.description: Mirrors Product.status for filter efficiency (avoids a JOIN on 'active stock only' queries). Populated at creation from Product.status; updated when the product is later marked discontinued. Discontinued rows remain queryable for historical reporting; downstream specs MUST exclude them from new transactions.
status.title: Status

administrationId.description: FK to Administration owning this stock record (REQ-IST-007 multi-tenant scope). Cross-administration reads / writes are masked 404 by AdministrationContextService — organisation A's 'Amsterdam Warehouse' is invisible to organisation B.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

quantityAvailable.description: REQ-IST-008. quantityAvailable = quantityOnHand - quantityReserved. Computed at every retrieval (list, detail and aggregation paths) — never stored. The expression is the declarative DSL form; the runtime evaluator falls back to PHP-level computation in InventoryStockService::computeAvailableQuantity() when an aggregation or filter targets the field.

active.label: Active
active.description: Stock is in use for normal warehouse operations. Eligible for new reservations, transfers, and outbound stock moves. Updated by downstream StockMove posting per REQ-IST-001.

discontinued.label: Discontinued

reactivate.label: Reactivate

quantity.description: On-hand quantity contributing to this snapshot. multipleOf 0.01 enforces 2-decimal precision (Money / quantity discipline; integer-cent arithmetic).
quantity.title: Quantity

unitCost.description: Cost per unit under the active valuation method. FIFO: weighted average of remaining open lot costs. Moving-average: running weighted average. Rounded to 4 decimal places for moving-average per design.md D3.
unitCost.title: Unit Cost

totalValue.description: Total inventory value = quantity * unitCost, rounded to 2 decimal places (Money discipline). Recomputed on every StockMove that affects this snapshot.
totalValue.title: Total Value

valuationMethod.description: Costing method per REQ-INV-002. FIFO: oldest open StockMove lot consumed first. average: running weighted moving average. LIFO is intentionally excluded per NL GAAP. methodChange transition (FIFO <-> average) blocked when quantity > 0.
valuationMethod.title: Valuation Method

warehouse.title: Warehouse

status.description: Lifecycle state per REQ-INV-009. active: current snapshot updated on every movement. adjusted: manual correction applied or COGS posting pending (missing GL config flagged by CogsPosterService). obsolete: discontinued or moved-out item; historical only.
status.title: Status

administrationId.description: FK to Administration owning this snapshot (REQ-MA-001 multi-administratie scope). Cross-administration reads/writes are masked 404 by AdministrationContextService.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

lastStockMoveUuid.description: UUID of the most recent StockMove processed against this snapshot. Used for idempotent retry in FifoValuationService / MovingAverageValuationService (REQ-INV-003 idempotency scenario): if the same StockMove uuid arrives twice the second invocation is a no-op.
lastStockMoveUuid.title: Last Stock Move UUID

pendingCogs.description: True when the most recent outbound move could not post a COGS GLTransaction because GL account numbers are not yet configured (design.md Risks table + REQ-INV-007). Surfaces in the manifest view so operators know to configure the GL accounts.
pendingCogs.title: Pending COGS

postCOGS.label: Post COGS on sale dispatch
postCOGS.description: REQ-CG-002: when an InventoryValuation snapshot decreases by a saleDispatch event, materialise a balanced GLTransaction with Dr InventoryGLConfig.cogsAccountNumber / Cr InventoryGLConfig.inventoryAssetAccountNumber for delta_quantity * unitCost. Guard: unitCost != null AND active InventoryGLConfig with isActive=true exists for administrationId. Skips with structured warning (reasons: 'unitCost_missing', 'posting_disabled', 'config_missing') without writing partial GL entries.

actions.description: REQ-CG-002 declarative GL posting. Dr COGS / Cr Inventory Asset. journalCode='inkoop'; subLedgerType='inventory'; subLedgerRef=@self.id.

postReceipt.label: Post inventory asset on goods receipt
postReceipt.description: REQ-CG-003: when an InventoryValuation snapshot increases by a goodsReceipt event, materialise a balanced GLTransaction with Dr InventoryGLConfig.inventoryAssetAccountNumber / Cr InventoryGLConfig.grIrClearingAccountNumber for received_quantity * unitCost. GR/IR clearing is subsequently settled by the AP invoice posting per bookkeeping-accounts-payable-core REQ-AP-003 (two-step pattern; avoids double-posting). Same skip conditions as postCOGS (REQ-CG-003 skip scenario).

actions.description: REQ-CG-003 declarative GL posting. Dr Inventory Asset / Cr GR/IR clearing. journalCode='inkoop'; subLedgerType='inventory'; subLedgerRef=@self.id.

postVariance.label: Post count variance
postVariance.description: REQ-CG-004: on a non-zero count-variance event, materialise a balanced GLTransaction whose Dr/Cr direction reflects the sign of (actualQuantity - bookQuantity). Positive variance: Dr Inventory Asset / Cr Inventory Adjustment. Negative variance: Dr Inventory Adjustment / Cr Inventory Asset. journalCode='memo'. ADR-031 exception (D4): direction is resolved by InventoryPostingGuard::direction(int) because the declarative DSL cannot express sign conditionals inline today. Zero variance is a strict no-op (no GLTransaction). Same skip conditions as postCOGS.

actions.description: REQ-CG-004 declarative GL posting (direction from PHP guard per ADR-031 exception). journalCode='memo'; subLedgerType='inventory'; subLedgerRef=@self.id. Zero-delta skipped by canPostVariance guard.

InventoryValuation.title: Inventory Valuation
InventoryValuation.description: Per-item, per-warehouse inventory valuation snapshot driven by the inventory-stock-movement-ledger StockMove stream. valuationMethod selects FIFO (oldest-lot-first cost layer traversal of open inbound StockMove lots) or average (running weighted moving average recalculated on each inbound receipt). The snapshot stores the current quantity, unitCost and totalValue used by both Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) posting on outbound moves (CogsPosterService -> balanced GLTransaction) and the balance-sheet inventory asset value. Schema.org Product because the snapshot is a Product-scoped measurement. status active|adjusted|obsolete and a methodChange transition (FIFO <-> average) are guarded by InventoryValuationMethodGuard::checkZeroStock(): both transitions to obsolete and any methodChange require on-hand quantity = 0. ADR-031 declarative path; the FIFO traversal, moving-average recalculation and COGS GL posting are imperative services per design.md D4 (cross-schema computed-amount writes outside the current declarative DSL range). REQ-INV-001 / REQ-INV-002 / REQ-INV-005.

InventoryVarianceReason.title: Inventory Variance Reason
InventoryVarianceReason.description: Configurable reason-code taxonomy for cycle-count variance per REQ-ICC-005. Each administration maintains its own active reason-code set (seeded with seven standard codes — DMG, OBS, ERR-COUNT, ERR-STOCK, THEFT, SYS, OTHER — by the system on first count); the operator chooses one per requiresReason=true line. Inactive codes (isActive=false) remain queryable for audit but are hidden from the UI dropdown and rejected by the VarianceGate so historical lines retain their FK while new lines cannot pick them. The category enum is closed so variance reports can roll up consistently across administrations.

reasonId.description: Reason code (e.g. DMG, OBS, ERR-COUNT) per REQ-ICC-005. Stable across administrations for the system-seeded set; admin-defined codes may diverge.

JournalEntry.title: Journal Entry
JournalEntry.description: A human-authored bookkeeping construct (memoriaalboeking / recurring template / reversing accrual). Posting one materialises exactly one balanced GLTransaction with its GLLine children per REQ-JE-007. Distinct from the GLTransaction it produces (REQ-JE-001).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable. Lines may be added or changed before submission or posting.

pending.label: Pending approval
pending.description: Submitted and awaiting an approver per administration policy. No GLTransaction exists yet.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Materialised into a balanced GLTransaction (REQ-JE-007). Immutable.

voided.label: Voided
voided.description: Superseded; its materialised GLTransaction has been reversed. Remains queryable for audit, excluded from default listings (REQ-JE-010).

submit.label: Submit for approval
submit.description: Submit a draft journal entry for approval when administration policy requires it (REQ-JE-008).

post.label: Post journal entry
post.description: Approve and post. Gated by OR's approval-workflow extension; on approval, materialises exactly one balanced GLTransaction per REQ-JE-007. No app-local approval logic (ADR-022).

actions.description: Materialise exactly one balanced GLTransaction (with GLLine children derived 1:1 from `lines`) and set glTransactionId. Declarative outcome per REQ-JE-007 / design D3 — no PHP orchestration.

postDirect.label: Post without approval
postDirect.description: Post directly when administration policy does not require approval (REQ-JE-008). approvalState must be `not-required`. Materialises one balanced GLTransaction per REQ-JE-007.

actions.description: Materialise exactly one balanced GLTransaction (with GLLine children derived 1:1 from `lines`) and set glTransactionId per REQ-JE-007.

reject.label: Reject

void.label: Void
void.description: Void a posted journal. Requires the materialised GLTransaction to already be reversed per REQ-GL-004 / REQ-JE-010.

KORAnnualTurnover.title: KOR Annual Turnover
KORAnnualTurnover.description: Lopende KOR-relevante omzet per kalenderjaar met drempel-benutting en maandprognose (REQ-KOR-002). Niet alle omzet telt mee: vrijgestelde prestaties (art. 11 OB), intracommunautaire leveringen en onroerend goed worden uitgesloten. Drempel-benutting wordt door KorMonitorService na elke geboekte AR-factuur herrekend; de x-openregister-aggregations-blok documenteert de equivalente declaratieve vorm (ADR-031).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: KORAnnualTurnover updates (post-invoice recalcs, uitgesloten-posten herclassificatie, prognose-status flips) MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — the running drempel-benutting is the fiscaal trigger for de revocatie-flow (REQ-KOR-004) en alert-dispatch (REQ-KOR-003).

currentRevenue.description: Lopende KOR-relevante omzet (SUM van KOR-eligible AR-facturen met leveringsDatum in dit jaar, status != draft) (REQ-KOR-002).
currentRevenue.title: Lopende Omzet

perMonth.description: Omzet per maand (YYYY-MM -> bedrag), basis voor de lineaire eindejaars-prognose (REQ-KOR-002).
perMonth.title: Per Maand

excludedItems.description: Posten die NIET meetellen voor de KOR-drempel (REQ-KOR-002): vrijgestelde prestaties, intracommunautaire leveringen, onroerend goed.

amount.description: The numeric value for bedrag.

excludedItems.title: Uitgesloten Posten

forecastYearEnd.description: Lineaire eindejaars-prognose op basis van maandgemiddelde year-to-date (REQ-KOR-002).
forecastYearEnd.title: Prognose Einde Jaar

prognoseStatus.description: Status van de prognose t.o.v. de drempel (REQ-KOR-002).
prognoseStatus.title: Prognose Status

administrationId.title: Administration ID

korTurnoverByYear.description: Declaratieve vorm van de KOR-drempel-benutting die KorMonitorService berekent (REQ-KOR-002). Somt KOR-eligible AR-omzet (vrijstellingsGrondslag = KOR_ART25_OB, status != draft, leveringsDatum in jaar) per administratie + jaar, exclusief uitgeslotenPosten; drempelBenutting = lopendeOmzet / drempel; prognoseEindeJaar via lineaire trend op maandgemiddelde. Wanneer de aggregatie-engine de maand-trend + uitsluitingen niet native kan uitdrukken, berekent KorMonitorService hetzelfde resultaat in PHP via de echte ObjectService API.

KOREUTurnover.title: KOR-EU Turnover
KOREUTurnover.description: Grensoverschrijdende KOR-EU omzetregistratie (alleen bij regime KOR_EU) per 1-1-2025 (REQ-KOR-008): EX-nummer, EU-brede EUR 100.000-drempel en omzet/drempel/benutting per lidstaat. Per-lidstaat drempels zijn DATA, niet code (design D7). Bevat de kwartaalopgaaf-status (Q1-Q4). Vermelding artikel 284 VAT-richtlijn 2006/112/EG.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: KOREUTurnover updates MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — per-lidstaat drempel-benutting en kwartaalopgaaf-status voeden de Q1-Q4 EU-aangiftes (art. 284 BTW-richtlijn) en gaan per OSS-route naar de Belastingdienst; correctie-historie is auditplichtig.

registrationId.description: FK naar KORRegistration met regime = KOR_EU.
registrationId.title: Registration ID

exNumber.description: EX-nummer toegekend door de Belastingdienst KOR-EU portal (handmatige invoer; SBR auto-assign out of scope) (REQ-KOR-008).
exNumber.title: Ex Nummer

perMemberState.description: Per EU-lidstaat: omzet, nationale KOR-drempel en benutting (data, niet code — design D7). Overschrijding van één lidstaat-drempel revoceert KOR-EU alleen voor die lidstaat (REQ-KOR-008).
perMemberState.title: Per Lidstaat

quarterlyReturnStatus.description: Status per kwartaal van de verplichte kwartaalopgaaf (REQ-KOR-008). Geen automatische indiening (design D8).
quarterlyReturnStatus.title: Kwartaalopgaaf Status

administrationId.description: FK naar de administratie; reads gescoped per administratie.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

KORRegistration.title: KOR Registration
KORRegistration.description: Eén KOR-registratie per onderneming per regime (NL-KOR of KOR-EU): aanmeldgegevens, ingangsdatum, drie-jaars-lock-in einddatum, status, en de Belastingdienst-referentie (REQ-KOR-001, REQ-KOR-007). Status verloopt via de declaratieve lifecycle (ADR-031): draft -> ACTIEF -> GEEINDIGD_OVERSCHRIJDING | GEEINDIGD_VRIJWILLIG. Wet OB 1968 art. 25 (NL-KOR) / art. 25a-25d (KOR-EU).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: KORRegistration changes (status transitions, lock-in evolution, Belastingdienst-referentie updates) MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022. Every change is fiscaal relevant — it gates voorbelasting-aftrek, factuurvermelding, en suppletie-berekening, and feeds into auditor + Belastingdienst review at year-end.

enterpriseId.description: FK naar de onderneming (Corporation / Entity) waarvoor de KOR geldt. KOR geldt per onderneming per KvK-nummer (REQ-KOR-010).
enterpriseId.title: Onderneming ID

regime.description: KOR-regime; onveranderlijk na aanmaak (design D1). KOR_NL = binnenlandse KOR (art. 25 OB); KOR_EU = grensoverschrijdend (art. 25a-25d OB, per 1-1-2025).
regime.title: Regime

status.description: Levenscyclus-status van de registratie (REQ-KOR-007). ACTIEF tot lockInEindDatum, daarna GEEINDIGD_VRIJWILLIG via opt-out, of GEEINDIGD_OVERSCHRIJDING bij drempel >100% (REQ-KOR-004).
status.title: Status

registrationDate.description: Datum waarop de ondernemer de KOR-aanmelding indiende bij mijnbelastingdienst.nl/zakelijk (REQ-KOR-001).

lockInEndDate.title: Lock In Eind Datum

registrationChannel.description: Kanaal van aanmelding. Aanmelding blijft web-formulier-only via mijnbelastingdienst.nl (out of scope: SBR/webservice).
registrationChannel.title: Aanmeld Kanaal

thresholdYear.description: Jaardrempel in EUR. NL-KOR: 20000 (geen pro-rata bij start halverwege het jaar — context-brief edge case). KOR-EU: per-lidstaat in KOREUTurnover.
thresholdYear.title: Drempel Jaar

previousRevenue.description: Historische omzet per jaar (jaar -> bedrag) voor de scenario-analyse in de aanmeldstroom (REQ-KOR-001).
previousRevenue.title: Voorgaande Omzet

GEEINDIGD_OVERSCHRIJDING.label: Geëindigd (overschrijding)
GEEINDIGD_OVERSCHRIJDING.description: Drempel >100% overschreden; gedwongen revocatie per leveringsdatum van de triggerfactuur (REQ-KOR-004). Een KORRevocation is gematerialiseerd met suppletie-bedrag.

GEEINDIGD_VRIJWILLIG.label: Geëindigd (vrijwillig)
GEEINDIGD_VRIJWILLIG.description: Vrijwillige opt-out na de drie-jaars-lock-in; effectief per 1-1 van het volgende kalenderjaar (REQ-KOR-007).

activate.label: Activeer KOR
activate.description: KOR gaat in op ingangsDatum. Publiceert kor.registration.activated zodat AP de voorbelasting-aftrek blokkeert en VAT-filing de aangifte opschort (REQ-KOR-006, cross-app).

revokeOverschrijding.label: Beëindig wegens overschrijding
revokeOverschrijding.description: Synchroon getriggerd door KorMonitorService bij drempel >100% (REQ-KOR-003/004). revocatieDatum = leveringsdatum van de triggerfactuur; KORRevocation met type=OVERSCHRIJDING + suppletie-bedrag wordt gematerialiseerd.

optOut.label: Vrijwillige opt-out
optOut.description: Alleen toegestaan vanaf vroegsteOpzegDatum (REQ-KOR-007). KORRevocation met type=VRIJWILLIG_NA_LOCKOUT, revocatieDatum = 1-1 van het volgende kalenderjaar.

KORRevocation.title: KOR Revocation
KORRevocation.description: Beëindiging van de KOR (REQ-KOR-004, REQ-KOR-007): gedwongen bij overschrijding of vrijwillig na de lock-in. Bij overschrijding is revocatieDatum ALTIJD de leveringsdatum van de triggerfactuur — niet einde-maand/kwartaal/jaar (design D4). Bevat het berekende suppletie-bedrag en de drie-jaars blokkade op heraanmelding.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: KORRevocation records MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — the revocatie-datum (leveringsdatum, niet einde-jaar), suppletie-bedrag and Belastingdienst-notificatie are fiscale documenten van de Belastingdienst en moeten onveranderlijk zijn voor audit + bezwaar.

revocationDate.description: KRITISCH: bij OVERSCHRIJDING de leveringsdatum van de triggerfactuur (NIET postingDatum/maand/kwartaal/jaar) (design D4, REQ-KOR-004). Bij VRIJWILLIG_NA_LOCKOUT de 1-1 van het volgende kalenderjaar.

KasgeldLimiet.title: Kasgeldlimiet
KasgeldLimiet.description: Daily short-term debt ceiling per Wet Fido (REQ-FDO-002). The ceiling is percentage × vastgestelde begroting per 1 januari, where percentage is the FidoNormcatalogus statutory value for the organisatie-type (REQ-FDO-009). Current exposure is the rolling 3-month average of net short-term debt; a declarative aggregation (kasgeldRolling3Month) recomputes it daily from the GL short-term debt postings. The enforcement ladder runs binnen-norm → overschrijding-1-kwartaal → overschrijding-2-kwartalen → sanering-verplicht (REQ-FDO-002).

kasgeldRolling3Month.description: Declarative shape of the daily kasgeldlimiet recompute (REQ-FDO-002). Sums net short-term debt = (opgenomen kasgeldleningen + rekening-courant draws + schuld RO + overige korte schuld < 1 jaar) − (korte vorderingen < 1 jaar) from the prior 90 banking days of GL short-term debt postings, divides by the number of banking days to obtain the rolling 3-month average, sets currentExposure and derives headroom = calculatedCeiling − currentExposure. status follows the enforcement ladder over consecutive quarters. When the engine cannot express the rolling window, the same result is computed from the real ObjectService API (find/findAll) over the GL ledger.

onOptOut._note: Was a comma-separated pair, 'lifecycle.optOutFromExceeded,lifecycle.optOutFromOptedIn'. A trigger names ONE event; a comma-list matches neither. Both paths end in the same outcome — the administration left KOR — and the recipients and message are identical either way, so they collapse to one event the app raises from both places. If the two paths ever need different wording, split them into two rules rather than reintroducing a list.

parentLedgerGroupId.description: Self-FK holding the parent LedgerGroup's `code` — a flat business key, exactly as the description says it mirrors: Account.parentAccountNumber references an accountNumber, not an object id. Null for a root group. WHY A BUSINESS KEY AND NOT AN ID: a real object id is not known at seed-authoring time, and OpenRegister's `@ref:` seed-token mechanism (which would mint one) is unusable here — it only walks `components.objects`, a bucket shillinq's fragment merge currently corrupts (see _objects_placement_note). A `code` is the only parent identity BOTH the PHP rollup and the manifest's declarative filter engine can resolve: the LedgerGroupDetail `children` relatedCollection filters `parentLedgerGroupId == @object.code`, and `@object.<field>` reads a FLAT payload field only — it cannot reach `@self.slug`. `code` is unique within an administration, which is the scope BudgetVsActualsReader loads. BudgetVsActualsReader keeps its id|slug|code lookup so hand-authored id or slug references still resolve. A parent with children uses its OWN BudgetLine if one exists; otherwise its value is the recursive sum of its children's resolved values (design.md §3d) — no double counting when both exist.

nexusByAssetYear.description: Declarative shape of the modified-nexus roll-up NexusCalculationService computes (REQ-IBA-002). Tamper-evidence is delegated to OR's audit-trail-immutable contract; the schema only declares the fields and the write-once lifecycle. The admin monitor (REQ-BNT-008) reads from this schema; manual edits are forbidden — operator concerns are addressed by adding a new record (e.g. compensating skip).

OrderPrimitive.title: Order
OrderPrimitive.description: The unified transactional workspace primitive (REQ-ORD-001) folding Subsidie (subsidie), PurchaseOrder (purchase) and DBAOpdracht (engagement) behind one `orderType` discriminator. `sales`/`booking`/`quote`/`blanket` are reserved discriminator values for future folds and are NOT populated by this change. Each type's full field set lives, unabridged, in its own optional field group (`subsidie`/`purchase`/`engagement`); the shared core (number, counterparty, currency, dates, total, state) is common. Lifecycle: `state` carries the UNION of every type's own vocabulary; each transition is scoped to exactly one `orderType` (x-openregister-lifecycle.transitions.*.orderType) so a subsidie Order can never attempt a purchase transition and vice-versa (REQ-ORD-002).

PassThroughMarkupRule.title: Pass-through Markup Rule
PassThroughMarkupRule.description: Per-administration master-data record defining the markup applied to pass-through expenses. Rules target (targetCustomerId + targetCategory), (targetCustomerId only), or null+null (global default). Lookup priority — customer+category > customer-only > global default — is enforced declaratively in the lookup() expression on Receipt/MileageEntry/PerDiem x-openregister-calculations (REQ-ERP-005). markupType=percentage applies amount × (1 + markupValue); markupType=fixedAmount adds markupValue to amount. Effective per fiscal year; rate locks on claim submission per REQ-ERP-010 (rule changes never affect historical claims).

Payee.title: Payee
Payee.description: Canonical "anyone we pay" master for accounts payable per REQ-AP-002 + REQ-AP-012 — covers suppliers, vendors, AND freelancers (Dutch ZZP'ers / sole traders / contractors), plus government payees. Holds party contact details, payment terms, a structured bankAccount object (IBAN + BIC/SWIFT + account holder), payeeType, folded financial fields (creditLimit, apBalance), dunning policy reference, and default expense account. Folds in the retired VendorFinancialProfile duplicate. Symmetric to CustomerMaster on the AR side. Per REQ-AP-001 + ADR-024 (registers, not parallel PHP tables) + ADR-022 (consumes OR contact abstraction when available via contactRef).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Vendor master register; every create / update / lifecycle transition is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022.

vendorNumber.description: Stable vendor identifier unique per administration. Operator-supplied; never auto-generated.
vendorNumber.title: Vendor Number

payeeType.description: Kind of party we pay per REQ-AP-012. supplier/vendor = trading companies; freelancer = Dutch ZZP'er / sole trader; contractor = subcontracted party; government = public-sector payee; other = anything else. The AP module treats every payeeType as a payable party.
payeeType.title: Payee Type

paymentTermDays.description: Default payment term in days (auto-sets APTransaction.dueDate on creation per REQ-AP-003).
paymentTermDays.title: Payment Term Days

defaultExpenseAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber for default expense coding on AP invoices.
defaultExpenseAccountNumber.title: Default Expense Account Number

bankAccount.description: Payee bank account for outgoing SEPA payments. Folds the retired VendorFinancialProfile iban/bic into a structured object. NOTE: bic IS the ISO 9362 SWIFT code (a "SWIFT code" and a BIC are the same identifier) — no separate swift field is modelled. Non-SEPA / cross-border international payments (non-IBAN account numbers, intermediary/correspondent banks) are OUT OF SCOPE here — a future capability; this object models SEPA IBAN/BIC only.

iban.description: Payee IBAN for outgoing SEPA payments. Read by the payment-run SEPA export as the creditor account.
iban.title: IBAN

bic.description: Bank ISO 9362 BIC / SWIFT code (same identifier). Creditor agent for the SEPA export.
bic.title: BIC

accountHolderName.description: Name on the bank account, if it differs from the payee legal name.
accountHolderName.title: Account Holder Name

bankAccount.title: Bank Account

creditLimit.description: Maximum outstanding AP balance permitted for this payee. Folded in from the retired VendorFinancialProfile per REQ-AP-012.
creditLimit.title: Credit Limit

apBalance.description: Current open accounts-payable balance for this payee (derived open-AP total; mirrors the vendorOpenApBalance aggregation). Folded in from the retired VendorFinancialProfile per REQ-AP-012.
apBalance.title: AP Balance

creditTerms.description: Free-text payment terms or reference to OR terms record.
creditTerms.title: Credit Terms

dunningPolicyRef.title: Dunning Policy Ref

country.title: Country
country.description: The country name or ISO code.

email.description: Primary contact email for remittance advice and queries.
email.title: Email

contactRef.description: FK to OR contact abstraction if stable per ADR-022; else null. Symmetric to AR REQ-AR-002. Resolution deferred to implementing cycle.
contactRef.title: Contact Ref

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this vendor record.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

lifecycleState.description: Vendor master lifecycle state. blocked: new AP invoices cannot transition from received to issued; archived: historical reference only.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

active.description: Vendor is active; AP invoices may be received and posted.

blocked.label: Blocked

archived.label: Archived
