Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: A payment related to an Order (or invoice). Generalises the booking DepositPayment and the grant disbursement/reclaim amounts so the order detail can render a Payments widget instead of carrying amount fields. Deposits, installments, grant disbursements and reclaims are all Payment rows.

orderId.description: The Order this payment belongs to.
orderId.title: Order ID

paymentType.description: deposit (booking) / installment / disbursement (grant uitbetaald) / reclaim (grant teruggevorderd) / final / refund.
paymentType.title: Payment Type

amount.description: Payment amount.
amount.title: Amount

status.description: Payment status.
status.title: Status

linkedInvoiceId.description: Invoice this payment settles, if any.
linkedInvoiceId.title: Linked Invoice ID

administrationId.description: Owning administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Payment is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

search.description: Search payments. Use to answer 'has invoice X been paid?' -- the read that closes the loop on an AR or AP invoice.

get.description: Get a single payment by id.

PaymentRequest.title: Payment Request
PaymentRequest.description: An online payment attempt against an AR invoice per REQ-APL-001. One AR invoice can carry several payment requests over its life (link expired and regenerated, a failed attempt then a new link, a link voided after partial credit) — each request has its own lifecycle, gateway identity and audit needs, so payment state lives here and never folds onto ARInvoice (design D1). Mirrors the proven DepositPayment shape minus booking fields, FK'd to ARInvoice. STORES NO PCI DATA: no card number, CVV, PAN, IBAN credential, or authorization token is ever persisted — OpenConnector (PCI-certified) handles all sensitive payment data and only opaque references (paymentIntentId, settlementReference) are stored here, identical to DepositPayment REQ-DP-001. v0.1.1 (portal-payment-initiation, REQ-SPPI-005) adds confirmationSummary — a subject-safe settlement receipt written on capture and surfaced through the customer portal's read-only paymentRequests collection.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Payment-attempt register; every create / update / lifecycle transition (authorize / capture / markUnapplied / fail / expire / void) is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022. The captured PaymentRequest is the canonical payment-evidence chain linked to the settled ARInvoice (REQ-APL-005).

invoiceReference.description: FK to the ARInvoice (UUID or slug) being paid. The capture transition settles this invoice through its existing matchPaid lifecycle transition (REQ-APL-005).
invoiceReference.title: Invoice Reference

amount.description: The invoice's outstanding amount at request creation, in the invoice currency. v1 links carry the full outstanding amount; if the outstanding changes (partial credit) the pending request is voided and a new one is created for the new amount (REQ-APL-006 / design D5).
amount.title: Amount

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, mirrors the invoice currency.
currency.title: Currency

paymentGateway.description: The gateway routing this request via the OpenConnector payment adapter. iDEAL via Mollie, cards via Stripe. The gateway set is owned by the OpenConnector adapter (no Mollie/Stripe SDK enters Shillinq).
paymentGateway.title: Payment Gateway

paymentIntentId.description: OPAQUE gateway/OpenConnector payment-intent reference. NOT a PCI field — no card data, no token, just the opaque correlation id the webhook + polling fallback resolve the record by. Mirrors DepositPayment.paymentIntentId (REQ-DP-001).
paymentIntentId.title: Payment Intent ID

state.description: Payment-request lifecycle state per REQ-APL-001. captured_unapplied is the exception state for a capture that could not settle its invoice — surfaced, never silently dropped (REQ-APL-005).
state.title: State

expiresAt.description: TTL boundary (per-administration config). A pending request expires at min(configured TTL, invoice settlement); the shared polling job flips pending → expired (design D7).
expiresAt.title: Expires At

failureReason.description: Last gateway error, operator-readable. The gateway error code/message only — never raw card data (mirrors DepositPayment REQ-DP-011). Required on the fail transition.
failureReason.title: Failure Reason

settlementReference.description: Gateway payout/batch reference recorded on capture (or enriched by the polling job where the gateway exposes payout data asynchronously). Feeds bookkeeping-bank-reconciliation auto-matching (REQ-BBR-002) so the Mollie/Stripe payout statement line matches the batch of captured requests (REQ-APL-006).
settlementReference.title: Settlement Reference

gatewayFeeAmount.description: Gateway fee (gross − net) surfaced on the bank-reconciliation match for operator posting per REQ-APL-006. Automatic fee journals are out of scope (v1 surfaces, does not auto-post).
gatewayFeeAmount.title: Gateway Fee Amount

capturedAt.description: Capture timestamp, set on the capture transition (REQ-APL-005).
capturedAt.title: Captured At

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this payment request. Scopes the payment-requests overview per-administration (REQ-APL-008).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

paymentLink.description: COMPUTED (REQ-APL-002): the customer-facing payment URL embedding the payment-request id, the invoice id, and a short-lived signed token, resolving to the OpenConnector hosted payment UI — resolved by the shared payment adapter (the REQ-DP-005 pattern). The app MUST NOT construct a direct Mollie/Stripe URL anywhere. Null unless state=pending AND the invoice is unsettled (visibleWhen); following a link for a non-pending request shows a friendly already-paid/expired page from the hosted UI, never a second charge.
paymentLink.title: Payment Link

confirmationSummary.description: Subject-safe, plain-language settlement receipt written by PaymentReconciliationService on capture (portal-payment-initiation, REQ-SPPI-005) — e.g. 'Invoice INV-2026-014 paid on 2026-07-23, reference tr_xxx'. Surfaced through the customer portal's read-only paymentRequests collection so the debtor sees a receipt without a dedicated portal inbox. Never overwritten by a replayed/idempotent webhook.
confirmationSummary.example: Invoice INV-2026-0042 paid on 2026-07-23, reference tr_WDqYK6vllg.
confirmationSummary.title: Confirmation Summary

paymentLink.description: OpenConnector hosted payment UI URL with a short-lived signed token (REQ-APL-002), resolved by the shared payment adapter following the bookings-deposits REQ-DP-005 pattern. Embeds the payment-request id + invoice id + signed token; resolves to OpenConnector's hosted payment UI. NO Mollie/Stripe URL is constructed in app PHP/JS — the calculation delegates to OpenConnector. Null unless state=pending and the invoice unsettled.

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: Payment link issued and valid; awaiting the customer's payment. The paymentLink calculation resolves only in this state and while the invoice is unsettled (REQ-APL-002).

authorized.label: Authorized
authorized.description: The gateway authorized the payment; funds reserved, awaiting capture. Card flows may authorize then capture; iDEAL captures directly (pending → captured).

captured.label: Captured
captured.description: Payment captured at the gateway. The linked ARInvoice is settled via its existing matchPaid lifecycle transition (AR core owns GL posting); settlementReference + gatewayFeeAmount recorded for bank-reconciliation auto-matching (REQ-APL-005 / REQ-APL-006). Terminal happy-path state.

captured_unapplied.label: Captured (unapplied)
captured_unapplied.description: Capture succeeded at the gateway but the invoice could not be settled (already credited / written-off / paid by other means). EXCEPTION state — surfaced prominently on the payment-requests overview's exceptions filter, never silently dropped, and refundable via the adapter's existing refund call (REQ-APL-005).

failed.label: Failed
failed.description: The gateway rejected the payment. failureReason carries the operator-readable gateway error. The customer may be offered a fresh link (regeneration creates a new request, history preserved).

expired.label: Expired
expired.description: The link's TTL elapsed before payment (time-based on expiresAt). An operator can regenerate, creating a new pending request (REQ-APL-008).

voided.label: Voided
voided.description: The invoice was settled by other means (bank match, credit note, write-off) or its outstanding amount changed — open pending requests are voided immediately so the link stops resolving to a payable session (REQ-APL-006 / design D5).

authorize.label: Authorize payment
authorize.description: The gateway authorized the payment (card flows). Reached idempotently from the shared PaymentReconciliationService on the gateway authorize event (REQ-APL-004).

capture.label: Capture payment
capture.description: Payment captured at the gateway. Settles the linked ARInvoice through its existing matchPaid lifecycle transition (AR core REQ-AR-004 owns GL settlement posting, dunning stop, ageing — this change posts nothing) with the PaymentRequest as payment evidence; records capturedAt, settlementReference and gatewayFeeAmount for bank-reconciliation auto-matching (REQ-APL-005 / REQ-APL-006). Idempotent: a replayed capture webhook is a no-op (REQ-APL-004).

markUnapplied.label: Mark captured but unapplied
markUnapplied.description: The capture succeeded but the linked ARInvoice settlement transition was impossible (already credited / written-off / paid by other means). The request is surfaced as an exception — never silently dropped — and offers a refund via the adapter's existing refund call (REQ-APL-005).

fail.label: Fail payment
fail.description: The gateway rejected the payment. Requires failureReason (the gateway error code/message — never raw card data).

expire.label: Expire link
expire.description: Time-based transition fired when now > expiresAt and no payment captured. The shared polling job already wakes for pending requests (design D7) — no app-local cron.

void.label: Void request
void.description: The invoice was settled by other means (bank match, credit note, write-off) or its outstanding amount changed — open requests are voided immediately so the link stops resolving (REQ-APL-006). The voiding hook rides the invoice lifecycle transitions declaratively (design D5).

PaymentRun.title: Payment Run
PaymentRun.description: A batch of approved Payee payments per REQ-AP-013 (consolidate-accounts-payable). Groups open AP invoices into a single outgoing payment instruction with a declarative lifecycle draft → approved → exported → reconciled. Approval (RBAC controller) is a hard gate before export — there is NO direct draft → exported transition. The actual SEPA pain.001 / CSV bank-file GENERATION is the separate payment-run-sepa-export change (writes exportedFileRef); this schema models only the batch + its lifecycle. Each paymentLines[] entry references one Payee + one APTransaction. bankAccount.iban / bankAccount.bic on the referenced Payee are the SEPA creditor source of truth.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Payment-batch register; every create / approve / export / reconcile transition is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022. Approval and export are the auditable control points before money leaves the administration.

runNumber.description: Stable batch identifier unique per administration. Operator-supplied.
runNumber.title: Run Number

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this payment run.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

executionDate.description: Requested execution date (ISO 20022 RequestedExecutionDate) for the batch.
executionDate.title: Execution Date

debtorAccountIban.description: IBAN of the administration's own (debtor) bank account the batch is paid from. SAFE placeholder in seed data.
debtorAccountIban.title: Debtor Account IBAN

status.description: Mirror of lifecycleState for list/filter convenience; the canonical state machine is x-openregister-lifecycle on lifecycleState.
status.title: Status

totalAmount.description: Sum of all paymentLines[].amount in the run currency. Integer-cent precision per ADR-031 money rules.
totalAmount.title: Total Amount

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. T2: base currency only (EUR).
currency.title: Currency

paymentLines.description: One line per Payee payment in the batch. Each line references a Payee and the AP invoice being settled.

payeeId.description: FK to Payee UUID / slug being paid.
payeeId.title: Payee ID

payeeName.description: Denormalised payee name for display / remittance.
payeeName.title: Payee Name

creditorIban.description: Creditor (payee) IBAN, sourced from the referenced Payee.bankAccount.iban. SAFE placeholder in seed data.
creditorIban.title: Creditor IBAN

amount.description: Line payment amount in the run currency.
amount.title: Amount

remittanceInfo.description: Unstructured or structured remittance reference (ISO 20022 RmtInf) — typically the vendor invoice number.
remittanceInfo.title: Remittance Info

apTransactionRef.description: FK to the APTransaction UUID / slug this line settles.
apTransactionRef.title: AP Transaction Ref

paymentLines.title: Payment Lines

exportedFileRef.description: FK / URI to the generated SEPA pain.001 / CSV bank file. Written by the separate payment-run-sepa-export change on the export transition; null until exported.
exportedFileRef.title: Exported File Ref

exportedAt.description: Timestamp the batch was exported to a bank file.
exportedAt.title: Exported At

reconciledAt.description: Timestamp the batch was reconciled against the bank statement.
reconciledAt.title: Reconciled At

lifecycleState.description: Canonical payment-run lifecycle state (see x-openregister-lifecycle).
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Batch under construction; payment lines may be added/removed.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Batch approved by a controller; immutable and ready for export. Hard gate before money leaves the administration.

exported.label: Exported
exported.description: SEPA pain.001 / CSV bank file generated (payment-run-sepa-export change); exportedFileRef set.

reconciled.label: Reconciled
reconciled.description: Batch reconciled against the bank statement; terminal state.

approve.label: Approve payment run
approve.description: Controller approves the batch. Four-eyes segregation of duties (payment-run-four-eyes, REQ-PR4E-001): the approver MUST differ from whoever prepared the batch — enforced server-side by FourEyesPaymentRunGuard, which derives the preparer from OpenRegister's immutable audit trail (ADR-022) and fails closed when the preparer is indeterminate. There is NO direct draft → exported transition. Approval is the control point before money leaves the administration.

export.label: Export payment run
export.description: Generate the SEPA pain.001 / CSV bank file (payment-run-sepa-export change) and set exportedFileRef + exportedAt. Only an approved batch can be exported. Duplicate-payment control (payment-control-guards, REQ-PCG-001): PaymentRunDuplicateGuard rejects the export server-side when any paymentLines[].apTransactionRef settles an AP invoice that is already paid, or is already queued in another open/executed PaymentRun (draft/approved/exported). Export is the last declarative choke point before money leaves — the approve transition's requires slot is occupied by FourEyesPaymentRunGuard and the OR lifecycle engine resolves a single requires guard per transition. Fails closed on any indeterminate check.

reconcile.label: Reconcile payment run
reconcile.description: Match the exported batch against the bank statement and set reconciledAt. Terminal.

Payroll.title: Payroll
Payroll.description: Payroll period sub-ledger record (REQ-PAY-002). Captures gross input and aggregated deduction totals; on issue it materialises a balanced GLTransaction (REQ-PAY-008) per the T1 JournalEntry pattern. UBL Peppol BIS 30 field shape is declared for T4 passthrough but NOT computed here (REQ-PAY-010).

payrollNumber.description: Payroll number, unique per administration (REQ-PAY-002). Maps to UBL cbc:ID for T4 (REQ-PAY-010).
payrollNumber.title: Payroll Number

periodStartDate.description: First day of the payroll period.
periodStartDate.title: Period Start Date

periodEndDate.description: Last day of the payroll period.
periodEndDate.title: Period End Date

grossAmount.description: Gross salary/wage in the administration's base currency (REQ-PAY-002).
grossAmount.title: Gross Amount

netAmount.description: Net amount = grossAmount - SUM(employee-borne deductions). Computed via aggregation (REQ-PAY-002); no PHP math service.
netAmount.title: Net Amount

placementFeeAmount.description: Placement fee owed to the staffing agency for detached workers only (REQ-PAY-007). Materialises a separate AP posting on issue.
placementFeeAmount.title: Placement Fee Amount

placementAgencyId.description: FK to the placement agency supplier (detached workers only).
placementAgencyId.title: Placement Agency ID

payDate.description: Scheduled pay date. Maps to UBL invoiceDate for T4.
payDate.title: Pay Date

glTransactionId.description: Back-reference to the materialised salary-expense GLTransaction once issued (REQ-PAY-008).
glTransactionId.title: GL Transaction ID

placementGlTransactionId.description: Back-reference to the placement-fee AP GLTransaction (detached workers only, REQ-PAY-008).
placementGlTransactionId.title: Placement GL Transaction ID

externalReference.description: Idempotency / source reference from external payroll software webhooks (REQ-PAY-009).
externalReference.title: External Reference

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this payroll.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

status.description: Payroll lifecycle (REQ-PAY-004). calculated and later are immutable except status. issued materialises GL + loonstrookje.
status.title: Status

retention.description: Payroll records retained 7 years per AWR art. 52.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable. Deductions may be assigned.

calculated.label: Calculated
calculated.description: Deductions assigned and net computed (REQ-PAY-004). Immutable; awaiting issuance.

issued.label: Issued
issued.description: GLTransaction materialised, loonstrookje generated, payroll-issued event published (REQ-PAY-004 / REQ-PAY-008).

paid.label: Paid
paid.description: Confirmed paid via bank reconciliation; payroll-paid event published (REQ-PAY-004).

calculate.label: Calculate
calculate.description: Aggregate deductions, compute net and validate annual statutory totals before issuance (REQ-PAY-004 / REQ-PAY-005).

issue.label: Issue payroll
issue.description: Materialise the salary-expense GLTransaction, generate the loonstrookje and publish payroll-issued (REQ-PAY-004 / REQ-PAY-006 / REQ-PAY-008).

actions.description: Materialise one balanced salary-expense GLTransaction (debit salary-expense account by contractType, credit payroll-liability) and set glTransactionId (REQ-PAY-008).
Generate a loonstrookje DeterminationLetter record with 7-year retention (REQ-PAY-006). PDF rendering is delegated to an external service; no template engine in Shillinq.
Publish the nl.conduction.payroll.issued CloudEvent to the configured external endpoint (REQ-PAY-009).

pay.label: Confirm paid
pay.description: Mark the payroll paid after bank reconciliation; publish payroll-paid (REQ-PAY-004 / REQ-PAY-009).

actions.description: Publish the nl.conduction.payroll.paid CloudEvent (REQ-PAY-009).

netAmount.description: Net amount = grossAmount minus the sum of employee-borne deductions for this payroll (REQ-PAY-002). Employer SV is excluded from net.

annualEmployeeDeductions.description: Per-employee annual deduction totals grouped by type for the payroll year, used by the calculate precondition to validate statutory limits and for tax/SV reporting (REQ-PAY-005).

x-openregister-ubl.description: Declared field shape for T4 payroll-disbursement passthrough; NOT emitted in T2 (REQ-PAY-010).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Payroll is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

PensioenvoorzieningDetail.title: Pensioenvoorziening Detail
PensioenvoorzieningDetail.description: Type-specific detail register for eigen-beheer pensioenvoorzieningen (REQ-PROV-014). FK back to a Provision with provisionType=pensioen. Detailed actuariële measurement (PUC, mortality, deelnemerstelling) is handled by bookkeeping-pension-ias19; this register captures the cross-reference and the high-level assumptions visible from the IAS 37 perspective.

actuarialMethod.description: Actuarial method (PUC mandatory for DB plans per IAS 19, REQ-PROV-014).

salaryGrowthAssumption.description: Salary growth assumption used in the actuariële berekening.

linkedActuaryReport.description: FK into docudesk for the actuariële rapport.
linkedActuaryReport.title: Linked Actuary Report

linkedPensionPlan.description: FK to a PensionPlan in bookkeeping-pension-ias19 when the entity uses both registers.
linkedPensionPlan.title: Linked Pension Plan

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Pensioenvoorziening Detail is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

PensionAssetDetail.title: Pension Asset Detail
PensionAssetDetail.description: Plan-asset breakdown by category with the IFRS 13 fair-value level (1 quoted / 2 observable / 3 unobservable) for one ActuarialValuation (REQ-PEN-007). The per-valuation category fair values must sum to ActuarialValuation.planAssetsFairValue.

fairValue.title: Fair Value

level.title: Level

PensionAssumptionSensitivity.title: Pension Assumption Sensitivity
PensionAssumptionSensitivity.description: DBO sensitivity line for one assumption delta on one ActuarialValuation per IAS 19 §145 (REQ-PEN-006). Each DB valuation generates eight lines: discount rate ±0.5pp, salary growth ±0.5pp, mortality ±1yr, inflation ±0.5pp. Records the effect on DBO, service cost and (optionally) net interest.

effectOnDBO.title: Effect On Dbo

effectOnServiceCost.title: Effect On Service Cost

effectOnNetInterest.description: Impact on net interest cost in EUR.
effectOnNetInterest.title: Effect On Net Interest

pensionSensitivityDeltas.description: Declarative shape of the per-assumption sensitivity recomputation (REQ-PEN-006). For each of the eight standard deltas the base DBO + service cost are recomputed and the difference stored as effectOnDBO / effectOnServiceCost. When the engine cannot recompute the actuarial base, the actuaris-supplied effect is entered directly and validated for completeness (eight lines per DB valuation).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Pension Assumption Sensitivity is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

PensionDisclosureTabel.description: Auto-generated jaarrekening disclosure table per IAS 19 §135–149 for a plan on a balansdatum (REQ-PEN-007, REQ-PEN-008). tableContent holds the structured disclosure (assumptions, DBO movement, asset movement, P&L + OCI summary, asset breakdown by category + fair-value level, duration, expected employer contribution) suitable for jaarrekening notes; for DC plans it carries only the contribution amount + regeling summary (REQ-PEN-008).

tableContent.description: Full disclosure table as structured JSON, auto-generated from PensionMovement + PensionAssetDetail + PensionAssumptionSensitivity records; renderable as Markdown/HTML for jaarrekening notes (REQ-PEN-007). For DC plans, only contribution + regeling summary (REQ-PEN-008).
tableContent.title: Table Content

status.title: Status

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

pensionDisclosureGeneration.description: Declarative shape of the disclosure-table generation (REQ-PEN-007). Consumes the completed PensionMovement (DBO + asset movement, P&L/OCI split), PensionAssetDetail (category + fair-value level) and PensionAssumptionSensitivity (eight sensitivity lines) records for the plan on the valuation date and emits a single PensionDisclosureTabel with all IAS 19 §135–149 line items. When the engine cannot template the merge, the same structure is built from the source records via the real ObjectService API.

x-openregister-disclosure-source.description: Declarative data-source contract consumed by bookkeeping-financial-statements REQ-FS-004 jaarrekening Note renderer. The Note schema's pension disclosure section reads PensionDisclosureTabel.tableContent for the (administrationId, valuationDate) tuple when status is `approved` or `published`, eliminating any manual copy/paste into the jaarrekening (REQ-PEN-007). When the renderer cannot project the JSON column directly, the same data is fetched via the real ObjectService API per ADR-022.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Pension Disclosure Table is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

PensionMovement.title: Pension Movement
PensionMovement.description: Per-period roll-forward of DBO and plan assets, split into the three IAS 19R buckets: service + past service + settlement (P&L), net interest (P&L) and actuarial gain/loss (OCI, non-recycling per IAS 19 §122) (REQ-PEN-003, REQ-PEN-004, REQ-PEN-009). dboClosing, planAssetsClosing, netPensionMovementPL and netPensionMovementOCI are computed roll-forward fields. Past service cost from a plan amendment is posted directly to P&L on the amendment date (REQ-PEN-009).

pastServiceCost.description: Past service cost from a plan amendment, posted directly to P&L on the amendment date (REQ-PEN-009). Negative when a benefit reduction.
pastServiceCost.title: Past Service Cost

netInterestCost.description: Net interest = discount rate × opening net pension liability (P&L) (REQ-PEN-003).
netInterestCost.title: Net Interest Cost

actuarialLossGainDBO.description: Total actuarial change on DBO (OCI). Negative = gain, positive = loss on the obligation (REQ-PEN-003, REQ-PEN-004).
actuarialLossGainDBO.title: Actuarial Loss Gain Dbo

dueToDemographicChanges.description: Portion of the DBO actuarial change due to mortality/disability/withdrawal (OCI).
dueToDemographicChanges.title: Due To Demographic Changes

dueToFinancialChanges.description: Portion due to discount-rate / inflation change (OCI).
dueToFinancialChanges.title: Due To Financial Changes

dueToExperienceAdjustments.description: Portion due to actual vs assumed experience (OCI).
dueToExperienceAdjustments.title: Due To Experience Adjustments

dboClosing.description: Computed dboOpening + serviceCostCurrent + pastServiceCost + netInterestCost + actuarialLossGainDBO − benefitsPaid (REQ-PEN-003).
dboClosing.title: Dbo Closing

expectedReturnOnAssets.description: Expected return = discount rate × opening assets (EUR).
expectedReturnOnAssets.title: Expected Return On Assets

employerContributions.description: Contributions paid by the employer (EUR). For DC plans this is the only pension cost recognised (REQ-PEN-008).
employerContributions.title: Employer Contributions

planAssetsClosing.description: Computed planAssetsOpening + expectedReturnOnAssets + actuarialGainLossAssets + employerContributions + employeeContributions − benefitsPaidFromAssets (REQ-PEN-003).
planAssetsClosing.title: Plan Assets Closing

netPensionMovementPL.description: Computed serviceCostCurrent + pastServiceCost + netInterestCost − gainOnSettlement; total P&L charge (REQ-PEN-003).
netPensionMovementPL.title: Net Pension Movement Pl

netPensionMovementOCI.description: Computed actuarialLossGainDBO − actuarialGainLossAssets; total OCI remeasurement, non-recycling (REQ-PEN-004).
netPensionMovementOCI.title: Net Pension Movement Oci

linkedJournalEntries.description: References to GL journal entries created from this movement (T2 GL integration).
linkedJournalEntries.title: Linked Journal Entries

notes.description: Free-text narrative on the period (e.g. plan amendment, rate change) (REQ-PEN-009).
notes.title: Notes

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

pensionRollForward.description: Declarative shape of the per-period DBO + plan-asset roll-forward (REQ-PEN-003). dboClosing carries the opening balance plus all movement buckets; planAssetsClosing rolls the asset side; netPensionMovementPL and netPensionMovementOCI partition the period charge into the disjoint P&L and OCI buckets per IAS 19R. When the OpenRegister aggregation engine cannot express the prior-period carry, the same arithmetic is recomputed from the prior PensionMovement closing balance + current ActuarialValuation via the real ObjectService API.

dboClosing.expression: dboOpening + serviceCostCurrent + pastServiceCost + netInterestCost + actuarialLossGainDBO - benefitsPaid

planAssetsClosing.expression: planAssetsOpening + expectedReturnOnAssets + actuarialGainLossAssets + employerContributions + employeeContributions - benefitsPaidFromAssets

x-openregister-posting-recipe.description: Declarative GL posting recipe for PensionMovement, consumed by the T1 bookkeeping-general-ledger JournalEntry materialiser (REQ-PEN-003, REQ-PEN-004, REQ-JE-007). Each bucket maps to a `bookkeeping-general-ledger` JournalEntry whose materialised GLTransaction posts the period charge to the configured chart-of-accounts range. The recipe is declarative: the JournalEntry orchestrator reads it on PensionMovement transition to `posted` and emits one JournalEntry per non-zero bucket; ids land in `PensionMovement.linkedJournalEntries`. Account ranges follow the standard Dutch SBR/RGS bookkeeping hierarchy (4xxx personeelslasten, 6xxx financiële lasten, 8xxx OCI/eigen vermogen) and may be overridden per administration via the chart-of-accounts mapping (REQ-COA-002).

buckets.name: serviceCost
buckets.description: IAS 19 service cost + past service cost - gain on settlement → personeelslasten (REQ-PEN-003 P&L bucket 1).

buckets.name: netInterest
buckets.description: IAS 19 net interest on the net pension liability → financiële lasten (REQ-PEN-003 P&L bucket 2).

buckets.name: remeasurementOCI
buckets.description: Actuarieel resultaat (DBO + assets) → OCI account (REQ-PEN-003 OCI bucket 3); marked non-recycling per REQ-PEN-004 so the GL engine MUST refuse any later JournalEntry that moves this balance to a P&L account.

x-openregister-deferred-tax-hint.description: Declarative deferred-tax detection hint consumed by bookkeeping-deferred-tax (REQ-DT-001). PensionMovement creates timing differences between the commercial (IFRS / RJ 271) measurement of the pension liability and its tax basis (in NL: pension provisions are typically only deductible when contributions are paid out, so the commercial provision creates a deductible temporary difference / DTA). The detector reads this hint and emits TemporaryDifference records with category=pension per fiscal period per administration; the OCI component flows to TaxProvision.recognisedInOCI per REQ-DT-009.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Pension Movement is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

PerformanceObligation.title: Performance Obligation
PerformanceObligation.description: A distinct promised good or service within a contract (IFRS 15.22-30, REQ-IFRS15-005). Carries the satisfaction pattern (point-in-time | over-time) and, for over-time POs, the output method (units-delivered, milestones, time-elapsed, percentage-of-completion) or input method (cost-to-cost, labour-hours, machine-hours, units-produced). For cost-to-cost it sources actual + estimated cost from the project-accounting module (costBasis FK) and derives percentageComplete = actualCostToDate / revisedTotalEstimatedCost (REQ-IFRS15-005). Holds the stand-alone selling price (SSP) used for relative allocation and the resulting allocated price.

x-openregister-hrmq-payroll-source.description: Declarative HRMQ payroll feed for the SBIE payroll carve-out base (REQ-CBC-005). Eligible payroll costs per jurisdiction (wages, salaries, payroll taxes, employer pension contributions; bonus, severance, equity comp per OESO Model Rules Art. 5.3.3 with stock-based compensation kept aligned with the GloBE income adjustment) sourced from the hrmq app: each PayrollLine record carries an employeeJurisdiction field; the feed sums eligible payroll across all PayrollLine records per (period, jurisdiction). Intercompany seconded staff use the operating-jurisdiction (not legal-employer-jurisdiction) per Art. 5.3.3.4. Optional feed — when hrmq is not provisioned, the carve-out base remains 0 and the carve-out collapses to the tangible-assets component only.
x-openregister-hrmq-payroll-source.secondmentRule: Seconded staff are attributed to the operating-jurisdiction (where the activity is performed), not the legal-employer-jurisdiction (OESO Model Rules Art. 5.3.3.4).

payrollMap.amountExpr: SUM(PayrollLine.eligibleCompensation WHERE employeeJurisdiction = @self.jurisdiction AND sbieEligible = true AND period = @self.period)

numberOfEmployeesFeed.description: Concurrent feed of FTE per jurisdiction into the CbCR 7-field roll-up (REQ-CBC-002).

annualRosterValidation.description: Annual deelnemersbestand validation of the employee roster before the actuarial valuation lock (parity with REQ-PEN-010 / pension-ias19 HRMQ roster source). Validation passes when SUM(Employee.fte) matches the prior-year roster within ±5% per jurisdiction.

x-openregister-hrmq-payroll-source.status: DEFERRED — optional declarative contract only; live integration ships with the not-yet-merged hrmq apply cycle on a live instance.

x-openregister-tangible-assets-source.description: Declarative tangible-assets-NBV feed for the SBIE carve-out base (REQ-CBC-005). Per-jurisdiction net book value of eligible tangible assets (excluding cash, cash equivalents, intangibles, and held-for-sale assets per OESO Model Rules Art. 5.3) sourced from the bookkeeping-fixed-assets-depreciation app: each FixedAsset record carries a jurisdictionOfUse field; the feed sums NBV across all in-scope assets per (period, jurisdiction). Inventory, financial assets, and IFRS 16 right-of-use lease assets are EXCLUDED from the OESO definition unless held in long-term operating use — the feed honours the OESO carve-out scoping flag on FixedAsset.sbieEligible.
exclusions: IFRS 16 RoU lease assets NOT in long-term operating use (Art. 5.3.4)

tangibleAssetsNbvMap.amountExpr: SUM(FixedAsset.netBookValueAtPeriodEnd WHERE jurisdictionOfUse = @self.jurisdiction AND sbieEligible = true AND period = @self.period)

x-openregister-tangible-assets-source.status: DEFERRED — declarative contract only; live integration ships with the not-yet-merged bookkeeping-fixed-assets-depreciation apply cycle on a live instance.

x-openregister-vpb-current-source.description: Declarative NL Vpb (vennootschapsbelasting) current-tax feed for the adjustedCoveredTaxes input on NL-resident jurisdiction computations (REQ-CBC-004). Per-entity Vpb current-year + prior-year amounts sourced from the bookkeeping-vpb-mkb app; the NL fiscal-unity consolidation collapses fiscale-eenheid members into a single entity-level current-tax line before the per-jurisdiction sum, so intra-fiscale-eenheid Vpb double-counting cannot occur. Only the NL jurisdiction record is fed; non-NL jurisdiction computations continue to source their covered tax from local-jurisdiction tax provisions.
x-openregister-vpb-current-source.fiscalUnityRule: Fiscale eenheid members are collapsed into a single moederentiteit current-tax line before the per-jurisdiction sum (Vpb art. 15); intra-fiscale-eenheid transactions are already eliminated upstream in bookkeeping-vpb-mkb.
x-openregister-vpb-current-source.status: DEFERRED — declarative contract only; live integration ships with the not-yet-merged bookkeeping-vpb-mkb apply cycle on a live instance.

x-openregister-deferred-tax-source.description: Declarative deferred-tax feed for the adjusted covered taxes (REQ-CBC-004) and the GloBE income corrections (REQ-CBC-003). Per-jurisdiction DTA timing differences sourced from the bookkeeping-deferred-tax app: commercial-fiscaal divergence (IFRS valuation vs Vpb box 1 valuation) is recast on the GloBE basis per OESO Model Rules Art. 4.4 (covered-tax effect) + Art. 3.2.7 (DTA effect on GloBE income). The DTA effect is appended to globeIncomeAdjustments as type=deferred-tax-effect; the covered-tax effect is appended to coveredTaxAdjustments and folded into adjustedCoveredTaxes.
x-openregister-deferred-tax-source.status: DEFERRED — declarative contract only; live integration ships with the not-yet-merged bookkeeping-deferred-tax apply cycle on a live instance.

ProvincialeFondsPosting.title: Provincial Fund Posting
ProvincialeFondsPosting.description: Sector-specific posting for provinciale fondsen: provinciefonds, algemene uitkering, decentralisatie-uitkering, and integratie-uitkering. On transition to 'posted', materialises a balanced 2-line GLTransaction per T1 REQ-GL-001 with sourceReference back to this posting. Does NOT carry its own ledger lines per design D3.

fondsType.description: Type of provinciale fonds uitkering per REQ-PRB-004.
fondsType.title: Fund Type

benefitAmount.description: Total uitkering amount in EUR. This amount is materialised into a balanced GLTransaction on post per REQ-PRB-004.

benefitDecision.description: Beschikkingnummer of the uitkering (official reference number from the relevant ministry).
benefitDecision.title: Distribution Decision

journalEntryId.title: Journal Entry ID

administrationId.title: Administration ID

debitAccountNumber.description: Account to debit in the materialised GLTransaction (e.g. liquid assets account for the uitkering receivable).
debitAccountNumber.title: Debit Account Number

creditAccountNumber.description: Account to credit in the materialised GLTransaction (e.g. uitkering inkomstenrekening per fondsType).
creditAccountNumber.title: Credit Account Number

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the fonds posting.
state.title: State

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Fonds posting is being prepared; no GL impact yet.

posted.label: Geboekt
posted.description: Posting is confirmed; a balanced 2-line GLTransaction has been materialised per REQ-GL-001.

reversed.label: Gestorneerd
reversed.description: Posting has been reversed; a contra-GLTransaction has been materialised.

post.label: Boek uitkering
post.description: Materialise a balanced 2-line GLTransaction (debit assets, credit inkomsten) for the uitkeringBedrag and set journalEntryId.

reverse.label: Storneer uitkering
reverse.description: Materialise a contra-GLTransaction to reverse the original posting.

onPost.description: Materialise a balanced 2-line GLTransaction per T1 REQ-GL-001. Debit debitAccountNumber for uitkeringBedrag, credit creditAccountNumber for uitkeringBedrag. Set sourceReference to ProvincialeFondsPosting.id. Write journalEntryId FK back to this record. Idempotency key: (administrationId, id) prevents re-posting on repair-step re-run.

totalByFondsType.description: Total uitkering bedrag per fondsType for the administration, excluding reversed postings. Used by the provinciale fondsen index page.

Provision.title: Provision
Provision.description: Core polymorphic IAS 37 / RJ 252 voorziening record (REQ-PROV-001, REQ-PROV-002, REQ-PROV-003, REQ-PROV-007, REQ-PROV-010, REQ-PROV-018). Carries the three-criteria recognition (legal/constructive obligation + obligating event + probabilityOfOutflow > 0.5 + bestEstimate), the sensitivity range (rangeLow / rangeHigh), the expectedTiming horizon split, the disconteringsvoet + discounted value when material future timing applies, the linkedAccount FK into the chart of accounts, the peer-review + CFO audit trail and the optional FK into one of six type-specific detail registers (pensioen, jubileum, herstructurering, garantie, milieu, claims). probabilityOfOutflow ≤ 0.5 routes to ContingentLiability instead.

provisionType.description: Discriminator selecting which type-specific detail register applies (REQ-PROV-001).
provisionType.title: Provision Type

recognitionDate.description: Date the provision was first recognised (REQ-PROV-001).
recognitionDate.title: Recognition Date

recognitionRationale.description: Narrative explaining why the three IAS 37 / RJ 252 criteria are satisfied (REQ-PROV-001).
recognitionRationale.example: Garantieclausule in algemene voorwaarden + 1.5% historische claim-rate
recognitionRationale.title: Recognition Rationale

obligatingEvent.description: Past event that created the obligation (IAS 37 §17, REQ-PROV-001).
obligatingEvent.example: Verkoop goederen met waarborg 12 maanden per contractvoorwaarden
obligatingEvent.title: Obligating Event

probabilityOfOutflow.description: Decimal 0–1 probability of outflow of economic resources (IAS 37 §23, REQ-PROV-001, REQ-PROV-007). Must be > 0.5 for balance-sheet recognition; 0.05–0.5 routes to ContingentLiability; ≤ 0.05 is remote.
probabilityOfOutflow.title: Probability Of Outflow

bestEstimate.description: Management's best estimate of the outflow in EUR (IAS 37 §36, REQ-PROV-002). REQ-PROV-018 triggers peer-review when > EUR 100K or > 1% of prior-year balance total.
bestEstimate.title: Best Estimate

bestEstimateRationale.description: Narrative documenting the methodology and sources used to arrive at bestEstimate (REQ-PROV-002).
bestEstimateRationale.example: EUR 12M omzet × 1.5% historische claim-rate (5-jaar gemiddelde) - reeds geleverde claims
bestEstimateRationale.title: Best Estimate Rationale

rangeLow.description: Lower bound of the sensitivity range in EUR (IAS 37 §39, REQ-PROV-002).
rangeLow.title: Range Low

rangeHigh.description: Upper bound of the sensitivity range in EUR (IAS 37 §39, REQ-PROV-002).
rangeHigh.title: Range High

expectedTiming.description: Horizon split of expected outflows (REQ-PROV-003, REQ-PROV-017). longTerm > 0 triggers REQ-PROV-003 disconteringsvoet.

shortTerm.description: Expected outflow within 1 year in EUR.
shortTerm.title: Short Term

expectedTiming.title: Expected Timing

discountRateApplied.description: Risk-adjusted disconteringsvoet applied when expected timing > 1 year is material (IAS 37 §45, REQ-PROV-003). Pre-tax rate reflecting current market assessments + risk specific to the liability.
discountRateApplied.title: Discount Rate Applied

discountedValue.description: Present value of bestEstimate after disconteringsvoet (REQ-PROV-003, REQ-PROV-017). Computed via x-openregister-calculations.discountedValue.
discountedValue.title: Discounted Value

linkedAccount.description: FK to balance-sheet account code in bookkeeping-chart-of-accounts (REQ-PROV-016).
linkedAccount.title: Linked Account

status.description: Lifecycle state (REQ-PROV-001 / REQ-PROV-009 / REQ-PROV-010).
status.title: Status

expert.description: External expert (actuary, environmental bureau, legal counsel) consulted (REQ-PROV-006, REQ-PROV-013).
expert.title: Expert

peerReviewer.description: FK to peer-reviewer person (other than recognition author) (REQ-PROV-010, REQ-PROV-018).
peerReviewer.title: Peer Reviewer

cfoApprover.description: FK to CFO / audit-committee approver for material provisions (REQ-PROV-018).
cfoApprover.title: Cfo Approver

cfoApprovalDate.description: Date CFO / audit committee approved the recognition (REQ-PROV-018).
cfoApprovalDate.title: Cfo Approval Date

priorYearBalanceTotal.description: Prior-year balanstotaal in EUR used by the schema validator to apply the 1% materiality test (REQ-PROV-018).
priorYearBalanceTotal.title: Prior Year Balance Total

linkedPensionProvisionDetail.description: FK to the PensioenvoorzieningDetail when provisionType=pensioen (REQ-PROV-014).
linkedPensionProvisionDetail.title: Linked Pensioenvoorziening Detail

linkedAnniversaryProvisionDetail.description: FK to the JubileumvoorzieningDetail when provisionType=jubileum (REQ-PROV-011).
linkedAnniversaryProvisionDetail.title: Linked Jubileumvoorziening Detail

linkedRestructuringProvisionDetail.description: FK to the HerstructureringsvoorzieningDetail when provisionType=herstructurering (REQ-PROV-005).
linkedRestructuringProvisionDetail.title: Linked Herstructureringsvoorziening Detail

linkedGuaranteeProvisionDetail.description: FK to the GarantievoorzieningDetail when provisionType=garantie (REQ-PROV-012).
linkedGuaranteeProvisionDetail.title: Linked Garantievoorziening Detail

linkedEnvironmentProvisionDetail.description: FK to the MilieuvoorzieningDetail when provisionType=milieu (REQ-PROV-013).
linkedEnvironmentProvisionDetail.title: Linked Milieuvoorziening Detail

linkedClaimsProvisionDetail.description: FK to the ClaimsVoorzieningDetail when provisionType=claims (REQ-PROV-006).
linkedClaimsProvisionDetail.title: Linked Claims Voorziening Detail

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

discountedValue.description: Present value of bestEstimate per IAS 37 §45 (REQ-PROV-003). discountedValue = bestEstimate / (1 + discountRateApplied)^yearsToOutflow. Computed only when discountRateApplied > 0; nullable otherwise.
discountedValue.expression: discountRateApplied > 0 ? bestEstimate / pow(1 + discountRateApplied, yearsToOutflow) : null

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable. Provision being recognised; three-criteria and peer review under review.

active.label: Active
active.description: Recognised on balance sheet; movements tracked per period (REQ-PROV-004).

released.label: Released
released.description: Provision fully used or released; no further movements expected.

activate.label: Activate provision
activate.description: Recognise on balance sheet once three criteria + peer review (and CFO sign-off when material) are complete (REQ-PROV-001, REQ-PROV-005, REQ-PROV-006, REQ-PROV-010, REQ-PROV-018).

startHerwaardering.label: Start annual herwaardering
startHerwaardering.description: Open the provision for annual balansdatum herwaardering (REQ-PROV-009).

completeHerwaardering.label: Complete herwaardering
completeHerwaardering.description: Lock the herwaardering; any estimate change recorded prospectively as effectOfChangeInEstimate on the next ProvisionMovement (REQ-PROV-009, REQ-PROV-019).

release.label: Release provision
release.description: Provision fully utilised or released; no further movements expected.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Provision is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

ProvisionDisclosureTabel.title: Provision Disclosure Table
ProvisionDisclosureTabel.description: Auto-generated jaarrekening disclosure table per IAS 37 §85 / RJ 252 §408 (REQ-PROV-008). Aggregates Provision + ProvisionMovement + ContingentLiability records into a single structured record per period per provisionType (header: count + total opening; movement table per Provision; contingent-liability section; materiality narrative > EUR 100K / > 1% balanstotaal; sensitivity narrative from rangeLow / rangeHigh).

count.description: Number of provisions of this type in the period (REQ-PROV-008).
count.title: Count

openingBalance.description: Sum of openingBalance across all ProvisionMovement records of this type (REQ-PROV-008).
openingBalance.title: Opening Balance

additions.description: Sum of additions across all ProvisionMovement records of this type (REQ-PROV-008).
additions.title: Additions

used.description: Sum of usedDuringPeriod across all ProvisionMovement records of this type (REQ-PROV-008).
used.title: Used

released.description: Sum of releasedUnused across all ProvisionMovement records of this type (REQ-PROV-008).
released.title: Released

unwinding.description: Sum of unwindingOfDiscount across all ProvisionMovement records of this type (REQ-PROV-008).
unwinding.title: Unwinding

estimatesChange.description: Sum of effectOfChangeInEstimate across all ProvisionMovement records of this type (REQ-PROV-008, REQ-PROV-019).
estimatesChange.title: Estimates Change

closingBalance.description: Sum of closingBalance across all ProvisionMovement records of this type (REQ-PROV-008).
closingBalance.title: Closing Balance

narrative.description: Materiality + sensitivity narrative for the jaarrekening note (REQ-PROV-002, REQ-PROV-008, REQ-PROV-018).
narrative.example: Garantievoorziening EUR 75K per 31 december 2026, waarvan EUR 45K in 2026 is gebruikt voor reparaties. Sensitivity EUR 80K–150K op basis van 1.0%–2.5% claim-rate variantie.
narrative.title: Narrative

contingentLiabilitySection.description: Narrative covering ContingentLiability disclosures for this type (REQ-PROV-015).
contingentLiabilitySection.title: Contingent Liability Section

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

provisionDisclosureGeneration.description: Declarative shape of the disclosure-table generation (REQ-PROV-008). Joins ProvisionMovement records per provisionType per period, computes the sum buckets and emits one ProvisionDisclosureTabel per (period, provisionType). When the engine cannot template the merge, the same arithmetic is rebuilt from ProvisionMovement + ContingentLiability via the real ObjectService API.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Provision Disclosure Table is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

ProvisionMovement.title: Provision Movement
ProvisionMovement.description: Per-period roll-forward of a single Provision per IAS 37 §84 (REQ-PROV-004, REQ-PROV-016, REQ-PROV-017, REQ-PROV-019). Carries the opening balance, dotation, onttrekking, vrijval, unwinding of discount, effect of change in discount rate, effect of change in estimate, translation differences and the computed closing balance. Once status=closed the record is immutable; corrections are recorded as prospective effectOfChangeInEstimate on the next open period (REQ-PROV-019 / IAS 8). linkedJournalEntries connect every bucket to the GL journal entries that posted it.

period.description: Period identifier in YYYY-MM or YYYY format (REQ-PROV-004).
period.title: Period

openingBalance.description: Carrying amount at the start of the period in EUR (REQ-PROV-004).
openingBalance.title: Opening Balance

additions.description: Dotaties charged to the P&L this period in EUR (REQ-PROV-004).
additions.title: Additions

additionsAcquired.description: Additions acquired via business combination in EUR (IAS 37 §84(b)).
additionsAcquired.title: Additions Acquired

usedDuringPeriod.description: Amount used (paid / settled) during the period in EUR (REQ-PROV-004).
usedDuringPeriod.title: Used During Period

releasedUnused.description: Vrijval — amount released because the obligation no longer exists or has been reduced (REQ-PROV-004).
releasedUnused.title: Released Unused

unwindingOfDiscount.description: Unwinding of discount as rente bijgeboekt in EUR (REQ-PROV-017). unwindingOfDiscount = max(0, priorDiscountedValue * discountRateApplied).
unwindingOfDiscount.title: Unwinding Of Discount

effectOfChangeInDiscountRate.description: P&L / discountedValue effect of changing the disconteringsvoet (REQ-PROV-003).
effectOfChangeInDiscountRate.title: Effect Of Change In Discount Rate

effectOfChangeInEstimate.description: Prospective schattingswijziging per IAS 8 (REQ-PROV-019). Corrections to closed periods are recorded here in the next open period rather than retroactively adjusted.
effectOfChangeInEstimate.title: Effect Of Change In Estimate

translationDifferences.description: FX translation differences for foreign-currency provisions (out of scope of v1, kept for parity with IAS 37 §84(e)).
translationDifferences.title: Translation Differences

closingBalance.description: Carrying amount at the end of the period in EUR (REQ-PROV-004). closingBalance = openingBalance + additions + additionsAcquired - usedDuringPeriod - releasedUnused + unwindingOfDiscount + effectOfChangeInDiscountRate + effectOfChangeInEstimate + translationDifferences.
closingBalance.title: Closing Balance

linkedJournalEntries.description: FKs into the GL journal entries that posted every bucket of this movement (REQ-PROV-016).
linkedJournalEntries.title: Linked Journal Entries

narrative.description: Free-form explanation of the period's mutation (e.g. why effectOfChangeInEstimate is non-zero) (REQ-PROV-019).
narrative.title: Narrative

status.description: Movement lifecycle. Once status=closed the record is immutable per REQ-PROV-004 / REQ-PROV-019.
status.title: Status

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

closingBalance.description: Roll-forward closing balance per IAS 37 §84 (REQ-PROV-004). Sums every movement bucket; immutable once status=closed.
closingBalance.expression: openingBalance + additions + additionsAcquired - usedDuringPeriod - releasedUnused + unwindingOfDiscount + effectOfChangeInDiscountRate + effectOfChangeInEstimate + translationDifferences

open.label: Open
open.description: Editable during the period; buckets accept dotaties, onttrekkingen, vrijvallen, unwinding.

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: Period closed; record is immutable. Corrections recorded as prospective effectOfChangeInEstimate on the next open period (REQ-PROV-019).

close.label: Close period
close.description: Lock the movement once the period close is reconciled to GL (REQ-PROV-004, REQ-PROV-016).

provisionRollForward.description: Declarative roll-forward emitting ProvisionMovement records per Provision per period (REQ-PROV-004). Closing of period N is the opening of period N+1. When the OpenRegister aggregation engine cannot express the prior-period carry, the same arithmetic is recomputed from the prior ProvisionMovement closing balance via the real ObjectService API.

closingBalance.expression: openingBalance + additions + additionsAcquired - usedDuringPeriod - releasedUnused + unwindingOfDiscount + effectOfChangeInDiscountRate + effectOfChangeInEstimate + translationDifferences

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Provision Movement is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

PublicSectorStatement.title: Public Sector Statement
PublicSectorStatement.description: An international public-sector accrual financial statement for one fiscal year of a government or public entity, used by the public-sector rule domain to evaluate the IPSASB IPSAS framework (statement composition, cash-flow classification, inventory lower-of-cost measurement, contingent-liability prohibition, non-cash-generating-asset impairment, non-exchange revenue / tax-on-taxable-event recognition, the budget comparison, consolidation eliminations, short-term employee benefits, financial-instrument recognition and the IPSAS 43 right-of-use lease model) and the US GASB statements (the GASB 34 dual government-wide / fund model and its measurement focuses, MD&A, the major-fund criteria, GASB 54 fund-balance classifications, GASB 84 fiduciary fund types, the GASB 87 single lease model, the GASB 96 SBITA model and the GASB 103 budgetary-comparison RSI). The NL-BBV framework is modelled separately by BbvStatement. Per ADR-022 this is a register object, not an embedded structure.

framework.description: Which international public-sector framework this statement is prepared under: the IPSASB IPSAS accrual framework or the US GASB statements.
framework.title: Framework

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction the framework applies to: 'global' for IPSAS, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (US) for GASB.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

reportingEntity.description: Name of the reporting public-sector entity.
reportingEntity.title: Reporting Entity

fiscalYear.description: The fiscal year the statement covers.
fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency the statement is presented in.
currency.title: Currency

consolidated.description: Whether the statement is a consolidated (group) statement, triggering the IPSAS 35 intragroup-elimination rule.
consolidated.title: Consolidated

budgetMadePublic.description: Whether the entity makes its approved budget publicly available, which under IPSAS 24 requires a budget comparison in the complete set of statements (IPSAS 1.21).
budgetMadePublic.title: Budget Made Public

components.description: The component statements present (IPSAS 1.21): financialPosition, financialPerformance, changesInNetAssets, cashFlow, notes, and budgetComparison where applicable.
components.title: Components

cashFlowActivities.description: The cash-flow activity classes the cash-flow statement reports (IPSAS 2.18): operating, investing, financing.

inventories.title: Inventories

contingentLiabilities.title: Contingent Liabilities

carryingAmount.title: Carrying Amount

revalued.title: Revalued

impairments.title: Impairments

Format follows the Belastingdienst Wet minimumbelasting 2024 filing spec; data is merged from this `qdmtt-return` record + the linked NL-resident `group-entity-registry` record + the per-jurisdiction `pillar2-jurisdiction-computation` for jurisdiction=NL. QuarterlyTaxStatement.title: Quarterly Tax Statement
QuarterlyTaxStatement.description: Read-only computed Vpb quarterly income statement (REQ-VPB-003, REQ-VPB-009). Materialised on demand by OCA\Shillinq\Service\TaxReportService from GLTransaction + GLLine via the real OpenRegister ObjectService API (find/findAll) — never authored by operators. The x-openregister-aggregations block documents the equivalent declarative roll-up: GLLine filtered by administration + fiscal period, grouped by account type and taxTreatment, producing revenue, operating expenses, non-operating items, special deductions and net taxable income, plus an untagged-posting warning count (REQ-VPB-010).

quarterlyTaxStatement.description: Declarative shape of the quarterly Vpb statement TaxReportService computes (REQ-VPB-003, REQ-VPB-009). Filters GLLine by administrationId + periodId, joins Account for accountType, groups by accountType and taxTreatment, sums amounts, and derives netTaxableIncome = revenue - operatingExpenses + nonOperating - specialDeductions. When the aggregation engine cannot express the GLLine→Account join + tax-treatment grouping, TaxReportService computes the same result in PHP via the real ObjectService API.

RealisedFxPosting.title: Realised FX Posting
RealisedFxPosting.description: Append-only audit record per foreign-currency ARInvoice settlement (REQ-MC-010). Carries the settled invoice, the foreign amount, the invoice-date and payment-date rates, the signed realised difference in functional cents, the direction (gain/loss) and the GL account attribution (realised gain/loss account plus AR-control clearing). The realised difference equals foreignAmount x (paymentRate - invoiceRate); a positive value is a gain, negative a loss. Distinct from FxRevaluationPosting which records the UNREALISED period-end mark of open balances.

onBudgetOvershoot._note: This rule has never fired. It carried a field=>value map ({criterium: begroting, kind: error}) — the SCHEDULED path's grammar — on a CREATED trigger. createdFilterMatches() reads a single clause {field, operator, value}, so it looked for a 'field' key, found none, and returned false for every bevinding. It cannot be repaired as-is either: the intent is criterium=begroting AND kind=error, and the created path has no combinator, only one clause. Narrowing to criterium=begroting alone would notify the portefeuillehouder about warnings and uncertainties as well as errors, which is a different rule than REQ-RV-001 asks for. Left disabled and honest rather than half-right, pending combinators on the created path — the created-vs-scheduled convergence deferred by ConductionNL/openregister#2787. DO NOT re-enable without a filter: with none, this matches every Rechtmatigheidsbevinding.

ReconciliationBridge.title: Reconciliation Bridge
ReconciliationBridge.description: The RJ-to-IFRS conversion for one period and metric (equity or net result): opening RJ balance, adjustments per standard, tax effect per jurisdiction and closing IFRS balance (REQ-DGAAP-005, REQ-DGAAP-006). A declarative aggregation over the period's reconciled DualTransactions; each adjustment line is drill-down navigable to its StandardSpecificCalculation and GL entries (REQ-DGAAP-008).

bridgeByPeriodStandard.description: Declarative shape of the reconciliation-bridge roll-up (REQ-DGAAP-005, REQ-DGAAP-006). Groups reconciled DualTransactions by (period, divergenceReasonCode) within an administration and framework pair, sums the divergence amounts per standard into adjustments[], sums temporary vs. permanent differences, and derives closingBalanceIfrs = openingBalanceRj + sum(adjustments). Deferred-tax effect is summed per jurisdiction from each temporary DualTransaction's deferredTaxEffect. When the OpenRegister aggregation engine cannot express the cross-schema join for per-jurisdiction tax effect, the same result is computed from the real ObjectService API (find/findAll).

ReconciliationMatch.title: Reconciliation Match

Confirmed matches emit a `reconciliation-match-confirmed` event consumed by AR/AP invoice lifecycles per REQ-BR-006.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: REQ-AT-001: ReconciliationMatch carries an immutable audit trail per ADR-022. Candidate emission, operator confirm/reject, and downstream invoice transitions append audit events.

RecurringInvoiceProfile.title: Recurring Invoice Profile
RecurringInvoiceProfile.description: A recurring (periodic) billing definition — the template Shillinq uses to generate ordinary ARInvoice records on a schedule (REQ-RIN-001). The customer is a Nextcloud addressbook contact (customerReference), never an invented party schema. Generation produces standard ARInvoice records carrying recurringProfileId + billingPeriod provenance; there is no parallel invoice type. Numbering, per-line BTW and Peppol delivery are owned by bookkeeping-quote-order-invoice (CHAINED); SEPA collection is owned by bookkeeping-sepa-direct-debit (CHAINED).

shillinq-recurring-invoice-generation.name: Recurring invoice generation
shillinq-recurring-invoice-generation.description: Evaluated at least daily by OpenRegister's scheduled machinery. Selects RecurringInvoiceProfile records with status=active AND nextRunDate<=today and asks the RecurringInvoiceGenerator to generate the due period's ordinary ARInvoice (REQ-RIN-002). No app-local TimedJob/cron and no invalid IRegistrationContext::registerJob registration; generation is idempotent on the (profile, billingPeriod) key (REQ-RIN-004).

RenteRisicoNorm.title: Rente-risiconorm
RenteRisicoNorm.description: 4-year rolling interest-rate herfinanciering + rate-reset exposure ceiling per Wet Fido (REQ-FDO-003). Ceiling = 20% × uitstaande vaste schuld per 1 januari. The forward-looking 4-year per-year exposure is projected declaratively (renteRisico4YearProjection) from recorded Leningen with repayment schedules and floating-rate reset dates; a new lening whose forward exposure would breach 20% in any of the next four years is refused (or recorded with an override, REQ-FDO-008).

renteRisico4YearProjection.description: Declarative shape of the 4-year forward rente-risiconorm projection (REQ-FDO-003). Reads recorded Leningen with repaymentSchedule and floating-rate renteherzieningsmoment, projects per-year herfinanciering (maturing principal) + rate-reset volume for the next four years, sets forwardLooking4Year and derives headroomPerYear = ceiling − exposure per year. Recomputed on every lening-entry and floating-rate reset-event. When the engine cannot express the forward arithmetic, the same result is computed from the real ObjectService API (find/findAll) over recorded Leningen.

Requisition.title: Purchase Requisition
Requisition.description: Internal purchase requisition (aanvraag) raised by an employee before a PurchaseOrder exists (REQ-REQ-001). Lifecycle draft -> submitted -> approved|rejected -> converted. Approval reuses BudgetBlocker (budget availability + override-mandate) and MandateEnforcer (mandate resolution) from bookkeeping-verplichtingenadministratie via a shared field contract (programma/boekjaar/totaalbedrag_excl_btw/soort) — no parallel approval engine is built. An approved Requisition converts to a PurchaseOrder via RequisitionConversionService, which reuses PurchaseOrderService::createPurchaseOrder() unmodified.

reject.description: Reject the requisition; rejectionReason MUST be recorded (enforced by RequisitionService::rejectRequisition, REQ-REQ-004).

convertToPO.label: Omzetten naar inkooporder
convertToPO.description: Materialise a PurchaseOrder from the approved requisition via RequisitionConversionService::convertToPurchaseOrder(), which reuses PurchaseOrderService::createPurchaseOrder() unmodified (REQ-REQ-005). Guarded by RequisitionConversionGuard::canConvert (status must be 'approved'); the actual PO creation is imperative (creates a new cross-schema record and writes back its id) and is performed by the service, mirroring how PurchaseOrderService::blockSendUntilApproved() itself mutates lifecycleState outside the generic transition engine.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create/update/lifecycle transition of a Requisition (submit/approve/reject/convertToPO) is logged to OR's immutable audit trail, including actor + timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

Resource.title: Resource

RetainedEarnings.title: Retained Earnings
RetainedEarnings.description: Tracks the retained-earnings sub-ledger position per fiscal year per REQ-YEC-002: opening balance, net income for the period, distributions paid, and closing balance. Materialised via the FiscalYear close lifecycle (retained-earnings transfer JournalEntry) and linked to its driving ClosingEntry. Sub-ledger view onto the equity-side retained-earnings GL account. All amounts in integer cents (money-safe).

retainedEarningsId.description: Operator-stable identifier for this retained-earnings record. Per REQ-YEC-002.
retainedEarningsId.title: Retained Earnings ID

fiscalYearId.title: Fiscal Year ID

openingBalanceCents.description: Retained earnings at the start of the fiscal year in integer cents (signed; negative values represent accumulated deficit). Equals prior FY closingBalanceCents per REQ-YEC-002 rollforward.
openingBalanceCents.title: Opening Balance Cents

netIncomeCents.description: Net income for the fiscal year (revenue minus expenses) in integer cents (signed; negative = net loss). Calculated as the income-summary closing balance after revenue and expense closing entries are posted. Per REQ-YEC-002.
netIncomeCents.title: Net Income Cents

distributionsCents.description: Dividends or distributions paid out during the fiscal year in integer cents (non-negative). Deducted from net income for closing-balance calculation. Per REQ-YEC-002.
distributionsCents.title: Distributions Cents

closingBalanceCents.description: Retained earnings at the end of the fiscal year in integer cents (signed). Computed as openingBalanceCents + netIncomeCents - distributionsCents per REQ-YEC-002.
closingBalanceCents.title: Closing Balance Cents

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the retained-earnings balances.
currency.title: Currency

closingEntryId.description: Reference to the ClosingEntry that materialised the retained-earnings transfer for this FY. Set when the FY close lifecycle posts the entry per REQ-YEC-002 / REQ-YEC-009.
closingEntryId.title: Closing Entry ID

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this retained-earnings record. Composite uniqueness with fiscalYearId per D5.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

validateRollforward.description: Validate the retained-earnings rollforward identity per REQ-YEC-002: closingBalanceCents == openingBalanceCents + netIncomeCents - (distributionsCents OR 0). Evaluated by the FiscalYear in-progress -> closed transition before the period locks.

validateCarryforward.description: Validate that this FY's openingBalanceCents equals the prior FY's closingBalanceCents (within rounding tolerance) per REQ-YEC-008.

RetainerDrawdown.title: Retainer Drawdown
RetainerDrawdown.description: Immutable per-time-entry consumption record against a RetainerPool. Created automatically by the TimeEntry create lifecycle hook (REQ-RETN-002, Design D2). drawdownAmount = hoursOrAmount × drawdownRate where drawdownRate is the pool's retainerRate at materialization time — NOT the timesheet's billable rate (Design D2 + REQ-RETN-002). Once status=materialized, the record is read-only; reversal/adjustment creates a new record linking back via reversalOfDrawdownId.

RetainerPool.title: Retainer Pool
RetainerPool.description: A monthly retainer allocation per client (and optional project) with an effective-period window, a fixed pool amount in the pool currency, a per-hour or per-day retainer rate used to convert time-entry hours into drawdown amount, and a rollover policy (carryover cap in amount or hours, or reset-balance for monthly reset). One pool per (clientId, projectId, period) combination; overlapping periods for the same (client, project) pair MUST be rejected (REQ-RETN-001). Operator-driven lifecycle draft → active → closed → archived; once closed, pool amount/rate/policy are immutable so the true-up calculation remains deterministic (Design D6).

retention.description: Retainer pools (commercial agreements + billing audit trail) 7 jaar bewaren (Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen art. 52).

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Operator can edit pool amount, rate, period, and policy.

active.label: Actief
active.description: Time entries within the period materialise drawdowns; balance queries are live.

closed.label: Afgesloten
closed.description: Period has elapsed and the period-end true-up has been generated; pool fields are immutable.

archived.label: Gearchiveerd
archived.description: Read-only audit trail; no further mutations.

activate.label: Activeren
activate.description: Activate the pool so drawdowns can be recorded (REQ-RETN-001).

close.label: Afsluiten

archive.label: Archiveren
archive.description: Move pool to read-only audit state after settlement (REQ-RETN-010).

drawdownsByPool.description: Declarative shape of the drawdown-balance aggregation (REQ-RETN-003). Sums RetainerDrawdown.drawdownAmount for this pool where drawdownDate <= as-of-date and status in (materialized, adjusted). The available-balance UI computes poolAmount - drawnAmount + sum(RetainerRollover.carryoverAmount where targetPeriodPoolId=@self.id).

trueUpsByPool.description: Declarative count of period-end true-ups attached to this pool (REQ-RETN-006). Used by the detail view to prevent duplicate true-up creation per REQ-RETN-007.

nonOverlappingPeriod.description: Per REQ-RETN-001, two active/closed RetainerPool records for the same (clientId, projectId) pair MUST NOT have overlapping [periodStart, periodEnd] windows. The precondition validates on transition draft→active. Error message: 'Retainer pool exists for {client} in period {start}..{end}; overlapping periods not allowed'.

Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

RetainerRollover.title: Retainer Rollover
RetainerRollover.description: Immutable carryover record between consecutive RetainerPools for the same (clientId, projectId) pair (REQ-RETN-004, REQ-RETN-009). On pool close (lifecycle.close), a RetainerRollover is created capturing the unused balance, the cap that was applied (if any), and whether reset-balance forced carryover to zero. Adjustments MUST create a new record (status=adjusted) referencing the original via adjustsRolloverId; original record is never mutated (Design D6).

RetainerTrueUp.title: Retainer True-Up
RetainerTrueUp.description: Period-end reconciliation record per RetainerPool (REQ-RETN-006, Design D5). Auto-created by the period-close lifecycle hook (RetainerPool.transitions.close) or by manual operator trigger (REQ-RETN-007). Captures actualDrawdown vs. poolAmount, the resolved overage rate via rate-card-engine (REQ-RETN-005), and the resulting overageInvoiceAmount destined for adjustment-invoice generation (REQ-RETN-008). Operator-driven lifecycle generated → pending-approval → approved → invoiced → settled, with reversed as an out-of-band correction state (REQ-RETN-007). Approvals require the retainer:approve-true-up permission per ADR-023 (REQ-RETN-011).

RevenueRecognitionEvent.title: Revenue Recognition Event
RevenueRecognitionEvent.description: Evidence that a performance obligation moved toward satisfaction in a period (REQ-IFRS15-005, REQ-IFRS15-007). Records the recognised amount, the basis (units delivered, % complete, milestone), and the supporting evidence (delivery note, timesheet, sign-off). Posting a RevenueRecognitionEvent materialises exactly one balanced GLTransaction (debit accrued-revenue / credit revenue) via the T1 materialisation extension, linked by glTransactionId.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: IFRS 15 revenue-recognition records MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — every change feeds the IFRS 15.116-119 contract-balance reconciliation, the IFRS 15.120 RPO disclosure, and the variable-consideration constraint trail that auditors review per IFRS 15.123-126 significant-judgements disclosure.

recognitionGlPosting.description: Posting a RevenueRecognitionEvent materialises exactly one balanced GLTransaction via the T1 materialisation extension (REQ-IFRS15-007): debit the accrued-revenue control account and credit the revenue account for recognisedAmount. RevenueCutoffService is the engine-side writer when the declarative materialisation engine cannot resolve the cross-schema control-account lookup; it writes through the real OpenRegister ObjectService saveObject API and stores the resulting GLTransaction id back onto glTransactionId.

RevenueWaterfall.title: Revenue Waterfall
RevenueWaterfall.description: Read-only per-contract, per-period time series of the transaction price flowing into recognised revenue (IFRS 15.120 remaining-performance-obligation disclosure, REQ-IFRS15-008). Stores allocated price, prior cumulative, period recognised, cumulative recognised, remaining amount, remaining months, and the deferred-liability / accrual-asset split. Aggregatable by customer, segment, and consolidated; forecast forward 60+ months. Derived nightly after the cut-off; never authored by operators.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: IFRS 15 revenue-recognition records MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — every change feeds the IFRS 15.116-119 contract-balance reconciliation, the IFRS 15.120 RPO disclosure, and the variable-consideration constraint trail that auditors review per IFRS 15.123-126 significant-judgements disclosure.

revenueWaterfallByContractPeriod.description: Declarative shape of the per-contract, per-period revenue roll-up RevenueCutoffService computes (REQ-IFRS15-008). Groups RevenueRecognitionEvent by (contractId, period) within an administration, sums recognisedAmount into periodRecognised, carries priorCumulativeRecognised from the prior period, derives cumulativeRecognised = priorCumulativeRecognised + periodRecognised and remainingAmount = transactionPriceAllocated - cumulativeRecognised, and forecasts the remaining amount forward over remainingMonths (60+, IFRS 15.120). contractGroupId enables group-level rollup for combination-of-contracts (REQ-IFRS15-011). When the OpenRegister aggregation engine cannot express the prior-period carry or the forward forecast, RevenueCutoffService computes the same result in PHP via the real ObjectService API.

Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

ReviewWorkflow.title: Review Workflow
ReviewWorkflow.description: Accountant-review workflow for a jaarrekening (REQ-T9-007). A strict linear progression (design D6): concept -> in-review -> vastgesteld -> gedeponeerd, with per-step assignee, status and an immutable comment/handover log. During in-review the bestuur cannot edit source data without cancelling (enforced via AnnualReportGuard). The accountantsverklaring attaches at the in-review -> vastgesteld boundary.

Declares applicable entity types, regulatory deadline, mandatory fields, and the Belastingdienst / DNB submission contract (endpoint URL + authentication scheme). Carries the declarative draft -> validated -> submitted -> approved / rejected lifecycle per REQ-SBR-005. T3 declares the contract; T4 implements outbound submission via openconnector Digipoort source slug.

unmappedAccountCount.description: Count of active Account records that lack an XBRLMapping entry for @self.taxonomyVersion (REQ-SBR-006 mapping coverage + REQ-SBR-007).

daysUntilFilingDeadline.description: Whole days remaining until the regulatory filing deadline. Negative once the deadline has passed, and null when filingDeadline is not set — which flows through to deadlineApproaching resolving false rather than guessing a reference date.

deadlineApproaching.description: True when the filing is still open (not submitted, not approved) and its deadline falls within the next 30 days (REQ-SBR-008). Materialised so the filingDeadlineApproaching scheduled notification can filter on it, and re-evaluated daily without an object write by OpenRegister's temporal calculation sweep (daysUntilFilingDeadline references `now`, which flags this schema as temporal). This is the declarative replacement for the legacy rule's `schedule.fireAt = filingDeadline - P30D` / `skipIf status in [submitted, approved]` pair.

filingDeadlineApproaching.description: Notify operators 30 days before the regulatory filing deadline per REQ-SBR-008. The scheduled trigger re-checks daily; the filter is the 30-day window plus the skip condition — a filing already submitted or approved has left the draft status and is therefore no longer matched.

SchatkistbankierenSaldo.description: Daily cash-park position to the Agentschap van de Generale Thesaurie (AGT) with drempelbedrag automation (REQ-FDO-005). drempelbedrag = max(0.75% × begrotingstotaal, €1,000,000) capped at €1bn (computed declaratively). When the rekening-courant saldo exceeds the drempelbedrag for the third consecutive banking day, the daily sweep job parks the excess to AGT; the sweep is idempotent.
