StockMove.title: Stock Move
StockMove.description: Immutable double-entry stock-movement ledger entry (Odoo / Tryton Stock Move pattern). One StockMove atomically debits source location and credits destination location for a single (item + quantity + unit cost) tuple. Movement type taxonomy: receipt (null source = goods inbound), transfer (both locations populated = lateral move), issue (null destination = goods outbound), manufacture (assembly), repack (consolidation). Lifecycle draft → posted → cancelled; posting flips `locked = true` and triggers GL materialisation (asset / COGS) via x-openregister-lifecycle-action. Cancellation creates an offsetting StockMove (not patch) so the original posted row remains immutable per IAS 2 + Dutch CTR. No PHP StockMoveService — the lifecycle, GL materialisation and audit trail are declarative per ADR-031 (ADR-031 exception path: StockReservationGuard + StockMoveImmutabilityGuard + StockMoveOffsetCreator for the optimistic-lock CAS, the locked-after-post guard, and the offset-row materialisation that the declarative DSL cannot yet express). Reserved quantity is held against InventoryStock.reservedQuantity on draft and released on post or cancel.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Operator is composing the move. Quantity reserved against source InventoryStock.reservedQuantity. Editable; no GL posting; no immutability lock.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Immutable. locked=true; postedAt set; InventoryStock.quantity updated at source (debit) and destination (credit); GL transaction materialised when movementType is receipt / issue / manufacture. Subsequent edits are rejected with HTTP 409 — cancellation creates an offsetting move.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: Terminal. cancelledAt set; reservation released. From draft: no offset row needed (no posting happened). From posted: StockMoveOffsetCreator emits a balanced offsetting StockMove with swapped source/destination, movementReason='cancellation', notes referencing the original, offsetOfMoveId set.

post.label: Post move
post.description: Commit the draft. Releases reservation; updates InventoryStock.quantity on both sides; materialises a balanced GLTransaction for receipt / issue / manufacture per REQ-SM-006. Locked thereafter.

actions.description: Stamp postedAt and locked=true on transition per REQ-SM-003.

Release reservedQuantity and decrement source / increment destination InventoryStock.quantity per REQ-SM-004 + REQ-SM-005. CAS optimistic-lock on InventoryStock.version; collision surfaces to operator with retry message.

REQ-SM-006: receipt debits Inventory Asset / credits Goods-in-Transit; issue debits COGS / credits Inventory Asset; manufacture debits Finished Goods / credits Raw Materials. transfer and repack are lateral (no GL). Amount per line = quantity * unitCost, currency = administration base. GL lines carry subLedgerType='inventory', subLedgerRef=<StockMove.id>.

cancel.label: Cancel move
cancel.description: From draft: release reservation, mark cancelled, no offset row. From posted: emit an offsetting StockMove (StockMoveOffsetCreator) that reverses the on-hand effect with swapped source/destination, then reverse the original GLTransaction per REQ-SM-003 + REQ-SM-006. The original posted row is NOT patched — immutability preserved.

actions.description: Stamp cancelledAt and force movementReason='cancellation' on the cancellation transition per REQ-SM-007.
Draft-cancel path (REQ-SM-004): only the reservation needs releasing; no on-hand change since posting never happened.

Posted-cancel path (REQ-SM-003): emit a balanced offsetting StockMove with sourceLocationId / destinationLocationId swapped, quantity preserved, movementReason='cancellation', notes='Offset for <original.movementNumber>', offsetOfMoveId=<original.id>. The original posted row stays immutable; the offset is itself posted (locked) so the InventoryStock.quantity nets to zero and the GLTransaction is reversed by the same materialise-gl-transaction rule applied to the offset.

receiptHasNoSource.condition: movementType == 'receipt' AND sourceLocationId IS NOT NULL

issueHasNoDestination.condition: movementType == 'issue' AND destinationLocationId IS NOT NULL

transferHasBothLocations.condition: movementType IN ('transfer', 'manufacture', 'repack') AND (sourceLocationId IS NULL OR destinationLocationId IS NULL)
transferHasBothLocations.message: Transfer / manufacture / repack movements require both sourceLocationId and destinationLocationId.
transferHasBothLocations.messageNl: Overdracht / productie / herverpakking vereisen zowel een bron- als bestemmingslocatie.

sourceDifferentFromDestination.condition: sourceLocationId IS NOT NULL AND destinationLocationId IS NOT NULL AND sourceLocationId == destinationLocationId
sourceDifferentFromDestination.message: Source and destination locations must differ.

lockedRejectsEdits.condition: @current.locked == true AND (CHANGED(quantity) OR CHANGED(unitCost) OR CHANGED(sourceLocationId) OR CHANGED(destinationLocationId) OR CHANGED(movementType) OR CHANGED(itemId))
lockedRejectsEdits.message: Move is locked; cancellation creates offset.
lockedRejectsEdits.messageNl: Boeking is vergrendeld; annuleren maakt een tegenboeking aan.

netQuantityForLocation.description: Stock-ledger reconciliation per REQ-SM-005: InventoryStock.quantity = initialStock + SUM(destination posted moves) - SUM(source posted moves). Excludes cancelled rows.
netQuantityForLocation.expression: SUM(quantity WHERE destinationLocationId = @location AND itemId = @item) - SUM(quantity WHERE sourceLocationId = @location AND itemId = @item)
netQuantityForLocation.description_long: Powers the Stock Ledger drill-down view and the InventoryStock reconciliation check.

reservedQuantityForLocation.description: Reserved-stock visibility per REQ-SM-009: SUM(draft moves whose source is this location for this item). Powers the Reserved Stock index and the Available = quantity - reservedQty breakdown on the InventoryStock detail.

movesByType.description: Stock Movements index filter aggregation per REQ-SM-008: count of moves per movementType for the dashboard tile.

Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

SvcReceipt.title: Service Receipt (Prestatieverklaring)
SvcReceipt.description: Service-entry-sheet confirming delivery of a contracted service against one or more purchase orders (REQ-PO3W-011). Symmetric to GoodsReceiptNote for the goods case. Lifecycle draft -> confirmed -> accepted / rejected; no quality-check step (services have nothing to physically inspect). Supports partial/periodic confirmation via periodStart/periodEnd (e.g. one SvcReceipt per month for a 12-month contract). cost_center + project_code propagate from the originating PO(s).

TaxEstimate.title: Tax Estimate
TaxEstimate.description: Real-time annual income tax (IB) liability projection for Dutch ZZP freelancers. Materialized view consuming GL year-to-date snapshot and TaxRegimeConfiguration per REQ-TAX-004 and ADR-031 D3. Computed on read or scheduled refresh; records calculation inputs for audit trail per D5.

current.label: Current
current.description: Most recent annual tax liability estimate for this administration and fiscal year.

superseded.label: Superseded
superseded.description: An updated estimate has been computed. Record retained for audit trail and liability delta comparison per REQ-TAX-004.

supersede.label: Supersede estimate
supersede.description: Triggered when a new TaxEstimate is computed for the same administrationId + fiscalYear.

onGlLinePosted.description: When a GLLine posts, amends, or reverses for an income/expense account, the current TaxEstimate for (administrationId, fiscalYear) is transitioned to 'superseded' and a new estimate is computed. Implements REQ-TAX-007 and REQ-TAX-012 recalculation trigger. Idempotency: only one estimate per (administrationId, fiscalYear, snapshotDate) remains 'current'.

ytdByCategory.description: YTD income and expense totals per administrationId and fiscalYear through snapshotDate. Drives TaxEstimate materialized-view computation: YTD sums from TaxSummaryReport grouped by income vs expense categories, then projected to annual using months-elapsed formula per REQ-TAX-008.

currentEstimateByYear.description: Most recent current TaxEstimate per administrationId and fiscalYear. Surfaced as 'Estimated annual liability' KPI on Tax Filing Prep dashboard per REQ-TAX-006.

TaxPaymentTracking.description: A recorded Vpb payment (provisional, final, or adjustment) linked to a GL account by accountNumber (REQ-VPB-002). Operator-authored; CRUD via OpenRegister's generic object API.

TenderNedProcurement.title: TenderNed Aanbesteding
TenderNedProcurement.description: A procurement tender imported from TenderNed (Logius central procurement platform). Wraps the public dossier metadata (REQ-001) and links to the materialised Shillinq Commitment. Both the aanbestedende dienst (public buyer) and the inschrijvende leverancier (winning vendor) consume this schema, with role-based visibility filtering (design D6).

tenderId.description: TenderNed identifier of the tender dossier — unique per administration (REQ-001).

tenderNedUrl.description: Deeplink to the public TenderNed dossier for drill-through verantwoording (REQ-007).
tenderNedUrl.title: Tender Ned URL

cpvCodes.description: Common Procurement Vocabulary (CPV 2008) classification codes, stored as-is without reclassification (design D7).

administrationId.title: Administration ID

beeindigen.label: Beëindigen

divergenceDetails.description: Per-field divergence breakdown (price, quantity, date) used by the exception workflow (REQ-MATCH-003).

rejectedPoLineIds.title: Rejected PO Line Ids

TimeIntakeBatch.title: Time Intake Batch
TimeIntakeBatch.description: Idempotency ledger for the billing-intake ingress adapter (ADR-031 external-integration exception). One row per accepted (administrationId, batchId) tuple; records what happened to the batch (received -> invoiced/failed), not a business-object lifecycle. Re-POSTing the same batchId with an identical payload short-circuits to the stored invoiceId (duplicated:true); a different payload under the same batchId is a 409 conflict, detected via payloadHash.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration this batch was ingested into (server-resolved from the session, never client-supplied — ADR-005).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

batchId.description: Idempotency key supplied by the caller. Unique per administration.
batchId.title: Batch ID

sourceApp.description: The Conduction app that emitted this batch.
sourceApp.title: Source App

organisationRef.description: The shillinq customer/organisation id (FK to CustomerMaster.customerId) this batch is billed against.
organisationRef.title: Organisation Ref

projectId.description: Optional FK to Project — the batch's projectRef, if supplied.
projectId.title: Project ID

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the batch (EUR only for this slice).
currency.title: Currency

periodStart.description: Start of the covered time-entry period.
periodStart.title: Period Start

periodEnd.description: End of the covered time-entry period.
periodEnd.title: Period End

entryCount.description: Number of time entries accepted from this batch (== BillableInvoiceLine rows on the resulting invoice).
entryCount.title: Entry Count

status.description: Ingress ledger state, not a business-object lifecycle (design.md). 'invoiced' once draftInvoice() has succeeded and this row is persisted.
status.title: Status

invoiceId.title: Invoice ID

receivedAt.title: Received At

payloadHash.description: sha256 of the normalised request payload (organisationRef, billingModel, currency, period, entries[]), computed at ingest time. Used to distinguish an identical replay (duplicated:true) from a batchId reused with a materially different payload (409 conflict, REQ per 'Idempotent intake by batch id').
payloadHash.title: Payload Hash

TimelineDeadLetter.title: Timeline Dead-Letter Entry
TimelineDeadLetter.description: Terminal parking lot for timeline events that exhausted their async-retry budget (retryCount > maxRetries on TimelinePublishRetryEntry). Populated by PipelinqTimelineRetryJob, listed by the TimelineDeadLetterController admin view, and re-queued via the controller's `retry` action which copies the entry back into TimelinePublishRetryEntry (retryCount reset to 0, fresh nextRetryAt). lastError captures the final failure reason recorded by the retry job. dispatchedAt is set when an admin manually re-queues — supports the audit trail of admin intervention without deleting the dead-letter row immediately (kept for post-mortem).

externalId.description: Booking externalId (UUID) the dead event references.
externalId.title: External ID

contactId.description: Linked pipelinq Contact id from the original event.
contactId.title: Contact ID

timestampIso.description: Original event timestamp in ISO-8601 UTC — preserved so a manual re-queue rebuilds an identical timeline entry (idempotent deduplication downstream).
timestampIso.title: Timestamp ISO

retryCount.description: Final retry count reached before the entry was dead-lettered (typically maxRetries).
retryCount.title: Retry Count

lastError.description: Most recent failure reason captured before dead-lettering (safe-to-log; never the bearer token).
lastError.title: Last Error

failedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the entry was moved to the dead-letter queue.
failedAt.title: Failed At

dispatchedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp an admin manually re-queued this entry. NULL until the operator triggers the retry action; once set, the entry SHOULD be considered handled (downstream audit pulls it as a closed case).
dispatchedAt.title: Dispatched At

TimelinePublishRetryEntry.title: Timeline Publish Retry Entry
TimelinePublishRetryEntry.description: Persisted async-retry record for a single timeline event whose synchronous publish failed (slice 07/08 → slice 09). Owned by PersistentTimelineRetryQueue: created on enqueue, mutated on each retry tick by PipelinqTimelineRetryJob (retryCount++, nextRetryAt advances per exponential backoff 1m / 5m / 30m), deleted on success. Moves to TimelineDeadLetter once retryCount exceeds maxRetries. Payload mirrors the TimelineEventDto fields the publish call needs to be reconstructed exactly (type, externalId, contactId, timestampIso, metadata) so the retry job can re-issue the identical POST /api/v1/timeline call. lastError captures the most recent failure reason (for operator triage) and lastAttemptAt the most recent run timestamp.

type.description: Timeline event type (e.g. booking.created, booking.confirmed). Mirrors TimelineEventDto::type().
type.title: Type

externalId.description: Booking externalId (UUID) the event references. Mirrors TimelineEventDto::externalId().
externalId.title: External ID

contactId.description: Linked pipelinq Contact id. Mirrors TimelineEventDto::contactId().
contactId.title: Contact ID

timestampIso.description: Original event timestamp in ISO-8601 UTC. Re-rendered as the timestamp field of the retried payload so deduplication downstream is stable (cloud-event id is type:externalId:timestamp).
timestampIso.title: Timestamp ISO

metadata.description: Caller-supplied event metadata (scalar fields). Never contains secrets per ADR-005.
metadata.title: Metadata

retryCount.description: Number of retry attempts performed so far. 0 on first enqueue, incremented on every PipelinqTimelineRetryJob tick that fails.
retryCount.title: Retry Count

maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts before the entry moves to TimelineDeadLetter. Defaults to 3 (D3 in the giant).
maxRetries.title: Max Retries

nextRetryAt.description: Earliest ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the retry job may attempt this entry again. Initialised to now() on enqueue, then advanced per exponential backoff (now + 1m / 5m / 30m) on each failed retry.
nextRetryAt.title: Next Retry At

lastError.description: Most recent failure reason (safe-to-log: transport / breaker_open / publish_failed / max_retries_exhausted). Captured by PipelinqTimelineRetryJob for operator triage; never carries the bearer token (ADR-005).
lastError.title: Last Error

lastAttemptAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent retry job tick that touched this entry. NULL until the job runs at least once.
lastAttemptAt.title: Last Attempt At

ToleranceMatrix.title: Tolerantiematrix
ToleranceMatrix.description: Per-programma / per-taakveld / per-SiSa-regeling BADO tolerance ceilings (REQ-002). Defaults from BADO statutory maxima (1% approval, 3% qualification on getrouwheid + rechtmatigheid, 3% onzekerheden); a protocol may tighten but never loosen. Ceiling validation enforced by BadoControleprotocolService::validateCeilings.

faithfulnessApprovalCeiling.description: Getrouwheid approval ceiling as percent of materialiteit; statutory max 1%.
faithfulnessApprovalCeiling.title: Getrouwheid Approval Ceiling

faithfulnessQualificationCeiling.description: Getrouwheid qualification ceiling; statutory max 3% (BADO art. 5 lid 2).
faithfulnessQualificationCeiling.title: Getrouwheid Qualification Ceiling

lawfulnessQualificationCeiling.description: Rechtmatigheid qualification ceiling; statutory max 3% (BADO art. 5 lid 2).
lawfulnessQualificationCeiling.title: Rechtmatigheid Qualification Ceiling

methodologyNote.description: Auditor notes on methodology / risk-based tightening.
methodologyNote.title: Methodology Note

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Tolerantiematrix is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on ToleranceProfile with actor, timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-AT-001..AT-002. Retention is governed by OR per REQ-AT-005 (no shillinq cleanup job).

currencyRoundingTolerance.title: Currency Rounding Tolerance

exceptionRouting.title: Exception Routing

Leaving this empty falls back to app config gr_ir_clearing_account (default 2910).
grIrClearingAccount.title: Gr Ir Clearing Account

TransactionPrice.title: Transaction Price
TransactionPrice.description: The decomposed transaction price of a contract (IFRS 15.46-72, REQ-IFRS15-002). Splits the price into fixed consideration, estimated variable consideration (with estimation method and the IFRS 15.56 constraint), significant-financing-component adjustment (payment timing > 12 months), non-cash consideration at fair value, and consideration payable to the customer (a price reduction). Total = fixed + min(variable, constraint) + financing + nonCash - payableToCustomer.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: IFRS 15 revenue-recognition records MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — every change feeds the IFRS 15.116-119 contract-balance reconciliation, the IFRS 15.120 RPO disclosure, and the variable-consideration constraint trail that auditors review per IFRS 15.123-126 significant-judgements disclosure.

variableConsideration.description: Unconstrained estimate for rebates, discounts, bonuses, refunds (REQ-IFRS15-002).
variableConsideration.title: Variable Consideration

estimationMethod.description: Method of estimating variable consideration (IFRS 15.53): expected value or most-likely amount (REQ-IFRS15-003).
estimationMethod.title: Estimation Method

constraintAmount.description: Variable consideration limited to the amount highly probable not to reverse (IFRS 15.56, REQ-IFRS15-003). The constrained amount, not the raw estimate, enters the total.
constraintAmount.title: Constraint Amount

constraintReason.description: Documented justification for the constraint level (market volatility, return rates, etc.), auditable in the disclosure pack (REQ-IFRS15-003).
constraintReason.title: Constraint Reason

significantFinancingComponent.description: Adjustment for the time value of money when payment timing exceeds 12 months (IFRS 15.60-62, REQ-IFRS15-002).
significantFinancingComponent.title: Significant Financing Component

nonCashConsideration.description: Fair value of non-cash consideration (equity, goods, future discounts) (IFRS 15.66-69).
nonCashConsideration.title: Non Cash Consideration

considerationPayableToCustomer.description: Amounts payable to the customer, treated as a reduction of the transaction price (IFRS 15.70-72, REQ-IFRS15-002).
considerationPayableToCustomer.title: Consideration Payable To Customer

activate.label: Activate
activate.description: Multi-criteria compliance check evaluates all active BankingRule criteria scoped to the account's administration (REQ-SCHATKIST-005). All rules must pass; any failure blocks the transition and is recorded as a compliance audit event per REQ-SCHATKIST-008.

preconditions.description: Multi-criteria compliance precondition (REQ-SCHATKIST-005): every BankingRule where isActive=true AND administrationId=@self.administrationId MUST evaluate to PASS for this account. Engine MUST evaluate every applicable rule (no short-circuit) and persist per-rule results onto the resulting ComplianceReport.criteriaResults; if ANY rule fails the transition is blocked.

rules.check: no other TreasuryAccount in administrationId has the same iban when BankingRule.evaluationCriteria.checkDuplicates=true

preconditions.fallback: If the engine cannot evaluate multi-criteria preconditions declaratively, ADR-031 exception path applies: OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\ComplianceValidator::isCompliant($accountId, $rules) is called by the lifecycle engine.

sideEffects.description: On successful activation a ComplianceReport with status=draft is generated capturing per-rule pass/fail and the weighted complianceScore.

monitor.label: Begin Monitoring

suspend.label: Suspend

suspendFromMonitored.label: Suspend (from monitored)
suspendFromMonitored.description: Suspension can also occur during the monitored phase when a periodic compliance check fails.

reactivate.label: Re-activate
reactivate.description: Operator remediated the failure; all active BankingRule criteria must pass again (REQ-SCHATKIST-004).

preconditions.description: Re-activation MUST re-evaluate every active BankingRule for this administration; all rules must pass before the account returns to active.

Encodes the signing-mandate matrix (role × amount × instrument), permitted instruments and counterparty allowlist within the Wet Fido envelope. TrialBalanceLine.title: Trial Balance Line
TrialBalanceLine.description: Read-only per-account, per-period trial-balance row: opening balance (prior-period close), period debit/credit movements, and the computed closing balance for one general-ledger account (REQ-TB-001). Computed on demand by TrialBalanceService from GLTransaction + GLLine + Account; never authored directly by operators (REQ-TB-007).

trialBalanceByAccountPeriod.description: Declarative shape of the per-account period roll-up TrialBalanceService computes (REQ-TB-001, REQ-TB-018). Groups GLLine by (periodId, accountNumber) within an administration, sums debit and credit movements, joins Account for name/type/parent, and derives closingBalance = openingBalance + (debitMovement - creditMovement). openingBalance is carried from the prior period's closingBalance (REQ-TB-002). When the OpenRegister aggregation engine cannot express the prior-period carry + cross-schema join, TrialBalanceService computes the same result in PHP from the real ObjectService API.

UrenDagregistratie.title: Uren dagregistratie
UrenDagregistratie.description: Dagelijkse fiscaal-gecategoriseerde uren-ledger voor het urencriterium (REQ-URC-001). Apart van — en gevoed door — de billable UrenRegistratie (time-tracking) uit bookkeeping-time-tracking: time-tracking-uren stromen in als BILLABLE_KLANTWERK, niet-billable overhead (acquisitie, administratie, scholing, reistijd) wordt handmatig of agenda-afgeleid geregistreerd. De reistijd-cap (max 4 uur/dag, REQ-URC-001) en backfill-regels (REQ-URC-017) worden afgedwongen door UrenDagregistratieGuard (ADR-031). Naamkeuze UrenDagregistratie vermijdt botsing met de bestaande monolith-schema UrenRegistratie (ADR-037).

Replaces the former imperative string min/max formula. JSON-AST: round((@aggregate.billable / max(1, @aggregate.available)) * 100, 1).

UrencriteriumYear.title: Urencriterium jaar
UrencriteriumYear.description: Per-onderneming, per-kalenderjaar rolling dashboard van het urencriterium (art. 3.6 Wet IB 2001). Houdt de doel-norm (1.225 of 800 uur), de lopende tally, de prognose tot einde jaar, de drempel-status (OP_KOERS/RISICO/KRITIEK) en het grotendeels-criterium bij. De doel-norm wordt automatisch bepaald op basis van het ondernemingsprofiel (REQ-URC-000). Save-precondition UrencriteriumYearGuard valideert norm-grondslag-consistentie en drempel-status (ADR-031 uitzonderingspad). Per onderneming één record per kalenderjaar (REQ-URC-014).

UsageRatePlan.title: Usage Rate Plan
UsageRatePlan.description: Price book for consumption-based billing (REQ-UMB-001). A plan rates a metered resource either `flat` (quantity x unitPriceCents) or `graduated` (the quantity is split across ascending tiers, each slice priced at its tier unitPriceCents; the final tier's upTo is null and catches all remaining volume). Declares the VAT rate and revenue account so a rated line flows straight into the existing invoice pipeline.

upTo.title: Up To

unitPriceCents.title: Unit Price Cents

Each entry records the prior and new constrained estimate, the constraint reason, the delta, the operator who recorded it, and the GLTransaction posted to recognise additional revenue (delta > 0) or reverse revenue (delta < 0).

proposedOpinion.description: REQ-007 BADO decision tree (NV COS 700-serie). Mirrors BadoControleprotocolCalculator::deriveOpinion — first match wins: pervasive scope limitation → oordeelonthouding; materieel findings across the majority of topics → afkeurend; any materieel finding → met-beperking; otherwise → goedkeurend. The conditional cross-topic aggregation is not yet expressible declaratively, so the calculator is the engine-side fallback (ADR-031).

vpbBalansFiltered.description: Vpb-balans per ondernemingsactiviteit per REQ-VPB-003: filters GLLine on (accountNumber IN VpbBalansLink.accountNumbers AND periodId IN fiscalYearPeriods) and groups per costCenterId, producing Activa/Passiva/Resultaat per ondernemingsactiviteit. Output dataset name VpbBalansFiltered with schema.org type schema:Dataset. Per ADR-031, no PHP Vpb-balans service — operators consume the aggregation directly. The T1 REQ-GL-005 balance invariant is honoured per cost-center (Task 8): a cost-center where activaTotal + passivaTotal != 0 surfaces an `unbalancedOndernemingsactiviteit` warning.

activaTotal.expression: case when Account.accountType = 'asset' then GLLine.debit - GLLine.credit else 0 end

passivaTotal.expression: case when Account.accountType = 'liability' or Account.accountType = 'equity' then GLLine.credit - GLLine.debit else 0 end

resultaatTotal.expression: case when Account.accountType = 'revenue' then GLLine.credit - GLLine.debit when Account.accountType = 'expense' then -(GLLine.debit - GLLine.credit) else 0 end

balansSluit.description: T1 REQ-GL-005 balance invariant per cost-center; false surfaces `unbalancedOndernemingsactiviteit` warning.

unbalancedOndernemingsactiviteit.message: Vpb-balans per ondernemingsactiviteit is niet in balans (T1 REQ-GL-005). Activa - Passiva - Resultaat != 0; controleer GL-postings voor cost-center {{costCenterId}}.

orphanedVpbPligtigAccounts.description: Task 11 invariant warning: lists Account records with `vpbPligtig: true` that are NOT referenced by ANY VpbBalansLink.accountNumbers. Orphans signal a configuration gap — postings against an orphan account never appear in any ondernemingsactiviteit's Vpb-balans. Surfaced in the Vpb menu detail view (REQ-VPB-005).

WbsoBeschikking.title: WBSO Beschikking
WbsoBeschikking.description: RVO grant decision (beschikking) awarding S&O (Speur- en Ontwikkelingswerk) hours for a WBSO project (REQ-WBSO-001). Records the granted ceiling of S&O hours and the hourly rate against which the realisatie (SoUurregistratie) and the closing WbsoMededeling are validated. The granted hours form the immutable ceiling that the mededeling realisatie may never exceed (REQ-WBSO-005).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Beschikking changes (rate corrections, granted-hour adjustments, state flips) MUST be audit-trail-immutable per ADR-022 — the granted ceiling governs every downstream realisatie and the closing mededeling.

WbsoMededeling.title: WBSO Mededeling
WbsoMededeling.description: WBSO realisatie mededeling reporting the realised S&O hours for a beschikking period to RVO (REQ-WBSO-003). The realised hours may never exceed the beschikking's granted ceiling — the submit and resubmit transitions are guarded by WbsoMededeligGuard::canSubmit which enforces this ceiling (REQ-WBSO-005).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Mededeling submissions MUST be audit-trail-immutable per ADR-022 — the mededeling is the statutory realisatie report filed with RVO.

XbrlInstance.title: XBRL Instance
XbrlInstance.description: An NL-taxonomie XBRL instance document derived from a posted T3 FinancialStatement (REQ-SBR-001/002). One record per filing event per administration + reporting period + entry point. Carries the canonicalised XML payload, its SHA-256 tamper-evidence hash, the resolved Mapping FK (REQ-SBR-006), the Digipoort acknowledgement receipt id when submitted (REQ-SBR-004), and the declarative draft → validated → submitted → accepted/rejected lifecycle (REQ-SBR-003 / ADR-031). No re-aggregation of ledger lines; the instance is a pure transformation on top of FinancialStatement (D1 in design.md).

isStarter.description: True when the ZZP-er is in their first 5 years of self-employment and may claim startersaftrek.
isStarter.title: Is Starter

startersClaimsThisRegime.description: Number of startersaftrek claims made within the 5-year starter window (max 3 per Wet IB 2001 art. 3.77). Lifecycle gates startersaftrek to <= 3 claims per REQ-ZZP-006.
startersClaimsThisRegime.title: Starters Claims This Regime

taxableProfit.description: Taxable profit for taxYear derived via x-openregister-aggregations from GL. REQ-ZZP-006.
taxableProfit.title: Taxable Profit

selfEmployedDeductionAmount.description: Zelfstandigenaftrek deduction amount. Derived from seeded deduction-amounts + qualifiesForUrencriterium per Wet IB 2001 art. 3.76. REQ-ZZP-005.
selfEmployedDeductionAmount.title: Self-Employed Deduction Amount

starterDeductionAmount.description: Startersaftrek amount. Zero when isStarter false OR startersClaimsThisRegime >= 3. Wet IB 2001 art. 3.77. REQ-ZZP-005.
starterDeductionAmount.title: Starter Deduction Amount

mkbProfitExemptionPercentage.description: MKB-winstvrijstelling percentage from seeded deduction-amounts (e.g. 0.127 = 12.7%). Wet IB 2001 art. 3.79a. REQ-ZZP-005.
mkbProfitExemptionPercentage.title: SME Profit Exemption Percentage

mkbProfitExemptionAmount.description: Derived: (taxableProfit - zelfstandigenaftrekAmount - startersaftrekAmount) x mkbWinstvrijstellingPercentage. Wet IB 2001 art. 3.79a. REQ-ZZP-005.
mkbProfitExemptionAmount.title: SME Profit Exemption Amount

totalDeduction.description: Sum of zelfstandigenaftrekAmount + startersaftrekAmount + mkbWinstvrijstellingAmount. REQ-ZZP-005.
totalDeduction.title: Total Deduction

ZzpDeduction.title: ZZP-aftrek
ZzpDeduction.description: ZZP tax deduction eligibility per freelancer per year (REQ-ZZP-004). Derives ytdQualifyingHours from UrenRegistratie (REQ-ZZP-003) and computes zelfstandigenaftrek + startersaftrek + MKB-winstvrijstelling from the zzp-deduction-amounts seed (REQ-ZZP-006).

ytdQualifyingHours.description: Sum of UrenRegistratie.hours where category != excluded for the year, per personId (REQ-ZZP-003). ADR-031 exception: if OR cannot span fiscal periods, OCA\Shillinq\Guard\UrencriteriumGuard::currentYtdHours provides the fallback.
ytdQualifyingHours.expr: sum(UrenRegistratie.hours where category != 'excluded' and personId == @self.personId and year(workDate) == @self.year)

ytdQualifyingHours.description: YTD sum of UrenRegistratie.hours for the same (administrationId, personId) within taxYear where category is one of the qualifying categories. Cross-object SUM relocated from x-openregister-calculations per ADR-031 (the per-object evaluator cannot fold over other objects). REQ-ZZP-003. ADR-031 exception path: if the OR aggregation engine cannot express the period filter, OCA\Shillinq\Guard\UrencriteriumGuard::currentYtdHours applies.

taxableProfit.description: GL-derived self-employment income for taxYear: sum of GLLine.amount over the self-employment-income tax category. Cross-object SUM relocated from x-openregister-calculations per ADR-031 (the per-object evaluator cannot fold over other objects).

retention.description: Financial records retained 7 years per AWR art. 52 (REQ-ZZP-009).

onCriteriumMet.description: Notify zzp-administrator when 1225-urencriterium is met. REQ-ZZP-004.
onCriteriumMet.title: Urencriterium gehaald
onCriteriumMet.message: Het urencriterium voor {{taxYear}} is gehaald ({{ytdQualifyingHours}} uren). Zelfstandigenaftrek is van toepassing.

onCriteriumAtRisk._note: Kept as an app event rather than converted to {type: scheduled}. The condition is 'PROJECTED end-of-year qualifying hours < 1225' — a projection over ytdQualifyingHours and the remaining year, not a stored field, and the scheduled filter grammar has no numeric comparison. shillinq must compute the projection and raise this event; a monthly scheduled trigger could pick the cadence but not the test.
onCriteriumAtRisk.description: Monthly projection: warn zzp-administrator when projected EOY qualifying hours < 1225. REQ-ZZP-004.
onCriteriumAtRisk.title: Dreigend onderschrijden urencriterium
onCriteriumAtRisk.message: Projectie einde jaar: {{projected}} uur (< 1225). Dreigend onderschrijden urencriterium {{taxYear}}.

urencriteriumTracker.title: Urencriterium
urencriteriumTracker.description: YTD qualifying hours progress toward the 1225-urencriterium (or 800 for starters-opvolgers), green/yellow/red bands. Threshold from urencriterium-thresholds.json per REQ-ZZP-004.

ZzpDeductionAmounts.title: ZZP Deduction Amounts
ZzpDeductionAmounts.description: Master data table of statutory ZZP (zelfstandige) deduction amounts per tax year per Wet IB 2001: zelfstandigenaftrek (art. 3.76), startersaftrek (art. 3.77), and the mkb-winstvrijstelling percentage (art. 3.79a). One row per taxYear; ZzpDeduction.{zelfstandigenaftrekAmount,startersaftrekAmount,mkbWinstvrijstellingPercentage} are looked up from this table via the `deduction` @ref reference and locked into the snapshot at save time.

taxYear.description: Tax year these statutory amounts apply to (e.g. 2026).
taxYear.title: Tax Year

selfEmployedDeduction.description: Zelfstandigenaftrek amount in EUR for this tax year (Wet IB 2001 art. 3.76).
selfEmployedDeduction.title: Self-Employed Deduction

starterDeduction.description: Startersaftrek amount in EUR for this tax year (Wet IB 2001 art. 3.77).
starterDeduction.title: Starter Deduction

mkbProfitExemptionPercentage.description: MKB-winstvrijstelling percentage for this tax year as a fraction (e.g. 0.1231 = 12.31%) per Wet IB 2001 art. 3.79a.
mkbProfitExemptionPercentage.title: SME Profit Exemption Percentage

source.description: Regulatory source for these amounts (e.g. 'Belastingdienst — cijfers 2026').
source.title: Source

bookkeeper.description: Bookkeepers maintain ZZP deduction master data per tax year.

employee.description: Read-only: ZZP'ers may view applicable deduction amounts.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a ZZP Deduction Amounts is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

title.title: Title

kernGegevensConfig.title: Core Data Configuration
kernGegevensConfig.description: Administration-level configuration record holding the denominators required for the CBS Kerngegevens jaarstaten computation per REQ-CBSE-003. Operators set these values yearly; the aggregation surfaces a 'denominator last updated' warning when any value is >12 months old.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration (gemeente/provincie/waterschap) that this config belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

fiscalYearId.description: FK to the FiscalYear for which these denominators apply.
fiscalYearId.title: Fiscal Year ID

residentCount.description: Number of inhabitants per CBS Kerngegevens denominator. Used to compute lasten per inwoner, baten per inwoner, etc.
residentCount.title: Resident Count

area.description: Total surface area of the administration in km². Used for oppervlak-based denominators.
area.title: Area

weightedArea.description: Weighted surface area in km² (land + water weighted factor). Used for gewogen-oppervlak denominators.
weightedArea.title: Weighted Area

boardSize.description: Number of elected council seats (raadsleden / statenleden). Used for bestuursomvang-based ratios.
boardSize.title: Governing Board Size

civilServantsCount.description: FTE count of civil servants. Used for personeelslasten per fte denominator.
civilServantsCount.title: Number of Civil Servants

lastUpdatedAt.description: Date the operator last updated these denominators. Aggregation surfaces a warning when >12 months old per REQ-CBSE-003.
lastUpdatedAt.title: Last Updated At

denominatorStaleWarning.description: Derived (do not set directly): true when denominators have not been updated in the past 12 months. Materialised via x-openregister-calculations.
denominatorStaleWarning.title: Denominator Stale Warning

denominatorStaleWarning.description: True when denominators have not been updated in the past 12 months. JSON-AST: if(lastUpdatedAt != null, diffDays(now(), lastUpdatedAt) > 365, true). REQ-CBSE-003.

kerngegevensRatios.description: Kerngegevens jaarstaten aggregation consuming the closed fiscal-year jaarrekening and the administration-level kernGegevensConfig denominators per REQ-CBSE-003. Produces lasten per inwoner, baten per inwoner. Annual cadence; XML output; openconnector source: cbs-kerngegevens.

totalLasten.description: Total lasten (expenditure) for the fiscal year.

totalBaten.description: Total baten (revenue) for the fiscal year.

lastenPerInwoner.description: Lasten per inwoner ratio in EUR.

batenPerInwoner.description: Baten per inwoner ratio in EUR.

quarterly-cbs-iv3-detail-submission.name: Quarterly CBS Iv3-detail submission
quarterly-cbs-iv3-detail-submission.description: Generates and submits the Iv3-detail bestand for all closed administrations on a quarterly schedule per REQ-CBSE-002. Triggers the iv3DetailByTaakveldCategorie aggregation on GLLine, renders via docudesk template iv3-detail-2026.csv, and submits via openconnector source cbs-iv3-detail.

quarterly-cbs-iv3-ozb-submission.name: Quarterly CBS Iv3-OZB submission
quarterly-cbs-iv3-ozb-submission.description: Generates and submits the Iv3-OZB bestand for all closed administrations on a periodic schedule per REQ-CBSE-004. Triggers the iv3OzbByCategorieHeffing aggregation on GLLine, renders via docudesk template iv3-ozb-2026.csv, and submits via openconnector source cbs-iv3-ozb.

annual-cbs-kerngegevens-submission.name: Annual CBS Kerngegevens jaarstaten submission
annual-cbs-kerngegevens-submission.description: Generates and submits the Kerngegevens jaarstaten bestand annually after jaarrekening-close per REQ-CBSE-003. Triggers the kerngegevensRatios aggregation, renders via docudesk template kerngegevens-2026.xml, and submits via openconnector source cbs-kerngegevens.

trigger.description: Annual trigger fires on jaarrekening-close lifecycle event from T3 bookkeeping-financial-statements per design D5.

annual-cbs-emu-bestand-submission.name: Annual CBS EMU-bestand submission
annual-cbs-emu-bestand-submission.description: Generates and submits the EMU-bestand annually and quarterly per REQ-CBSE-005. Consumes the emuBestandSaldo aggregation on Iv3Export, renders via docudesk template emu-bestand-2026.xml, and submits via openconnector source cbs-emu-bestand.

trigger.description: Annual trigger fires on jaarrekening-close lifecycle event from T3. Quarterly runs are also triggered by the base IV3 quarterly workflow.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Core Data Configuration is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).
